# Base44 Project

Use this repository to run and edit the app locally, then publish changes back through Base44.

Any change pushed to the repo will also be reflected in the Base44 Builder.

## Prerequisites

1. Clone the repository using the project's Git URL.
2. Navigate to the project directory.
3. Install dependencies: `npm install`.
4. Install the Base44 CLI: `npm install -g base44@latest`.

See the [Base44 CLI docs](https://docs.base44.com/developers/references/cli/get-started/overview) if you want to run Base44 commands directly.

## Run Locally

Run the full local development environment from the project root:

```bash
base44 dev
```

`base44 dev` starts the local Base44 development backend and, when this app is configured for it, also starts the frontend dev server for you. Use the frontend URL printed by the command.

For example, when the Base44 project config includes a `serveCommand`, `base44 dev` can launch the frontend too:

```json5
{
  "site": {
    "serveCommand": "npm run dev"
  }
}
```

In a Base44 project this lives in `base44/config.jsonc`.

## Run Only The Frontend

If you only want to work on the frontend against the hosted Base44 backend, run:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Open the local URL printed by Vite.

## Use The Hosted Backend

For frontend-only development, create or update `.env.local` in the project root:

```bash
VITE_BASE44_APP_ID=your_app_id
VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL=https://your-app.base44.app
```

`VITE_BASE44_APP_ID` identifies the Base44 app.

`VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL` tells the Base44 Vite plugin where to send local `/api` requests. Point it at your deployed Base44 app URL when you want the local frontend to use the hosted backend.

When you use `base44 dev`, the command injects the local Base44 values for you, so `.env.local` is mainly needed for frontend-only workflows.

## Publish Your Changes

After pushing your changes to git, open the Base44 dashboard and publish the app:

```bash
base44 dashboard open
```

## Docs & Support

Documentation: [https://docs.base44.com/Integrations/Using-GitHub](https://docs.base44.com/Integrations/Using-GitHub)

Base44 CLI command reference: [https://docs.base44.com/developers/references/cli/commands/introduction](https://docs.base44.com/developers/references/cli/commands/introduction)

Support: [https://app.base44.com/support](https://app.base44.com/support)

# AGENTS.md

## Project Context

This is a Base44 app repository. Treat it as user-owned application code, keep changes focused on the user's request, and preserve existing project conventions.

Start with `README.md` for local setup, environment variables, and publish workflow.

## Base44 References

- CLI overview: https://docs.base44.com/developers/references/cli/get-started/overview.md
- Agent skills: https://docs.base44.com/developers/backend/overview/skills.md

If your agent supports Agent Skills, install or update Base44 skills before Base44-specific work:

```bash
npx skills add base44/skills
```

## Key Files

- `src/`: frontend application source.
- `src/api/base44Client.js`: frontend Base44 SDK client.
- `vite.config.js`: Vite config and Base44 Vite plugin setup.
- `.env.local`: local-only environment values; never commit secrets.

## Working Notes

- Use `base44 dev` as the default local development command when you need the local Base44 backend. It can run the backend and frontend together.
- When docs or code mention the frontend being started automatically, that usually means the Base44 project config includes `site.serveCommand`, for example `"serveCommand": "npm run dev"` in `base44/config.jsonc`.
- Use `npm run dev` only for frontend-only work against the hosted Base44 backend.
- Prefer the existing Base44 CLI workflow over adding new npm scripts for Base44-specific tasks.
- Reuse the existing SDK client and Vite plugin patterns before adding new Base44 integration paths.
- Run the relevant checks from `package.json` before finishing code changes.

FILE: public/sw.js
========================================
// Service worker for Splitter Orbs — fast-startup caching.
// Bump CACHE_VERSION below together with APP_VERSION in src/lib/appVersion.js
// so that an update purges every cache from prior versions on activate.
const CACHE_VERSION = "1.0.0";
const CACHE_NAME = `splitter-orbs-v${CACHE_VERSION}`;
const PRECACHE_URLS = ["/", "/index.html", "/manifest.json"];

self.addEventListener("install", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.open(CACHE_NAME)
      .then((cache) => cache.addAll(PRECACHE_URLS))
      .then(() => self.skipWaiting())
  );
});

self.addEventListener("activate", (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    caches.keys()
      .then((keys) => Promise.all(
        keys.filter((k) => k !== CACHE_NAME).map((k) => caches.delete(k))
      ))
      .then(() => self.clients.claim())
  );
});

self.addEventListener("fetch", (event) => {
  const req = event.request;
  if (req.method !== "GET") return;

  // Navigation requests: network-first so updates apply immediately,
  // falling back to the cached app shell when offline.
  if (req.mode === "navigate") {
    event.respondWith(
      fetch(req)
        .then((res) => {
          const copy = res.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((c) => c.put(req, copy)).catch(() => {});
          return res;
        })
        .catch(() => caches.match(req).then((r) => r || caches.match("/index.html")))
    );
    return;
  }

  // Static assets (hashed JS/CSS, fonts, images): cache-first, then cache the response.
  const dest = req.destination;
  if (
    new URL(req.url).origin === self.location.origin ||
    dest === "font" || dest === "image" || dest === "style" || dest === "script"
  ) {
    event.respondWith(
      caches.match(req).then((cached) => cached || fetch(req).then((res) => {
        if (res && res.status === 200 && (res.type === "basic" || res.type === "cors")) {
          const copy = res.clone();
          caches.open(CACHE_NAME).then((c) => c.put(req, copy)).catch(() => {});
        }
        return res;
      }).catch(() => cached))
    );
  }
});

// Shared HMAC signing/verification and device-fingerprint comparison
// for secure anonymous profile snapshots.

const SIGNALS = [
  'screenWidth',
  'screenHeight',
  'colorDepth',
  'hardwareConcurrency',
  'maxTouchPoints',
  'timezone',
  'canvasHash',
];

// Sign a payload object with HMAC-SHA256 and return a JSON string blob.
export async function signBlob(payload, secret) {
  const data = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const enc = new TextEncoder();
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', enc.encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']
  );
  const sig = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, enc.encode(data));
  const sigHex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(sig))
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('');
  return JSON.stringify({ payload, signature: sigHex });
}

// Verify the HMAC signature and return the payload, or null if tampered/invalid.
export async function verifyAndUnpackBlob(blob, secret) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(blob);
    const { payload, signature } = parsed;
    if (!payload || !signature) return null;
    const data = JSON.stringify(payload);
    const enc = new TextEncoder();
    const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
      'raw', enc.encode(secret), { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['verify']
    );
    const sigBytes = new Uint8Array(
      signature.match(/.{2}/g).map((h) => parseInt(h, 16))
    );
    const valid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, sigBytes, enc.encode(data));
    return valid ? payload : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// Compare two fingerprint objects; returns true if >= threshold fraction of signals match.
export function compareFingerprints(stored, fresh, threshold = 0.7) {
  if (!stored || !fresh) return false;
  let matches = 0;
  for (const key of SIGNALS) {
    if (stored[key] !== undefined && fresh[key] !== undefined) {
      if (String(stored[key]) === String(fresh[key])) matches++;
    }
  }
  return matches / SIGNALS.length >= threshold;
}

// Generate a random nonce for one-time-use enforcement.
export function generateNonce() {
  if (crypto.randomUUID) return crypto.randomUUID();
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
}

// Server-side game logic shared across backend functions.
// This is the authoritative source for all gameplay-affecting computations.
// The frontend has its own copies in src/game/ for display/preview only.

// ---- Leagues ----
export const LEAGUES = [
  { id: 0, name: "Beginner", min: 0, color: "#94a3b8" },
  { id: 1, name: "Rookie", min: 100, color: "#84cc16" },
  { id: 2, name: "Cadet", min: 300, color: "#22d3ee" },
  { id: 3, name: "Veteran", min: 600, color: "#3b82f6" },
  { id: 4, name: "Champion", min: 1000, color: "#8b5cf6" },
  { id: 5, name: "Master", min: 1500, color: "#f43f5e" },
  { id: 6, name: "Legend", min: 2000, color: "#fbbf24" },
];

export function getLeague(trophies) {
  let league = LEAGUES[0];
  for (const l of LEAGUES) {
    if ((trophies || 0) >= l.min) league = l;
  }
  return league;
}

function getLeagueId(trophies) {
  let id = 0;
  for (const l of LEAGUES) {
    if ((trophies || 0) >= l.min) id = l.id;
  }
  return id;
}

export const LEAGUE_SKILL = [0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, 0.78, 0.9, 0.95];
export function getLeagueExpectedSkill(trophies) {
  return LEAGUE_SKILL[getLeagueId(trophies)] || 0.5;
}

// ---- Trophy / Elo ----
export const TROPHY_BASE = 30;
export function computeTrophyChange(myTrophies, oppTrophies, won) {
  const diff = oppTrophies - myTrophies;
  const expected = 1 / (1 + Math.pow(10, diff / 400));
  const score = won ? 1 : 0;
  const change = Math.round(TROPHY_BASE * (score - expected));
  if (won) return Math.max(change, 8);
  return Math.min(change, -6);
}

// ---- Match rewards ----
export const MATCH_REWARD_WIN = 50;
export const MATCH_REWARD_LOSS = 20;
export const SHARD_PER_WIN = 1;
export const SHARD_PER_LOSS = 0;
export const SHARD_RANKED_STREAK_BONUS = 1;

// ---- AI opponents ----
export const AI_OPPONENTS = [
  { name: "Rookie Bot", trophies: 0, skill: 0.35 },
  { name: "Cadet Bot", trophies: 150, skill: 0.5 },
  { name: "Veteran Bot", trophies: 400, skill: 0.65 },
  { name: "Elite Bot", trophies: 800, skill: 0.8 },
  { name: "Master Bot", trophies: 1400, skill: 0.92 },
];

// Pick an AI opponent matched to the player's league skill.
export function pickAiOpponent(trophies) {
  const expectedSkill = getLeagueExpectedSkill(trophies || 0);
  let best = AI_OPPONENTS[0], bestDiff = Infinity;
  for (const bot of AI_OPPONENTS) {
    const d = Math.abs(bot.skill - expectedSkill);
    if (d < bestDiff) { bestDiff = d; best = bot; }
  }
  return best;
}

  return level === 1 ? 2 : Math.min(BUY_CAP, needed);
}
export function copiesNeeded(level) { return CARD_COPIES_NEEDED[level] || 0; }

// ---- Helpers ----
export function getCardRarity(kind, id) {
  const table = kind === "tower" ? TOWER_TYPES : kind === "ability" ? ABILITIES : ORB_TYPES;
  return table[id]?.rarity || "common";
}

export function getCardLevel(me, kind, id) {
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? me?.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? me?.ability_cards : me?.orb_cards;
  return cards?.[id]?.level || 0;
}

export function normalizeProfile(me) {
  if (!me) me = {};
  let migratedShards = 0;
  const migrateCards = (cards) => {
    if (!cards || typeof cards !== "object") return {};
    const out = {};
    for (const [id, c] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      const level = c?.level || 0;
      const copies = c?.copies || 0;
      if (c?.boughtCopies === undefined) {
        const needed = level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? (CARD_COPIES_NEEDED[level] || 0) : 0;
        const overflow = Math.max(0, copies - needed);
        out[id] = { level, copies: copies - overflow, boughtCopies: 0 };
        migratedShards += overflow * SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW;
      } else {
        out[id] = { level, copies, boughtCopies: c.boughtCopies || 0 };
      }
    }
    return out;
  };
  const towerCards = migrateCards(me.tower_cards);
  const abilityCards = migrateCards(me.ability_cards);
  const orbCards = migrateCards(me.orb_cards);

  for (const id of (me.unlocked_towers || [])) {
    if (!towerCards[id] || towerCards[id].level === 0) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of (me.unlocked_abilities || [])) {
    if (!abilityCards[id] || abilityCards[id].level === 0) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_TOWERS) {
    if (!towerCards[id]) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_ABILITIES) {
    if (!abilityCards[id]) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_ORBS) {
    if (!orbCards[id] || orbCards[id].level === 0) orbCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of SENDABLE_ORBS) {
    if (!orbCards[id]) orbCards[id] = { level: 0, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }

  const owned_skins = Array.isArray(me.owned_skins)
    ? me.owned_skins.filter((id) => !REMOVED_SKINS.includes(id))
    : [];

  return {
    ...me,
    tower_cards: towerCards, ability_cards: abilityCards, orb_cards: orbCards,
    shards: (me.shards || 0) + migratedShards,
    owned_skins,
  };
}

export function getCardInfo(me, kind, id) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
  const card = cards[id] || { level: 0, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  const level = card.level || 0;
  const copies = card.copies || 0;
  const boughtCopies = card.boughtCopies || 0;
  const needed = level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? copiesNeeded(level) : 0;
  const rarity = getCardRarity(kind, id);
  const copyShardCost = COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY[rarity] || COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY.common;
  const buyable = level >= 1 && level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? buyableCopies(level, needed) : 0;
  return { level, copies, needed, buyableCopies: buyable, boughtCopies, copyShardCost, rarity, maxed: level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL, locked: level === 0 };
}

// ---- Milestone unlocks ----
export function checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, orbCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [orbId, threshold] of Object.entries(ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!orbCards[orbId] || orbCards[orbId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(orbId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

export function checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, towerCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [towerId, threshold] of Object.entries(TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!towerCards[towerId] || towerCards[towerId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(towerId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

export function checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, abilityCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [abilityId, threshold] of Object.entries(ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!abilityCards[abilityId] || abilityCards[abilityId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(abilityId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

  { id: "card_master", icon: "⭐", reward: { coins: 1000, shards: 50 }, check: (p) => {
    const all = [...Object.values(p.tower_cards || {}), ...Object.values(p.ability_cards || {}), ...Object.values(p.orb_cards || {})];
    return all.some((c) => (c?.level || 0) >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL);
  }},
  { id: "matches_25", icon: "🎮", reward: { coins: 100, shards: 3 }, check: (p) => ((p.wins || 0) + (p.losses || 0)) >= 25 },
];

export function evaluateAchievements(profile, matchResult) {
  const unlocked = profile.achievements || [];
  const newlyUnlocked = [];
  for (const ach of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (unlocked.includes(ach.id)) continue;
    try {
      if (ach.check(profile, matchResult)) newlyUnlocked.push(ach);
    } catch (e) { /* skip */ }
  }
  return newlyUnlocked;
}

// ---- Daily missions ----
const DAILY_MISSION_TEMPLATES = [
  { id: "win2", goal: 2, reward: 100 },
  { id: "play3", goal: 3, reward: 50 },
  { id: "ranked1", goal: 1, reward: 75 },
];

function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export function getDailyMissions(me) {
  const dm = me?.daily_missions || {};
  if (dm.date !== todayStr() || !Array.isArray(dm.tasks) || dm.tasks.length === 0) {
    return DAILY_MISSION_TEMPLATES.map((t) => ({ ...t, progress: 0, completed: false }));
  }
  return dm.tasks;
}

export function updateDailyMissions(me, { won, mode }) {
  const tasks = getDailyMissions(me).map((t) => ({ ...t }));
  let bonusCoins = 0;
  for (const t of tasks) {
    if (t.completed) continue;
    let inc = 0;
    if (t.id === "play3") inc = 1;
    else if (t.id === "win2" && won) inc = 1;
    else if (t.id === "ranked1" && won && mode === "ranked") inc = 1;
    if (inc > 0) {
      t.progress = Math.min(t.goal, t.progress + inc);
      if (t.progress >= t.goal && !t.completed) {
        t.completed = true;
        bonusCoins += t.reward;
      }
    }
  }
  return { daily_missions: { date: todayStr(), tasks }, bonusCoins };
}

// ---- Crate reward rolling (server-side) ----
function chestSkinPool(maxRarityOrder) {
  const pool = [];
  for (const [catId, cat] of Object.entries(SKIN_CATALOGS)) {
    for (const skin of Object.values(cat)) {
      if (skin.source !== "chest") continue;
      if (RARITIES[skin.rarity].order <= maxRarityOrder) pool.push({ ...skin, category: catId });
    }
  }
  return pool;
}

// Combined pool of all rollable cards (towers + abilities + crate orbs) with rarity.
function buildCardPool() {
  const allTowers = Object.values(TOWER_TYPES);
  const allAbilities = Object.values(ABILITIES).filter((a) => !ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[a.id]);
  const crateOrbs = ["sprint", "swarmer", "zap_orb"];
  const allOrbs = crateOrbs.map((id) => ORB_TYPES[id]).filter(Boolean);
  return [
    ...allTowers.map((t) => ({ kind: "tower", def: t, rarity: t.rarity })),
    ...allAbilities.map((a) => ({ kind: "ability", def: a, rarity: a.rarity })),
    ...allOrbs.map((o) => ({ kind: "orb", def: o, rarity: o.rarity })),
  ];
}

// Weighted-per-tier: pick a rarity tier with common-heavy weights, then a
// uniformly random card of that tier. Base weights by order: common 64, rare 26,
// epic 7, legendary 2, mythical 0.5. Higher chests (maxRarity >= 2) boost the
// non-common tiers so rare-and-up drops more often; Common stays the most likely
// single tier in every chest.
const TIER_WEIGHTS = [64, 26, 7, 2, 0.5];
function pickEqualPerTier(pool, maxRarityOrder) {
  const tiers = [];
  for (let o = 0; o <= maxRarityOrder; o++) {
    if (pool.some((c) => RARITIES[c.rarity].order === o)) tiers.push(o);
  }
  if (tiers.length === 0) return pool[0];
  // Boost non-common tiers based on the chest's rarity cap.
  const boost = maxRarityOrder <= 1 ? 1 : maxRarityOrder === 2 ? 1.6 : maxRarityOrder === 3 ? 2.4 : 3.2;
  const weights = tiers.map((o) => (o === 0 ? TIER_WEIGHTS[o] : (TIER_WEIGHTS[o] || 0) * boost));
  const total = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let r = Math.random() * total, tier = tiers[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < tiers.length; i++) { r -= weights[i]; if (r <= 0) { tier = tiers[i]; break; } }
  const ofTier = pool.filter((c) => RARITIES[c.rarity].order === tier);
  return ofTier[Math.floor(Math.random() * ofTier.length)];
}

function rollCard(p, crate, bonus, multiCardChance) {
  const pool = buildCardPool();
  const pick = pickEqualPerTier(pool, crate.maxRarity ?? 1);

  let copies = 1;
  if (multiCardChance) {
    const r = Math.random();
    const p3 = multiCardChance[3] || 0;
    const p2 = multiCardChance[2] || 0;
    if (r < p3) copies = 3;
    else if (r < p3 + p2) copies = 2;
  }

  return { type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies, bonus };
}

function rollRareCard(p, crate) {
  const pool = buildCardPool();
  const pick = pickEqualPerTier(pool, crate.maxRarity ?? 2);
  return { type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies: 1, bonus: false };
}

// Guaranteed new (unowned) card from common→epic, equal per tier. Fallback to a
// random epic card with bonus consolation shards when the player owns them all.
function rollNewCard(p, crate) {
  const pool = buildCardPool();
  const cardLevel = (c) => {
    const cards = c.kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : c.kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
    return cards[c.def.id]?.level || 0;
  };
  const unowned = pool.filter((c) => cardLevel(c) === 0 && RARITIES[c.rarity].order <= 2);
  if (unowned.length) {
    const tiers = [...new Set(unowned.map((c) => RARITIES[c.rarity].order))];
    const tier = tiers[Math.floor(Math.random() * tiers.length)];
    const ofTier = unowned.filter((c) => RARITIES[c.rarity].order === tier);
    const pick = ofTier[Math.floor(Math.random() * ofTier.length)];
    return { type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies: 1, bonus: false };
  }
  const epics = pool.filter((c) => RARITIES[c.rarity].order === 2);
  const pick = epics.length ? epics[Math.floor(Math.random() * epics.length)] : pool[0];
  return { type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies: 1, bonus: true, consolationShards: 8 };
}

function rollMultiCardBundle(p, crate) {
  const item = rollCard(p, crate, false, null);
  const p3 = crate.multiCardChance?.[3] || 0.1;
  item.copies = Math.random() < p3 ? 3 : 2;
  return item;
}

function rollSkin(p, crate, bonus) {
  const pool = chestSkinPool(crate.maxRarity ?? 4);
  if (pool.length === 0) return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  const weights = pool.map((s) => 1 / (RARITIES[s.rarity].order + 1));
  const total = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let r = Math.random() * total, pick = pool[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) { r -= weights[i]; if (r <= 0) { pick = pool[i]; break; } }
  const owned = (p.owned_skins || []).includes(pick.id);
  if (owned) {
    const shards = RARITIES[pick.rarity].shardConvert * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
    return { type: "shards", amount: shards, bonus, skinDup: pick.id };
  }
  return { type: "skin", skinId: pick.id, rarity: pick.rarity, category: pick.category, bonus };
}

function rollCoins(crate, bonus) {
  const base = crate.currency === "gems" ? 60 : crate.currency === "coins" ? 40 : 25;
  const amt = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1));
  return { type: "coins", amount: amt, bonus };
}

function rollShards(crate, bonus) {
  const base = crate.currency === "gems" ? 4 : 2;
  const amt = (base + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
  return { type: "shards", amount: amt, bonus };
}

function rollGems(crate, bonus) {
  const base = 2;
  const amt = (base + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
  return { type: "gems", amount: amt, bonus };
}

function rollOneSlot(p, crate) {
  const bonus = Math.random() < (crate.bonusChance || 0);
  if (crate.skinChance > 0 && Math.random() < crate.skinChance) return rollSkin(p, crate, bonus);
  if (Math.random() < crate.cardChance) return rollCard(p, crate, bonus, crate.multiCardChance);
  if ((crate.gemChance || 0) > 0 && Math.random() < crate.gemChance) return rollGems(crate, bonus);
  if (Math.random() < (crate.coinChance || 0)) return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  if ((crate.gemChance || 0) > 0) return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  return rollShards(crate, bonus);
}

export function rollCrateRewards(me, crate) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const items = [];
  const total = crate.itemCount || 1;
  const guaranteed = Math.min(crate.guaranteedCards || 0, total);
  const premium = crate.id === "mythical" || crate.id === "legendary";
  if (crate.guaranteeNewCard) {
    items.push(rollNewCard(p, crate));
    for (let i = 1; i < total; i++) items.push(rollOneSlot(p, crate));
    return items;
  }
  if (premium && guaranteed >= 2) {
    items.push(rollRareCard(p, crate));
    items.push(rollMultiCardBundle(p, crate));
    for (let i = 2; i < guaranteed; i++) items.push(rollCard(p, crate, false, crate.multiCardChance));
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < guaranteed; i++) items.push(rollCard(p, crate, false, crate.multiCardChance));
  }
  for (let i = guaranteed; i < total; i++) items.push(rollOneSlot(p, crate));
  return items;
}

// Apply crate rewards to a profile object; returns { profile, perItem }.
export function applyCrateRewards(me, items) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const owned = new Set(p.owned_skins || []);
  const perItem = items.map((item) => {
    const info = { ...item, newUnlock: false, levelUp: null, skinNew: false, skinDup: !!item.skinDup };
    if (item.type === "coins") p.coins = Math.min(COIN_CAP, (p.coins || 0) + item.amount);
    else if (item.type === "gems") p.gems = (p.gems || 0) + item.amount;
    else if (item.type === "shards") p.shards = (p.shards || 0) + item.amount;
    else if (item.type === "skin") {
      if (owned.has(item.skinId)) { info.skinDup = true; }
      else { owned.add(item.skinId); info.skinNew = true; }
    } else if (item.type === "card") {
      const copies = item.copies || 1;
      const cards = item.cardKind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : item.cardKind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
      const card = cards[item.id];
      const fromLevel = card?.level || 0;
      if (!card || card.level === 0) {
        cards[item.id] = { level: 1, copies: Math.max(0, copies - 1), boughtCopies: 0 };
        info.newUnlock = true;
        info.levelUp = { fromLevel: 0, toLevel: 1, copies: Math.max(0, copies - 1), needed: copiesNeeded(1), duplicate: false, overflow: 0, shardsGained: 0 };
      } else if (card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL) {
        const shardsGained = SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW * copies;
        p.shards = (p.shards || 0) + shardsGained;
        info.levelUp = { fromLevel, toLevel: fromLevel, copies: card.copies, needed: 0, duplicate: true, overflow: copies, shardsGained };
      } else {
        const newCopies = card.copies + copies;
        const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
        cards[item.id] = { level: card.level, copies: newCopies, boughtCopies: card.boughtCopies || 0 };
        info.levelUp = { fromLevel, toLevel: fromLevel, copies: newCopies, needed, duplicate: true, overflow: 0, shardsGained: 0 };
      }
      if (item.consolationShards) p.shards = (p.shards || 0) + item.consolationShards;
    }
    return info;
  });
  p.owned_skins = Array.from(owned);
  return { profile: p, perItem };
}

export const CLIENT_WRITABLE_FIELDS = [
  "sound_enabled", "sound_categories", "haptics_enabled", "haptics_intensity",
  "advanced_haptics_enabled", "tower_menu_anytime", "language",
];

// Shared security helpers for all backend functions.
// Provides EULA enforcement, per-user rate limiting, and optimistic concurrency.

export const CURRENT_EULA_VERSION = "1.1";

// Rate limit categories: max calls per 60s window.
export const RATE_LIMITS = {
  economy: 10,
  card_upgrade: 30,
  cosmetic: 30,
  social: 20,
  finalize: 2,
  matchmaking: 5,
};

const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60_000;

// AI match verification constants
export const AI_MIN_MATCH_DURATION = 60; // seconds — casual/ranked AI matches must last at least this long
export const AI_DAILY_WIN_CAP = 100; // max AI wins per day to prevent bot farming

// Stale 'starting' MatchSession thresholds
export const STALE_STARTING_MS = 75 * 1000;  // inline guard: ignore 'starting' sessions older than this (matchmake + getActiveSession)
export const STALE_CLEANUP_MS = 120 * 1000; // cleanup workflow: finish 'starting' sessions older than this

export function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// ---- EULA gate ----
// Returns an error Response (403) if the user hasn't accepted the current EULA,
// or null if they're cleared. Call this at the top of every gameplay-affecting function.
export function checkEula(user) {
  if ((user.eula_accepted_version || "") !== CURRENT_EULA_VERSION) {
    return Response.json(
      { error: "eula_required", currentVersion: CURRENT_EULA_VERSION },
      { status: 403 }
    );
  }
  return null;
}

// ---- Rate limiting ----
// Pure function — checks the rate limit from the user object already loaded.
// Returns { exceeded: boolean, newRateLimits: object|null }.
// If not exceeded, merge newRateLimits into your final update patch (no extra DB write).
// If exceeded, return 429 immediately.
export function checkRateLimit(user, category) {
  const limit = RATE_LIMITS[category];
  if (!limit) return { exceeded: false, newRateLimits: null };

  const now = Date.now();
  const rl = user.rate_limits || {};
  const entry = rl[category] || { count: 0, windowStart: 0 };

  // New window
  if (now - (entry.windowStart || 0) > RATE_WINDOW_MS) {
    return {
      exceeded: false,
      newRateLimits: { ...rl, [category]: { count: 1, windowStart: now } },
    };
  }

  // Over limit
  if ((entry.count || 0) >= limit) {
    return { exceeded: true, newRateLimits: null };
  }

  // Increment within window
  return {
    exceeded: false,
    newRateLimits: {
      ...rl,
      [category]: { count: (entry.count || 0) + 1, windowStart: entry.windowStart },
    },
  };
}

// Convenience: returns a 429 Response for rate limit exceeded.
export function rateLimitResponse() {
  return Response.json({ error: "rate_limit_exceeded" }, { status: 429 });
}

// ---- Optimistic concurrency ----
// Reads the user, runs computePatch(user) to validate and build the update,
// then re-reads to check updated_date hasn't changed before writing.
// computePatch should return { patch: {...} } or { error: Response }.
// Returns { error: Response } on failure, or { patch, user } on success.
// Optimistic concurrency with transparent retry on concurrent modification.
// Re-reads the user fresh on each attempt so rapid sequential upgrades don't abort.
const MAX_CONCURRENCY_RETRIES = 3;
export async function secureUpdate(base44, userId, computePatch) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_CONCURRENCY_RETRIES; attempt++) {
    const user = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(userId);
    const version = user.updated_date;

    const result = await computePatch(user);
    if (result.error) return { error: result.error };
    if (result.skip) return { ...result, user };

    // Re-read to verify no concurrent modification
    const recheck = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(userId);
    if (recheck.updated_date !== version) {
      // Retry: re-read fresh user and recompute on next loop iteration
      continue;
    }

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(userId, result.patch);
    return { ...result, user };
  }
  // Exhausted retries — surface the conflict
  return { error: Response.json({ error: "concurrent_modification" }, { status: 409 }) };
}

// ---- Generic optimistic concurrency on any entity ----
// Same read→compute→recheck→write loop as secureUpdate, but for non-User entities
// (e.g. MatchSession). computePatch receives the freshly-read record and returns
// { patch } to apply, { skip } to bail without writing (e.g. already-finished),
// or { error } to abort. On success returns { ...result, record }.
export async function secureEntityUpdate(base44, entityName, recordId, computePatch) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < MAX_CONCURRENCY_RETRIES; attempt++) {
    const record = await base44.asServiceRole.entities[entityName].get(recordId);
    const version = record.updated_date;

    const result = await computePatch(record);
    if (result.error) return { error: result.error };
    if (result.skip) return { ...result, record };

    const recheck = await base44.asServiceRole.entities[entityName].get(recordId);
    if (recheck.updated_date !== version) continue;

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities[entityName].update(recordId, result.patch);
    return { ...result, record };
  }
  return { error: Response.json({ error: "concurrent_modification" }, { status: 409 }) };
}

// ---- AI match daily win cap ----
// Checks and computes the daily AI win counter patch.
// Returns { exceeded: boolean, patch: object }.
// Include patch in your final update to persist the counter.
export function checkAiDailyWinCap(user, won) {
  const today = todayStr();
  const aiWinsDate = user.ai_wins_date || "";
  let aiWinsToday = user.ai_wins_today || 0;

  if (aiWinsDate !== today) {
    aiWinsToday = 0;
  }

  if (won && aiWinsToday >= AI_DAILY_WIN_CAP) {
    return { exceeded: true, patch: null };
  }

  return {
    exceeded: false,
    patch: {
      ai_wins_date: today,
      ai_wins_today: won ? aiWinsToday + 1 : aiWinsToday,
    },
  };
}

// ---- AI match duration verification ----
// Checks that the elapsed time since the recorded match start meets the minimum.
// Returns { valid: boolean, elapsed: number }.
export function verifyAiMatchDuration(user) {
  const startTime = user.ai_match_start_time;
  if (!startTime) return { valid: false, elapsed: 0 };
  const elapsed = (Date.now() - new Date(startTime).getTime()) / 1000;
  return { valid: elapsed >= AI_MIN_MATCH_DURATION, elapsed: Math.floor(elapsed) };
}

// Shared version-gate helpers for backend functions.
// Provides semver comparison, AppConfig fetching (auto-creates defaults),
// and a client-version check that returns a 426 Response when below min.

// Compares semver strings (major.minor.patch). Returns -1 / 0 / 1.
export function compareVersions(a, b) {
  // Strip any '-...' pre-release suffix (e.g. '1.1.0-beta') before numeric
  // compare so suffixes never produce NaN-equal (silent miscomparison) results.
  const seg = (v) => (v || "0.0.0").split(".").map((s) => Number(s.split("-")[0]));
  const pa = seg(a);
  const pb = seg(b);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const av = pa[i] || 0;
    const bv = pb[i] || 0;
    if (av < bv) return -1;
    if (av > bv) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

// Fetches the single AppConfig record. Creates one with defaults if none exists.
// Returns { min_required_version, latest_version }.
export async function getVersionInfo(base44) {
  const configs = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AppConfig.list();
  if (configs.length === 0) {
    const created = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AppConfig.create({
      min_required_version: "1.0.0",
      latest_version: "1.0.0",
    });
    return {
      min_required_version: created.min_required_version,
      latest_version: created.latest_version,
    };
  }
  const c = configs[0];
  return {
    min_required_version: c.min_required_version || "1.0.0",
    latest_version: c.latest_version || "1.0.0",
  };
}

// Returns a 426 Response if clientVersion < minRequired, or null if OK.
// Missing clientVersion is treated as "0.0.0" (always below a real min).
export function checkClientVersion(clientVersion, minRequired) {
  const cv = clientVersion || "0.0.0";
  if (compareVersions(cv, minRequired) < 0) {
    return Response.json(
      { error: "update_required", min_required_version: minRequired },
      { status: 426 }
    );
  }
  return null;
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Marks the tutorial as completed. `tutorial_done` is a backend-only field.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    if (user.tutorial_done) {
      return Response.json({ success: true, already: true });
    }

    await base44.auth.updateMe({ tutorial_done: true });
    return Response.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/matchmake/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, STALE_STARTING_MS } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { getVersionInfo, checkClientVersion } from '../../shared/versionGate.ts';

const LEAGUE_MINS = [0, 100, 300, 600, 1000, 1500, 2000];
function getLeagueId(trophies) {
  let id = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < LEAGUE_MINS.length; i++) if ((trophies || 0) >= LEAGUE_MINS[i]) id = i;
  return id;
}

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // EULA gate
    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    // Rate limit (matchmaking)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'matchmaking');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

    // Version gate — reject outdated clients
    const versionInfo = await getVersionInfo(base44);
    const versionErr = checkClientVersion(body.client_version, versionInfo.min_required_version);
    if (versionErr) return versionErr;

    const mode = body.mode || 'casual';
    const myTrophies = user.trophies || 0;
    const myName = user.display_name || 'Player';
    const myCosmetics = {
      orbPattern: user.equipped_orb_pattern || 'default',
      stationSkin: user.equipped_station_skin || 'default',
      towerSkin: user.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
      leftTowerSkin: user.equipped_left_tower_skin || user.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
      rightTowerSkin: user.equipped_right_tower_skin || user.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
      stationEmblem: user.equipped_station_emblem || 'default',
      leftTowerEmblem: user.equipped_left_tower_emblem || 'default',
      rightTowerEmblem: user.equipped_right_tower_emblem || 'default',
    };

    // 1. Check for an already-matched entry
    const matched = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({
      player_id: user.id, mode, status: 'matched'
    });
    if (matched.length > 0 && matched[0].session_id) {
      const session = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.get(matched[0].session_id);
      if (session) {
        const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;
        return Response.json({
          sessionId: session.id,
          opponentId: amA ? session.player_b_id : session.player_a_id,
          opponent: {
            name: amA ? session.player_b_name : session.player_a_name,
            trophies: amA ? session.player_b_trophies : session.player_a_trophies,
          },
          seed: session.shared_seed,
          role: amA ? 'a' : 'b',
        });
      }
    }

    // 1b. Converge on a session the opponent already created. The lower-id
    // player creates the MatchSession and deletes both queue entries, so the
    // higher-id player won't find a 'matched' entry — look up an active
    // 'starting' session where we're a participant instead.
    const mySessionsA = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_a_id: user.id, status: 'starting'
    });
    const mySessionsB = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_b_id: user.id, status: 'starting'
    });
    const activeSessions = [...mySessionsA, ...mySessionsB];
    // Skip stale 'starting' sessions (opponent never connected) — let the cleanup workflow finish them
    const freshSessions = activeSessions.filter((s) => (Date.now() - new Date(s.created_date).getTime()) < STALE_STARTING_MS);
    if (freshSessions.length > 0) {
      freshSessions.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_date).getTime() - new Date(a.created_date).getTime());
      const session = freshSessions[0];
      const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;
      return Response.json({
        sessionId: session.id,
        opponentId: amA ? session.player_b_id : session.player_a_id,
        opponent: {
          name: amA ? session.player_b_name : session.player_a_name,
          trophies: amA ? session.player_b_trophies : session.player_a_trophies,
        },
        seed: session.shared_seed,
        role: amA ? 'a' : 'b',
      });
    }

    // 2. Find or create my waiting entry
    let waiting = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({
      player_id: user.id, mode, status: 'waiting'
    });
    let myQueue;
    if (waiting.length === 0) {
      myQueue = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.create({
        player_id: user.id, player_name: myName, trophies: myTrophies,
        league: getLeagueId(myTrophies), mode, status: 'waiting',
      });
      // Persist rate limit counter when creating a new queue entry
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });
    } else {
      myQueue = waiting[0];
      const staleElapsed = (Date.now() - new Date(myQueue.created_date).getTime()) / 1000;
      if (staleElapsed > 15) {
        await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(myQueue.id).catch(() => {});
        myQueue = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.create({
          player_id: user.id, player_name: myName, trophies: myTrophies,
          league: getLeagueId(myTrophies), mode, status: 'waiting',
        });
        await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });
      }
    }

    // 3. Find candidates
    const elapsed = (Date.now() - new Date(myQueue.created_date).getTime()) / 1000;
    const band = 50 + Math.floor(elapsed / 5) * 50;
    const candidates = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({
      mode, status: 'waiting'
    });
    let best = null, bestDiff = Infinity;
    for (const c of candidates) {
      if (c.player_id === user.id) continue;
      const diff = Math.abs((c.trophies || 0) - myTrophies);
      if (diff <= band && diff < bestDiff) { bestDiff = diff; best = c; }
    }

    if (!best) {
      return Response.json({ searching: true, searchSeconds: Math.floor(elapsed) });
    }

    // 4. Only the player with the lower id creates the session
    if (user.id < best.player_id) {
      const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647);
      const session = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.create({
        player_a_id: user.id,
        player_b_id: best.player_id,
        player_a_name: myName,
        player_b_name: best.player_name || 'Player',
        player_a_trophies: myTrophies,
        player_b_trophies: best.trophies || 0,
        mode,
        status: 'starting',
        shared_seed: seed,
        events_a: [],
        events_b: [],
        heartbeat_a: 0,
        heartbeat_b: 0,
        hp_a: 120,
        hp_b: 120,
        ready_a: false,
        ready_b: false,
        cosmetics_a: myCosmetics,
        cosmetics_b: {},
        game_time: 0,
      });
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.update(myQueue.id, { status: 'matched', session_id: session.id });
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.update(best.id, { status: 'matched', session_id: session.id });
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(myQueue.id);
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(best.id);
      return Response.json({
        sessionId: session.id,
        opponentId: best.player_id,
        opponent: { name: best.player_name || 'Player', trophies: best.trophies || 0 },
        seed,
        role: 'a',
      });
    }

    return Response.json({ searching: true, searchSeconds: Math.floor(elapsed) });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/getActiveSession/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { STALE_STARTING_MS } from '../../shared/security.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const wantedSessionId = body?.sessionId;

    // If a specific sessionId is requested (private-match join), fetch it directly.
    if (wantedSessionId) {
      const session = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.get(wantedSessionId);
      if (!session || (session.player_a_id !== user.id && session.player_b_id !== user.id)) {
        return Response.json({ active: false });
      }
      const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;
      return Response.json({
        active: true,
        sessionId: session.id,
        opponentId: amA ? session.player_b_id : session.player_a_id,
        opponent: {
          name: amA ? session.player_b_name : session.player_a_name,
          trophies: amA ? session.player_b_trophies : session.player_a_trophies,
        },
        seed: session.shared_seed,
        role: amA ? 'a' : 'b',
        status: session.status,
        gameTime: session.game_time || 0,
        events_a: session.events_a || [],
        events_b: session.events_b || [],
        myHp: amA ? session.hp_a : session.hp_b,
        oppHp: amA ? session.hp_b : session.hp_a,
        oppCosmetics: amA ? (session.cosmetics_b || {}) : (session.cosmetics_a || {}),
      });
    }

    const sessionsA = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_a_id: user.id, status: { $in: ['starting', 'playing', 'paused'] }
    });
    const sessionsB = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_b_id: user.id, status: { $in: ['starting', 'playing', 'paused'] }
    });

    const all = [...sessionsA, ...sessionsB];
    // Skip stale 'starting' sessions (opponent never connected) — only 'playing'/'paused' or fresh 'starting' are rejoinable
    const fresh = all.filter((s) => s.status !== 'starting' || (Date.now() - new Date(s.created_date).getTime()) < STALE_STARTING_MS);
    if (fresh.length === 0) return Response.json({ active: false });

    // Most recent
    fresh.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.created_date).getTime() - new Date(a.created_date).getTime());
    const session = fresh[0];
    const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;

    return Response.json({
      active: true,
      sessionId: session.id,
      opponentId: amA ? session.player_b_id : session.player_a_id,
      opponent: {
        name: amA ? session.player_b_name : session.player_a_name,
        trophies: amA ? session.player_b_trophies : session.player_a_trophies,
      },
      seed: session.shared_seed,
      role: amA ? 'a' : 'b',
      status: session.status,
      gameTime: session.game_time || 0,
      events_a: session.events_a || [],
      events_b: session.events_b || [],
      myHp: amA ? session.hp_a : session.hp_b,
      oppHp: amA ? session.hp_b : session.hp_a,
      oppCosmetics: amA ? (session.cosmetics_b || {}) : (session.cosmetics_a || {}),
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/buyCardCopy/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import {
  normalizeProfile, getCardRarity, copiesNeeded, buyableCopies,
  COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY, MAX_CARD_LEVEL,
} from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const kind = (body?.kind || '').toString();
    const id = (body?.id || '').toString();
    if (!kind || !id) return Response.json({ error: 'kind and id required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!['tower', 'ability', 'orb'].includes(kind)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid kind' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'card_upgrade');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const p = normalizeProfile(u);
      const cards = kind === 'tower' ? p.tower_cards : kind === 'ability' ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
      const card = cards[id];
      if (!card || card.level === 0) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'card not unlocked' }, { status: 400 }) };
      if (card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'card maxed' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
      const buyable = buyableCopies(card.level, needed);
      const bought = card.boughtCopies || 0;
      if (bought >= buyable) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'buy limit reached' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const rarity = getCardRarity(kind, id);
      const cost = COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY[rarity] || COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY.common;
      if ((p.shards || 0) < cost) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough shards' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newShards = (p.shards || 0) - cost;
      const newCards = { ...cards, [id]: { level: card.level, copies: card.copies + 1, boughtCopies: bought + 1 } };
      const cardField = kind === 'tower' ? 'tower_cards' : kind === 'ability' ? 'ability_cards' : 'orb_cards';
      return {
        patch: {
          shards: newShards,
          shards_spent: (u.shards_spent || 0) + cost,
          [cardField]: newCards,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    const cardField = kind === 'tower' ? 'tower_cards' : kind === 'ability' ? 'ability_cards' : 'orb_cards';
    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      shards: result.patch.shards,
      [cardField]: result.patch[cardField],
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/finalizeMatch/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureEntityUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import {
  normalizeProfile, getLeague, computeTrophyChange,
  MATCH_REWARD_WIN, MATCH_REWARD_LOSS, SHARD_PER_WIN, SHARD_RANKED_STREAK_BONUS,
  checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks, checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks, checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks,
  evaluateAchievements, updateDailyMissions,
} from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    // Rate limit (finalize category)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'finalize');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const { sessionId, outcome, gameTime } = body;
    if (!sessionId) return Response.json({ error: 'sessionId required' }, { status: 400 });

    // ---- Atomic session claim ----
    // Only the call that transitions the session from non-'finished' to 'finished'
    // applies rewards to both players. A concurrent second call (e.g. both players
    // tapping finish at the same time) fails the optimistic-concurrency guard,
    // re-reads, sees status === 'finished', and returns the stored result with
    // zero additional rewards — no double trophies/coins/shards.
    const claim = await secureEntityUpdate(base44, 'MatchSession', sessionId, (session) => {
      if (!session) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'Session not found' }, { status: 404 }) };

      if (session.player_a_id !== user.id && session.player_b_id !== user.id) {
        return { error: Response.json({ error: 'Not a participant' }, { status: 403 }) };
      }

      // Idempotent — if already finished, return stored result (no write)
      if (session.status === 'finished') {
        const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;
        return {
          skip: true,
          alreadyFinished: true,
          amA,
          winnerId: session.winner_id,
          myChange: amA ? (session.result_a_change || 0) : (session.result_b_change || 0),
          myNewTrophies: amA ? (session.result_a_trophies || 0) : (session.result_b_trophies || 0),
          iWon: session.winner_id === user.id,
        };
      }

      const amA = session.player_a_id === user.id;

      // ---- Outcome verification against session HP ----
      const myHp = amA ? session.hp_a : session.hp_b;
      const oppHp = amA ? session.hp_b : session.hp_a;

      let winnerId;
      if (outcome === 'forfeit' || outcome === 'loss') {
        winnerId = amA ? session.player_b_id : session.player_a_id;
      } else {
        if (myHp <= 0 && oppHp > 0) {
          return { error: Response.json({ error: 'outcome_mismatch', detail: 'Your HP is 0' }, { status: 400 }) };
        }
        if (myHp > 0 && oppHp > 0) {
          return { error: Response.json({ error: 'outcome_mismatch', detail: 'Both players have HP remaining' }, { status: 400 }) };
        }
        if (myHp <= 0 && oppHp <= 0) {
          return { error: Response.json({ error: 'outcome_mismatch', detail: 'Both HP are 0' }, { status: 400 }) };
        }
        winnerId = user.id;
      }

      const aWon = winnerId === session.player_a_id;

      // Compute reward math (pure — no DB writes here) using fresh user reads.
      // These reads happen inside the claim so a retried claim re-reads fresh data.
      return (async () => {
        const userA = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(session.player_a_id);
        const userB = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(session.player_b_id);

        const isPrivate = session.mode === 'private';
        const noTrophies = isPrivate || session.mode === 'casual';
        const shardIncomeA = computeShardIncome(aWon, isPrivate, session.mode, userA.win_streak || 0);
        const shardIncomeB = computeShardIncome(!aWon, isPrivate, session.mode, userB.win_streak || 0);
        const changeA = noTrophies ? 0 : computeTrophyChange(userA.trophies || 0, userB.trophies || 0, aWon);
        const changeB = noTrophies ? 0 : computeTrophyChange(userB.trophies || 0, userA.trophies || 0, !aWon);
        const newTrophiesA = noTrophies ? (userA.trophies || 0) : Math.max(0, (userA.trophies || 0) + changeA);
        const newTrophiesB = noTrophies ? (userB.trophies || 0) : Math.max(0, (userB.trophies || 0) + changeB);

        const updateA = {
          trophies: newTrophiesA,
          wins: isPrivate ? (userA.wins || 0) : (userA.wins || 0) + (aWon ? 1 : 0),
          losses: isPrivate ? (userA.losses || 0) : (userA.losses || 0) + (aWon ? 0 : 1),
          win_streak: isPrivate ? (userA.win_streak || 0) : (aWon ? (userA.win_streak || 0) + 1 : 0),
          peak_trophies: Math.max(userA.peak_trophies || 0, newTrophiesA),
          coins: (userA.coins || 0) + (aWon ? MATCH_REWARD_WIN : MATCH_REWARD_LOSS),
          shards: (userA.shards || 0) + shardIncomeA,
          last_match: new Date().toISOString(),
          total_seconds_played: (userA.total_seconds_played || 0) + Math.floor(gameTime || 0),
        };

        const updateB = {
          trophies: newTrophiesB,
          wins: isPrivate ? (userB.wins || 0) : (userB.wins || 0) + (!aWon ? 1 : 0),
          losses: isPrivate ? (userB.losses || 0) : (userB.losses || 0) + (!aWon ? 0 : 1),
          win_streak: isPrivate ? (userB.win_streak || 0) : (!aWon ? (userB.win_streak || 0) + 1 : 0),
          peak_trophies: Math.max(userB.peak_trophies || 0, newTrophiesB),
          coins: (userB.coins || 0) + (!aWon ? MATCH_REWARD_WIN : MATCH_REWARD_LOSS),
          shards: (userB.shards || 0) + shardIncomeB,
          last_match: new Date().toISOString(),
          total_seconds_played: (userB.total_seconds_played || 0) + Math.floor(gameTime || 0),
        };

        const sessionPatch = {
          status: 'finished',
          winner_id: winnerId,
          outcome: outcome || 'win',
          finished_date: new Date().toISOString(),
          result_a_change: changeA,
          result_b_change: changeB,
          result_a_trophies: newTrophiesA,
          result_b_trophies: newTrophiesB,
          game_time: gameTime || 0,
        };

        return {
          patch: sessionPatch,
          meta: {
            amA, aWon, winnerId, changeA, changeB,
            newTrophiesA, newTrophiesB, shardIncomeA, shardIncomeB,
            updateA, updateB, userA, userB,
          },
        };
      })();
    });

    if (claim.error) return claim.error;

    // ---- Already-finished path: return stored result, no rewards applied ----
    if (claim.alreadyFinished) {
      // Still persist the rate-limit counter for the caller
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits }).catch(() => {});
      return Response.json({
        alreadyFinished: true,
        winnerId: claim.winnerId,
        myChange: claim.myChange,
        myNewTrophies: claim.myNewTrophies,
        myShardIncome: 0,
        iWon: claim.iWon,
      });
    }

    // ---- Winning claim path: apply rewards to both players ----
    const m = claim.meta;

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(m.userA.id, m.updateA);
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(m.userB.id, m.updateB);

    // Persist the rate limit counter on the caller's profile
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });

    // ---- Post-match processing (milestones, achievements, missions, shard crate) ----
    // Applied to BOTH players so neither misses progression from this match.
    // The alreadyFinished path (opponent's finalize) does NOT re-apply extras.
    const amA = m.amA;
    const callerNewTrophies = amA ? m.newTrophiesA : m.newTrophiesB;
    const callerWon = m.winnerId === user.id;
    const callerShardIncome = amA ? m.shardIncomeA : m.shardIncomeB;
    const callerUser = amA ? m.userA : m.userB;
    const callerUpdate = amA ? m.updateA : m.updateB;
    const opponentId = amA ? m.userB.id : m.userA.id;
    const opponentUser = amA ? m.userB : m.userA;
    const opponentUpdate = amA ? m.updateB : m.updateA;
    const matchMode = claim.record.mode;

    const callerExtras = computeExtras({ ...callerUser, ...callerUpdate }, callerWon, matchMode);
    if (Object.keys(callerExtras.extraPatch).length > 0) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, callerExtras.extraPatch);
    }
    // Opponent's extras — best-effort, non-blocking on the response.
    try {
      const opponentExtras = computeExtras({ ...opponentUser, ...opponentUpdate }, !callerWon, matchMode);
      if (Object.keys(opponentExtras.extraPatch).length > 0 && opponentId !== user.id) {
        await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(opponentId, opponentExtras.extraPatch);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* best-effort */ }

    const { extraPatch, shardDrop, shardCrateAmt, orbUnlocks, towerUnlocks, abilityUnlocks, achievementUnlocks } = callerExtras;

    // Create match record (best-effort)
    try {
      await base44.entities.MatchRecord.create({
        result: callerWon ? 'win' : 'loss',
        opponent_name: amA ? (claim.record.player_b_name || 'Opponent') : (claim.record.player_a_name || 'Opponent'),
        opponent_trophies: amA ? (claim.record.player_b_trophies || 0) : (claim.record.player_a_trophies || 0),
        trophies_change: amA ? m.changeA : m.changeB,
        mode: claim.record.mode,
        duration_seconds: Math.floor(gameTime || 0),
      });
    } catch (e) { /* best-effort */ }

    const myChange = amA ? m.changeA : m.changeB;
    const myCoins = extraPatch.coins !== undefined ? extraPatch.coins : (amA ? m.updateA.coins : m.updateB.coins);
    const myShards = extraPatch.shards !== undefined ? extraPatch.shards : (amA ? m.updateA.shards : m.updateB.shards);

    return Response.json({
      winnerId: m.winnerId,
      myChange,
      myNewTrophies: callerNewTrophies,
      myCoins,
      myShards,
      myShardIncome: callerShardIncome,
      iWon: callerWon,
      shardDrop,
      shardCrateAmt,
      orbUnlocks,
      towerUnlocks,
      abilityUnlocks,
      achievementUnlocks,
      oldTrophies: callerUser.trophies || 0,
      oldLeague: getLeague(callerUser.trophies || 0),
      newLeague: getLeague(callerNewTrophies),
      promoted: callerNewTrophies > (callerUser.trophies || 0) && getLeague(callerNewTrophies).id > getLeague(callerUser.trophies || 0).id,
      demoted: callerNewTrophies < (callerUser.trophies || 0) && getLeague(callerNewTrophies).id < getLeague(callerUser.trophies || 0).id,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

function computeShardIncome(won, isPrivate, mode, currentStreak) {
  if (isPrivate || !won) return 0;
  let income = SHARD_PER_WIN;
  if (mode === 'ranked' && ((currentStreak || 0) + 1) % 3 === 0) income += SHARD_RANKED_STREAK_BONUS;
  return income;
}

// Computes the post-match extraPatch (shard crate, milestone orb/tower/ability
// unlocks, achievements, daily missions) for a single player from their own
// perspective. Used for BOTH players in a multiplayer match so neither misses
// progression. Returns { extraPatch, shardDrop, shardCrateAmt, orbUnlocks,
// towerUnlocks, abilityUnlocks, achievementUnlocks }.
function computeExtras(profile, won, mode) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(profile);
  const newTrophies = p.trophies || 0;
  const extraPatch = {};
  let shardDrop = false, shardCrateAmt = 0;

  // Shard crate (ranked wins only)
  if (won && mode === 'ranked') {
    const gamesSince = (p.games_since_shard || 0) + 1;
    let shouldTrigger = false;
    if (gamesSince >= 5) shouldTrigger = true;
    else if (gamesSince >= 4 && Math.random() < 0.7) shouldTrigger = true;
    if (shouldTrigger) {
      shardCrateAmt = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
      extraPatch.shards = (p.shards || 0) + shardCrateAmt;
      extraPatch.games_since_shard = 0;
      shardDrop = true;
    } else {
      extraPatch.games_since_shard = gamesSince;
    }
  }

  // Milestone unlocks
  const orbCards = { ...(p.orb_cards || {}) };
  const orbUnlocks = checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, orbCards);
  if (orbUnlocks.length > 0) {
    for (const id of orbUnlocks) orbCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
    extraPatch.orb_cards = orbCards;
  }
  const towerCards = { ...(p.tower_cards || {}) };
  const towerUnlocks = checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, towerCards);
  if (towerUnlocks.length > 0) {
    for (const id of towerUnlocks) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
    extraPatch.tower_cards = towerCards;
    extraPatch.unlocked_towers = [...new Set([...(p.unlocked_towers || []), ...towerUnlocks])];
  }
  const abilityCards = { ...(p.ability_cards || {}) };
  const abilityUnlocks = checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, abilityCards);
  if (abilityUnlocks.length > 0) {
    for (const id of abilityUnlocks) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
    extraPatch.ability_cards = abilityCards;
    extraPatch.unlocked_abilities = [...new Set([...(p.unlocked_abilities || []), ...abilityUnlocks])];
  }

  // Achievements
  const achProfile = { ...p, ...extraPatch };
  const achievementUnlocks = evaluateAchievements(achProfile, { won, mode });
  if (achievementUnlocks.length > 0) {
    extraPatch.achievements = [...(p.achievements || []), ...achievementUnlocks.map((a) => a.id)];
    extraPatch.new_achievements = [...(p.new_achievements || []), ...achievementUnlocks.map((a) => a.id)];
  }

  // Daily missions
  const { daily_missions: newMissions, bonusCoins: missionCoins } = updateDailyMissions(p, { won, mode });
  extraPatch.daily_missions = newMissions;
  if (missionCoins > 0) extraPatch.coins = (extraPatch.coins !== undefined ? extraPatch.coins : (p.coins || 0)) + missionCoins;

  return { extraPatch, shardDrop, shardCrateAmt, orbUnlocks, towerUnlocks, abilityUnlocks, achievementUnlocks };
}

FILE: base44/functions/getFriends/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Returns all Friends-page data for the caller in one call: accepted friends
// (with live names/trophies), incoming + outgoing pending friend requests, and
// pending game invites. The client subscribes to the underlying entities for
// live updates and refetches this on any change.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const [friendsA, friendsB, incoming, outgoing, invitesTo, invitesFrom] = await Promise.all([
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({ user_a_id: user.id, status: 'active' }),
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({ user_b_id: user.id, status: 'active' }),
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({ to_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' }),
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({ from_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' }),
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.filter({ to_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' }),
      base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.filter({ from_user_id: user.id, status: { $in: ['pending', 'accepted'] } }),
    ]);

    const friendRows = [...friendsA, ...friendsB];
    const friendIds = friendRows.map((f) => (f.user_a_id === user.id ? f.user_b_id : f.user_a_id));
    const friendUsers = await Promise.all(
      friendIds.map((id) => base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(id).catch(() => null))
    );
    const friends = friendUsers
      .filter((u) => u)
      .map((u) => ({ id: u.id, name: u.display_name || 'Player', trophies: u.trophies || 0 }));

    const incomingIds = incoming.map((r) => r.from_user_id);
    const incomingUsers = await Promise.all(
      incomingIds.map((id) => base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(id).catch(() => null))
    );
    const incomingReqs = incoming.map((r, i) => ({
      requestId: r.id,
      from_user_id: r.from_user_id,
      from_name: incomingUsers[i]?.display_name || r.from_name || 'Player',
      from_trophies: incomingUsers[i]?.trophies || 0,
    }));

    const outgoingReqs = outgoing.map((r) => ({
      requestId: r.id,
      to_user_id: r.to_user_id,
      to_name: r.to_name || 'Player',
    }));

    const pendingInvites = invitesTo.map((inv) => ({
      inviteId: inv.id,
      from_user_id: inv.from_user_id,
      from_name: inv.from_name || 'Player',
      created_date: inv.created_date,
    }));

    const myInvites = invitesFrom.map((inv) => ({
      inviteId: inv.id,
      to_user_id: inv.to_user_id,
      to_name: inv.to_name || 'Player',
      status: inv.status,
      session_id: inv.session_id,
      created_date: inv.created_date,
    }));

    return Response.json({
      friends,
      incoming: incomingReqs,
      outgoing: outgoingReqs,
      invites: pendingInvites,
      myInvites,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Checks that the requested display name is not already in use by another user
// (case-insensitive) before saving it to the caller's profile.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json();
    const name = (body?.name || '').toString().trim();

    // Length validation: 3–20 characters
    if (!name || name.length < 3) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'invalid_name' }, { status: 400 });
    if (name.length > 20) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'too_long' }, { status: 400 });

    // Charset validation: letters, numbers, spaces, and common punctuation (- _ .)
    if (!/^[a-zA-Z0-9\s\-_.]+$/.test(name)) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'invalid_name' }, { status: 400 });

    // Profanity blocklist (case-insensitive, whole-word and substring)
    const PROFANITY_BLOCKLIST = [
      'nigger', 'nazi', 'fascist', 'hitler', 'fuck', 'shit', 'asshole', 'bitch',
      'cunt', 'dick', 'pussy', 'arschloch', 'scheiße', 'wichser', 'hure', 'ficker'
    ];
    const lowerName = name.toLowerCase();
    for (const term of PROFANITY_BLOCKLIST) {
      if (lowerName.includes(term)) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'name_inappropriate' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Case-insensitive uniqueness check via server-side filtered query.
    const escaped = name.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const existing = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
      display_name: { $regex: `^${escaped}$`, $options: 'i' }
    });
    const taken = existing.some((u) => u.id !== user.id);
    if (taken) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'name_taken' }, { status: 409 });

    await base44.auth.updateMe({ display_name: name });
    return Response.json({ success: true, name });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/redeemVoucher/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Server-side voucher code table. Add/remove codes here without an app update.
const VOUCHER_CODES = {
  "TEST1000": { coins: 1000, gems: 1000, shards: 1000, multiUse: true },
  "100COINS": { coins: 100, multiUse: false },
  "20SHARDS": { shards: 20, multiUse: false },
};

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const code = (body?.code || '').toString().trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!code) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_code' }, { status: 400 });

    const voucher = VOUCHER_CODES[code];
    if (!voucher) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_code' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const redeemed = Array.isArray(u.redeemed_vouchers) ? u.redeemed_vouchers : [];
      if (!voucher.multiUse && redeemed.includes(code)) {
        return { error: Response.json({ error: 'already_redeemed' }, { status: 400 }) };
      }

      const patch = {
        coins: (u.coins || 0) + (voucher.coins || 0),
        gems: (u.gems || 0) + (voucher.gems || 0),
        shards: (u.shards || 0) + (voucher.shards || 0),
        rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
      };
      if (!voucher.multiUse) {
        patch.redeemed_vouchers = [...redeemed, code];
      }

      return { patch };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      reward: { coins: voucher.coins || 0, gems: voucher.gems || 0, shards: voucher.shards || 0 },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Server-side leaderboard: queries PlayerProfile sorted by trophies, filters out
// deleted/neutralized accounts server-side, and returns the caller's rank position.
// This replaces the client-side filtering that was previously done in Leaderboard.jsx.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // Fetch top 50 by trophies — server-side sort
    const users = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.list('-trophies', 50);

    // Server-side filter: exclude deleted/neutralized accounts
    const filtered = users.filter((u) => {
      const name = (u.display_name || '').trim();
      if (!name || name === 'Deleted') return false;
      if (u.neutralized) return false;
      return true;
    });

    // Find the caller's rank (position in the full sorted list, not just top 50)
    let myRank = -1;
    if (user) {
      // If the caller isn't in the top 50, we need their position.
      // Fetch enough to find them — use a broad query filtered by trophies >= caller's.
      const myTrophies = user.trophies || 0;
      if (filtered.some((u) => u.id === user.id)) {
        myRank = filtered.findIndex((u) => u.id === user.id);
      } else {
        // Count how many users have more trophies than the caller
        const higher = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
          trophies: { $gt: myTrophies },
        });
        myRank = higher.length;
      }
    }

    return Response.json({
      rows: filtered.map((u) => ({
        id: u.id,
        display_name: u.display_name || 'Player',
        trophies: u.trophies || 0,
        wins: u.wins || 0,
        losses: u.losses || 0,
      })),
      myRank: myRank >= 0 ? myRank + 1 : -1,
      myTrophies: user?.trophies || 0,
      myId: user?.id,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Admin-only: bans a player by username. Sets banned/ban_reason/ban_until on the
// target User and creates a BanRecord audit entry. Rejects banning admins or self.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const admin = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!admin) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    if (admin.role !== 'admin') return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const username = (body?.username || '').toString().trim();
    const reason = (body?.reason || '').toString().trim().slice(0, 500);
    const permanent = !!body?.permanent;
    const durationValue = Number(body?.durationValue) || 0;
    const durationUnit = (body?.durationUnit || '').toString();

    if (!username) return Response.json({ error: 'username required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!reason) return Response.json({ error: 'reason required' }, { status: 400 });

    // Compute ban_until
    let banUntil: string | null = null;
    let durationLabel = 'permanent';
    if (!permanent) {
      if (durationValue <= 0) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid duration' }, { status: 400 });
      const unitMs = { hours: 3600_000, days: 86_400_000, weeks: 604_800_000 }[durationUnit];
      if (!unitMs) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid duration unit' }, { status: 400 });
      banUntil = new Date(Date.now() + durationValue * unitMs).toISOString();
      durationLabel = `${durationValue}${durationUnit === 'hours' ? 'h' : durationUnit === 'days' ? 'd' : 'w'}`;
    }

    // Resolve target by display name (case-insensitive, server-side query)
    const escaped = username.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const targets = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
      display_name: { $regex: `^${escaped}$`, $options: 'i' }
    });
    const target = targets[0];
    if (!target) return Response.json({ error: 'user_not_found' }, { status: 404 });
    if (target.id === admin.id) return Response.json({ error: 'self' }, { status: 400 });
    if (target.role === 'admin') return Response.json({ error: 'cannot_ban_admin' }, { status: 400 });

    // Apply the ban
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(target.id, {
      banned: true,
      ban_reason: reason,
      ban_until: banUntil,
      neutralized: true,
    });

    // Audit record
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.BanRecord.create({
      admin_id: admin.id,
      admin_name: admin.display_name || admin.full_name || 'Admin',
      target_id: target.id,
      target_name: target.display_name || 'Player',
      action: 'ban',
      reason,
      duration_label: durationLabel,
      ban_until: banUntil,
    });

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      target_name: target.display_name || 'Player',
      ban_until: banUntil,
      duration_label: durationLabel,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/cleanupStaleSessions/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { STALE_CLEANUP_MS } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Scheduled maintenance: finish 'starting' MatchSession records older than
// STALE_CLEANUP_MS (opponent never connected). No rewards are granted — both
// players are simply freed to search again. Called by the Stale Session
// Cleanup workflow every ~3 minutes.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);

    // Allow workflow calls (no user context) and admin direct calls; reject
    // non-admin direct invocation.
    try {
      const user = await base44.auth.me();
      if (user && user.role !== 'admin') {
        return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // No user context — workflow invocation, proceed.
    }

    const now = Date.now();
    const starting = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      status: 'starting'
    });

    let cleaned = 0;
    for (const s of starting) {
      if ((now - new Date(s.created_date).getTime()) < STALE_CLEANUP_MS) continue;
      // Re-fetch to avoid racing with finalizeMatch; only finish if still 'starting'
      const fresh = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.get(s.id);
      if (!fresh || fresh.status !== 'starting') continue;
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.update(s.id, {
        status: 'finished',
        outcome: 'timeout',
        winner_id: null,
        finished_date: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
      cleaned++;
    }

    return Response.json({ cleaned, checked: starting.length });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
