FILE: base44/functions/sendFriendRequest/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';

const MAX_PENDING = 50;

// Create a friend request from the caller to the user identified by `to_username`
// (case-insensitive display-name lookup). Rejects self-requests, duplicates,
// and already-friends pairs. Enforces a pending-request cap to prevent spam.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // Rate limit (social)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'social');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const toUsername = (body?.to_username || '').toString().trim();
    if (!toUsername) return Response.json({ error: 'username required' }, { status: 400 });

    // Server-side filtered query (case-insensitive) instead of loading 500 users
    const escaped = toUsername.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const targets = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
      display_name: { $regex: `^${escaped}$`, $options: 'i' }
    });
    const target = targets[0];
    if (!target) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'not_found' }, { status: 404 });
    if (target.id === user.id) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'self' }, { status: 400 });

    // Already friends?
    const [a, b] = [user.id, target.id].sort();
    const existingFriends = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({
      $or: [
        { user_a_id: a, user_b_id: b },
        { user_a_id: b, user_b_id: a },
      ],
    });
    if (existingFriends.length > 0) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'already_friends' }, { status: 409 });

    // Duplicate pending request (either direction)?
    const existingReq = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({
      $or: [
        { from_user_id: user.id, to_user_id: target.id, status: 'pending' },
        { from_user_id: target.id, to_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' },
      ],
    });
    if (existingReq.length > 0) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'already_pending' }, { status: 409 });

    // Block check: either user may have blocked the other via reporting
    const myBlocked = Array.isArray(user.blocked_users) ? user.blocked_users : [];
    const targetBlocked = Array.isArray(target.blocked_users) ? target.blocked_users : [];
    if (myBlocked.includes(target.id) || targetBlocked.includes(user.id)) {
      return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'blocked' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Cap outgoing pending requests
    const myPending = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({
      from_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending'
    });
    if (myPending.length >= MAX_PENDING) return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'limit' }, { status: 429 });

    await base44.entities.FriendRequest.create({
      from_user_id: user.id,
      from_name: user.display_name || 'Player',
      to_user_id: target.id,
      to_name: target.display_name || 'Player',
      to_username: toUsername,
      status: 'pending',
    });

    // Persist rate limit counter
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });

    return Response.json({ success: true, to_name: target.display_name || 'Player' });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// Admin-only: unbans a player by username. Clears the ban fields, unsets

export default async function(req) {

    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);

    const users = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.list('-created_date', 500);

      reason: '',
      duration_label: '',
      ban_until: null,
    });

    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });

}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Look up a user by display name (case-insensitive) for the add-friend preview.
// Returns only { id, display_name, trophies } — never the email.
// Rate-limited via the 'social' category to prevent username enumeration.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const username = (body?.username || '').toString().trim();
    if (!username) return Response.json({ error: 'username required' }, { status: 400 });

    // Rate limit: prevent username enumeration
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'social');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();
    if (rl.newRateLimits) {
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Server-side filtered query (case-insensitive) instead of loading 500 users
    const escaped = username.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
    const targets = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
      display_name: { $regex: `^${escaped}$`, $options: 'i' }
    });
    const target = targets[0];
    if (!target) return Response.json({ found: false });
    if (target.id === user.id) return Response.json({ found: true, isSelf: true });

    return Response.json({
      found: true,
      id: target.id,
      display_name: target.display_name || 'Player',
      trophies: target.trophies || 0,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/claimAchievementRewards/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { ACHIEVEMENTS } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

// Securely claims achievement rewards server-side.
// Body: { achievementIds?: string[] } — if omitted/empty, claims ALL unclaimed unlocked achievements.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    let body = {};
    try { body = await req.json(); } catch { /* no body */ }
    const requestedIds = Array.isArray(body.achievementIds) ? body.achievementIds : null;

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const unlocked = u.achievements || [];
      const alreadyClaimed = u.claimed_achievements || [];

      let toClaim;
      if (requestedIds && requestedIds.length > 0) {
        toClaim = requestedIds.filter((id) => unlocked.includes(id) && !alreadyClaimed.includes(id));
      } else {
        toClaim = unlocked.filter((id) => !alreadyClaimed.includes(id));
      }

      if (toClaim.length === 0) {
        return { patch: { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits }, claimed: [] };
      }

      let totalCoins = 0;
      let totalShards = 0;
      const claimedIds = [];
      for (const id of toClaim) {
        const ach = ACHIEVEMENTS.find((a) => a.id === id);
        if (!ach) continue;
        totalCoins += ach.reward.coins || 0;
        totalShards += ach.reward.shards || 0;
        claimedIds.push(id);
      }

      if (claimedIds.length === 0) {
        return { patch: { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits }, claimed: [] };
      }

      return {
        patch: {
          coins: (u.coins || 0) + totalCoins,
          shards: (u.shards || 0) + totalShards,
          claimed_achievements: [...alreadyClaimed, ...claimedIds],
          new_achievements: [],
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        },
        claimed: claimedIds,
        totalCoins,
        totalShards,
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;

    const claimed = result.claimed || [];
    if (claimed.length === 0) {
      return Response.json({ success: true, claimed: [], coins: user.coins || 0, shards: user.shards || 0, claimed_achievements: user.claimed_achievements || [] });
    }

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      claimed,
      coins: result.patch.coins,
      shards: result.patch.shards,
      claimed_achievements: result.patch.claimed_achievements,
      totalCoins: result.totalCoins,
      totalShards: result.totalShards,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/levelUpCard/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { normalizeProfile, copiesNeeded, MAX_CARD_LEVEL } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const kind = (body?.kind || '').toString();
    const id = (body?.id || '').toString();
    if (!kind || !id) return Response.json({ error: 'kind and id required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!['tower', 'ability', 'orb'].includes(kind)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid kind' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'card_upgrade');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const p = normalizeProfile(u);
      const cards = kind === 'tower' ? p.tower_cards : kind === 'ability' ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
      const card = cards[id];
      if (!card || card.level === 0) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'card not unlocked' }, { status: 400 }) };
      if (card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'card maxed' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
      if (card.copies < needed) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough copies' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newCards = { ...cards, [id]: { level: card.level + 1, copies: card.copies - needed, boughtCopies: 0 } };
      const cardField = kind === 'tower' ? 'tower_cards' : kind === 'ability' ? 'ability_cards' : 'orb_cards';
      return {
        patch: {
          [cardField]: newCards,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    const cardField = kind === 'tower' ? 'tower_cards' : kind === 'ability' ? 'ability_cards' : 'orb_cards';
    return Response.json({ success: true, [cardField]: result.patch[cardField] });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { EQUIPPED_FIELDS } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const field = (body?.field || '').toString();
    const id = (body?.id || '').toString();
    if (!field || !id) return Response.json({ error: 'field and id required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!EQUIPPED_FIELDS.includes(field)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid field' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'cosmetic');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      if (id !== 'default') {
        const owned = Array.isArray(u.owned_skins) ? u.owned_skins : [];
        if (!owned.includes(id)) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'skin not owned' }, { status: 400 }) };
      }

      return {
        patch: {
          [field]: id,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ success: true, [field]: id });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const userId = user.id;

    // 1. Delete all match records owned by this user
    const matchRecords = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchRecord.filter({ created_by_id: userId });
    for (const mr of matchRecords) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchRecord.delete(mr.id);
    }

    // 2. Delete matchmaking queue entries
    const queueEntries = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({ player_id: userId });
    for (const qe of queueEntries) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(qe.id);
    }

    // 3. Delete social graph: friendships, friend requests, and game invites
    const friendships = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({
      $or: [{ user_a_id: userId }, { user_b_id: userId }]
    });
    for (const f of friendships) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.delete(f.id);
    }
    const friendRequests = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({
      $or: [{ from_user_id: userId }, { to_user_id: userId }]
    });
    for (const r of friendRequests) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.delete(r.id);
    }
    const gameInvites = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.filter({
      $or: [{ from_user_id: userId }, { to_user_id: userId }]
    });
    for (const inv of gameInvites) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.delete(inv.id);
    }

    // 3b. Delete GDPR-related personal data: EULA acceptances, profile snapshots,
    //     user reports (as reporter or reported), and ban records targeting this user.
    const eulaAcceptances = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.EulaAcceptance.filter({ user_id: userId });
    for (const e of eulaAcceptances) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.EulaAcceptance.delete(e.id);
    }
    const snapshots = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.filter({ user_id: userId });
    for (const s of snapshots) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.delete(s.id);
    }
    const reports = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.UserReport.filter({
      $or: [{ reporter_id: userId }, { reported_id: userId }]
    });
    for (const r of reports) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.UserReport.delete(r.id);
    }
    const banRecords = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.BanRecord.filter({ target_id: userId });
    for (const b of banRecords) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.BanRecord.delete(b.id);
    }

    // 4. Mark any active match sessions as finished (opponent gets auto-win)
    const sessionsA = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_a_id: userId, status: { $in: ['starting', 'playing', 'paused'] }
    });
    const sessionsB = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.filter({
      player_b_id: userId, status: { $in: ['starting', 'playing', 'paused'] }
    });
    for (const s of [...sessionsA, ...sessionsB]) {
      const winnerId = s.player_a_id === userId ? s.player_b_id : s.player_a_id;
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.update(s.id, {
        status: 'finished',
        winner_id: winnerId,
        outcome: 'forfeit',
        finished_date: new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }

    // 5. Reset all game progress to fresh-install defaults (the auth account itself stays)
    await base44.auth.updateMe({
      display_name: 'Player',
      trophies: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, win_streak: 0,
      coins: 500, gems: 20, shards: 0, peak_trophies: 0,
      games_since_shard: 0, hand_level: 0,
      onboarded: false, tutorial_done: false,
      age_verified: false, is_under_16: false,
      sound_enabled: true, haptics_enabled: true, advanced_haptics_enabled: false,
      tower_menu_anytime: false, language: 'en',
      unlocked_towers: ['basic', 'machinegun', 'boomerang', 'bomb'],
      unlocked_abilities: ['zap', 'portal', 'repair', 'freeze'],
      selected_abilities: ['zap', 'portal', 'repair'],
      selected_towers: ['basic', 'machinegun', 'boomerang', 'bomb'],
      selected_orbs: ['normal', 'fast', 'bomb', 'splitter', 'tank'],
      tower_cards: {
        basic: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, machinegun: { level: 1, copies: 0 },
        boomerang: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, bomb: { level: 1, copies: 0 }
      },
      ability_cards: {
        zap: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, portal: { level: 1, copies: 0 },
        repair: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, freeze: { level: 1, copies: 0 }
      },
      orb_cards: {
        normal: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, fast: { level: 1, copies: 0 },
        bomb: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, splitter: { level: 1, copies: 0 },
        tank: { level: 1, copies: 0 }, sprint: { level: 0, copies: 0 },
        swarmer: { level: 0, copies: 0 }, shield: { level: 0, copies: 0 },
        healer: { level: 0, copies: 0 }
      },
      achievements: [], new_achievements: [], claimed_achievements: [],
      owned_skins: [],
      equipped_orb_pattern: 'default', equipped_station_skin: 'default',
      equipped_tower_skin: 'default', equipped_left_tower_skin: 'default',
      equipped_right_tower_skin: 'default', equipped_station_emblem: 'default',
      equipped_left_tower_emblem: 'default', equipped_right_tower_emblem: 'default',
      daily_missions: {}, last_free_crate: ''
    });

    return Response.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/postAuthInit/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Server-side post-auth initialization:
//   1. One-time 200-gem beta gift (idempotent via beta_gift_gems flag)
//   2. Daily login stamp (appends today's date to login_days if not present)
// These fields are backend-only — the client must not write them via updateMe.
// Routed through secureUpdate so concurrent calls (e.g. a fast page reload right
// after login) can't both see beta_gift_gems=false and both grant 200 gems.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const patch: any = {};

      // 1. Beta gift
      if (!u.beta_gift_gems) {
        patch.beta_gift_gems = true;
        patch.gems = (u.gems || 0) + 200;
      }

      // 2. Login stamp
      const days: string[] = Array.isArray(u.login_days) ? u.login_days : [];
      if (!days.includes(today)) {
        patch.login_days = [...days, today];
      }

      // 3. Auto-clear expired temp bans so they self-heal without admin action.
      if (u.banned && u.ban_until && new Date(u.ban_until).getTime() < Date.now()) {
        patch.banned = false;
        patch.ban_reason = '';
        patch.ban_until = null;
        patch.neutralized = false;
      }

      if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0) {
        return { skip: true };
      }
      return { patch };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;

    if (result.skip) {
      return Response.json({ success: true, updated: false, user });
    }

    const updated = { ...user, ...result.patch };
    return Response.json({ success: true, updated: true, user: updated });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/restoreProfileSnapshot/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { secrets } from 'base44:runtime';
import { verifyAndUnpackBlob, compareFingerprints } from '../../shared/snapshot.ts';

const ACTIVITY_GATE_DAYS = 89;

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const newUser = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!newUser) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const { blob, fingerprint: freshFingerprint } = body;
    if (!blob) return Response.json({ error: 'Missing blob' }, { status: 400 });

    const secret = secrets.get('PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_SECRET');
    const payload = await verifyAndUnpackBlob(blob, secret);
    if (!payload) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 403 });

    const { profile, oldUserId, fingerprint: storedFingerprint, nonce } = payload;
    if (!oldUserId || !profile) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid payload' }, { status: 400 });

    // Find the snapshot record by old user ID.
    const snapshots = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.filter({ user_id: oldUserId });
    if (!snapshots || snapshots.length === 0) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'Snapshot not found or already consumed' }, { status: 404 });
    }
    const snapshot = snapshots[0];

    // Verify nonce matches (one-time use).
    if (snapshot.nonce !== nonce) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'Nonce mismatch' }, { status: 403 });
    }
    if (snapshot.consumed) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'Already consumed' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Activity gate: the original user must not have been active recently.
    // This blocks restore while the legitimate user is still playing.
    const oldUser = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(oldUserId).catch(() => null);
    if (oldUser) {
      const lastActivity = oldUser.last_match || oldUser.updated_date;
      if (lastActivity) {
        const daysSince = (Date.now() - new Date(lastActivity).getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);
        if (daysSince < ACTIVITY_GATE_DAYS) {
          return Response.json({ error: 'Original account still active' }, { status: 403 });
        }
      }
    }

    // Fingerprint comparison: require ~70% signal overlap (not 100%, to survive
    // browser updates and minor device changes; blocks cross-device restore).
    if (!compareFingerprints(storedFingerprint, freshFingerprint, 0.7)) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'Device mismatch' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Mark as consumed FIRST to prevent race conditions (two simultaneous restores).
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.update(snapshot.id, { consumed: true });

    // Apply the profile data to the new user.
    await base44.auth.updateMe(profile);

    // Migrate MatchRecords: clone from old user to new user (user-scoped create
    // sets created_by_id to the new user automatically).
    try {
      const oldRecords = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchRecord.filter(
        { created_by_id: oldUserId }
      );
      if (oldRecords && oldRecords.length > 0) {
        const newRecords = oldRecords.map((r) => ({
          result: r.result,
          opponent_name: r.opponent_name,
          opponent_trophies: r.opponent_trophies,
          trophies_change: r.trophies_change,
          coins_earned: r.coins_earned,
          mode: r.mode,
          duration_seconds: r.duration_seconds,
        }));
        await base44.entities.MatchRecord.bulkCreate(newRecords);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Match record migration is best-effort — don't fail the whole restore.
    }

    // Migrate Friendships: update user_a_id / user_b_id from old to new.
    try {
      const friendships = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({
        $or: [{ user_a_id: oldUserId }, { user_b_id: oldUserId }],
      });
      for (const f of friendships) {
        const update = {};
        if (f.user_a_id === oldUserId) update.user_a_id = newUser.id;
        if (f.user_b_id === oldUserId) update.user_b_id = newUser.id;
        if (Object.keys(update).length > 0) {
          await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.update(f.id, update);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Best-effort.
    }

    // Migrate pending FriendRequests: update from_user_id / to_user_id from old to new.
    try {
      const requests = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({
        $or: [{ from_user_id: oldUserId }, { to_user_id: oldUserId }],
      });
      for (const r of requests) {
        const update = {};
        if (r.from_user_id === oldUserId) update.from_user_id = newUser.id;
        if (r.to_user_id === oldUserId) update.to_user_id = newUser.id;
        if (Object.keys(update).length > 0) {
          await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.update(r.id, update);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // Best-effort.
    }

    // Delete the snapshot record (one-time use enforced).
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.delete(snapshot.id);

    // Wipe the old account's game data to prevent a duplicate profile.
    // (User records can't be deleted via the SDK, so we neutralize the profile.)
    try {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(oldUserId, {
        display_name: "Deleted",
        trophies: 0, peak_trophies: 0, wins: 0, losses: 0, win_streak: 0,
        coins: 0, gems: 0, shards: 0,
        tower_cards: {}, ability_cards: {}, orb_cards: {},
        owned_skins: [], unlocked_towers: [], unlocked_abilities: [],
        selected_towers: [], selected_abilities: [], selected_orbs: [],
      });
    } catch (e) { /* best-effort — old account is already inactive */ }

    return Response.json({ success: true, restored: true });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/assignRandomName/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Generates a unique random display name (player + 5-digit number) for
// users who are under their region's age threshold. Also sets the
// age_verified and is_under_16 flags on the user profile.
// The DOB itself is never sent to the backend — only the boolean flags.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // Generate a unique random name (player + 5-digit number)
    let name = '';
    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 10; attempt++) {
      const num = Math.floor(10000 + Math.random() * 90000);
      const candidate = `player${num}`;
      // Check uniqueness via server-side filtered query
      const existing = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.filter({
        display_name: { $regex: `^${candidate}$`, $options: 'i' }
      });
      if (existing.length === 0) {
        name = candidate;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (!name) return Response.json({ error: 'name_generation_failed' }, { status: 500 });

    await base44.auth.updateMe({
      display_name: name,
      age_verified: true,
      is_under_16: true,
    });

    return Response.json({ success: true, name });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/startAiMatch/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { getVersionInfo, checkClientVersion } from '../../shared/versionGate.ts';

// Records the start time of an AI (casual/ranked/training) match on the user's profile.
// finalizeAiMatch reads this to verify the match lasted at least the minimum duration.
// This prevents a modified client from instantly reporting fake wins.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // EULA gate
    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    // Rate limit (matchmaking category — starting a match)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'matchmaking');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

    // Version gate — reject outdated clients
    const versionInfo = await getVersionInfo(base44);
    const versionErr = checkClientVersion(body?.client_version, versionInfo.min_required_version);
    if (versionErr) return versionErr;

    const mode = (body?.mode || 'casual').toString();
    if (!['training', 'casual', 'ranked'].includes(mode)) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'invalid mode' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, {
      ai_match_start_time: now,
      rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
    });

    return Response.json({ success: true, startTime: now });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/createPrivateMatch/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { getVersionInfo, checkClientVersion } from '../../shared/versionGate.ts';

function cosmeticsOf(u) {
  return {
    orbPattern: u.equipped_orb_pattern || 'default',
    stationSkin: u.equipped_station_skin || 'default',
    towerSkin: u.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
    leftTowerSkin: u.equipped_left_tower_skin || u.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
    rightTowerSkin: u.equipped_right_tower_skin || u.equipped_tower_skin || 'default',
    stationEmblem: u.equipped_station_emblem || 'default',
    leftTowerEmblem: u.equipped_left_tower_emblem || 'default',
    rightTowerEmblem: u.equipped_right_tower_emblem || 'default',
  };
}

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // EULA gate
    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    // Rate limit (matchmaking)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'matchmaking');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));

    // Version gate — reject outdated clients
    const versionInfo = await getVersionInfo(base44);
    const versionErr = checkClientVersion(body?.client_version, versionInfo.min_required_version);
    if (versionErr) return versionErr;

    const inviteId = body?.inviteId;
    if (!inviteId) return Response.json({ error: 'inviteId required' }, { status: 400 });

    const invite = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.get(inviteId);
    if (!invite) return Response.json({ error: 'not_found' }, { status: 404 });
    if (invite.to_user_id !== user.id) return Response.json({ error: 'forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
    if (invite.status !== 'pending') return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'not_pending' }, { status: 409 });

    // Expire stale invites (older than 60s)
    const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(invite.created_date).getTime();
    if (ageMs > 60000) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.update(inviteId, { status: 'expired' });
      return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'expired' }, { status: 410 });
    }

    const inviter = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(invite.from_user_id);
    const me = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(user.id);

    // Block check
    const myBlocked = Array.isArray(me.blocked_users) ? me.blocked_users : [];
    const inviterBlocked = Array.isArray(inviter.blocked_users) ? inviter.blocked_users : [];
    if (myBlocked.includes(inviter.id) || inviterBlocked.includes(user.id)) {
      return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'blocked' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    const seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647);
    const session = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.MatchSession.create({
      player_a_id: invite.from_user_id,
      player_b_id: user.id,
      player_a_name: invite.from_name || inviter.display_name || 'Player',
      player_b_name: me.display_name || 'Player',
      player_a_trophies: inviter.trophies || 0,
      player_b_trophies: me.trophies || 0,
      mode: 'private',
      status: 'starting',
      shared_seed: seed,
      events_a: [],
      events_b: [],
      heartbeat_a: 0,
      heartbeat_b: 0,
      hp_a: 120,
      hp_b: 120,
      ready_a: false,
      ready_b: false,
      cosmetics_a: cosmeticsOf(inviter),
      cosmetics_b: cosmeticsOf(me),
      game_time: 0,
    });

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.update(inviteId, {
      status: 'accepted',
      session_id: session.id,
    });

    // Persist rate limit counter
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      sessionId: session.id,
      seed,
      role: 'b',
      opponentId: invite.from_user_id,
      opponent: { name: invite.from_name || inviter.display_name || 'Player', trophies: inviter.trophies || 0 },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/openCrate/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { normalizeProfile, CRATE_TYPES, rollCrateRewards, applyCrateRewards, COIN_CAP } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const crateId = (body?.crateId || '').toString();
    const claimFree = !!body?.claimFree;
    if (!crateId || !CRATE_TYPES[crateId]) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid crate' }, { status: 400 });

    const crate = CRATE_TYPES[crateId];

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const p = normalizeProfile(u);

      // Payment validation
      if (claimFree) {
        if (crateId !== 'wooden') return { error: Response.json({ error: 'only wooden is free' }, { status: 400 }) };
        const today = todayStr();
        if (u.last_free_crate === today) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'already claimed today' }, { status: 400 }) };
        p.last_free_crate = today;
      } else {
        if (crate.currency === 'coins') {
          if ((p.coins || 0) < crate.cost) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough coins' }, { status: 400 }) };
          p.coins = (p.coins || 0) - crate.cost;
        } else if (crate.currency === 'gems') {
          if ((p.gems || 0) < crate.cost) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough gems' }, { status: 400 }) };
          p.gems = (p.gems || 0) - crate.cost;
        }
      }

      // Roll rewards server-side
      const items = rollCrateRewards(p, crate);
      const { profile: updated, perItem } = applyCrateRewards(p, items);

      const crates = u.crates_opened || { free: 0, gem: 0, shard: 0, purchased: 0 };
      const crateKey = claimFree ? 'free' : 'purchased';
      const patch = {
        coins: Math.min(COIN_CAP, updated.coins || 0),
        gems: updated.gems || 0,
        shards: updated.shards || 0,
        tower_cards: updated.tower_cards,
        ability_cards: updated.ability_cards,
        orb_cards: updated.orb_cards,
        owned_skins: updated.owned_skins,
        crates_opened: { ...crates, [crateKey]: (crates[crateKey] || 0) + 1 },
        rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
      };
      if (claimFree) patch.last_free_crate = updated.last_free_crate;

      return { patch, perItem };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      items: result.perItem,
      coins: result.patch.coins,
      gems: result.patch.gems,
      shards: result.patch.shards,
      tower_cards: result.patch.tower_cards,
      ability_cards: result.patch.ability_cards,
      orb_cards: result.patch.orb_cards,
      owned_skins: result.patch.owned_skins,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/submitReport/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Submit a report against another user. Side effects:
// 1. Creates a UserReport record for admin review.
// 2. Removes any existing Friendship between the pair.
// 3. Deletes pending FriendRequests in either direction.
// 4. Adds the reported user to the reporter's blocked_users array so
//    future friend requests and game invites from the reported user are rejected.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // Rate limit (social)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'social');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const reportedId = (body?.reportedId || '').toString().trim();
    const category = (body?.category || '').toString().trim();
    const description = (body?.description || '').toString().trim().slice(0, 500);

    if (!reportedId) return Response.json({ error: 'reportedId required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!category) return Response.json({ error: 'category required' }, { status: 400 });
    if (reportedId === user.id) return Response.json({ error: 'self' }, { status: 400 });

    const validCategories = ['harassment', 'cheating', 'inappropriate_name', 'spam', 'other'];
    if (!validCategories.includes(category)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_category' }, { status: 400 });

    // Fetch the reported user's display name for the audit record
    const reportedUser = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(reportedId).catch(() => null);
    const reportedName = reportedUser?.display_name || 'Player';

    // 1. Create the report record
    await base44.entities.UserReport.create({
      reporter_id: user.id,
      reported_id: reportedId,
      reported_name: reportedName,
      category,
      description,
      status: 'pending',
    });

    // 2. Remove any existing Friendship (both orderings)
    const [a, b] = [user.id, reportedId].sort();
    const friendships = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({
      $or: [
        { user_a_id: a, user_b_id: b },
        { user_a_id: b, user_b_id: a },
      ],
    });
    for (const f of friendships) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.delete(f.id).catch(() => {});
    }

    // 3. Delete pending FriendRequests in either direction
    const requests = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.filter({
      $or: [
        { from_user_id: user.id, to_user_id: reportedId, status: 'pending' },
        { from_user_id: reportedId, to_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' },
      ],
    });
    for (const r of requests) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.delete(r.id).catch(() => {});
    }

    // Also cancel any pending GameInvite between the pair
    const invites = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.filter({
      $or: [
        { from_user_id: user.id, to_user_id: reportedId, status: 'pending' },
        { from_user_id: reportedId, to_user_id: user.id, status: 'pending' },
      ],
    });
    for (const inv of invites) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.GameInvite.update(inv.id, { status: 'cancelled' }).catch(() => {});
    }

    // 4. Add reported user to the reporter's blocked_users array (avoid duplicates)
    const currentBlocked = Array.isArray(user.blocked_users) ? user.blocked_users : [];
    const updatePatch = { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits };
    if (!currentBlocked.includes(reportedId)) {
      updatePatch.blocked_users = [...currentBlocked, reportedId];
    }
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, updatePatch);

    return Response.json({ success: true, reportedName });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/upgradeHand/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { HAND_UPGRADE_COSTS, MAX_HAND_LEVEL } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const level = u.hand_level || 0;
      if (level >= MAX_HAND_LEVEL) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'hand maxed' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const cost = HAND_UPGRADE_COSTS[level] || 0;
      if ((u.shards || 0) < cost) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough shards' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newShards = (u.shards || 0) - cost;
      const newLevel = level + 1;
      return {
        patch: {
          shards: newShards,
          hand_level: newLevel,
          shards_spent: (u.shards_spent || 0) + cost,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ success: true, shards: result.patch.shards, hand_level: result.patch.hand_level });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/grantCurrency/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Admin-only: grant coins, gems, shards, or trophies to a player by username.
// Looks up the target via display_name (case-insensitive), then updates their
// balance using the service-role SDK (the admin acts on another user's record).
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const admin = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!admin) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    if (admin.role !== 'admin') return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const username = (body?.username || '').toString().trim();
    const currency = (body?.currency || '').toString().trim();
    const amount = Math.floor(Number(body?.amount));

    if (!username || !currency || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount === 0) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_input' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (!['coins', 'gems', 'shards', 'trophies'].includes(currency)) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_currency' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const users = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.list('-created_date', 500);
    const target = users.find((u) =>
      (u.display_name || '').toLowerCase() === username.toLowerCase()
    );
    if (!target) return Response.json({ error: 'user_not_found' }, { status: 404 });

    const current = target[currency] || 0;
    const next = Math.max(currency === 'trophies' ? 0 : 0, current + amount);
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(target.id, { [currency]: next });

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      username: target.display_name,
      currency,
      amount,
      newBalance: next,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/consumeMerge/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { secrets } from 'base44:runtime';
import { verifyAndUnpackBlob } from '../../shared/snapshot.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const blob = body?.blob;
    if (!blob) return Response.json({ error: 'Missing blob' }, { status: 400 });

    const secret = secrets.get('PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_SECRET');
    const payload = await verifyAndUnpackBlob(blob, secret);
    if (!payload) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid signature' }, { status: 403 });

    const { profile } = payload;
    if (!profile) return Response.json({ error: 'Invalid payload' }, { status: 400 });

    // Only merge onto a fresh Google account (no progress yet).
    const isExisting = user.onboarded || (user.wins > 0) || (user.losses > 0) || (user.trophies > 0);
    if (isExisting) {
      // Still mark the account as Google-linked even when no merge happens.
      // Log and surface failures instead of silently swallowing them.
      let googleLinked = true;
      try {
        await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { google_linked: true });
      } catch (linkError) {
        console.error('Failed to set google_linked on existing account:', linkError);
        googleLinked = false;
      }
      return Response.json({ success: false, reason: 'existing_account', google_linked: googleLinked });
    }

    // Apply the stashed profile fields server-side (trusted, signed data).
    const safeFields = [
      'display_name', 'trophies', 'wins', 'losses', 'win_streak',
      'coins', 'gems', 'shards', 'peak_trophies', 'games_since_shard',
      'achievements', 'new_achievements', 'claimed_achievements',
      'tower_cards', 'ability_cards', 'orb_cards',
      'unlocked_towers', 'unlocked_abilities',
      'selected_abilities', 'selected_towers', 'selected_orbs',
      'owned_skins', 'equipped_orb_pattern', 'equipped_station_skin',
      'equipped_tower_skin', 'equipped_left_tower_skin', 'equipped_right_tower_skin',
      'equipped_station_emblem', 'equipped_left_tower_emblem', 'equipped_right_tower_emblem',
      'hand_level', 'onboarded', 'tutorial_done',
      'login_days', 'total_seconds_played',
      'coins_spent', 'gems_spent', 'shards_spent',
      'last_free_crate', 'last_free_gem_crate', 'beta_gift_gems',
    ];
    const patch = {};
    for (const key of safeFields) {
      if (profile[key] !== undefined) patch[key] = profile[key];
    }
    // Don't overwrite the EULA acceptance on the new account
    delete patch.eula_accepted_version;
    delete patch.eula_accepted_date;

    // Mark this account as Google-linked (both merged and existing-account paths
    // indicate a Google-authenticated session).
    patch.google_linked = true;

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, patch);
    return Response.json({ success: true, merged: true });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/acceptEula/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    let body = {};
    try { body = await req.json(); } catch { /* no body */ }
    const version = (body && body.version) || "1.0";

    const userId = user.id;
    const userAgent = req.headers.get('user-agent') || 'unknown';
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    // Record the acceptance in the EulaAcceptance entity (audit trail)
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.EulaAcceptance.create({
      user_id: userId,
      version,
      accepted_date: now,
      user_agent: userAgent,
    });

    // Single atomic profile write: EULA fields + onboarded flag + onboarding
    // metadata (language, country, age gate). Doing this in one updateMe (vs.
    // a backend write followed by a separate client write) prevents a
    // read-modify-write race where the second write clobbers onboarded back
    // to false on a stale read — which would re-trigger onboarding after a
    // cache clear once the session guard is gone.
    const profilePatch = {
      eula_accepted_version: version,
      eula_accepted_date: now,
      onboarded: true,
    };
    if (body && typeof body.language === 'string') profilePatch.language = body.language;
    if (body && typeof body.country === 'string') profilePatch.country = body.country;
    if (body && typeof body.age_verified === 'boolean') profilePatch.age_verified = body.age_verified;
    if (body && typeof body.is_under_16 === 'boolean') profilePatch.is_under_16 = body.is_under_16;

    await base44.auth.updateMe(profilePatch);

    return Response.json({ success: true, version });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

========================================
FILE: base44/functions/finalizeAiMatch/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate, verifyAiMatchDuration, checkAiDailyWinCap } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import {
  normalizeProfile, getLeague, computeTrophyChange, pickAiOpponent,
  MATCH_REWARD_WIN, MATCH_REWARD_LOSS, SHARD_PER_WIN, SHARD_RANKED_STREAK_BONUS,
  checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks, checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks, checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks,
  evaluateAchievements, updateDailyMissions,
} from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const mode = (body?.mode || 'casual').toString();
    const outcome = (body?.outcome || 'loss').toString();
    const gameTime = Math.floor(Number(body?.gameTime) || 0);

    if (!['training', 'casual', 'ranked'].includes(mode)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid mode' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!['win', 'loss', 'forfeit'].includes(outcome)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid outcome' }, { status: 400 });

    const won = outcome === 'win';

    // Training mode: rate limit only, no rewards, no duration/cap verification
    if (mode === 'training') {
      const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
        const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'finalize');
        if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };
        return { patch: { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits } };
      });
      if (result.error) return result.error;

      const p = normalizeProfile(user);
      return Response.json({
        won, training: true, change: 0,
        oldTrophies: p.trophies || 0, newTrophies: p.trophies || 0,
        oldLeague: getLeague(p.trophies || 0), newLeague: getLeague(p.trophies || 0),
        promoted: false, demoted: false, shardDrop: false, shardCrateAmt: 0,
        orbUnlocks: [], towerUnlocks: [], achievementUnlocks: [], shardsEarned: 0,
      });
    }

    // Casual/Ranked: full verification
    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'finalize');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      // Verify match duration from server-tracked start time
      const durCheck = verifyAiMatchDuration(u);
      if (!durCheck.valid) {
        return { error: Response.json({ error: 'match_too_short', elapsed: durCheck.elapsed }, { status: 400 }) };
      }

      // Check daily AI win cap
      const capCheck = checkAiDailyWinCap(u, won);
      if (capCheck.exceeded) {
        return { error: Response.json({ error: 'daily_ai_win_cap_reached' }, { status: 429 }) };
      }

      const p = normalizeProfile(u);

      // Pick AI opponent server-side (player can't fake opponent trophies)
      const aiOpp = pickAiOpponent(p.trophies || 0);
      const opponentName = mode === 'casual' ? `Casual Bot · ${aiOpp.name}` : aiOpp.name;
      // Track the AI opponent's trophies to the player's actual trophies (±20
      // jitter) so ranked Elo swings stay fair regardless of league. The bot's
      // fixed trophy value (0/150/400/800/1400) would otherwise be hundreds off
      // the player's at Champion+, making losses cost ~27 and wins only +8.
      const opponentTrophies = Math.max(0, Math.round((p.trophies || 0) + (Math.random() * 40 - 20)));

      const isCasual = mode === 'casual';
      const oldTrophies = p.trophies || 0;
      const change = isCasual ? 0 : computeTrophyChange(oldTrophies, opponentTrophies, won);
      const newTrophies = isCasual ? oldTrophies : Math.max(0, oldTrophies + change);
      const oldLeague = getLeague(oldTrophies);
      const newLeague = getLeague(newTrophies);
      const promoted = newTrophies > oldTrophies && newLeague.id > oldLeague.id;
      const demoted = newTrophies < oldTrophies && newLeague.id < oldLeague.id;

      // Compute rewards
      const coinsEarned = won ? MATCH_REWARD_WIN : MATCH_REWARD_LOSS;
      let shardsEarned = won ? SHARD_PER_WIN : 0;
      if (won && mode === 'ranked' && ((p.win_streak || 0) + 1) % 3 === 0) shardsEarned += SHARD_RANKED_STREAK_BONUS;

      const update = {
        trophies: newTrophies,
        wins: (p.wins || 0) + (won ? 1 : 0),
        losses: (p.losses || 0) + (won ? 0 : 1),
        win_streak: won ? (p.win_streak || 0) + 1 : 0,
        coins: (p.coins || 0) + coinsEarned,
        shards: (p.shards || 0) + shardsEarned,
        peak_trophies: Math.max(p.peak_trophies || 0, newTrophies),
        last_match: new Date().toISOString(),
        total_seconds_played: (p.total_seconds_played || 0) + gameTime,
        ...capCheck.patch,
        rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
      };

      // Shard crate: every 4-5 ranked wins
      let shardDrop = false, shardCrateAmt = 0;
      if (won && mode === 'ranked') {
        const gamesSince = (p.games_since_shard || 0) + 1;
        let shouldTrigger = false;
        if (gamesSince >= 5) shouldTrigger = true;
        else if (gamesSince >= 4 && Math.random() < 0.7) shouldTrigger = true;
        if (shouldTrigger) {
          shardCrateAmt = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6);
          update.shards += shardCrateAmt;
          update.games_since_shard = 0;
          shardDrop = true;
        } else {
          update.games_since_shard = gamesSince;
        }
      }

      // Trophy milestone unlocks
      let orbUnlocks = [], towerUnlocks = [], abilityUnlocks = [];
      const orbCards = { ...(p.orb_cards || {}) };
      orbUnlocks = checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, orbCards);
      if (orbUnlocks.length > 0) {
        for (const id of orbUnlocks) orbCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
        update.orb_cards = orbCards;
      }
      const towerCards = { ...(p.tower_cards || {}) };
      towerUnlocks = checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, towerCards);
      if (towerUnlocks.length > 0) {
        for (const id of towerUnlocks) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
        update.tower_cards = towerCards;
        update.unlocked_towers = [...new Set([...(p.unlocked_towers || []), ...towerUnlocks])];
      }
      const abilityCards = { ...(p.ability_cards || {}) };
      abilityUnlocks = checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks(newTrophies, abilityCards);
      if (abilityUnlocks.length > 0) {
        for (const id of abilityUnlocks) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
        update.ability_cards = abilityCards;
        update.unlocked_abilities = [...new Set([...(p.unlocked_abilities || []), ...abilityUnlocks])];
      }

      // Achievements
      const updatedProfile = { ...p, ...update };
      const newAchievements = evaluateAchievements(updatedProfile, { won, mode });
      let achievementUnlocks = [];
      if (newAchievements.length > 0) {
        update.achievements = [...(p.achievements || []), ...newAchievements.map((a) => a.id)];
        update.new_achievements = [...(p.new_achievements || []), ...newAchievements.map((a) => a.id)];
        achievementUnlocks = newAchievements;
      }

      // Daily missions
      const { daily_missions: newMissions, bonusCoins: missionCoins } = updateDailyMissions(p, { won, mode });
      update.daily_missions = newMissions;
      if (missionCoins > 0) update.coins += missionCoins;

      return {
        patch: update,
        meta: {
          won, change, opponentName, opponentTrophies, oldTrophies, newTrophies,
          oldLeague, newLeague, promoted, demoted, shardDrop, shardCrateAmt,
          orbUnlocks, towerUnlocks, abilityUnlocks, achievementUnlocks, shardsEarned,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;

    const m = result.meta;
    // Create match record (best-effort)
    try {
      await base44.entities.MatchRecord.create({
        result: m.won ? 'win' : 'loss',
        opponent_name: m.opponentName,
        opponent_trophies: m.opponentTrophies,
        trophies_change: m.change,
        mode,
        duration_seconds: gameTime,
      });
    } catch (e) { /* best-effort */ }

    return Response.json({
      ...m,
      coins: result.patch.coins,
      shards: result.patch.shards,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';

function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const wantClaim = body.claim === true;
    const today = todayStr();
    const lastClaim = user.last_free_crate || null;
    const eligible = lastClaim !== today;

    if (!wantClaim) {
      return Response.json({ eligible, lastClaim });
    }

    // Claiming — use secure update with rate limit
    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const currentLast = u.last_free_crate || null;
      if (currentLast === today) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'already claimed today' }, { status: 400 }) };

      return {
        patch: {
          last_free_crate: today,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ eligible: false, lastClaim: today });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/exchangeGems/entry.ts

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { GEM_TO_COIN_RATE, GEM_EXCHANGE_OPTIONS, COIN_CAP } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const gemAmount = Math.floor(Number(body?.gemAmount));
    if (!Number.isFinite(gemAmount) || gemAmount <= 0) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid amount' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!GEM_EXCHANGE_OPTIONS.includes(gemAmount)) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid amount' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      if ((u.gems || 0) < gemAmount) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough gems' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newGems = (u.gems || 0) - gemAmount;
      const newCoins = Math.min(COIN_CAP, (u.coins || 0) + gemAmount * GEM_TO_COIN_RATE);
      return {
        patch: {
          gems: newGems,
          coins: newCoins,
          gems_spent: (u.gems_spent || 0) + gemAmount,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ success: true, gems: result.patch.gems, coins: result.patch.coins });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';

// Admin-only: updates the min_required_version and latest_version on the
// single AppConfig record. Creates the record if it doesn't exist yet.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });
    if (user.role !== 'admin') return Response.json({ error: 'Forbidden' }, { status: 403 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const minRequired = (body.min_required_version || "").toString().trim();
    const latest = (body.latest_version || "").toString().trim();

    if (!minRequired || !latest) {
      return Response.json({ error: 'invalid_input' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const configs = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AppConfig.list();
    if (configs.length === 0) {
      const created = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AppConfig.create({
        min_required_version: minRequired,
        latest_version: latest,
      });
      return Response.json({
        min_required_version: created.min_required_version,
        latest_version: created.latest_version,
      });
    }

    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.AppConfig.update(configs[0].id, {
      min_required_version: minRequired,
      latest_version: latest,
    });

    return Response.json({
      min_required_version: minRequired,
      latest_version: latest,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/setLoadout/entry.ts
========================================
import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import {
  normalizeProfile, TOWER_TYPES, ABILITIES, ORB_TYPES, SENDABLE_ORBS,
  TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE, ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE, ABILITY_LOADOUT_SIZE,
} from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const towers = Array.isArray(body?.towers) ? body.towers : [];
    const orbs = Array.isArray(body?.orbs) ? body.orbs : [];
    const abilities = Array.isArray(body?.abilities) ? body.abilities : [];

    if (towers.length < 1 || towers.length > TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid tower count' }, { status: 400 });
    if (orbs.length < 1 || orbs.length > ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid orb count' }, { status: 400 });
    if (abilities.length !== ABILITY_LOADOUT_SIZE) return Response.json({ error: 'must pick 3 abilities' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'cosmetic');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const p = normalizeProfile(u);

      for (const id of towers) {
        if (typeof id !== 'string' || !TOWER_TYPES[id]) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'invalid tower' }, { status: 400 }) };
        if ((p.tower_cards[id]?.level || 0) < 1) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'tower not unlocked' }, { status: 400 }) };
      }
      for (const id of orbs) {
        if (typeof id !== 'string' || !SENDABLE_ORBS.includes(id) || !ORB_TYPES[id]) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'invalid orb' }, { status: 400 }) };
        if ((p.orb_cards[id]?.level || 0) < 1) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'orb not unlocked' }, { status: 400 }) };
      }
      for (const id of abilities) {
        if (typeof id !== 'string' || !ABILITIES[id]) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'invalid ability' }, { status: 400 }) };
        if ((p.ability_cards[id]?.level || 0) < 1) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'ability not unlocked' }, { status: 400 }) };
      }

      if (new Set(towers).size !== towers.length) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'duplicate tower' }, { status: 400 }) };
      if (new Set(orbs).size !== orbs.length) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'duplicate orb' }, { status: 400 }) };
      if (new Set(abilities).size !== abilities.length) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'duplicate ability' }, { status: 400 }) };

      return {
        patch: {
          selected_towers: towers,
          selected_orbs: orbs,
          selected_abilities: abilities,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      selected_towers: result.patch.selected_towers,
      selected_orbs: result.patch.selected_orbs,
      selected_abilities: result.patch.selected_abilities,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse } from '../../shared/security.ts';

// Accept a pending friend request addressed to the caller. Creates a mutual
// Friendship record (user ids stored sorted so the pair is unique) and deletes
// the request. Runs as service role so the Friendship can be created with both
// party ids regardless of which user is "a" or "b".
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    // Rate limit (social)
    const rl = checkRateLimit(user, 'social');
    if (rl.exceeded) return rateLimitResponse();

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const requestId = body?.requestId;
    if (!requestId) return Response.json({ error: 'requestId required' }, { status: 400 });

    const request = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.get(requestId);
    if (!request) return Response.json({ error: 'not_found' }, { status: 404 });
    if (request.to_user_id !== user.id) return Response.json({ error: 'forbidden' }, { status: 403 });
    if (request.status !== 'pending') return Response.json({ success: false, error: 'not_pending' }, { status: 409 });

    const [a, b] = [request.from_user_id, request.to_user_id].sort();
    const fromUser = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.get(request.from_user_id);

    // Idempotent: if friendship already exists, just clean up the request
    const existing = await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.filter({
      $or: [{ user_a_id: a, user_b_id: b }, { user_a_id: b, user_b_id: a }],
    });
    if (existing.length === 0) {
      await base44.asServiceRole.entities.Friendship.create({
        user_a_id: a,
        user_b_id: b,
        user_a_name: a === request.from_user_id ? (request.from_name || 'Player') : (user.display_name || 'Player'),
        user_b_name: b === request.to_user_id ? (user.display_name || 'Player') : (request.from_name || 'Player'),
        status: 'active',
      });
    }
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.FriendRequest.delete(requestId);

    // Persist rate limit counter
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.User.update(user.id, { rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits });

    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      friend: { id: fromUser.id, name: fromUser.display_name || 'Player', trophies: fromUser.trophies || 0 },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { secrets } from 'base44:runtime';
import { signBlob, generateNonce } from '../../shared/snapshot.ts';

export default async function(req) {

    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const fingerprint = body.fingerprint || {};
    const secret = secrets.get('PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_SECRET');

    // Read the user's current server-side profile (trusted, not client-supplied)
    const profile = {
      display_name: user.display_name,
      trophies: user.trophies || 0,
      wins: user.wins || 0,
      losses: user.losses || 0,
      win_streak: user.win_streak || 0,
      coins: user.coins || 0,
      gems: user.gems || 0,

      sound_enabled: user.sound_enabled,
      sound_categories: user.sound_categories,
      haptics_enabled: user.haptics_enabled,
      haptics_intensity: user.haptics_intensity,
      advanced_haptics_enabled: user.advanced_haptics_enabled,
      tower_menu_anytime: user.tower_menu_anytime,
      games_since_shard: user.games_since_shard || 0,
      hand_level: user.hand_level || 0,
      onboarded: user.onboarded,
      tutorial_done: user.tutorial_done,
      owned_skins: user.owned_skins || [],
      equipped_orb_pattern: user.equipped_orb_pattern,
      equipped_station_skin: user.equipped_station_skin,
      equipped_tower_skin: user.equipped_tower_skin,
      equipped_left_tower_skin: user.equipped_left_tower_skin,
      equipped_right_tower_skin: user.equipped_right_tower_skin,
      equipped_station_emblem: user.equipped_station_emblem,
      equipped_left_tower_emblem: user.equipped_left_tower_emblem,
      equipped_right_tower_emblem: user.equipped_right_tower_emblem,
      last_free_crate: user.last_free_crate,
      last_free_gem_crate: user.last_free_gem_crate,
      beta_gift_gems: user.beta_gift_gems,
      achievements: user.achievements || [],
      new_achievements: user.new_achievements || [],
      claimed_achievements: user.claimed_achievements || [],
      tower_cards: user.tower_cards || {},
      ability_cards: user.ability_cards || {},
      orb_cards: user.orb_cards || {},
      unlocked_towers: user.unlocked_towers || [],
      unlocked_abilities: user.unlocked_abilities || [],
      selected_abilities: user.selected_abilities || [],
      selected_towers: user.selected_towers || [],
      selected_orbs: user.selected_orbs || [],
      login_days: user.login_days || [],
      total_seconds_played: user.total_seconds_played || 0,
      coins_spent: user.coins_spent || 0,
      gems_spent: user.gems_spent || 0,
      shards_spent: user.shards_spent || 0,
    };

    const nonce = generateNonce();
    const payload = {
      profile,
      oldUserId: user.id,
      fingerprint,
      nonce,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    const blob = await signBlob(payload, secret);

    // Upsert: delete any existing snapshot for this user, then create the new one.
    // One record per user — no history accumulates.
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.deleteMany({ user_id: user.id });
    await base44.asServiceRole.entities.ProfileSnapshot.create({
      user_id: user.id,
      blob,
      nonce,
      consumed: false,
    });

    return Response.json({ blob });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { SKIN_CATALOGS, REMOVED_SKINS } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    const category = (body?.category || '').toString();
    const skinId = (body?.skinId || '').toString();
    if (!category || !skinId) return Response.json({ error: 'category and skinId required' }, { status: 400 });

    const catalog = SKIN_CATALOGS[category];
    if (!catalog) return Response.json({ error: 'invalid category' }, { status: 400 });
    const skin = catalog[skinId];
    if (!skin) return Response.json({ error: 'skin not found' }, { status: 400 });
    if (skin.source !== 'shop') return Response.json({ error: 'skin not purchasable' }, { status: 400 });
    if (REMOVED_SKINS.includes(skinId)) return Response.json({ error: 'skin removed' }, { status: 400 });

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const owned = Array.isArray(u.owned_skins) ? u.owned_skins : [];
      if (owned.includes(skinId)) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'already owned' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const price = skin.price || 0;
      if ((u.gems || 0) < price) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough gems' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newGems = (u.gems || 0) - price;
      const newOwned = [...owned, skinId];
      return {
        patch: {
          gems: newGems,
          owned_skins: newOwned,
          gems_spent: (u.gems_spent || 0) + price,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({
      success: true,
      gems: result.patch.gems,
      owned_skins: result.patch.owned_skins,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';

function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// Daily gem chest for beta players: once per calendar day, grants 10–60 gems.
export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const today = todayStr();
    const lastClaim = user.last_free_gem_crate || null;
    const eligible = lastClaim !== today;

    const body = await req.json().catch(() => ({}));
    if (body.claim !== true) {
      return Response.json({ eligible, lastClaim });
    }

    // Claiming — secure update with optimistic concurrency
    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const currentLast = u.last_free_gem_crate || null;
      if (currentLast === today) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'already claimed today' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const gems = 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 51); // 10–60 inclusive
      const crates = u.crates_opened || { free: 0, gem: 0, shard: 0, purchased: 0 };
      return {
        patch: {
          last_free_gem_crate: today,
          gems: (u.gems || 0) + gems,
          crates_opened: { ...crates, gem: (crates.gem || 0) + 1 },
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        },
        granted: gems,
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ eligible: false, granted: result.granted });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FILE: base44/functions/upgradeSideTower/entry.ts
