import { createClientFromRequest } from 'npm:@base44/sdk@0.8.40';
import { checkEula, checkRateLimit, rateLimitResponse, secureUpdate } from '../../shared/security.ts';
import { SIDE_TOWER_UPGRADE_COSTS, MAX_SIDE_TOWER_LEVEL } from '../../shared/gameLogic.ts';

export default async function(req) {
  try {
    const base44 = createClientFromRequest(req);
    const user = await base44.auth.me();
    if (!user) return Response.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });

    const eulaErr = checkEula(user);
    if (eulaErr) return eulaErr;

    const result = await secureUpdate(base44, user.id, (u) => {
      const rl = checkRateLimit(u, 'economy');
      if (rl.exceeded) return { error: rateLimitResponse() };

      const level = u.side_tower_level || 0;
      if (level >= MAX_SIDE_TOWER_LEVEL) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'side tower maxed' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const cost = SIDE_TOWER_UPGRADE_COSTS[level] || 0;
      if ((u.shards || 0) < cost) return { error: Response.json({ error: 'not enough shards' }, { status: 400 }) };

      const newShards = (u.shards || 0) - cost;
      const newLevel = level + 1;
      return {
        patch: {
          shards: newShards,
          side_tower_level: newLevel,
          shards_spent: (u.shards_spent || 0) + cost,
          rate_limits: rl.newRateLimits,
        }
      };
    });

    if (result.error) return result.error;
    return Response.json({ success: true, shards: result.patch.shards, side_tower_level: result.patch.side_tower_level });
  } catch (error) {
    return Response.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

# Closed Beta Distribution — 20playtesters.com + Google Play

> Run Google Play's **Closed Testing** track and share the opt-in link with your 20playtesters.com cohort.

---

## Step 1 — Create a closed testing track
1. Play Console → your app → **Testing → Closed testing**.
2. Create a new closed track named **"Closed Beta"**.
3. Tester distribution: **Email list (closed testing)** — add up to 100 tester emails.
   - 20playtesters.com typically provides ~20 testers; the email-list method (cap 100) is the right fit.
4. Upload your signed `.aab` (see `docs/play-beta-build.md`) and roll out the release to this track.

## Step 2 — Get the opt-in link
- Once the release is active, the Play Console shows an opt-in URL:
  ```
  https://play.google.com/apps/testing/<your-package-id>
  ```
- Share this link with your 20playtesters.com testers.
- Testers must join with the Google account whose email you added to the list.

## Step 3 — 20playtesters.com campaign setup
1. Create a test campaign on **20playtesters.com**.
2. Paste the Google Play opt-in link as the build distribution method.
3. Add your **test brief**:
   - **Focus areas:** matchmaking balance, onboarding clarity, crash/ANR reports, control feel (click accuracy, tower placement), economy pacing.
   - **Duration:** 1–2 weeks.
   - **Feedback instructions:** use the 20playtesters dashboard for structured reports; use the in-game report flow for conduct issues.
4. 20playtesters recruits and coordinates the cohort; you receive feedback through their dashboard.

## Step 4 — In-app tester onboarding (already built)
The beta build already includes:
- A one-time **beta-welcome popup** (200-gem gift + pointer to the daily shop crate) — `src/components/BetaWelcomePopup.jsx`.
- **Daily free crate** + **daily gem crate** in the Shop — `base44/functions/claimDailyCrate`, `claimDailyGemCrate`.
- **In-game report flow** (Settings / profile) for bugs and conduct — `src/components/ReportUserDialog.jsx`, `base44/functions/submitReport`.

Recommend testers use the 20playtesters.com channel for structured bug reports and the in-game report for player-conduct issues.

## Step 5 — Monitor & iterate
- Watch the **Play Console pre-launch report** (automated tests on real devices).
- Track **crashes / ANRs** in Play Console → Android Vitals.
- Collect 20playtesters feedback, triage, and push fixes as a new closed-track release.
- Keep `AppConfig.min_required_version` at or below the current beta tag so testers aren't force-blocked (currently `1.1.0` ✅).

## Tester cap considerations
- **Email-list closed testing:** up to 100 testers per list — sufficient for a 20playtesters cohort.
- If you later exceed 100, switch to **Google Group closed testing** (unlimited via group opt-in) and update the 20playtesters campaign link.

# Beta Build & Version Config — Splitter Orbs

> How to produce the signed Android App Bundle (.aab) for the Google Play closed beta, and the version gate that keeps testers on the supported build.

---

## 1. Version tag

| Where | Value | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Client — `src/lib/appVersion.js` → `APP_VERSION` | `1.1.0-beta` | ✅ set |
| Server — `AppConfig.min_required_version` | `1.1.0` | ✅ already set |
| Server — `AppConfig.latest_version` | `1.1.0` | ✅ already set |

The version compare (`src/lib/versionCompare.js`) splits on `.` and maps non-numeric segments to `0`, so `1.1.0-beta` compares as `1.1.0` and **passes the force-update gate** — beta testers are not blocked. No `AppConfig` change is needed for the beta.

Update `PLAY_STORE_URL` in `src/lib/appVersion.js` once the Play listing is live (used by the force-update overlay on native builds).

---

## 2. Generate the Android App Bundle (.aab)

Base44 wraps your published web app in a native TWA and produces the .aab:

1. Editor → **Publish** (top-right) → **Mobile app** tab.
2. **Check Your App** → **Run App Scan** → **Google Play guidelines**; fix any flagged issues (Apply / Fix with AI).
3. **Build Store Files** → **Create Google Play files**.
4. Upload your app logo (512×512 PNG) — derive it from `public/icon.svg` (minimalist white + colorful accent).
5. *(Optional)* toggle **Add push notifications** if you want native push (the `SendPushNotification` integration is already available server-side).
6. **Generate Files** → **Download** the `.aab`.

### Package name
```
com.base<app-id>.app
```
Replace `<app-id>` with your Base44 app ID (from the editor URL). Register this exact package in the Play Console.

### Google login SHA fingerprint — important (this app uses Google OAuth)
The app offers Google sign-in during onboarding. After the first .aab upload, Google Play signs the app with its own key:

1. Play Console → **Setup → App integrity** → copy the **SHA-256 fingerprint**.
2. Base44 editor → **Mobile app** tab → **More Actions → Add Google Play SHA** → paste the fingerprint.

Without this, Google login will fail on the installed build.

---

## 3. App signing
- Use **Google Play App Signing** (recommended): upload the .aab and let Google manage the app-signing key.
- If you have an existing upload key, use it; otherwise let Play generate one on first upload.

---

## 4. Closed testing track upload
1. Play Console → your app → **Testing → Closed testing** → **Create release**.
2. Upload the `.aab`.
3. Add the tester email list (your 20playtesters.com cohort) — see `docs/play-closed-beta-distribution.md`.
4. Review the release → **Roll out** to the closed track.
5. Copy the opt-in link and share it with testers.

---

## 5. Iterating during beta
- **Content / design changes** go live **without a new store submission** — the TWA loads your published Base44 web app, so fixes ship instantly via **Publish**.
- **Native changes** (permissions, icon, package, push) require a new .aab upload to the closed track.
- Bump `APP_VERSION` for each meaningful beta update so the soft-update banner can prompt testers to reload.

---

## 6. Visual assets needed before build
- **512×512 PNG icon** — upload to the Base44 build + Play Console. Derive from `public/icon.svg`.
- **1024×500 feature graphic** — minimalist white with the "Splitter Orbs" wordmark + two orbs + wall motif.
- **3–5 screenshots** — use the in-app tool at **`/screenshot-tool`** to add uniform overlays to your screenshots.

---

## 7. Pre-launch scan checklist
- [ ] App Scan (Google Play guidelines) passed in the Base44 editor
- [ ] 512×512 icon uploaded to the build
- [ ] .aab downloaded
- [ ] Google Play SHA-256 fingerprint added back to Base44 (for Google login)
- [ ] Closed testing release rolled out
- [ ] Opt-in link shared with 20playtesters.com

## A. Data Safety form

### Does your app collect or share user data?
**Yes** — the app collects the following data types. **No data is shared with third parties.**

### 1. Personal info → Email address
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Collected | Yes |
| Shared | No |
| Encrypted in transit | Yes |

| Field | Value |

| Shared | No |

### 3. App activity → Game progress and stats
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Collected | Yes (trophies, wins, losses, currency, card levels, login streaks) |
| Shared | No |
| Encrypted in transit | Yes |
| Use | Gameplay progression and matchmaking |
| Required | Yes |

### 4. App activity → Match history
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Collected | Yes (opponent name, result, trophy change) |
| Shared | No |
| Encrypted in transit | Yes |
| Use | Player profile and stats |
| Required | Yes |

### 5. App activity → Friends list & game invites
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Collected | Yes |
| Shared | No |
| Encrypted in transit | Yes |
| Use | Social features |
| Required | Optional |

### 6. Device or other IDs → Device fingerprint hash
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Collected | Yes (cryptographic hash of screen resolution, timezone, canvas render hash) |
| Shared | No |
| Encrypted in transit | Yes |
| Use | Fraud prevention and secure profile restoration |
| Required | Yes (automatic) |

### Data NOT collected
- No location data
- No contacts
- No photos or videos
- No audio files
- No financial info
- No health data
- No web browsing history
- No installed-app inventory

### Data sharing
- **No data is shared with third parties.**
- **No advertising SDKs are used.**
- **No analytics providers receive user data.**

### Data encryption
- All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS / TLS).

### Data deletion
- Users can request deletion via **Settings → "Delete account"** (GDPR Art. 17).
- Device fingerprint hashes are deleted when a profile snapshot is consumed or after 90 days of inactivity.

# Native-Android & Google Play Readiness Audit — Splitter Orbs

> Audit of the web/PWA codebase against Google Play's closed-beta requirements and native-Android best practices. Findings are grouped as **Pass**, **Recommended**, and **Blocker**.

---

## 1. Pass (already in place)

| Check | Where | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Portrait orientation lock | `src/App.jsx` — `window.screen.orientation.lock("portrait")` | ✅ |
| Viewport locked, no zoom | `index.html` — `viewport-fit=cover, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no` | ✅ |
| Overscroll / pull-to-refresh disabled | `src/index.css` — `overscroll-behavior: none` on html/body/#root | ✅ |
| Text selection disabled (game) | `src/index.css` — `user-select: none` (re-enabled for inputs) | ✅ |
| 44px min touch targets | Game HUD buttons use `min-h-[44px]` | ✅ |
| Service worker registered (production) | `src/main.jsx` — `navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js')` | ✅ |
| SW update → re-check version gate | `src/App.jsx` — `controllerchange` listener → `recheckVersion()` | ✅ |
| Force-update / soft-update gate | `src/lib/AuthContext.jsx` — `checkVersion()` vs `AppConfig` | ✅ |
| GDPR age gate | `src/lib/ageGate.js` + onboarding | ✅ |
| EULA acceptance flow | `src/pages/Eula.jsx`, `base44/functions/acceptEula` | ✅ |
| Privacy policy (in-app, public) | `src/pages/PrivacyPolicy.jsx` at `/privacy` (viewable pre-auth) | ✅ |
| Impressum (§5 TMG) | `src/pages/Impressum.jsx` at `/impressum` | ✅ |
| Account deletion (GDPR Art. 17) | Settings → Delete account (`base44/functions/deleteAccount`) | ✅ |
| Ban / conduct moderation | `BannedOverlay`, `submitReport`, `banUser` | ✅ |
| No advertising SDKs | No ad packages in `package.json` | ✅ |
| No analytics data sharing | Only internal `base44.analytics.track` events | ✅ |
| Theme color set | `index.html` — `theme-color #ffffff` | ✅ |
| Standalone-only play gate | `src/App.jsx` — `isStandalone` check (PWA / native) | ✅ |

---

## 2. Recommended (fix before or shortly after beta)

### R1. Safe-area / notch insets not applied
- **Finding:** `src/index.css` has no `env(safe-area-inset-*)` usage. On notched Android devices, the top status bar and bottom nav gesture area may overlap HUD elements.
- **Fix:** Add safe-area padding to the main layout container, e.g. `padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top); padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);` in `src/components/MainLayout.jsx`, and ensure the game canvas accounts for insets.
- **Priority:** Medium — affects modern Android devices.

### R2. Verify `public/manifest.json` is present and valid
- **Finding:** `index.html` links to `/manifest.json`; confirm the file exists at `public/manifest.json` with `name`, `short_name`, `start_url`, `display: standalone`, `orientation: portrait`, `theme_color`, `background_color`, and icon set (192px + 512px).
- **Fix:** If missing, regenerate from the Base44 PWA defaults; ensure `display: standalone` so the Play Store TWA wrapper installs correctly.
- **Priority:** High — required for installability.

### R3. App icon set for the PWA / TWA
- **Finding:** `index.html` currently uses an inline SVG data-URI favicon. For the Play Store you need a 512×512 PNG icon and a 1024×500 feature graphic (see `docs/play-beta-build.md`).
- **Fix:** Generate the 512×512 icon (minimalist white + colorful accent) and reference it in the manifest; upload the feature graphic to the Play Console.
- **Priority:** High — required for the listing.

### R4. Target SDK / 64-bit (native wrapper only)
- **Finding:** This is a PWA delivered via Base44's native build. The Base44 native build sets the target SDK and 64-bit ABI automatically. Confirm in the generated `.aab` that `targetSdkVersion ≥ 34` and both `arm64-v8a` and `x86_64` ABIs are included.
- **Priority:** High — Play Store requirement.

### R5. No background location / SMS / call-log permissions
- **Finding:** The web app declares no native permissions. Confirm the native wrapper's `AndroidManifest.xml` does not request `ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION`, `READ_SMS`, `READ_CALL_LOG`, etc. (Base44's default TWA manifest should be clean).
- **Priority:** High — forbidden permissions trigger Play review delays.

---

## 3. Blockers (must fix before submission)

None identified — the codebase is Play-ready pending the **Recommended** items above (icon, feature graphic, manifest verification, safe-area insets).

---

## 4. Known beta limitations (called out in release notes)

These are existing gameplay issues, not launch blockers, and are disclosed to testers in the beta release notes:
- Shadow orb stealth has no fog/reveal visual cue in the canvas.
- Ranked matchmaking may select random-tier bots, causing unfair trophy swings.
- Some unlocked emblems do not display correctly in the collection/profile.

---

## 5. Pre-launch checklist (Play Console)

- [ ] Store listing copy pasted (`docs/play-store-listing.md`)
- [ ] 512×512 icon + 1024×500 feature graphic uploaded
- [ ] 3–5 screenshots with uniform overlays (use `/screenshot-tool`)
- [ ] Data Safety form filled (`docs/play-data-safety.md` §A)
- [ ] Content rating questionnaire completed (`docs/play-data-safety.md` §B)
- [ ] Privacy policy URL set (live `/privacy` route)
- [ ] Target audience & content set (13+, no UGC beyond names)
- [ ] Closed testing track created + .aab uploaded (`docs/play-beta-build.md`)
- [ ] Opt-in link shared with 20playtesters.com (`docs/play-closed-beta-distribution.md`)
- [ ] `AppConfig.min_required_version` ≤ current beta tag (currently 1.1.0 ✅)

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/toaster"
import { QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { queryClientInstance } from '@/lib/query-client'
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Route, Routes, Navigate, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import PageTransition from '@/components/PageTransition';
import PageNotFound from './lib/PageNotFound';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from '@/lib/AuthContext';
import UserNotRegisteredError from '@/components/UserNotRegisteredError';
import ScrollToTop from './components/ScrollToTop';
// Add page imports here
import MainLayout from '@/components/MainLayout';
import Home from '@/pages/Home';
import PreGameSetup from '@/pages/PreGameSetup';
import Game from '@/pages/Game';
import Shop from '@/pages/Shop';
import Collection from '@/pages/Collection';
import Leaderboard from '@/pages/Leaderboard';
import Settings from '@/pages/Settings';
import Friends from '@/pages/Friends';
import Admin from '@/pages/Admin';
import GameErrorBoundary from '@/components/GameErrorBoundary';
import { LanguageProvider } from '@/i18n/LanguageContext';
import Landing from '@/pages/Landing';
import PrivacyPolicy from '@/pages/PrivacyPolicy';
import Eula from '@/pages/Eula';
import Impressum from '@/pages/Impressum';
import ForceUpdateOverlay from '@/components/ForceUpdateOverlay';
import SoftUpdateBanner from '@/components/SoftUpdateBanner';
import BannedOverlay from '@/components/BannedOverlay';
import ScreenshotTool from '@/pages/ScreenshotTool';
import Login from '@/pages/Login';
import Register from '@/pages/Register';
import ForgotPassword from '@/pages/ForgotPassword';
import ResetPassword from '@/pages/ResetPassword';
import ProtectedRoute from '@/components/ProtectedRoute';
import WelcomeScreen from '@/components/WelcomeScreen';
import { useImmersiveEntry } from '@/hooks/useImmersive';
import BootLoader from '@/components/BootLoader';

const AuthenticatedApp = () => {
  const { isLoadingAuth, isLoadingPublicSettings, authError, navigateToLogin, versionStatus, versionInfo, recheckVersion, dismissUpdatePrompt, banStatus } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  // Hide the OS status bar on Android by entering fullscreen on the first tap.
  useImmersiveEntry();

  // Service Worker update listener: when a new SW takes control, re-check the
  // version gate in case a force-update landed while the app was open.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return;
    const handler = () => recheckVersion();
    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener("controllerchange", handler);
    return () => navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener("controllerchange", handler);
  }, [recheckVersion]);

  // Show loading spinner while checking app public settings or auth
  if (isLoadingPublicSettings || isLoadingAuth) {
    return <BootLoader />;
  }

  // Handle authentication errors
  if (authError) {
    if (authError.type === 'user_not_registered') {
      return <UserNotRegisteredError />;
    } else if (authError.type === 'auth_required') {
      // Redirect to login automatically
      navigateToLogin();
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Render the main app with smooth page-transition slide effects
  return (
    <>
    <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
      <Routes location={location} key={["/", "/shop", "/collection", "/leaderboard"].includes(location.pathname) ? "tabs" : location.pathname}>
        {/* Public auth routes */}
        <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
        <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />
        <Route path="/forgot-password" element={<ForgotPassword />} />
        <Route path="/reset-password" element={<ResetPassword />} />
        {/* Public legal pages (reviewable without an account) */}
        <Route path="/privacy" element={<PageTransition><PrivacyPolicy /></PageTransition>} />
        <Route path="/impressum" element={<PageTransition><Impressum /></PageTransition>} />
        <Route path="/eula" element={<PageTransition><Eula /></PageTransition>} />
        {/* Protected app pages — unauthenticated users see the Welcome entry */}
        <Route element={<ProtectedRoute unauthenticatedElement={<WelcomeScreen />} />}>
          <Route element={<MainLayout />}>
            <Route path="/" element={<PageTransition><Home /></PageTransition>} />
            <Route path="/shop" element={<PageTransition><Shop /></PageTransition>} />
            <Route path="/collection" element={<PageTransition><Collection /></PageTransition>} />
            <Route path="/leaderboard" element={<PageTransition><Leaderboard /></PageTransition>} />
            <Route path="/achievements" element={<Navigate to="/leaderboard" replace />} />
            <Route path="/settings" element={<PageTransition><Settings /></PageTransition>} />
            <Route path="/friends" element={<PageTransition><Friends /></PageTransition>} />
          </Route>
          <Route path="/admin" element={<PageTransition><Admin /></PageTransition>} />
          <Route path="/setup" element={<PageTransition><PreGameSetup /></PageTransition>} />
          <Route path="/game" element={<GameErrorBoundary><PageTransition><Game /></PageTransition></GameErrorBoundary>} />
          <Route path="/screenshot-tool" element={<PageTransition><ScreenshotTool /></PageTransition>} />
        </Route>
        <Route path="*" element={<PageTransition><PageNotFound /></PageTransition>} />
      </Routes>
    </AnimatePresence>
    {versionStatus === "force" && <ForceUpdateOverlay minRequired={versionInfo?.min_required_version} />}
    {versionStatus === "soft" && <SoftUpdateBanner latestVersion={versionInfo?.latest_version} onDismiss={dismissUpdatePrompt} />}
    {banStatus && <BannedOverlay reason={banStatus.reason} banUntil={banStatus.banUntil} />}
    </>
  );
};


function App() {
  // Browser hard-block: only allow play in installed PWA or native app.
  // Bypass in dev mode or iframe (Base44 builder preview) so the app remains previewable.
  const inIframe = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.self !== window.top;
  // Detect installed/native app context so the Play Store build enters the game
  // directly instead of the promotional Landing page. Browsers with none of
  // these signals still see the Landing page.
  const _ua = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? (window.navigator?.userAgent || '') : '';
  const _referrer = typeof document !== 'undefined' ? (document.referrer || '') : '';
  // Broadened WebView detection: matches the `wv` token, a literal `WebView`
  // string, or the `Version/x.x`-without-`wv` fallback per Chrome's documented
  // WebView UA forms — survives UA reduction or a wrapper that strips `wv`.
  const _isAndroidWebView = /Android.*?(wv|WebView)|Version\/\d+\.\d+/.test(_ua);
  const _isTwa = /android-app:\/\//.test(_referrer);
  const isStandalone = import.meta.env.DEV || inIframe ||
    (typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window.matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)')?.matches || window.navigator?.standalone === true)) ||
    _isAndroidWebView || _isTwa;

  // System dark-mode sync: follow the OS color scheme by toggling the 'dark' class.
  useEffect(() => {
    const mq = window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)");
    const apply = () => document.documentElement.classList.toggle("dark", mq.matches);
    apply();
    mq.addEventListener("change", apply);
    return () => mq.removeEventListener("change", apply);
  }, []);

  // Lock orientation to portrait on mobile (no-op where the API is unsupported)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof window !== "undefined" && window.screen?.orientation?.lock) {
      window.screen.orientation.lock("portrait").catch(() => {});
    }
  }, []);

  // Allow the privacy policy to be viewed in browser mode (app store review / DSGVO).
  const isPublicRoute = typeof window !== 'undefined' && ['/privacy', '/impressum', '/eula'].includes(window.location.pathname);

  if (!isStandalone && isPublicRoute) {
    return (
      <LanguageProvider>
        {window.location.pathname === '/privacy' ? <PrivacyPolicy /> : window.location.pathname === '/impressum' ? <Impressum /> : <Eula />}
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
  }

  if (!isStandalone) {
    return (
      <LanguageProvider>
        <Landing />
      </LanguageProvider>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthProvider>
      <LanguageProvider>
        <QueryClientProvider client={queryClientInstance}>
          <Router>
            <ScrollToTop />
            <AuthenticatedApp />
          </Router>
          <Toaster />
        </QueryClientProvider>
      </LanguageProvider>
    </AuthProvider>
  )
}

export default App

FILE: src/components/OnboardingOverlay.jsx

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ExternalLink, Shield } from "lucide-react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import GoogleLinkDialog from "@/components/GoogleLinkDialog";
import { CURRENT_EULA_VERSION } from "@/lib/eulaVersion";
import { SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES, calculateAge } from "@/lib/ageGate";
import DobPicker from "@/components/DobPicker";

export default function OnboardingOverlay({ me, onDone }) {
  const { t, setLang } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);
  const [selectedCountry, setSelectedCountry] = useState(null);
  const [username, setUsername] = useState(me?.display_name && me.display_name !== "Player" ? me.display_name : "");
  const [nameState, setNameState] = useState("idle"); // idle | checking | available | taken | inappropriate | error
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [showGoogleDialog, setShowGoogleDialog] = useState(false);
  const [eulaAccepted, setEulaAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [dob, setDob] = useState({ day: "", month: "", year: "" });
  const [ageError, setAgeError] = useState(null);
  const [submitError, setSubmitError] = useState(null);

  const checkName = async () => {
    if (!username.trim() || nameState === "checking") return;
    setNameState("checking");
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("setDisplayName", { name: username.trim() });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success) setNameState("available");
      else if (r?.error === "name_taken") setNameState("taken");
      else if (r?.error === "name_inappropriate") setNameState("inappropriate");
      else setNameState("error");
    } catch (e) {
      setNameState("error");
    }
  };

  const handleCountryNext = () => {
    if (!selectedCountry) return;
    const country = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === selectedCountry);
    if (country) setLang(country.lang);
    setStep(2);
  };

  const handleAgeSubmit = async () => {
    setAgeError(null);
    const d = parseInt(dob.day, 10);
    const m = parseInt(dob.month, 10);
    const y = parseInt(dob.year, 10);
    if (!d || !m || !y || y < 1900 || y > new Date().getFullYear()) {
      setAgeError("dob");
      return;
    }
    if (!eulaAccepted) {
      setAgeError("eula");
      return;
    }

    const age = calculateAge({ day: d, month: m, year: y });
    const threshold = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === selectedCountry)?.threshold || 16;

    if (age < threshold) {
      // Under-threshold: hard block — user cannot proceed
      setStep("blocked");
    } else {
      // At/above threshold: proceed to username step
      setStep(3);
    }
  };

  const handleContinue = async () => {
    if (nameState !== "available" || !eulaAccepted || saving) return;
    setSaving(true);
    setSubmitError(null);
    try {
      const country = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === selectedCountry);
      // Single backend write: acceptEula atomically persists the EULA
      // acceptance, onboarded flag, and onboarding metadata together so a
      // follow-up client updateMe can't race and clobber onboarded back to
      // false (which would re-trigger onboarding after a cache clear).
      await base44.functions.invoke("acceptEula", {
        version: CURRENT_EULA_VERSION,
        language: country?.lang || "en",
        country: selectedCountry,
        age_verified: true,
        is_under_16: false,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      // Onboarding must actually persist before we proceed to the tutorial;
      // otherwise Home re-reads onboarded=false and re-shows this modal,
      // trapping the player in an onboarding↔tutorial loop.
      setSaving(false);
      setSubmitError(t("onboarding.saveError"));
      return;
    }
    setSaving(false);
    onDone();
  };

  const handleGoogleConnect = () => {
    if (nameState !== "available") return;
    setShowGoogleDialog(true);
  };

  const handleGoogleRecover = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", window.location.href);
  };

  const countryLang = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === selectedCountry)?.lang || "en";
  const selectedCountryData = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === selectedCountry);
  const threshold = selectedCountryData?.threshold || 16;
  const countryLabel = selectedCountryData?.label || "";

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        {step === 0 && (
          <>
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="text-5xl mb-3 animate-float-bob">⚡</div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{t("onboarding.welcome")}</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="mb-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 border-2 border-indigo-200">
              <p className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-700 mb-1">{t("onboarding.recoverTitle")}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-indigo-600 mb-3 leading-relaxed">{t("onboarding.recoverBody")}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGoogleRecover}
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 transition-all"
              >
                <GoogleIcon size={18} /> {t("onboarding.recoverGoogle")}
              </button>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30"
            >
              {t("onboarding.newPlayer")} →
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {step === 1 && (
          <>
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="text-5xl mb-3 animate-float-bob">⚡</div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{t("onboarding.welcome")}</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">{t("onboarding.chooseRegion")}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">{t("onboarding.regionHint")}</p>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 mb-6">
              {SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c.code}
                  onClick={() => setSelectedCountry(c.code)}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 flex items-center gap-2 transition-all ${
                    selectedCountry === c.code
                      ? "border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 scale-105"
                      : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-2xl">{c.flag}</span>
                  <div className="text-left">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 leading-tight block">{c.label}</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">{t("onboarding.ageLimit", { n: c.threshold })}</span>
                  </div>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={handleCountryNext}
              disabled={!selectedCountry}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {t("onboarding.next")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {step === 2 && (
          <>
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="text-4xl mb-3">🎂</div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{t("onboarding.ageGate")}</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">{t("onboarding.ageGateHint")}</p>
            </div>

            <DobPicker
              value={dob}
              onChange={setDob}
              labels={{ day: t("onboarding.dobDay"), month: t("onboarding.dobMonth"), year: t("onboarding.dobYear"), title: t("onboarding.ageGate"), done: t("onboarding.continue") }}
            />
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mb-4 leading-relaxed text-center">{t("onboarding.dobNotice", { threshold, region: countryLabel })}</p>

            <label className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-4 cursor-pointer">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                checked={eulaAccepted}
                onChange={(e) => setEulaAccepted(e.target.checked)}
                className="mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 shrink-0"
              />
              <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
                {t("eula.acceptPrefix")}{" "}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => navigate("/eula")}
                  className="text-blue-500 underline font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"
                >
                  {t("eula.title")}
                  <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </button>
              </span>
            </label>

            {ageError === "dob" && (
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mb-3 text-center animate-pop-in">{t("onboarding.dobError")}</p>
            )}

            <button
              onClick={handleAgeSubmit}
              disabled={saving || !dob.day || !dob.month || !dob.year || !eulaAccepted}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {saving ? "…" : t("onboarding.continue")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {step === 3 && (
          <>
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="text-4xl mb-3">👤</div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{t("onboarding.chooseUsername")}</h2>
              <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">{t("onboarding.usernameHint")}</p>
            </div>

            <div className="mb-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50 to-blue-50 border-2 border-indigo-200">
              <p className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-700 mb-0.5">{t("onboarding.googleRecover")}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-indigo-600 mb-3">{t("onboarding.googleRecoverDesc")}</p>
              <button
                onClick={handleGoogleConnect}
                disabled={nameState !== "available"}
                className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-300 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <GoogleIcon size={18} /> {t("onboarding.connectGoogle")}
              </button>
            </div>

            <div className="mb-4">
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={username}
                  onChange={(e) => { setUsername(e.target.value); setNameState("idle"); }}
                  placeholder={t("onboarding.usernamePlaceholder")}
                  maxLength={20}
                  className={`flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 ${
                    nameState === "taken" || nameState === "error" || nameState === "inappropriate"
                      ? "border-rose-400"
                      : nameState === "available"
                      ? "border-emerald-400"
                      : "border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400"
                  }`}
                />
                <button
                  onClick={checkName}
                  disabled={!username.trim() || nameState === "checking"}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                >
                  {nameState === "checking" ? "…" : t("onboarding.checkName")}
                </button>
              </div>
              {nameState === "available" && (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500 mt-1.5 animate-pop-in">✓ {t("onboarding.nameAvailable")}</p>
              )}
              {nameState === "taken" && (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mt-1.5 animate-pop-in">{t("settings.nameTaken")}</p>
              )}
              {nameState === "inappropriate" && (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mt-1.5 animate-pop-in">{t("settings.nameInappropriate")}</p>
              )}
              {nameState === "error" && (
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mt-1.5 animate-pop-in">{t("settings.nameError")}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {submitError && (
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mb-3 text-center animate-pop-in">{submitError}</p>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={handleContinue}
              disabled={nameState !== "available" || saving}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {saving ? "…" : t("onboarding.continue")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}

        {step === "blocked" && (
          <>
            <div className="text-center mb-6">
              <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                <Shield className="w-8 h-8 text-rose-500" />
              </div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">{t("onboarding.underAgeBlockTitle")}</h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 leading-relaxed">{t("onboarding.underAgeBlockBody", { threshold, region: countryLabel })}</p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setStep(1)}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30"
            >
              {t("onboarding.changeRegion")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>

      {showGoogleDialog && (
        <GoogleLinkDialog me={{ ...me, display_name: username.trim(), country: selectedCountry }} onClose={() => setShowGoogleDialog(false)} returnUrl={window.location.href} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";

// Simple, dependency-free date-of-birth picker using native <select> dropdowns.
// Props contract (unchanged): DobPicker({ value, onChange, labels })
//   value:   { day, month, year } (each "" when unset)
//   labels:  { day, month, year, title, done }
//   onChange: called with a plain object, e.g. onChange({ ...value, day: v })
export default function DobPicker({ value, onChange, labels }) {
  const days = Array.from({ length: 31 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const months = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, i) => i + 1);
  const years = Array.from({ length: 100 }, (_, i) => new Date().getFullYear() - i);

  const set = (k, v) => onChange({ ...value, [k]: v });

  const fields = [
    { key: "day", label: labels.day, options: days },
    { key: "month", label: labels.month, options: months },
    { key: "year", label: labels.year, options: years },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-2">
      {fields.map((f) => (
        <select
          key={f.key}
          value={value[f.key]}
          onChange={(e) => set(f.key, e.target.value ? Number(e.target.value) : "")}
          className={`px-2 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 bg-white outline-none transition-colors appearance-none text-center ${
            value[f.key] ? "" : "text-slate-400"
          }`}
        >
          <option value="">{f.label}</option>
          {f.options.map((o) => (
            <option key={o} value={o} className="text-slate-800">
              {o}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/GameErrorBoundary.jsx

import React from "react";

// Catches render errors in the game subtree so a crash never produces a blank
// white screen — instead a compact fallback with a way back out is shown.
export default class GameErrorBoundary extends React.Component {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error) {
    return { error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error, info) {
    // Surface the error so it can be diagnosed from the console.
    console.error("[GameErrorBoundary]", error, info);
  }

  handleBack = () => {
    const from = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("from");
    const dest = from === "settings" ? "/settings" : "/";
    this.setState({ error: null });
    window.location.href = dest;
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.error) {
      return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-6 text-slate-900">
          <div className="text-5xl mb-4">🛠️</div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black mb-2">Something went wrong</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6 max-w-xs">
            The match could not be loaded. Your progress is safe.
          </p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button
              onClick={this.handleBack}
              className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold hover:bg-slate-700"
            >
              Back
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
              className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300"
            >
              Retry
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}

import React from "react";
import { PLAY_STORE_URL } from "@/lib/appVersion";

function isNativeApp() {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (window.Capacitor || window.cordova)) return true;
  return false;
}

async function pwaRefresh() {
  if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
    try {
      const regs = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
      await Promise.all(regs.map((r) => r.unregister()));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  if (typeof caches !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(keys.map((k) => caches.delete(k)));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  window.location.reload();
}

// Dismissable banner shown when the client version is above min but below latest.
// Dismiss state is stored in sessionStorage so it persists for the session but
// reappears on the next app launch.
export default function SoftUpdateBanner({ latestVersion, onDismiss }) {
  const native = isNativeApp();

  const handleUpdate = () => {
    if (native) {
      window.location.href = PLAY_STORE_URL;
    } else {
      pwaRefresh();
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-[150] bg-amber-500 text-white px-4 py-2.5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 animate-pop-in shadow-md">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
        <span className="text-sm shrink-0">✨</span>
        <p className="text-xs font-bold truncate">
          New version available — tap to update
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
        <button onClick={handleUpdate} className="text-xs font-black underline px-1.5 py-0.5">
          Update
        </button>
        <button onClick={onDismiss} className="text-white/80 hover:text-white text-lg leading-none px-1" aria-label="Dismiss">
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// TWA (Play Store PWA) intentionally falls into the PWA path — its content
// updates via the service worker, not the Play Store.
function isNativeApp() {
  if (typeof window !== "undefined" && (window.Capacitor || window.cordova)) return true;
  return false;
}

// PWA update: unregister all service workers, clear caches, hard reload.
async function pwaRefresh() {
  if ("serviceWorker" in navigator) {
    try {
      const regs = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations();
      await Promise.all(regs.map((r) => r.unregister()));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  if (typeof caches !== "undefined") {
    try {
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(keys.map((k) => caches.delete(k)));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }
  window.location.reload();
}

export default function ForceUpdateOverlay({ minRequired }) {
  const native = isNativeApp();

  const handleUpdate = () => {
    if (native) {

  return (

FILE: src/components/MainLayout.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Outlet, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import BottomNav from "./BottomNav";
import Home from "@/pages/Home";
import Shop from "@/pages/Shop";
import Collection from "@/pages/Collection";
import Leaderboard from "@/pages/Leaderboard";

const TAB_PATHS = ["/", "/shop", "/collection", "/leaderboard"];
const TABS = [
  { path: "/", Comp: Home },
  { path: "/shop", Comp: Shop },
  { path: "/collection", Comp: Collection },
  { path: "/leaderboard", Comp: Leaderboard },
];

export default function MainLayout() {
  const { pathname } = useLocation();
  const isTabPath = TAB_PATHS.includes(pathname);
  // Lazy-mount + keep-alive: a tab is mounted the first time it's visited and
  // stays mounted (hidden) afterwards, preserving its scroll and internal state.
  const [visited, setVisited] = useState(() =>
    isTabPath ? new Set([pathname]) : new Set()
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isTabPath) {
      setVisited((s) => (s.has(pathname) ? s : new Set([...s, pathname])));
    }
  }, [pathname, isTabPath]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-[100dvh] bg-slate-50">
      {TABS.map(({ path, Comp }) =>
        visited.has(path) ? (
          <div
            key={path}
            className={`${pathname === path ? "" : "hidden"} h-[100dvh] overflow-y-auto`}
          >
            <Comp />
          </div>
        ) : null
      )}
      {!isTabPath && <Outlet />}
      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/OrbPatternCanvas.jsx
========================================
import React, { useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { drawOrbPattern } from "@/game/orbPatternArt";

// Renders the REAL in-game orb pattern (canvas) so the shop/lab preview matches
// exactly what the player sees in a match — orb body, glossy highlight, and the
// actual pattern overlay from orbPatternArt, no separate SVG renderer to drift.
export default function OrbPatternCanvas({ skinId, size = 64, baseColor = "#60a5fa" }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = size * dpr; canvas.height = size * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
    const r = size / 2 - 2;
    const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2;
    // orb body + glow (mirrors GameCanvas drawOrb)
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = baseColor; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
    ctx.fillStyle = baseColor;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    // glossy highlight (mirrors GameCanvas)
    const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.35, cy - r * 0.35, 1, cx, cy, r);
    hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"); hg.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"); hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = hg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx, cy, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // the real pattern overlay
    drawOrbPattern(ctx, { x: cx, y: cy, color: baseColor, patternId: skinId }, r);
  }, [skinId, size, baseColor]);
  return <canvas ref={canvasRef} style={{ width: size, height: size }} className="block" />;
}

FILE: src/components/CardFlipReveal.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import confetti from "canvas-confetti";
import { TOWER_TYPES, ORB_TYPES, ABILITIES } from "@/game/constants";
import { RARITIES, getSkin } from "@/game/skins";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import CrateIcon from "@/components/CrateIcon";
import TowerIcon from "@/components/game/TowerIcon";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";
import CoinIcon from "@/components/game/CoinIcon";
import GemIcon from "@/components/GemIcon";
import SkinPreview from "@/components/SkinPreview";

const ABILITY_ICONS = { zap: "⚡", portal: "🌀", repair: "➕", freeze: "❄️", rage: "🔥", shield: "🛡️", burner: "🌋", meteor: "☄️", glue: "🟢", overclock: "⚙️" };

// Crate tone → glow color for the shake phase.
const CRATE_GLOW = {
  wood: "rgba(180,83,9,0.6)",
  silver: "rgba(148,163,184,0.7)",
  gold: "rgba(251,191,36,0.85)",
  crystal: "rgba(167,139,250,0.85)",
  legendary: "rgba(244,63,94,0.85)",
  emerald: "rgba(16,185,129,0.85)",
};

// Multi-item chest reveal: shake the crate with a glow + burst, then deal N
// face-down cards the player taps to flip. The flip is driven by a single
// transform on the card wrapper (no layered transforms on the back face) so
// the 3D rotateY stays smooth. Each face-down card pulses a rarity-colored
// aura before flipping (common = none); flipping fires a rarity-tinted flash.
export default function CardFlipReveal({ items, crateTone, onClose }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("shaking");
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(() => items.map(() => false));

  useEffect(() => {
    const tm = setTimeout(() => setPhase("cards"), 1100);
    return () => clearTimeout(tm);
  }, []);

  const flip = (i) => {
    if (phase !== "cards") return;
    setFlipped((prev) => {
      if (prev[i]) return prev;
      const next = [...prev];
      next[i] = true;
      const item = items[i];
      const order = item.type === "skin" ? (RARITIES[item.rarity]?.order ?? 0) : 0;
      // confetti for epic+ skins and bonus slots
      if ((item.type === "skin" && order >= 2) || item.bonus) {
        const end = Date.now() + 800;
        (function frame() {
          confetti({
            particleCount: 8, spread: 90, startVelocity: 55,
            origin: { x: 0.5, y: 0.4 },
            colors: [RARITIES[item.rarity]?.color || "#fbbf24", "#ffffff"],
          });
          if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        })();
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  const allFlipped = flipped.every(Boolean);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl">
        {phase === "shaking" && (
          <div className="py-10 relative flex flex-col items-center">
            <div className="relative">
              <div
                className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full animate-crate-burst pointer-events-none"
                style={{ background: `radial-gradient(circle, ${CRATE_GLOW[crateTone] || CRATE_GLOW.wood} 0%, transparent 70%)` }}
              />
              <div
                className="mb-4 animate-crate-shake animate-crate-glow inline-block"
                style={{ "--crate-glow": CRATE_GLOW[crateTone] || CRATE_GLOW.wood }}
              >
                <CrateIcon size={88} tone={crateTone} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <p className="text-slate-400 font-bold">{t("shop.opening")}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {phase === "cards" && (
          <>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 mb-4">{t("shop.tapCards")}</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-3 mb-5">
              {items.map((item, i) => (
                <FlipCard key={i} item={item} flipped={flipped[i]} onFlip={() => flip(i)} t={t} index={i} />
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              disabled={!allFlipped}
              className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold transition-all ${
                allFlipped ? "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-700" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-300 cursor-not-allowed"
              }`}
            >
              {allFlipped ? t("shop.awesome") : t("shop.flipAll")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function FlipCard({ item, flipped, onFlip, t, index }) {
  const rarityId = item.type === "skin"
    ? item.rarity
    : item.type === "card"
      ? (item.cardKind === "tower" ? TOWER_TYPES[item.id]?.rarity : item.cardKind === "orb" ? ORB_TYPES[item.id]?.rarity : ABILITIES[item.id]?.rarity)
      : null;
  const rarityColor = RARITIES[rarityId]?.color || "#94a3b8";
  const rarityOrder = RARITIES[rarityId]?.order ?? 0;
  const rarityName = rarityId ? t(`rarities.${rarityId}`) : null;
  const showAura = !flipped && rarityOrder >= 1;

  return (
    <div
      style={{
        perspective: "1000px",
        animation: `card-deal-in 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) ${index * 120}ms backwards`,
      }}
    >
      <div
        onClick={onFlip}
        style={{
          position: "relative", width: 100, height: 128, transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
          transition: "transform 0.55s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)",
          transform: flipped ? "rotateY(180deg)" : "rotateY(0deg)",
          cursor: flipped ? "default" : "pointer",
        }}
      >
        {/* face down */}
        <div
          style={{ position: "absolute", inset: 0, backfaceVisibility: "hidden", WebkitBackfaceVisibility: "hidden", transform: "translateZ(0)" }}
          className="rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-300 bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-100 to-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md animate-card-idle-float"
        >
          {showAura && (
            <div
              className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl animate-rarity-aura pointer-events-none"
              style={{ "--aura": rarityColor }}
            />
          )}
          <span className="text-3xl relative">❓</span>
          {showAura && (
            <span
              className="absolute bottom-1.5 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 text-[8px] font-black tracking-wider uppercase"
              style={{ color: rarityColor, textShadow: "0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.8)" }}
            >
              {rarityName}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        {/* face up — only mounted once flipped so nothing bleeds through while face-down */}
        {flipped && (
        <div
          style={{
            position: "absolute", inset: 0, backfaceVisibility: "hidden", WebkitBackfaceVisibility: "hidden",
            transform: "rotateY(180deg) translateZ(0)",
          }}
          className="rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2 shadow-md"
        >
          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl pointer-events-none"
            style={{ boxShadow: `inset 0 0 16px ${rarityColor}55`, borderColor: rarityColor }}
          />
          {flipped && rarityOrder >= 1 && (
            <div
              className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl pointer-events-none animate-reveal-flash"
              style={{ background: `radial-gradient(circle at center, ${rarityColor}55, transparent 70%)` }}
            />
          )}
          {flipped && rarityOrder >= 1 && (
            <div
              className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl pointer-events-none animate-shimmer-sweep"
              style={{ background: `linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, ${rarityColor}40 50%, transparent 70%)`, backgroundSize: "200% 200%" }}
            />
          )}
          {item.bonus && (
            <span className="absolute -top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-amber-400 text-amber-900 text-[9px] font-black shadow">BONUS</span>
          )}
          {item.type === "card" && item.copies > 1 && (
            <span className="absolute -top-2 right-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-violet-500 text-white text-[9px] font-black shadow">×{item.copies}</span>
          )}
          <RewardIcon item={item} />
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-700 leading-tight text-center mt-1">{rewardLabel(item, t)}</span>
          {rarityName && (
            <span className="text-[9px] font-black mt-0.5" style={{ color: rarityColor }}>{rarityName}</span>
          )}
          <StatusLine item={item} t={t} />
        </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Restored card info: NEW UNLOCK badge for new cards, copy progress for
// duplicates, shards when maxed, and dupe-shards for skin duplicates.
function StatusLine({ item, t }) {
  if (item.type === "card") {
    if (item.consolationShards) return <span className="text-[9px] font-bold mt-0.5 text-violet-500">+{item.consolationShards} {t("shop.dupeShards")}</span>;
    if (item.newUnlock) return <span className="text-[9px] font-black mt-0.5 text-emerald-500">{t("shop.newUnlock")}</span>;
    if (item.levelUp?.overflow) return <span className="text-[9px] font-bold mt-0.5 text-violet-500">{t("shop.shardsMaxed", { n: item.levelUp.shardsGained })}</span>;
    if (item.levelUp?.duplicate) return <span className="text-[9px] font-bold mt-0.5 text-slate-500">{t("shop.duplicate", { n: item.levelUp.copies, m: item.levelUp.needed })}</span>;
  }
  if (item.type === "skin" && item.skinDup) {
    return <span className="text-[9px] font-bold mt-0.5 text-violet-500">+{t("shop.dupeShards")}</span>;
  }
  return null;
}

function RewardIcon({ item }) {
  if (item.type === "card") {
    if (item.cardKind === "tower") return <TowerIcon type={item.id} size={40} />;
    if (item.cardKind === "orb") {
      const def = ORB_TYPES[item.id];
      return <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black text-white" style={{ background: def?.color || "#94a3b8", boxShadow: `0 0 10px ${def?.color || "#94a3b8"}88` }}>{def?.hp}</div>;
    }
    const def = ABILITIES[item.id];
    return <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-lg" style={{ background: (def?.color || "#94a3b8") + "22" }}>{ABILITY_ICONS[item.id] || "✨"}</div>;
  }
  if (item.type === "skin") return <SkinPreview category={item.category} skinId={item.skinId} size={48} />;
  if (item.type === "coins") return <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-amber-500"><CoinIcon size={26} /><span className="font-black text-sm">×{item.amount}</span></div>;
  if (item.type === "gems") return <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-cyan-500"><GemIcon size={24} /><span className="font-black text-sm">×{item.amount}</span></div>;
  if (item.type === "shards") return <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-violet-500"><ShardIcon size={24} /><span className="font-black text-sm">×{item.amount}</span></div>;
  return null;
}

function rewardLabel(item, t) {
  if (item.type === "card") {
    const group = item.cardKind === "tower" ? "towers" : item.cardKind === "ability" ? "abilities" : "orbs";
    return t(`${group}.${item.id}.name`);
  }
  if (item.type === "skin") {
    const skin = getSkin(item.category, item.skinId);
    return skin?.name || "";
  }
  return "";
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import { Flag, X, Check } from "lucide-react";

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: "harassment", labelKey: "report.categoryHarassment", icon: "😠" },
  { id: "cheating", labelKey: "report.categoryCheating", icon: "🚫" },
  { id: "inappropriate_name", labelKey: "report.categoryInappropriateName", icon: "🔤" },
  { id: "spam", labelKey: "report.categorySpam", icon: "📢" },
  { id: "other", labelKey: "report.categoryOther", icon: "❓" },
];

export default function ReportUserDialog({ reportedId, reportedName, onClose, onSubmitted }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(null);
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (!category || submitting) return;
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("submitReport", {
        reportedId,
        category,
        description: description.trim(),
      });
      if (res.data?.success) {
        setSuccess(true);
        setTimeout(() => {
          onSubmitted?.();
          onClose?.();
        }, 1800);
      } else {
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
        {success ? (
          <div className="text-center py-6">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <Check className="w-8 h-8 text-emerald-500" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">{t("report.successTitle")}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">{t("report.successBody")}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Flag className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{t("report.title")}</h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 truncate">{reportedName}</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
                <X className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-2">{t("report.categoryLabel")}</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-1.5 mb-4">
              {CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  onClick={() => setCategory(c.id)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-left transition-all ${
                    category === c.id
                      ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50"
                      : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-xl">{c.icon}</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1">{t(c.labelKey)}</span>
                  {category === c.id && <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-500" />}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1.5">{t("report.descriptionLabel")}</p>
            <textarea
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder={t("report.descriptionPlaceholder")}
              maxLength={500}
              rows={3}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm text-slate-700 resize-none mb-4"
            />

            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={onClose}
                disabled={submitting}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {t("report.cancel")}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                disabled={!category || submitting}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold hover:bg-rose-600 disabled:opacity-40 transition-all"
              >
                {submitting ? "…" : t("report.submit")}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 text-center mt-3">{t("report.blockNote")}</p>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { NavLink, useNavigate, useLocation } from "react-router-dom";
import { Home, Package, Gamepad2, Layers, Trophy } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";

// Sub-screens where the bottom nav should be hidden (full-page flows).
const HIDDEN_PATHS = ["/settings", "/friends", "/setup", "/game"];

export default function BottomNav() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const location = useLocation();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [hasNew, setHasNew] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    const check = () => base44.auth.me().then((m) => {
      const unlocked = m.achievements || [];
      const claimed = m.claimed_achievements || [];
      setHasNew(unlocked.filter((id) => !claimed.includes(id)).length > 0);
    }).catch(() => {});
    check();
    window.addEventListener("focus", check);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("focus", check);
  }, []);

  if (HIDDEN_PATHS.includes(location.pathname)) return null;

  const tabs = [
    { to: "/", icon: Home, label: t("nav.home") },
    { to: "/shop", icon: Package, label: t("nav.shop") },
    { to: "/setup", icon: Gamepad2, label: t("nav.play"), center: true },
    { to: "/collection", icon: Layers, label: t("collection.title") },
    { to: "/leaderboard", icon: Trophy, label: t("nav.ranks"), badge: hasNew },
  ];

  return (
    <nav className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 pointer-events-none">
      <div className="max-w-[480px] mx-auto bg-white/95 backdrop-blur border-t border-slate-200 rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] px-2 pt-1.5 pb-[calc(6px+env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))] flex items-end justify-around pointer-events-auto">
        {tabs.map((tab) => {
          const Icon = tab.icon;
          if (tab.center) {
            return (
              <button
                key={tab.to}
                onClick={() => navigate(tab.to)}
                className="flex flex-col items-center -mt-6 group select-none"
              >
                <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/40 group-hover:scale-110 group-active:scale-95 transition-transform">
                  <Icon className="w-7 h-7" />
                </div>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-700 mt-0.5">{tab.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          }
          return (
            <NavLink
              key={tab.to}
              to={tab.to}
              end={tab.to === "/"}
              className={({ isActive }) =>
                `relative flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] px-2.5 py-1.5 transition-colors select-none ${
                  isActive ? "text-blue-500" : "text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600"
                }`
              }
            >
              <Icon className="w-5 h-5" />
              {tab.badge && <span className="absolute top-0 right-0.5 w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500 animate-pulse" />}
              <span className="text-[9px] font-bold mt-0.5">{tab.label}</span>
            </NavLink>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </nav>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { stashLocalProfile } from "@/lib/googleMerge";
import { getThresholdByCountry } from "@/lib/ageGate";
import { Shield } from "lucide-react";

export default function GoogleLinkDialog({ me, onClose, returnUrl }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [step, setStep] = useState("age");
  const [ageConfirmed, setAgeConfirmed] = useState(false);
  const [linking, setLinking] = useState(false);
  const threshold = getThresholdByCountry(me?.country);

  const handleAgeContinue = () => {
    if (!ageConfirmed) return;
    setStep("confirm");
  };

  const handleConfirm = async () => {
    setLinking(true);
    await stashLocalProfile(me);
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", returnUrl || window.location.href);
  };

  if (step === "age") {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[95] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
        <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("ageGate.title")}</h3>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mb-4 leading-relaxed">
            {t("ageGate.body", { threshold })}
          </p>
          <label className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-5 cursor-pointer">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={ageConfirmed}
              onChange={(e) => setAgeConfirmed(e.target.checked)}
              className="mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 shrink-0"
            />
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
              {t("ageGate.confirm", { threshold })}
            </span>
          </label>
          <div className="flex gap-3">
            <button onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-bold hover:border-slate-300 transition-all">
              {t("ageGate.cancel")}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleAgeContinue}
              disabled={!ageConfirmed}
              className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white font-black hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {t("ageGate.continue")}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[95] bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-slate-50 border-2 border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center">
            <GoogleIcon size={24} />
          </div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("onboarding.googleDialogTitle")}</h3>
        </div>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mb-6 leading-relaxed">{t("onboarding.googleDialogBody")}</p>
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={onClose} disabled={linking} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 font-bold hover:border-slate-300 transition-all disabled:opacity-40">
            {t("onboarding.googleDialogCancel")}
          </button>
          <button onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={linking} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white font-black hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40">
            {linking ? "…" : t("onboarding.googleDialogConfirm")}
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Hand } from "lucide-react";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";

const HAND_COSTS = [5, 10, 18, 28, 40];
const MAX_LEVEL = 5;
const BASE_CLICKS = 20;
const BASE_RECHARGE = 0.5;

export default function HandUpgradeCard({ level, shards, onUpgrade }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const maxed = level >= MAX_LEVEL;
  const cost = maxed ? 0 : HAND_COSTS[level] || 0;
  const affordable = !maxed && shards >= cost;
  const maxClicks = BASE_CLICKS + level * 2;
  const recharge = Math.max(0.1, BASE_RECHARGE - level * 0.04).toFixed(2);
  const nextMaxClicks = BASE_CLICKS + (level + 1) * 2;
  const nextRecharge = Math.max(0.1, BASE_RECHARGE - (level + 1) * 0.04).toFixed(2);

  return (
    <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-violet-200 shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-400 to-fuchsia-500 flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-md shadow-violet-500/30 shrink-0">
          <Hand size={30} strokeWidth={2.5} />
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
          <h3 className="font-black text-slate-900">{t("shop.handTitle")}</h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{t("shop.handDesc")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Level pips */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 my-3">
        {Array.from({ length: MAX_LEVEL }).map((_, i) => (
          <div
            key={i}
            className={`flex-1 h-2 rounded-full transition-all ${
              i < level ? "bg-violet-500" : "bg-slate-200"
            }`}
          />
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* Current stats + next preview */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
          {t("shop.handCurrent", { clicks: maxClicks, recharge })}
        </span>
        {!maxed && (
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-500">{t("shop.handNext")}</span>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Action */}
      {maxed ? (
        <div className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-violet-100 text-violet-600 font-black text-sm text-center">
          {t("shop.maxLabel")}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <button
          onClick={onUpgrade}
          disabled={!affordable}
          className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
            affordable
              ? "bg-gradient-to-r from-violet-500 to-fuchsia-500 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-violet-500/30"
              : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
          }`}
        >
          {t("shop.handUpgrade")} · <ShardIcon size={14} /> {cost}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
