import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import GemIcon from "@/components/GemIcon";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import { sfx } from "@/game/sound";

const PACKS = [
  { id: "small", gems: 80, price: "$0.99", popular: false },
  { id: "medium", gems: 180, price: "$1.99", popular: true },
  { id: "large", gems: 400, price: "$3.99", popular: false },
  { id: "mega", gems: 1000, price: "$7.99", popular: false },
];

export default function GemPacks({ onGemsChange }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [eligible, setEligible] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [granted, setGranted] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.functions.invoke("claimDailyGemCrate", {})
      .then((res) => setEligible(!!res.data?.eligible))
      .catch(() => setEligible(false));
  }, []);

  const claim = async () => {
    if (busy || !eligible) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("claimDailyGemCrate", { claim: true });
      if (res.data?.granted) {
        setEligible(false);
        setGranted(res.data.granted);
        sfx.coin();
        if (onGemsChange) onGemsChange();
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="mb-8">
      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 mb-1">{t("shop.gemPacksTitle")}</h2>
      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("shop.gemPacksHint")}</p>

      {/* Gem packs grid — hidden for legal compliance (component retained) */}
      <div className="relative rounded-3xl hidden">
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {PACKS.map((pack) => (
            <div
              key={pack.id}
              className={`relative p-4 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 flex flex-col items-center ${
                pack.popular ? "border-cyan-400" : "border-slate-200"
              }`}
            >
              {pack.popular && (
                <span className="absolute -top-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-500 text-white text-[8px] font-black tracking-wide">
                  {t("shop.popular")}
                </span>
              )}
              <div className="mb-1 animate-float-bob"><GemIcon size={36} /></div>
              <p className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 leading-none">{pack.gems}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mb-2">{t("shop.gems")}</p>
              <button disabled className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 font-bold text-sm cursor-not-allowed">
                {t("shop.comingSoon")}
              </button>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-1.5">{pack.price}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        {/* Coming Soon overlay */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-3xl bg-white/75 backdrop-blur-[2px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center px-4 pointer-events-none">
          <div className="text-3xl mb-1">✨</div>
          <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-700">{t("shop.comingSoon")}</h3>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-500 mt-1 max-w-[220px] leading-snug">{t("shop.betaSubtext")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Daily Gem Chest — beneath the overlay, interactive */}
      <div className="mt-3 p-4 rounded-3xl bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-50 to-blue-50 border-2 border-cyan-200 flex items-center gap-3">
        <div className="animate-float-bob"><GemIcon size={32} /></div>
        <div className="flex-1">
          <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{t("shop.dailyGemChest")}</h3>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">
            {granted ? `+${granted} 💎` : t("shop.dailyGemChestHint")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={claim}
          disabled={!eligible || busy}
          className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
            !eligible || busy
              ? "bg-slate-200 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
              : "bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-blue-500 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-cyan-500/30"
          }`}
        >
          {eligible ? t("shop.claimDailyGems") : t("shop.dailyGemsClaimed")}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Shield, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import { CURRENT_EULA_VERSION } from "@/lib/eulaVersion";

export default function EulaAcceptanceOverlay({ onAccepted }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [accepted, setAccepted] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    if (!accepted || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("acceptEula", { version: CURRENT_EULA_VERSION });
      onAccepted();
    } catch (e) {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDecline = () => {
    base44.auth.logout(window.location.origin);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[95] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center">
            <Shield className="w-6 h-6 text-amber-500" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("eula.title")}</h2>
        </div>

        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mb-4 leading-relaxed">{t("eula.intro")}</p>

        <label className="flex items-start gap-2 mb-4 cursor-pointer">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={accepted}
            onChange={(e) => setAccepted(e.target.checked)}
            className="mt-0.5 w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 shrink-0"
          />
          <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
            {t("eula.acceptPrefix")}{" "}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => navigate("/eula")}
              className="text-blue-500 underline font-bold inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"
            >
              {t("eula.title")}
              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </button>
          </span>
        </label>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <button
            onClick={handleDecline}
            disabled={busy}
            className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            {t("eula.decline")}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={handleAccept}
            disabled={!accepted || busy}
            className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform disabled:opacity-50"
          >
            {busy ? "…" : t("eula.accept")}
          </button>
        </div>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 text-center mt-3">{t("eula.mustAccept")}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/TutorialCoachmark.jsx
========================================
import React, { useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";

// Minimalist spotlight coachmark: dims the screen around a target element
// (via a huge box-shadow scrim) and shows a small instruction card.
// `padding` expands the highlight rect so it hugs the target more generously,
// and `progress` renders a small "{label}" progress bar (e.g. "3/5").
export default function TutorialCoachmark({ targetRef, title, body, cta, onCta, onSkip, progress, padding = 8, skippable = true }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [rect, setRect] = useState(null);
  const cardRef = useRef(null);
  const [cardH, setCardH] = useState(150);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (cardRef.current) {
      const r = cardRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.height > 0) setCardH(r.height);
    }
  }, [title, body, progress, cta]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const measure = () => {
      if (!targetRef?.current) { setRect(null); return; }
      const r = targetRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (r.width === 0 && r.height === 0) { setRect(null); return; }
      setRect(r);
    };
    measure();
    // Re-measure across a few frames + a short timeout so the highlight is
    // accurate once the target's layout has fully settled.
    const r1 = requestAnimationFrame(measure);
    const r2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(measure));
    const to = setTimeout(measure, 120);
    window.addEventListener("resize", measure);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", measure, true);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(r1);
      cancelAnimationFrame(r2);
      clearTimeout(to);
      window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
      window.removeEventListener("scroll", measure, true);
    };
  }, [targetRef]);

  const gap = 12;
  const placeAbove = rect ? rect.top + rect.height / 2 > window.innerHeight / 2 : false;
  const cardStyle = rect
    ? {
        left: "50%",
        transform: "translateX(-50%)",
        top: placeAbove ? Math.max(12, rect.top - cardH - gap) : Math.min(window.innerHeight - cardH - 12, rect.bottom + gap),
      }
    : { left: "50%", top: "50%", transform: "translate(-50%, -50%)" };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] pointer-events-none">
      {rect ? (
        <div
          className="absolute rounded-2xl ring-4 ring-blue-400/80"
          style={{
            left: rect.left - padding,
            top: rect.top - padding,
            width: rect.width + padding * 2,
            height: rect.height + padding * 2,
            boxShadow: "0 0 0 9999px rgba(15,23,42,0.55)",
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/55" />
      )}
      <div className="absolute pointer-events-auto" style={cardStyle}>
        <div ref={cardRef} className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-2xl w-[260px] max-w-[82vw]">
          <h3 className="font-black text-slate-900 text-base mb-1">{title}</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mb-3 leading-snug">{body}</p>
          {progress && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-3">
              <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
                <div className="h-full bg-blue-500 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${progress.pct}%` }} />
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 tabular-nums">{progress.label}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
            {skippable ? (
              <button onClick={onSkip} className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 underline">
                {t("tutorial.skip")}
              </button>
            ) : (
              <span />
            )}
            {cta && (
              <button
                onClick={onCta}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-blue-500 text-white text-sm font-bold hover:bg-blue-600 transition-colors"
              >
                {cta}
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";

export default function DailyMissions({ me }) {

  const [missions, setMissions] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (me) setMissions(getDailyMissions(me));
  }, [me]);

  if (!missions || missions.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">

          const pct = Math.min(100, (m.progress / m.goal) * 100);
          return (
            <div
              key={m.id}
              className={`p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 flex items-center gap-3 ${m.completed ? "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50" : "border-slate-200 bg-white"}`}
            >
              <div className="flex-1">
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">{t(`missions.${m.id}`)}</p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                  <div className="flex-1 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all ${m.completed ? "bg-emerald-400" : "bg-blue-400"}`}
                      style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 tabular-nums">{m.progress}/{m.goal}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-bold text-amber-500">
                {m.completed ? <span className="text-emerald-500 text-base">✓</span> : (<><CoinIcon size={11} />{m.reward}</>)}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/AgeGateRecheck.jsx
========================================
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import { SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES, calculateAge, countryByLang } from "@/lib/ageGate";
import { X } from "lucide-react";
import DobPicker from "@/components/DobPicker";

// Re-check dialog for users with is_under_16 === true.
// Re-asks region + DOB; if the user now meets their country's threshold,
// sets is_under_16=false so they can choose a custom name.
export default function AgeGateRecheck({ me, onClose, onSuccess }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const initialCountry = countryByLang(me?.language)?.code || null;
  const [country, setCountry] = useState(initialCountry);
  const [dob, setDob] = useState({ day: "", month: "", year: "" });
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const selectedThreshold = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === country)?.threshold || 16;

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    setError(null);
    if (!country) {
      setError("country");
      return;
    }
    const d = parseInt(dob.day, 10);
    const m = parseInt(dob.month, 10);
    const y = parseInt(dob.year, 10);
    if (!d || !m || !y || y < 1900 || y > new Date().getFullYear()) {
      setError("dob");
      return;
    }

    const age = calculateAge({ day: d, month: m, year: y });
    const threshold = SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === country)?.threshold || 16;

    if (age < threshold) {
      setError("under");
      return;
    }

    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.updateMe({ is_under_16: false });
      onSuccess();
    } catch (e) {
      setError("error");
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">{t("settings.recheckAge", { threshold: selectedThreshold })}</h3>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">{t("settings.recheckAgeDesc")}</p>
          </div>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
            <X className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Country picker */}
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 mb-2">{t("onboarding.chooseRegion")}</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-4">
          {SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c.code}
              onClick={() => setCountry(c.code)}
              className={`p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 transition-all ${
                country === c.code ? "border-blue-500 bg-blue-50 scale-105" : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
              }`}
            >
              <span className="text-xl">{c.flag}</span>
              <span className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-700 leading-tight text-center">{c.label}</span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {/* DOB selects */}
        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 mb-2">{t("onboarding.ageGateHint")}</p>
        <DobPicker
          value={dob}
          onChange={setDob}
          labels={{ day: t("onboarding.dobDay"), month: t("onboarding.dobMonth"), year: t("onboarding.dobYear"), title: t("settings.recheckAge", { threshold: selectedThreshold }), done: t("settings.confirmChange") }}
        />
        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mb-4 leading-relaxed">{t("onboarding.dobNotice")}</p>

        {error === "under" && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mb-3 text-center animate-pop-in">{t("settings.ageRecheckFail")}</p>
        )}
        {error === "error" && (
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mb-3 text-center animate-pop-in">{t("settings.nameError")}</p>
        )}

        <button
          onClick={handleSubmit}
          disabled={busy || !country || !dob.day || !dob.month || !dob.year}
          className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-blue-500/30 disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {busy ? "…" : t("settings.confirmChange")}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import { createPortal } from "react-dom";

// Small "i" badge for loadout grid items. Tapping opens a popover rendered
// via a fixed portal (createPortal to document.body) so it escapes the grid's
// stacking context and never gets overlapped by sibling cards. Position is
// computed from the badge button's getBoundingClientRect and clamped to the
// viewport. stopPropagation prevents the parent grid item's toggle from firing.
export default function LoadoutInfoBadge({ title, description }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const btnRef = useRef(null);
  const [pos, setPos] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !btnRef.current) return;
    const rect = btnRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    const popoverWidth = 160;
    const margin = 8;
    let left = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - popoverWidth / 2;
    left = Math.max(margin, Math.min(left, window.innerWidth - popoverWidth - margin));
    const top = rect.bottom + 6;
    let arrowLeft = rect.left + rect.width / 2 - left;
    arrowLeft = Math.max(12, Math.min(arrowLeft, popoverWidth - 12));
    setPos({ top, left, arrowLeft });

    const close = () => setOpen(false);
    window.addEventListener("scroll", close, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", close, true);
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <>
      <button
        ref={btnRef}
        type="button"
        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setOpen((v) => !v); }}
        className="absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-200/80 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-300 hover:text-slate-700 flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] font-black transition-colors z-20"
        aria-label="Show description"
      >
        i
      </button>
      {open && createPortal(
        <>
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90]" onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setOpen(false); }} />
          {pos && (
            <div
              className="fixed z-[100] w-40 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-xl text-left animate-pop-in"
              style={{ top: pos.top, left: pos.left }}
              onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
            >
              <div
                className="absolute -top-1.5 w-3 h-3 bg-white border-l-2 border-t-2 border-slate-200 rotate-45"
                style={{ left: pos.arrowLeft - 6 }}
              />
              <p className="font-bold text-[11px] text-slate-800 mb-0.5">{title}</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] leading-snug text-slate-500">{description}</p>
            </div>
          )}
        </>,
        document.body
      )}
    </>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { useInRouterContext, useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";

function InRouterBack({ label, className, fallback = "/" }) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  return (
    <button onClick={() => {
      if (window.history.state && window.history.state.idx > 0) {
        navigate(-1);
      } else {
        navigate(fallback);
      }
    }} className={className}>
      <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600" />
      <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 text-sm">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export default function LegalBackButton({ label, className }) {
  const inRouter = useInRouterContext();
  if (inRouter) {
    return <InRouterBack label={label} className={className} />;
  }
  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => {
        if (window.history.length > 1) {
          window.history.back();
        } else {
          window.location.href = "/";
        }
      }}
      className={className}
    >
      <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600" />
      <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 text-sm">{label}</span>
    </button>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/CountUp.jsx

import React, { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

// Animates a number from its previous value to the new value over ~400ms.
// Uses requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve.
export default function CountUp({ value, duration = 400 }) {
  const [display, setDisplay] = useState(value);
  const fromRef = useRef(value);
  const rafRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const from = fromRef.current;
    const to = value;
    if (from === to) return;
    const start = performance.now();
    const tick = (now) => {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
      const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
      const current = Math.round(from + (to - from) * eased);
      setDisplay(current);
      fromRef.current = current;
      if (t < 1) {
        rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
      } else {
        fromRef.current = to;
        setDisplay(to);
      }
    };
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
  }, [value, duration]);

  return <>{display}</>;
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";

export default function MatchHistory({ me }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [matches, setMatches] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!me?.id) return;
    base44.entities.MatchRecord.filter({ created_by_id: me.id }, "-created_date", 8)
      .then(setMatches)
      .catch(() => setMatches([]));
  }, [me]);

  if (!matches || matches.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="mb-6">
      <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 mb-2 px-1">{t("home.recentMatches")}</h2>
      <div className="space-y-1.5">
        {matches.map((m) => (
          <div key={m.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border border-slate-200 text-xs">
            <span className={`w-6 h-6 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-white ${m.result === "win" ? "bg-emerald-500" : "bg-rose-500"}`}>
              {m.result === "win" ? "W" : "L"}
            </span>
            <span className="flex-1 font-bold text-slate-700 truncate">{m.opponent_name}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold">{t(`setup.${m.mode}`)}</span>
            <span className={`font-bold tabular-nums ${m.trophies_change >= 0 ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-rose-500"}`}>
              {m.trophies_change >= 0 ? "+" : ""}{m.trophies_change}
            </span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/ScrollToTop.jsx

import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useLocation, useNavigationType } from "react-router-dom";

const getHashId = (hash) => {
  const rawId = hash.slice(1);

  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(rawId);
  } catch {
    return rawId;
  }
};

export default function ScrollToTop() {
  const { pathname, hash } = useLocation();
  const navigationType = useNavigationType();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (navigationType === "POP") return;

    if (hash) {
      const id = getHashId(hash);
      const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById(id)?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
      }, 50);
      return () => window.clearTimeout(timer);
    }

    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, left: 0, behavior: "instant" });
  }, [pathname, hash, navigationType]);

  return null;
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { EMBLEMS, EMBLEM_SLOTS, TOWER_SKINS, TOWER_SKIN_SLOTS, RARITIES, isSkinOwned } from "@/game/skins";
import SkinPreview from "@/components/SkinPreview";
import GemIcon from "@/components/GemIcon";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";

// Lab section: equip an emblem on the station / left tower / right tower
// (3 independent slots) and a tower skin on the left vs right side tower
// separately. Sits under the skin-buying headline in the Lab.
export default function EmblemsTowersSection({ me, onEquip, onBuy, t }) {
  const [emblemSlot, setEmblemSlot] = useState("station");
  const [towerSlot, setTowerSlot] = useState("leftTower");

  const emblemField = EMBLEM_SLOTS.find((s) => s.id === emblemSlot).field;
  const towerField = TOWER_SKIN_SLOTS.find((s) => s.id === towerSlot).field;
  const equippedEmblem = me?.[emblemField] || "default";
  const equippedTower = me?.[towerField] || "default";

  const emblems = Object.values(EMBLEMS)
    .filter((e) => e.id !== "default")
    .sort((a, b) => RARITIES[a.rarity].order - RARITIES[b.rarity].order);
  const towerSkins = Object.values(TOWER_SKINS)
    .sort((a, b) => RARITIES[a.rarity].order - RARITIES[b.rarity].order);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      {/* Emblems */}
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">{t("collection.emblems")}</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 mb-3">
          {EMBLEM_SLOTS.map((slot) => (
            <button
              key={slot.id}
              onClick={() => setEmblemSlot(slot.id)}
              className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition-all ${
                emblemSlot === slot.id ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-500"
              }`}
            >
              {t(`collection.emblemSlot.${slot.id}`)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {/* "None" chip */}
          <EmblemChip
            skin={EMBLEMS.default}
            equipped={equippedEmblem === "default"}
            onPick={() => onEquip(emblemField, "default")}
            t={t}
          />
          {emblems.map((skin) => (
            <EmblemChip
              key={skin.id}
              skin={skin}
              owned={isSkinOwned(me, "emblem", skin.id)}
              equipped={equippedEmblem === skin.id}
              onPick={() => onEquip(emblemField, skin.id)}
              t={t}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Side-tower skins (left / right independent) */}
      <div>
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">{t("collection.towerSkins")}</h2>
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 mb-3">
          {TOWER_SKIN_SLOTS.map((slot) => (
            <button
              key={slot.id}
              onClick={() => setTowerSlot(slot.id)}
              className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-bold transition-all ${
                towerSlot === slot.id ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-500"
              }`}
            >
              {t(`collection.towerSlot.${slot.id}`)}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
          {towerSkins.map((skin) => (
            <TowerSkinChip
              key={skin.id}
              skin={skin}
              owned={isSkinOwned(me, "tower", skin.id)}
              equipped={equippedTower === skin.id}
              canBuy={(me?.gems || 0) >= skin.price}
              onPick={() => onEquip(towerField, skin.id)}
              onBuy={() => onBuy("tower", skin)}
              t={t}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function EmblemChip({ skin, owned, equipped, onPick, t }) {

  const isNone = skin.id === "default";
  return (
    <div className={`relative p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white flex flex-col items-center transition-all ${equipped ? "border-slate-900 shadow-md scale-[1.02]" : "border-slate-200"}`}>

      {!isNone && <div className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: rarityColor }} />}
      <SkinPreview category="emblem" skinId={skin.id} size={52} />
      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 text-center leading-tight mt-1">{isNone ? t("collection.none") : skin.name}</span>
      {isNone ? (
        <button
          onClick={onPick}
          disabled={equipped}
          className={`mt-1 w-full py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${equipped ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:scale-105"}`}
        >
          {equipped ? t("collection.equipped") : t("collection.equip")}
        </button>
      ) : owned ? (
        <button
          onClick={onPick}
          disabled={equipped}
          className={`mt-1 w-full py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${equipped ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:scale-105"}`}
        >
          {equipped ? t("collection.equipped") : t("collection.equip")}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <span className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-violet-500 text-center leading-tight">{t("shop.chestOnly")}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function TowerSkinChip({ skin, owned, equipped, canBuy, onPick, onBuy, t }) {
  const rarityColor = RARITIES[skin.rarity].color;
  return (

      <div className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: rarityColor }} />
      <SkinPreview category="tower" skinId={skin.id} size={52} />
      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 text-center leading-tight mt-1">{skin.name}</span>
      {owned ? (
        <button
          onClick={onPick}
          disabled={equipped}
          className={`mt-1 w-full py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${equipped ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:scale-105"}`}
        >
          {equipped ? t("collection.equipped") : t("collection.equip")}
        </button>
      ) : skin.source === "chest" ? (
        <span className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-violet-500 text-center leading-tight">{t("shop.chestOnly")}</span>
      ) : (

            canBuy ? "bg-cyan-500 text-white hover:scale-105" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
          }`}
        >
          {skin.price === 0 ? t("shop.free") : <><GemIcon size={10} /> {skin.price}</>}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useId } from "react";
import { STATION_SKINS, TOWER_SKINS, EMBLEMS } from "@/game/skins";
import OrbPatternCanvas from "@/components/OrbPatternCanvas";
import { lighten, darken } from "@/game/colorUtils";

// Compact preview of a cosmetic skin, used in the Shop and Lab.
// Orb patterns render via the REAL in-game canvas renderer (OrbPatternCanvas) so
// the preview is exactly what the player sees in a match — no separate SVG path
// to drift. Station / tower / emblem previews remain lightweight SVG.
export default function SkinPreview({ category, skinId, size = 64, baseColor = "#60a5fa" }) {
  if (category === "orb") return <OrbPatternCanvas skinId={skinId} size={size} baseColor={baseColor} />;
  if (category === "emblem") return <EmblemPreview skinId={skinId} size={size} />;
  if (category === "station") return <StationSkinPreview skinId={skinId} size={size} />;
  if (category === "tower") return <TowerSkinPreview skinId={skinId} size={size} />;
  return null;
}

function EmblemSigil({ shape, cx, cy, u, acc }) {
  const gid = useId();
  switch (shape) {
    case "shield":
      return <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy - u} L ${cx + u * 0.8} ${cy - u * 0.7} L ${cx + u * 0.8} ${cy + u * 0.2} Q ${cx + u * 0.8} ${cy + u} ${cx} ${cy + u} Q ${cx - u * 0.8} ${cy + u} ${cx - u * 0.8} ${cy + u * 0.2} L ${cx - u * 0.8} ${cy - u * 0.7} Z`} fill={acc} />;
    case "crest":
      return (
        <g>
          <defs>
            <linearGradient id={`${gid}-p`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0" stopColor={lighten(acc, 0.3)} /><stop offset="1" stopColor={acc} />
            </linearGradient>
            <linearGradient id={`${gid}-h`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
              <stop offset="0" stopColor="#94a3b8" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#475569" />
            </linearGradient>
          </defs>
          {[-0.34, 0, 0.34].map((dx) => (
            <path key={dx} d={`M ${cx + dx * u} ${cy + u * 0.05} Q ${cx + dx * u * 1.4} ${cy - u * 0.35} ${cx + dx * u * 0.55} ${cy - u * 0.82} Q ${cx + dx * u * 0.85} ${cy - u * 0.4} ${cx + dx * u} ${cy + u * 0.05} Z`} fill={`url(#${gid}-p)`} />
          ))}
          {[-0.34, 0, 0.34].map((dx) => [1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => {
            const t = i * 0.2;
            const px = cx + dx * u * (0.2 + t * 0.35);
            const py = cy + u * 0.05 - t * u * 0.85;
            return <line key={`${dx}-${i}`} x1={px} y1={py} x2={px + dx * u * 0.12} y2={py - u * 0.06} stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.35)" strokeWidth={0.8} />;
          }))}
          <rect x={cx - u * 0.5} y={cy + u * 0.02} width={u} height={u * 0.16} fill={acc} />
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => <rect key={i} x={cx - u * 0.5 + i * u * 0.25} y={cy + u * 0.02} width={u * 0.12} height={u * 0.16} fill={lighten(acc, 0.25)} />)}
          <path d={`M ${cx - u * 0.42} ${cy + u * 0.18} Q ${cx - u * 0.5} ${cy + u * 0.7} ${cx} ${cy + u * 0.72} Q ${cx + u * 0.5} ${cy + u * 0.7} ${cx + u * 0.42} ${cy + u * 0.18} Z`} fill={`url(#${gid}-h)`} />
          <rect x={cx - u * 0.3} y={cy + u * 0.34} width={u * 0.6} height={u * 0.06} fill="#0f172a" />
        </g>
      );
    case "starburst": {
      const pts = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 16 - Math.PI / 2;
        const rr = i % 2 === 0 ? u : u * 0.42;
        pts.push(`${cx + Math.cos(a) * rr},${cy + Math.sin(a) * rr}`);
      }
      return <polygon points={pts.join(" ")} fill={acc} />;
    }
    case "swords":
      return (
        <g>
          {[-Math.PI / 4, Math.PI / 4].map((ang) => (
            <g key={ang} transform={`rotate(${(ang * 180) / Math.PI} ${cx} ${cy})`} fill={acc}>
              <polygon points={`${cx},${cy + u * 0.9} ${cx - u * 0.08},${cy + u * 0.1} ${cx + u * 0.08},${cy + u * 0.1}`} />

function EmblemPreview({ skinId, size }) {
  const skin = EMBLEMS[skinId] || EMBLEMS.default;
  const cx = size / 2, cy = size / 2, r = size / 2 - 2;
  const u = r * 0.6;
  const acc = skin.accent || "#fbbf24";
  const gid = useId();
  if (skin.id === "default") {
    return (
      <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`} width={size} height={size}>
        <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill="none" stroke="#cbd5e1" strokeWidth={1.5} strokeDasharray="3 3" />
      </svg>
    );
  }
  return (
    <svg viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`} width={size} height={size}>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id={gid} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#475569" /><stop offset="1" stopColor="#1e293b" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r} fill={`url(#${gid})`} />
      <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={r * 0.9} fill="none" stroke={acc} strokeWidth={Math.max(1, r * 0.13)} />
      <EmblemSigil shape={skin.shape} cx={cx} cy={cy} u={u} acc={acc} />
    </svg>
  );
}

import React from "react";

// Stacked-card / "copies" motif — used wherever card copy counts appear.
export default function CopyIcon({ size = 16, className }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width={size} height={size} className={className} aria-hidden>
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="copyFront" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0" stopColor="#f8fafc" />
          <stop offset="1" stopColor="#e2e8f0" />
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      {/* back card */}
      <rect x="3.5" y="3.5" width="12" height="16" rx="2.5" fill="#cbd5e1" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1.3" />
      {/* front card */}
      <rect x="8" y="6.5" width="12" height="16" rx="2.5" fill="url(#copyFront)" stroke="#64748b" strokeWidth="1.3" />
      <line x1="10.5" y1="10.5" x2="17.5" y2="10.5" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <line x1="10.5" y1="13.5" x2="17.5" y2="13.5" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" />
      <line x1="10.5" y1="16.5" x2="15" y2="16.5" stroke="#94a3b8" strokeWidth="1.1" strokeLinecap="round" />

  );
}

const DefaultFallback = () => (
  <div className="fixed inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
    <div className="w-8 h-8 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-slate-800 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
  </div>
);

export default function ProtectedRoute({ fallback = <DefaultFallback />, unauthenticatedElement }) {
  const { isAuthenticated, isLoadingAuth, authChecked, authError, checkUserAuth } = useAuth();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authChecked && !isLoadingAuth) {
      checkUserAuth();
    }
  }, [authChecked, isLoadingAuth, checkUserAuth]);

  if (isLoadingAuth || !authChecked) {
    return fallback;
  }

  if (authError) {
    if (authError.type === 'user_not_registered') {
      return <UserNotRegisteredError />;
    }
    return unauthenticatedElement;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return unauthenticatedElement;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}

import React from "react";

// Confetti particle burst from card center — 8 colored dots fly outward and fade.
export function ConfettiBurst({ color = "#fbbf24" }) {
  const colors = [color, "#10b981", "#3b82f6", "#f43f5e", "#fbbf24"];
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none z-30">
      {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, i) => {
        const angle = (i * 45 * Math.PI) / 180;
        const dist = 35 + (i % 2) * 15;
        const dx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
        const dy = Math.sin(angle) * dist;
        return (
          <div
            key={i}
            className="absolute w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full"
            style={{
              background: colors[i % colors.length],
              animation: "confetti-pop 0.6s ease-out forwards",
              "--dx": `${dx}px`,
              "--dy": `${dy}px`,
            }}
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

// Star burst — a star emoji scales up and fades out from card center.
export function StarBurst() {
  return (
    <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none z-30">
      <div className="text-3xl" style={{ animation: "star-burst 0.5s ease-out forwards" }}>⭐</div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";
import { isNativeWebView } from "@/lib/isNativeWebView";
import { Loader2 } from "lucide-react";

// Entry screen shown to unauthenticated users (fresh install / signed out).
// One-tap Google creates a real saveable account (90-day session); email and
// login links cover the alternatives. See PRD: New-player entry & auth flow.
export default function WelcomeScreen() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  // Hide Google inside the native WebView wrapper: Google blocks OAuth in
  // embedded WebViews (disallowed_useragent), so the button hangs forever.
  const inWebView = isNativeWebView();

  const handleGoogle = async () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setError("");
    setBusy(true);
    // loginWithProvider redirects to Google; on return the app re-inits with a
    // token, ProtectedRoute lets the user through, and Home runs onboarding.
    try {
      await base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", safeReturnTo());
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e?.message || "Could not start Google sign-in. Try again.");
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6"
      style={{
        paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)",
        paddingBottom: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 2.5rem)",
      }}
    >
      <div className="max-w-sm w-full mx-auto flex flex-col items-center">
        <div className="text-6xl mb-4 animate-float-bob">⚡</div>
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-black tracking-tighter mb-2 text-center">
          <span className="text-blue-500">SPLITTER</span>{" "}
          <span className="text-rose-500">ORBS</span>
        </h1>
        <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm text-center mb-10 max-w-xs leading-relaxed">
          Split-screen 1v1 tower defense. Blast orbs, build towers, climb the leagues.
        </p>

        {inWebView ? (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/register")}
              className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-blue-500 text-white text-base font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02] hover:bg-blue-600 transition-transform"
            >
              Continue with email
            </button>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] mt-2 text-center">
              New here? Create your account to start playing.
            </p>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <button
              onClick={handleGoogle}
              disabled={busy}
              className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-800 text-base font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-3 shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02] hover:border-slate-300 transition-transform disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {busy ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-slate-500" /> : <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5" />}
              {busy ? "Connecting…" : "Continue with Google"}
            </button>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-[11px] mt-2 text-center">
              New here? One tap creates your account.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/register")}
              className="w-full py-3.5 mt-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 text-sm font-bold hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-white transition-colors"
            >
              Continue with email
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="text-rose-500 text-[11px] mt-1 text-center font-bold">{error}</p>
        )}

        <div className="mt-8 text-center">
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/login")}
            className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800 transition-colors"
          >
            Already have an account?{" "}
            <span className="underline text-slate-700">Log in</span>
          </button>

export default function SideTowerUpgradeCard({ level, shards, onUpgrade }) {

          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{t("shop.sideTowerDesc")}</p>
        </div>
      </div>

          />

          </span>

      {/* Action */}

          {t("shop.maxLabel")}

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import confetti from "canvas-confetti";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";

export default function ShardCrateReveal({ shards, onClose }) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("shaking");
  const [shardElems, setShardElems] = useState([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t1 = setTimeout(() => {
      setPhase("burst");
      const elems = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(shards, 8); i++) {
        const ang = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / Math.min(shards, 8) + Math.random() * 0.3;
        elems.push({ id: i, ang, dist: 80 + Math.random() * 60 });
      }
      setShardElems(elems);

      const end = Date.now() + 800;
      (function frame() {
        confetti({ particleCount: 4, spread: 80, startVelocity: 50, origin: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 }, colors: ["#a3e635", "#65a30d", "#bef264", "#fbbf24"] });
        if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      })();
    }, 1000);

    const t2 = setTimeout(() => setPhase("reveal"), 1500);
    return () => { clearTimeout(t1); clearTimeout(t2); };
  }, [shards]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[80] bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-6" onClick={phase === "reveal" ? onClose : undefined}>
      <div className="text-center">
        {phase === "shaking" && (
          <div className="animate-crate-shake inline-block">
            <div className="relative w-32 h-32 mx-auto">
              <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-400 via-purple-500 to-indigo-600 shadow-2xl shadow-violet-500/50 border-4 border-violet-300/50" />
              <div className="absolute inset-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-300/30 to-transparent" />
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center animate-float-bob"><ShardIcon size={56} /></div>
              <div className="absolute -inset-8 rounded-full bg-violet-500/20 blur-2xl animate-pulse" />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {phase === "burst" && (
          <div className="relative w-64 h-64 mx-auto">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-violet-400/40 blur-3xl animate-ping" />
            <div className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-32 h-32 rounded-full border-4 border-violet-300 animate-ping" />
            {shardElems.map((s) => (
              <div
                key={s.id}
                className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 text-3xl transition-all duration-700 ease-out"
                style={{
                  transform: `translate(-50%, -50%) translate(${Math.cos(s.ang) * s.dist}px, ${Math.sin(s.ang) * s.dist}px) scale(1.2)`,
                  opacity: 0,
                }}
              >
                <ShardIcon size={28} />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {phase === "reveal" && (
          <div className="animate-pop-in">
            <div className="mb-4 animate-float-bob flex justify-center"><ShardIcon size={64} /></div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-violet-300 mb-2">Shard Crate!</h2>
            <p className="text-5xl font-black text-white mb-1">+{shards}</p>
            <p className="text-xl font-bold text-violet-300 mb-8">Shards</p>
            <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm animate-pulse">Tap to continue</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Geometric hexagonal league badge — scales via dim, polygon fits viewBox 36x36
export default function LeagueBadge({ trophies, size = "md", showLabel = false, className = "" }) {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const league = LEAGUES.reduce((acc, l) => ((trophies || 0) >= l.min ? l : acc), LEAGUES[0]);
  const dim = size === "lg" ? 64 : size === "sm" ? 28 : 36;
  const poly = "18 3 33 12 33 24 18 33 3 24 3 12";

  return (
    <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      <svg viewBox="0 0 36 36" width={dim} height={dim} style={{ filter: `drop-shadow(0 0 6px ${league.color}88)` }}>
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id={`lg${league.id}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0" stopColor={league.color} stopOpacity="1" />
            <stop offset="1" stopColor={league.color} stopOpacity="0.55" />
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        <polygon points={poly} fill={`url(#lg${league.id})`} stroke={league.color} strokeWidth="1.5" />
        <polygon points={poly} fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" />
        <text x="18" y="23" textAnchor="middle" fontSize="13" fontWeight="900" fill="white">
          {league.id + 1}
        </text>
      </svg>
      {showLabel && (
        <span className="font-black text-sm" style={{ color: league.color }}>{t(`leagues.${league.id}`)}</span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/components/GameCanvas.jsx
