import React, { useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import {
  GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT, WALL_Y, WALL_THICKNESS,
  PLAYER_STATION, OPPONENT_STATION, TOWER_TYPES, ORB_TYPES, getTowerStats,
  GRID_SIZE, snapToGrid,
} from "@/game/constants";
import { ORB_PATTERNS, STATION_SKINS, TOWER_SKINS, EMBLEMS } from "@/game/skins";
import { drawOrbPattern } from "@/game/orbPatternArt";
import { drawEmblem } from "@/game/emblemArt";

export default function GameCanvas({ stateRef, onCanvasClick, onCanvasPointerDown, onCanvasPointerMove, onCanvasPointerUp, previewRef }) {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const rafRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    const render = () => {
      const s = stateRef.current;
      if (!s) { rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render); return; }
      const preview = previewRef.current;

      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT);
      ctx.save();

      const zoom = s.hitStop > 0 ? 1 + 0.03 * (s.hitStop / 0.07) : 1;
      if (zoom !== 1) {
        ctx.translate(GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
        ctx.scale(zoom, zoom);
        ctx.translate(-GAME_WIDTH / 2, -GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
      }
      const shake = s.shake || 0;
      if (shake > 0) ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 16, (Math.random() - 0.5) * shake * 16);

      // ---- Field ----
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, GAME_HEIGHT);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "#f8fafc"); fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#ffffff"); fg.addColorStop(1, "#f1f5f9");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT);

      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(59,130,246,0.05)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS / 2, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT - WALL_Y);
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,63,94,0.05)";
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS / 2);

      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.04)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (let x = 0; x < GAME_WIDTH; x += 60) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, GAME_HEIGHT); ctx.stroke(); }
      for (let y = 0; y < GAME_HEIGHT; y += 60) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(GAME_WIDTH, y); ctx.stroke(); }

      if (s.player.effects.freeze > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(103,232,249,${0.12 * Math.min(1, s.player.effects.freeze / 4)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, WALL_Y, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT - WALL_Y);
      }

      drawWall(ctx);

      drawStation(ctx, PLAYER_STATION, s.player.hp, s.player.station.maxHp, "#3b82f6", s.player.effects.shield > 0, s.player.flash, "bottom", STATION_SKINS[s.playerSkins?.station] || STATION_SKINS.default, EMBLEMS[s.playerSkins?.stationEmblem] || EMBLEMS.default);
      drawStation(ctx, OPPONENT_STATION, s.opponent.hp, s.opponent.station.maxHp, "#f43f5e", s.opponent.effects.shield > 0, s.opponent.flash, "top", STATION_SKINS[s.oppSkins?.station] || STATION_SKINS.default, EMBLEMS[s.oppSkins?.stationEmblem] || EMBLEMS.default);

      s.player.sideTowers.forEach((st, i) => {
        const side = i === 0 ? "leftTower" : "rightTower";
        drawSideTower(ctx, st, "#3b82f6", "bottom", TOWER_SKINS[s.playerSkins?.[side]] || TOWER_SKINS[s.playerSkins?.tower] || TOWER_SKINS.default, EMBLEMS[s.playerSkins?.[side + "Emblem"]] || EMBLEMS.default);
      });
      s.opponent.sideTowers.forEach((st, i) => {
        const side = i === 0 ? "leftTower" : "rightTower";
        drawSideTower(ctx, st, "#f43f5e", "top", TOWER_SKINS[s.oppSkins?.[side]] || TOWER_SKINS[s.oppSkins?.tower] || TOWER_SKINS.default, EMBLEMS[s.oppSkins?.[side + "Emblem"]] || EMBLEMS.default);
      });

      if (s.editMode) {
        // Dim the battlefield so player towers stand out.
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.38)";
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT);
        // Orbs and opponent towers recede behind the dim layer.
        for (const orb of s.orbs) { ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45; drawOrb(ctx, orb); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
        for (const c of s.coinPickups) { ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5; drawCoinPickup(ctx, c); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
        for (const t of s.opponent.towers) { ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5; drawFantasyTower(ctx, t, "top"); ctx.globalAlpha = 1; }
        // Player towers drawn on top with a pulsing highlight ring.
        for (const t of s.player.towers) {
          drawEditHighlight(ctx, t);
          drawFantasyTower(ctx, t, "bottom");
        }
        if (s.player.selectedTower) {
          const t = s.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === s.player.selectedTower);
          if (t) {
            const stats = getTowerStats(t.type, t.level || 1, t.cardLevel || 1);
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(59,130,246,0.6)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, stats.range, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }
        }
      } else {
        for (const t of s.player.towers) drawFantasyTower(ctx, t, "bottom");
        for (const t of s.opponent.towers) drawFantasyTower(ctx, t, "top");

        // selected tower range ring
        if (s.player.selectedTower) {
          const t = s.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === s.player.selectedTower);
          if (t) {
            const stats = getTowerStats(t.type, t.level || 1, t.cardLevel || 1);
            ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(59,130,246,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, stats.range, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }
        }

        // targeting highlights
        if (s.targeting) {
          for (const orb of s.orbs) {
            if (orb.side !== 0 || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
            const sel = s.targeting.selected.includes(orb.id);
            ctx.strokeStyle = sel ? "#818cf8" : "rgba(129,140,248,0.5)";
            ctx.lineWidth = sel ? 4 : 2;
            ctx.setLineDash(sel ? [] : [5, 5]);
            ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, orb.radius + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
          }
        }

        for (const orb of s.orbs) drawOrb(ctx, orb);
        for (const c of s.coinPickups) drawCoinPickup(ctx, c);
      }

      for (const p of s.projectiles) drawProjectile(ctx, p);

      for (const g of s.glues || []) drawGluePuddle(ctx, g);
      for (const z of s.zones || []) drawZone(ctx, z);
      for (const m of s.meteors || []) drawMeteor(ctx, m);
      for (const ms of s.mortarShots || []) drawMortarShot(ctx, ms);
      for (const mg of s.magnets || []) drawMagnet(ctx, mg);
      for (const mi of s.mines || []) drawMine(ctx, mi);
      if (s.player.burner && s.player.burner.holding) drawBurnerBeam(ctx, s.player.burner);
      if (s.aiming) drawAimReticle(ctx, s.aiming, preview);
      for (const e of s.effects) drawEffect(ctx, e);
      for (const p of s.particles) drawParticle(ctx, p);
      for (const f of s.floaters) drawFloater(ctx, f);

      if (s.player.effects.shield > 0) drawShieldDome(ctx, PLAYER_STATION, s.player.effects.shield);

      if (preview && preview.placing) {
        const def = TOWER_TYPES[preview.placing];
        if (def) {
          const { mx, my } = preview;
          const { col, row, x: gx, y: gy } = snapToGrid(mx, my);
          ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(59,130,246,0.18)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
          for (let cx = GRID_SIZE / 2; cx < GAME_WIDTH; cx += GRID_SIZE) {
            for (let cy = GRID_SIZE / 2; cy < GAME_HEIGHT; cy += GRID_SIZE) {
              if (cy <= WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS / 2 || cy > GAME_HEIGHT - 24) continue;
              ctx.strokeRect(cx - GRID_SIZE / 2, cy - GRID_SIZE / 2, GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE);
            }
          }
          const occupied = s.player.towers.some((t) => t.gridCol === col && t.gridRow === row)
            || s.player.sideTowers.some((st) => st.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(st.x - gx, st.y - gy) < GRID_SIZE * 0.7);
          const inBounds = gy > WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS && gy < GAME_HEIGHT - 24 && gx > 20 && gx < GAME_WIDTH - 20
            && Math.hypot(gx - PLAYER_STATION.x, gy - PLAYER_STATION.y) >= 64;
          const ok = !occupied && inBounds && s.player.coins >= def.cost;
          ctx.fillStyle = ok ? "rgba(59,130,246,0.18)" : "rgba(244,63,94,0.18)";
          ctx.fillRect(gx - GRID_SIZE / 2, gy - GRID_SIZE / 2, GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE);
          ctx.strokeStyle = ok ? def.color : "#f43f5e";
          ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(gx, gy, def.range, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.setLineDash([]);
          ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
          drawFantasyTower(ctx, { type: preview.placing, x: gx, y: gy, hp: 60, maxHp: 60, spawn: 0, level: 1 }, "bottom");
          ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
        }
      }

      ctx.restore();

      // ---- Overlays (no shake/zoom) ----
      if (s.flash > 0) {
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${Math.min(0.85, s.flash)})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT);
      }
      if (s.player.effects.rage > 0) drawRageVignette(ctx, s.player.effects.rage);
      if (s.waveBanner > 0) drawWaveBanner(ctx, s.wave, s.waveBanner, s.time);
      if (s.overtimeActive && !s.maxPressureActive) drawOvertimeBanner(ctx, s.overtimeScale, s.escalationTier);
      if (s.maxPressureActive && !s.towerBleedActive) drawMaxPressureBanner(ctx);
      if (s.towerBleedActive) drawTowerBleedBanner(ctx);
      if (s.tierBanner) drawTierAnnouncement(ctx, s.tierBanner.tier, s.tierBanner.life);

      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(render);
    };
    render();
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
  }, [stateRef, previewRef]);

  return (
    <canvas
      ref={canvasRef}
      width={GAME_WIDTH}
      height={GAME_HEIGHT}
      onClick={onCanvasClick}
      onPointerDown={onCanvasPointerDown}
      onPointerMove={onCanvasPointerMove}
      onPointerUp={onCanvasPointerUp}
      onPointerLeave={onCanvasPointerUp}
      className="w-full h-full block cursor-crosshair touch-none"
    />
  );
}

// ---- Fantasy stone wall ----
function drawWall(ctx) {
  const y = WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS / 2;
  const h = WALL_THICKNESS;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.fillRect(0, y + h, GAME_WIDTH, 9);
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, y, 0, y + h);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#a8a29e"); g.addColorStop(0.25, "#78716c"); g.addColorStop(0.75, "#57534e"); g.addColorStop(1, "#44403c");
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(0, y, GAME_WIDTH, h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)"; ctx.fillRect(0, y, GAME_WIDTH, 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(0,0,0,0.4)"; ctx.fillRect(0, y + h - 2, GAME_WIDTH, 2);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  const segW = 50;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y + h / 2); ctx.lineTo(GAME_WIDTH, y + h / 2); ctx.stroke();
  for (let x = 0; x <= GAME_WIDTH; x += segW) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h / 2); ctx.stroke(); }
  for (let x = -segW / 2; x <= GAME_WIDTH; x += segW) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + segW / 2, y + h / 2); ctx.lineTo(x + segW / 2, y + h); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(34,197,94,0.2)"; ctx.fillRect(0, y + h - 3, GAME_WIDTH, 3);
}

// ---- Fantasy castle keep ----
function drawStation(ctx, pos, hp, maxHp, color, shielded, flash, side, skin, emblem) {
  const flip = side === "top";
  const x = pos.x, y = pos.y;
  const dir = -1; // both keeps render upright (battlements + flag on top)
  const body = (skin && skin.body) || ["#cbd5e1", "#94a3b8", "#64748b"];
  const trim = (skin && skin.trim) || "#cbd5e1";

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.22)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + (flip ? -28 : 30), 34, 7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - 28, y, x + 28, y);
  g.addColorStop(0, body[0]); g.addColorStop(0.5, body[1]); g.addColorStop(1, body[2]);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.fillRect(x - 26, y - 18, 52, 36);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"; ctx.fillRect(x - 26, y - 18, 52, 3);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.3)"; ctx.fillRect(x - 26, y + 15, 52, 3);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.25)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 26, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 26, y);
  ctx.moveTo(x - 10, y - 18); ctx.lineTo(x - 10, y);
  ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y - 18); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y);
  ctx.moveTo(x - 10, y); ctx.lineTo(x - 10, y + 18);
  ctx.moveTo(x + 10, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, y + 18);
  ctx.stroke();

  const battY = y + dir * 20;
  ctx.fillStyle = trim;
  [-16, 0, 16].forEach((dx) => { ctx.fillRect(x + dx - 5, battY - 4, 10, 8); });

  const poleX = x + 22;
  const poleTop = y + dir * 34;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#475569"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(poleX, y); ctx.lineTo(poleX, poleTop); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(poleX, poleTop); ctx.lineTo(poleX + 14, poleTop + dir * 4); ctx.lineTo(poleX, poleTop + dir * 9); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();

  if (emblem && emblem.id !== "default") {
    drawEmblem(ctx, x, y, 11, emblem);
  } else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = color; ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 3, y - 3, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  if (flash > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(244,63,94,${Math.min(0.6, flash)})`;
    ctx.fillRect(x - 26, y - 18, 52, 36);
  }

  const barY = flip ? y - 34 : y + 34;
  const w = 60;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.12)"; ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, barY, w, 6);
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, barY, w * Math.max(0, hp / maxHp), 6);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.25)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(x - w / 2 + 0.5, barY + 0.5, w - 1, 5);
}

// ---- Frost overlay for frozen towers ----
function drawTowerFrost(ctx, x, y, frozen) {
  const intensity = Math.min(1, frozen / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(103,232,249,${0.22 * intensity})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(186,230,253,${0.75 * intensity})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    const a = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + Date.now() / 2500;
    const cx = x + Math.cos(a) * 17;
    const cy = y + Math.sin(a) * 17;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * 6, cy + Math.sin(a) * 6);
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a + 0.5) * 4, cy + Math.sin(a + 0.5) * 4);
    ctx.moveTo(cx, cy); ctx.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a - 0.5) * 4, cy + Math.sin(a - 0.5) * 4);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.3 * intensity})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 5, y - 5, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

// ---- Fantasy turret — distinct silhouette per type ----
function drawFantasyTower(ctx, t, side) {
  const def = TOWER_TYPES[t.type];
  const c = def?.color || "#64748b";
  const hp = t.hp ?? 60;
  const maxHp = t.maxHp ?? 60;
  const alive = hp > 0;
  const x = t.x, y = t.y;
  const flip = side === "top";
  const dir = flip ? 1 : -1;
  const level = t.level || 1;
  const tall = (level - 1) * 10;

  let scale = 1;
  if (t.spawn > 0) {
    const p = 1 - t.spawn / 0.45;
    scale = 0.4 + 0.6 * p + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 0.18;
  }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(x, y);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  ctx.translate(-x, -y);

  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.15)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + 16, 18, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  if (!alive) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cbd5e1";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 12, y + 8, 24, 6);
    ctx.restore();
    return;
  }

  if (def?.bouncer) {
    const stats = getTowerStats(t.type, level, t.cardLevel || 1);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(20,184,166,0.12)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, stats.range, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  const bodyTop = y - 2 - tall;
  drawTowerBody(ctx, t, x, y, bodyTop, level, dir);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = level >= 6 ? "#fbbf24" : c; ctx.shadowBlur = 14 + level * 4;
  drawTowerTop(ctx, t, x, y, bodyTop, c, level, dir);
  ctx.restore();

  if (level >= 6) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(251,191,36,${0.5 + pulse * 0.4})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 24 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(251,191,36,${0.1 + pulse * 0.08})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  if (level > 1) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
    const spacing = level <= 3 ? 8 : 6;
    const pipR = level >= 6 ? 2.5 : 2;
    const start = x - (level - 1) * spacing / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < level; i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(start + i * spacing, y + 11, pipR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
  }

  ctx.restore();

  if (hp < maxHp) drawHealthBar(ctx, x, bodyTop - 6, 32, hp, maxHp, c);
  if (t.poisonTimer && t.poisonTimer > 0) drawTowerInfection(ctx, t, x, bodyTop - 16, side === "bottom");
  if (t.frozen > 0) drawTowerFrost(ctx, x, y, t.frozen);
}

function drawTowerBody(ctx, t, x, y, bodyTop, level, dir) {
  const type = t.type;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - 16, y, x + 16, y);
  if (type === "siege") {
    g.addColorStop(0, "#d6d3d1"); g.addColorStop(0.5, "#a8a29e"); g.addColorStop(1, "#78716c");
  } else if (type === "venom" || type === "pyre") {
    g.addColorStop(0, "#e2e8f0"); g.addColorStop(0.5, "#cbd5e1"); g.addColorStop(1, "#94a3b8");
  } else {
    g.addColorStop(0, "#cbd5e1"); g.addColorStop(0.5, "#94a3b8"); g.addColorStop(1, "#64748b");
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  if (type === "siege") {
    ctx.fillRect(x - 18, y + 6, 36, 10);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#78716c";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 16, y + 16, 6, 6);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 10, y + 16, 6, 6);
  } else if (type === "glacier") {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 14, y + 14); ctx.lineTo(x - 8, bodyTop); ctx.lineTo(x + 8, bodyTop); ctx.lineTo(x + 14, y + 14); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x - 16, y + 14); ctx.lineTo(x - 12, bodyTop); ctx.lineTo(x + 12, bodyTop); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 14); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"; ctx.fillRect(x - 16, bodyTop, 4, 14 + (y - bodyTop));
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.fillRect(x + 12, bodyTop, 4, 14 + (y - bodyTop));
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 16, y + 6); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 6); ctx.stroke();
    const battY = bodyTop + dir * 8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#cbd5e1";
    ctx.fillRect(x - 14, battY - 4, 6, 7);
    ctx.fillRect(x - 3, battY - 4, 6, 7);
    ctx.fillRect(x + 8, battY - 4, 6, 7);
    if (level >= 3) {
      ctx.fillRect(x - 9, battY - 9, 5, 6);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, battY - 9, 5, 6);
    }
  }
}

function drawTowerTop(ctx, t, x, y, bodyTop, c, level, dir) {
  const cy = y - 2;
  const tall = (level - 1) * 10;
  switch (t.type) {
    case "machinegun": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + i * 7, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) { ctx.fillRect(x + i * 7 - 1.5, cy - 12, 3, 8); }
      break;
    }
    case "sniper": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(x + 5, cy); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + 6); ctx.lineTo(x - 5, cy); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 22 - tall * 0.4); ctx.stroke();
      break;
    }
    case "bomb": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 8); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 6, cy - 14, x + 2, cy - 18); ctx.stroke();
      break;
    }
    case "boomerang": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 8, 0.5, Math.PI * 1.5); ctx.lineTo(x, cy); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 8, Math.PI + 0.5, Math.PI * 2.5); ctx.lineTo(x, cy); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "bouncer": {
      ctx.lineWidth = 5; ctx.strokeStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 2, 8, Math.PI, 0); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, cy - 2, 4, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, cy - 2, 4, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f87171";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 9, cy + 4, 5, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, cy + 4, 5, 4);
      break;
    }
    case "glacier": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const sx = x - 10 + i * 5;
        const sh = 10 + (i % 2) * 6 + tall;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, cy - 2); ctx.lineTo(sx + 2.5, cy - sh); ctx.lineTo(sx + 5, cy - 2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 14 - tall, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "arc": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#475569"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 20 - tall); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 20 - tall, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const a = Date.now() / 100 + i * 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 20 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * 10, cy - 20 - tall + Math.sin(a) * 10); ctx.stroke();
      }
      break;
    }
    case "pyre": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 2, 9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      const flameH = 12 + tall + Math.sin(Date.now() / 100) * 3;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 7, cy - 2); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - 8, cy - flameH * 0.6, x, cy - flameH); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 8, cy - flameH * 0.6, x + 7, cy - 2); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 4, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "venom": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath();
      if (ctx.roundRect) { ctx.roundRect(x - 8, cy - 10, 16, 12, 3); } else { ctx.rect(x - 8, cy - 10, 16, 12); }
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 3, cy - 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 3, cy - 6, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy + 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "siege": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#78716c"; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 12, cy - 2); ctx.lineTo(x + 12, cy - 14 - tall); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 12, cy - 14 - tall, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#a8a29e"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 4); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 12); ctx.stroke();
      break;
    }
    case "orb_mortar": {
      const recoil = t.fireFlash > 0 ? (t.fireFlash / 0.3) * 5 : 0;
      ctx.fillStyle = "#57534e";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, cy + 2, 11, 5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.save();
      ctx.translate(x, cy);
      ctx.rotate(dir > 0 ? Math.PI * 0.75 : -Math.PI * 0.25);
      ctx.translate(0, recoil);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#78716c";
      ctx.fillRect(-4, -18, 8, 16);
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(-5, -20, 10, 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -18, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      break;
    }
    case "repulsor": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 10, cy - 4, 20, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e0e7ff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      const recoil = t.fireFlash > 0 ? (t.fireFlash / 0.3) * 4 : 0;
      if (recoil > 0) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(99,102,241,${recoil / 4})`;
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 8 + i * 4 + recoil, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      break;
    }
    case "cryo": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 6, cy + 2); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + 6, cy + 2); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#e0f2fe";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 16 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 2, cy - 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "seeker": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#831843";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 9, cy - 2, 18, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, cy - 8, 3, 8);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 5, cy - 8, 3, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 6.5, cy - 8, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 6.5, cy - 8, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "prism": {
      const float = Math.sin(Date.now() / 400) * 3;
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall + float); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, cy + float); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + 14 + float); ctx.lineTo(x - 10, cy + float); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall + float); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, cy + float); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + float); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.2)";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall + float); ctx.lineTo(x - 10, cy + float); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + float); ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "flak": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 10, cy - 4, 20, 8);
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 8, cy - 4); ctx.lineTo(x - 12, cy - 12 - tall * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(x + 12, cy - 12 - tall * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(x + 8, cy - 4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 12 - tall * 0.3, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "harpoon": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#475569"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 10, cy); ctx.lineTo(x + 10, cy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 10, cy); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, cy - 8, x + 10, cy); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 16 - tall); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 16 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, cy - 12 - tall); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "twin": {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 6, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 6, cy, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, cy - 2, 3, 10);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 5, cy - 2, 3, 10);
      break;
    }
    case "tesla": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const yOff = cy - 2 - i * 5 - tall;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, yOff, 5 - i * 0.5, 2.5 - i * 0.3, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 16 - tall, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const a = Date.now() / 80 + i * Math.PI / 2;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 16 - tall); ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * 10, cy - 16 - tall + Math.sin(a) * 10); ctx.stroke();
      }
      break;
    }
    case "detonator": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, cy - 2, 16, 6);
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy - 8 - tall * 0.3, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fef2f2";
      ctx.font = "900 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
      ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("!", x, cy - 8 - tall * 0.3);
      break;
    }
    case "magnet": {
      // Horseshoe magnet with glowing poles
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - 8, cy - 14 - tall);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 8, cy + 2);
      ctx.arc(x, cy + 2, 8, Math.PI, 0, true);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 8, cy - 14 - tall);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy - 14 - tall);
      ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy + 2);
      ctx.arc(x, cy + 2, 4, 0, Math.PI, false);
      ctx.lineTo(x - 4, cy - 14 - tall);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fill();
      // Pole tips
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 9, cy - 16 - tall, 5, 4);
      ctx.fillRect(x + 4, cy - 16 - tall, 5, 4);
      // Glow at poles
      const mPulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(99,102,241,${mPulse * 0.5})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 6.5, cy - 14 - tall, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 6.5, cy - 14 - tall, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "capacitor": {
      // Charging cylinder with energy buildup
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 7, cy - 14 - tall, 14, 18);
      // Charge level glow
      const charge = (t._charge || 0) / 3;
      const chargeH = charge * 14;
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 5, cy + 2 - chargeH, 10, chargeH);
      // Electric arcs at top when near full
      if (charge > 0.7) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
          const a = Date.now() / 80 + i * 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 14 - tall);
          ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * 8, cy - 14 - tall + Math.sin(a) * 8);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      // Top cap
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.fillRect(x - 8, cy - 16 - tall, 16, 3);
      break;
    }
    case "overcharger": {
      // Pulsing energy emitter with radiating waves
      const oPulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 150);
      // Core
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // Radiating waves
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34,211,238,${0.4 + oPulse * 0.3})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const waveR = 8 + i * 5 + oPulse * 4;
        ctx.globalAlpha = (0.4 - i * 0.1) * (1 - oPulse * 0.3);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, cy, waveR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // Antenna spikes
      ctx.strokeStyle = c; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 8); ctx.lineTo(x, cy - 14 - tall);
      ctx.moveTo(x - 8, cy); ctx.lineTo(x - 14, cy);
      ctx.moveTo(x + 8, cy); ctx.lineTo(x + 14, cy);
      ctx.stroke();
      break;
    }
    case "mine_layer": {
      // Mine dispenser with visible mine orbs
      ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 10, cy - 2, 20, 8);
      // Mine orbs on top
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 5, cy - 8 - tall * 0.2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + 5, cy - 8 - tall * 0.2, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // Spikes on mines
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ea580c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
      for (const mx of [x - 5, x + 5]) {
        for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 4 + Math.PI / 4;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(mx + Math.cos(a) * 4, cy - 8 - tall * 0.2 + Math.sin(a) * 4);
          ctx.lineTo(mx + Math.cos(a) * 7, cy - 8 - tall * 0.2 + Math.sin(a) * 7);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      // Dispenser chute
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b";
      ctx.fillRect(x - 3, cy + 4, 6, 3);
      break;
    }
    default: {
      ctx.fillStyle = c;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 12 - tall * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(x + 9, cy); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + 8); ctx.lineTo(x - 9, cy); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.55)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, cy - 9); ctx.lineTo(x + 4, cy - 4); ctx.lineTo(x, cy + 1); ctx.lineTo(x - 4, cy - 4); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
  }
}

function drawSideTower(ctx, st, color, side, skin, emblem) {
  const alive = st.hp > 0;
  const x = st.x, y = st.y;
  const flip = side === "top";
  const dir = flip ? 1 : -1;
  const body = (skin && skin.body) || ["#cbd5e1", "#94a3b8", "#64748b"];
  const trim = (skin && skin.trim) || "#cbd5e1";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.18)";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y + 22, 22, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  if (!alive) { ctx.fillStyle = "#cbd5e1"; ctx.fillRect(x - 14, y + 14, 28, 6); return; }

  // subtle gate archway accent
  ctx.strokeStyle = `${color}40`; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 22, y - 6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y - 30, x + 22, y - 6);
  ctx.stroke();

  const baseY = y + 16;
  const topY = y - 30;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - 16, y, x + 16, y);
  g.addColorStop(0, body[0]); g.addColorStop(0.5, body[1]); g.addColorStop(1, body[2]);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x - 16, baseY); ctx.lineTo(x - 12, topY); ctx.lineTo(x + 12, topY); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, baseY); ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"; ctx.fillRect(x - 16, topY, 4, baseY - topY);
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.fillRect(x + 12, topY, 4, baseY - topY);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 16, y + 4); ctx.lineTo(x + 16, y + 4); ctx.stroke();

  const battY = topY + dir * 7;
  ctx.fillStyle = trim;
  ctx.fillRect(x - 14, battY - 4, 6, 7);
  ctx.fillRect(x - 3, battY - 4, 6, 7);
  ctx.fillRect(x + 8, battY - 4, 6, 7);

  if (emblem && emblem.id !== "default") {
    drawEmblem(ctx, x, y - 2, 7, emblem);
  } else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = color; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.fillStyle = color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - 2, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - 2, y - 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  drawHealthBar(ctx, x, topY - 8, 32, st.hp, st.maxHp, color);
  if (st.poisonTimer && st.poisonTimer > 0) drawTowerInfection(ctx, st, x, topY - 18, side === "bottom");
  if (st.frozen > 0) drawTowerFrost(ctx, x, y - 2, st.frozen);
}

function drawHealthBar(ctx, cx, y, w, hp, maxHp, color) {
  const x = cx - w / 2;
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.1)"; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 5);
  ctx.fillStyle = color; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w * Math.max(0, hp / maxHp), 5);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.2)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(x + 0.5, y + 0.5, w - 1, 4);
}

// Radioactive infection aura on a tower; shows a "tap to cleanse" hint for the player's own towers.
function drawTowerInfection(ctx, t, x, hintY, isPlayer) {
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(132,204,22,${0.4 + pulse * 0.4})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, t.y, 22 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(132,204,22,${0.12 + pulse * 0.1})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, t.y, 22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  if (isPlayer) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3f6212";
    ctx.font = "900 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("👆 tap to cleanse", x, hintY);
  }
}

// ---- Orb: HP number in center, type-specific decoration ----
function drawOrb(ctx, orb) {
  const r = orb.radius;
  let scale = 1;
  if (orb.spawnAge < 0.3) {
    const p = orb.spawnAge / 0.3;
    scale = 0.3 + 0.7 * p + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * 0.2;
  }

  // mine: pulsing danger ring
  if (orb.detonateOnClick) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 120);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(249,115,22,${0.4 + pulse * 0.4})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 8 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y);
  ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  ctx.shadowColor = orb.color; ctx.shadowBlur = orb.detonateOnClick ? 22 : 18;
  ctx.fillStyle = orb.color;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // tank armor plates
  if (orb.type === "tank") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.4)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r - 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.25)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r - 3), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r - 3), 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // mine fuse spark
  if (orb.detonateOnClick) {
    const spark = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 80);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(254,240,138,${spark})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r - 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // glossy highlight
  const hg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x - r * 0.35, orb.y - r * 0.35, 1, orb.x, orb.y, r);
  hg.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)"); hg.addColorStop(0.4, "rgba(255,255,255,0.15)"); hg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = hg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();

  // equipped orb pattern overlay (bought orbs carry the owner's pattern)
  drawOrbPattern(ctx, orb, r);

  // Upgraded orb aura ring — tiered by card level (2–5); level 1 stays clean
  const cardLvl = orb.cardLevel || 1;
  if (cardLvl >= 2) {
    const auraR = r + 4;
    if (cardLvl === 2) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(203,213,225,0.55)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, auraR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    } else if (cardLvl === 3) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(251,191,36,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, auraR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    } else if (cardLvl === 4) {
      const pulse = 0.6 + 0.25 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 300);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(251,191,36,${pulse})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, auraR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    } else { // level 5 — vivid amber + animated shimmer arc
      const pulse = 0.7 + 0.3 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 250);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(245,158,11,${pulse})`; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, auraR + 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      const shim = (Date.now() / 600) % (Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(254,240,138,0.9)"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, auraR + 1, shim, shim + 1.4); ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  // ---- type-specific decorations for new orbs ----
  // shielder: hexagonal shield ring
  if (orb.shieldHp > 0) {
    const shieldPct = orb.shieldHp / (ORB_TYPES.shield?.shield || 40);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(251,146,60,${0.5 + shieldPct * 0.4})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 6 + (Date.now() / 800);
      const px = orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 6);
      const py = orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 6);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(251,146,60,${0.08 * shieldPct})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // sprint: motion trail behind
  if (orb.ignoresTowers) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(6,182,212,0.35)";
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.8;
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    const dir = orb.side === 0 ? -1 : 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y);
    ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + dir * r * 3);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  }
  // healer: pulsing cross icon above
  if (orb.type === "healer") {
    const pulse = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(74,222,128,${pulse})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(orb.x - 5, orb.y - r - 10); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + 5, orb.y - r - 10);
    ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r - 15); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y - r - 5);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  }

  // bomb: explode-on-death marker — fuse spark + bomb glyph + faint pulsing ring
  if (orb.explodesOnDeath) {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 150);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(244,63,94,${0.25 + pulse * 0.25})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 5 + pulse * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    const spark = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 90);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(254,240,138,${spark})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r - 2, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.font = "12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("💣", orb.x, orb.y - r - 11);
  }

  // attacker indicator
  if (orb.attacker && !orb.detonateOnClick && !orb.explodesOnDeath) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,63,94,0.9)";
    ctx.font = "900 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("⚔", orb.x, orb.y - r - 8);
  }

  // armored: hexagonal armor plates
  if (orb.type === "armored") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.55)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath();
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 6;
      const px = orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r - 3);
      const py = orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r - 3);
      if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
    }
    ctx.closePath();
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.18)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r - 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // carrier: smaller orbs visible inside
  if (orb.type === "carrier") {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 3 + Date.now() / 800;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r * 0.4), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r * 0.4), 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(249,115,22,0.4)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r - 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  }
  // growth: pulsing growth ring that intensifies over time
  if (orb.type === "growth") {
    const age = orb._growthAge || 0;
    const t = Math.min(1, age / 8);
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(34,197,94,${0.3 + t * 0.4})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2 + t * 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 4 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    const stages = Math.floor(t * 3);
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(34,197,94,${0.5 + t * 0.5})`;
    for (let i = 0; i < stages; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r - 8 - i * 4, 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  // shield_bubble: protective bubble aura
  if (orb.type === "shield_bubble") {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 300);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(56,189,250,${0.3 + pulse * 0.3})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 6 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(56,189,250,${0.08 * pulse})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // berserker: rage cracks that intensify as HP drops
  if (orb.type === "berserker") {
    const ratio = Math.max(0, orb.hp / orb.maxHp);
    const intensity = 1 - ratio;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(239,68,68,${0.4 + intensity * 0.5})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5 + intensity * 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 4 + Date.now() / 500;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r - 2), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r - 2));
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 4 + intensity * 6), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 4 + intensity * 6));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    if (intensity > 0.5) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(239,68,68,${(intensity - 0.5) * 0.3})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }

  // leech: drain tether to attached tower + pulsing crimson aura
  if (orb.type === "leech") {
    if (orb._leechTargetId) {
      // The tether is drawn from the orb to the tower — but we don't have tower refs here.
      // Show a pulsing attachment glow instead.
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 150);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(190,18,60,${0.6 + pulse * 0.3})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 5 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      // Drain particles
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(190,18,60,${pulse * 0.5})`;
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 3 + Date.now() / 200;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 4), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 4), 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
    } else {
      // Seeking: pulsing targeting ring
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 250);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(190,18,60,${0.3 + pulse * 0.3})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 4 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    }
    // Fangs indicator
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(244,63,94,0.9)";
    ctx.font = "900 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("🩸", orb.x, orb.y - r - 8);
  }

  // summoner: spawn portal glow + minion indicator
  if (orb.type === "summoner") {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
    // Pulsing spawn aura
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(124,58,237,${0.4 + pulse * 0.3})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 5 + pulse * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    // Mini orb icons orbiting
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(167,139,250,0.6)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 3 + Date.now() / 600;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 8), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 8), 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    // Spawn timer ring
    const timerPct = (orb.summonTimer || 0) / (orb.summonInterval || 2.5);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#7c3aed"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 3, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + timerPct * Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  }

  // HP number in center
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y);
  if (scale !== 1) ctx.scale(scale, scale);
  const fontSize = Math.max(13, Math.round(r * 0.95));
  ctx.font = `900 ${fontSize}px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.55)";
  ctx.strokeText(Math.ceil(orb.hp), 0, 1);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.fillText(Math.ceil(orb.hp), 0, 1);
  ctx.restore();

  if (orb.frozen > 0) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#22d3ee"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.8)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 4;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r - 4), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r - 4));
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 6), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 6));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
  if (orb.slowTimer > 0) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(56,189,248,0.7)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  }
  if (orb.burn > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(249,115,22,0.25)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  if (orb.poisonTimer > 0 && (orb.poisonStacks || 0) > 0) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(132,204,22,0.3)";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#65a30d";
    ctx.font = "900 9px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(orb.poisonStacks, orb.x, orb.y - r - 8);
  }

  // radioactive: pulsing sickly-green glow + bold hazard trefoil + dripping aura
  if (orb.type === "radioactive") {
    const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
    // pulsing radial glow
    const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r, orb.x, orb.y, r + 18);
    glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(132,204,22,${0.45 + pulse * 0.3})`);
    glow.addColorStop(1, "rgba(132,204,22,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = glow;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // dripping aura ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(101,163,13,${0.5 + pulse * 0.3})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.setLineDash([5, 4]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    // falling green droplets
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(132,204,22,0.85)";
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 4 + (Date.now() / 900);
      const drip = (Date.now() / 500 + i * 0.25) % 1;
      const dy = drip * (r + 10);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 4), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 4) + dy, 2.2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    // bold hazard trefoil
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y - r - 12);
    ctx.scale(1.15, 1.15);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#3f6212";
    ctx.font = "900 17px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText("☣", 0, 0);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  // phantom: stealth shimmer + reveal glow (distinct from shadow/fog)
  if (orb.phantom) {
    if (orb.revealed) {
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 250);
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(139,92,246,${0.6 + pulse * 0.4})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      const timerPct = (orb.phantomRevealTimer || 0) / (orb.revealDuration || 3);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#8b5cf6"; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 4, -Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2 + timerPct * Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      const fog = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, 2, orb.x, orb.y, r + 14);
      fog.addColorStop(0, "rgba(139,92,246,0.8)");
      fog.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(167,139,250,0.5)");
      fog.addColorStop(1, "rgba(167,139,250,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = fog;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(139,92,246,0.4)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // shadow: fog cloud hides the orb until the reveal window, then a warning glow
  if (orb.stealth && !orb.phantom) {
    if (orb.revealed) {
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 250);
      ctx.save();
      ctx.shadowColor = "#ef4444"; ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(239,68,68,${0.45 + pulse * 0.25})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      ctx.save();
      const fog = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, 2, orb.x, orb.y, r + 18);
      fog.addColorStop(0, "rgba(51,65,85,0.95)");
      fog.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(71,85,105,0.7)");
      fog.addColorStop(1, "rgba(71,85,105,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = fog;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // faint inner silhouette so players sense an orb hiding in the mist
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.5)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
    }
  }

  // zap_orb: blue electricity orb with stretch/latch rendering
  if (orb.type === "zap_orb") {
    if (orb._zapState === "latched" && orb._zapTarget) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(59,130,246,${0.6 + 0.3 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 80)})`;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
      ctx.shadowColor = "#3b82f6"; ctx.shadowBlur = 14;
      const segs = 5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y);
      for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
        const tt = i / segs;
        const lx = orb.x + (orb._zapTarget.x - orb.x) * tt + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
        const ly = orb.y + (orb._zapTarget.y - orb.y) * tt + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12;
        ctx.lineTo(lx, ly);
      }
      ctx.lineTo(orb._zapTarget.x, orb._zapTarget.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
      const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 100);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(59,130,246,${0.15 + pulse * 0.1})`;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r + 8 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    if ((orb._zapState === "hopping" || orb._zapState === "seeking") && orb._zapNextTarget) {
      const dx = orb._zapNextTarget.x - orb.x, dy = orb._zapNextTarget.y - orb.y;
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(59,130,246,0.3)";
      ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.6;
      ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - dx * 0.15, orb.y - dy * 0.15);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
    }
    const crack = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 60);
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(147,197,253,${crack})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 3 + Date.now() / 200;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * (r + 6 + crack * 3), orb.y + Math.sin(a) * (r + 6 + crack * 3));
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }
}

// Pulsing highlight ring shown around player towers in edit mode.
function drawEditHighlight(ctx, t) {
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(59,130,246,${0.5 + pulse * 0.4})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 26 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(59,130,246,${0.08 + pulse * 0.06})`;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 26, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
}

// ---- Coin pickup ----
function drawCoinPickup(ctx, c) {
  const bob = Math.sin((c.bob || 0) * 4) * 6;
  const a = Math.min(1, c.life / 1.2);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  const pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 200);
  // outer glow ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(251,191,36,${0.25 + pulse * 0.3})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y + bob, 24 + pulse * 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  // soft halo
  const halo = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x, c.y + bob, 4, c.x, c.y + bob, 30);
  halo.addColorStop(0, "rgba(251,191,36,0.5)");
  halo.addColorStop(1, "rgba(251,191,36,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = halo;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y + bob, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // coin body with gradient + glow
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "#fbbf24"; ctx.shadowBlur = 22;
  const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x - 5, c.y + bob - 5, 2, c.x, c.y + bob, 18);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "#fde68a"); cg.addColorStop(0.6, "#fbbf24"); cg.addColorStop(1, "#f59e0b");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y + bob, 18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
  // inner ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(c.x, c.y + bob, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  // star
  ctx.fillStyle = "#92400e";
  ctx.font = "900 20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.fillText("★", c.x, c.y + bob + 1);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// ---- Projectile: trail + glow + shape per type ----
function drawProjectile(ctx, p) {
  if (p.trail && p.trail.length > 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < p.trail.length; i++) {
      const t = p.trail[i];
      ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
      ctx.globalAlpha = (i / p.trail.length) * 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 2 + i * 0.4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = p.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
  ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
  const spin = (p.age || 0) * 14;
  if (p.type === "sniper") {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 4, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(p.x - 8, p.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x + 8, p.y); ctx.stroke();
  } else if (p.type === "bomb") {
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(spin);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -6); ctx.lineTo(6, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, 6); ctx.lineTo(-6, 0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  } else if (p.type === "boomerang") {
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(spin * 2);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, 0, Math.PI * 1.4); ctx.lineTo(0, 0); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 5, Math.PI, Math.PI * 2.4); ctx.lineTo(0, 0); ctx.fill();
  } else if (p.type === "glacier") {
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(spin);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, -6); ctx.lineTo(4, 0); ctx.lineTo(0, 6); ctx.lineTo(-4, 0); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  } else if (p.type === "pyre") {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fde68a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  } else if (p.type === "venom") {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x - 1.5, p.y - 1.5, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  } else if (p.type === "siege") {
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y); ctx.rotate(spin);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, 0, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  } else {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.type === "machinegun" ? 3 : 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawParticle(ctx, p) {
  const a = Math.max(0, p.life / p.maxLife);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  if (p.sparkle) {
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = p.color; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(p.x - p.size * 2, p.y); ctx.lineTo(p.x + p.size * 2, p.y);
    ctx.moveTo(p.x, p.y - p.size * 2); ctx.lineTo(p.x, p.y + p.size * 2);
    ctx.stroke();
  } else {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
    ctx.rotate((p.life * 8) % (Math.PI * 2));
    ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
    ctx.fillRect(-p.size, -p.size, p.size * 2, p.size * 2);
    ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawFloater(ctx, f) {
  const a = Math.min(1, f.life / 0.4);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.font = `900 ${f.size}px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 4; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.6)";
  ctx.strokeText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  ctx.fillStyle = f.color;
  ctx.fillText(f.text, f.x, f.y);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawEffect(ctx, e) {
  const p = 1 - e.life / e.maxLife;
  if (e.type === "pop" || e.type === "click" || e.type === "hit") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - p;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 8 + p * 22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "explosion") {
    // Layered blast: shockwave + fireball + bright core + sparks
    const fireR = 6 + p * 44;
    const coreR = 6 + p * 30;
    const shockR = 10 + p * 60;
    // shockwave ring (fast, fades)
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, (1 - p) * 0.8);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fff7ed"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, shockR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    // fireball
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, (1 - p) * 0.85);
    const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(e.x, e.y, 2, e.x, e.y, fireR);
    fg.addColorStop(0, "#fde68a"); fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#f97316"); fg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(239,68,68,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = fg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, fireR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // bright core
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p * 1.5);
    const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(e.x, e.y, 1, e.x, e.y, coreR);
    cg.addColorStop(0, "#ffffff"); cg.addColorStop(0.5, "#fde68a"); cg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(251,146,60,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = cg;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, coreR, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    // sparks
    ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, (1 - p) * 0.9);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fde68a"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.lineCap = "round";
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 7;
      const r0 = 8 + p * 12;
      const r1 = r0 + 12 + p * 34;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(e.x + Math.cos(a) * r0, e.y + Math.sin(a) * r0);
      ctx.lineTo(e.x + Math.cos(a) * r1, e.y + Math.sin(a) * r1);
      ctx.stroke();
    }
    ctx.lineCap = "butt";
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "zap") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - p;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x - 10, e.y - 10); ctx.lineTo(e.x + 5, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.x - 5, e.y + 5); ctx.lineTo(e.x + 10, e.y + 10); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "portal" || e.type === "spawnPortal") {
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = e.type === "portal" ? 4 : 2; ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.8;
    const r = e.type === "portal" ? 30 : 6 + p * 18;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(e.x, e.y, r, (e.type === "portal" ? 16 : 6) + p * 10, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    if (e.type === "spawnPortal") { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, r * 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "repair") {
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color; ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.4;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 40 + p * 20, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "lightning_chain") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.95;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#fde68a"; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
    ctx.shadowColor = "#facc15"; ctx.shadowBlur = 18;
    if (e.points.length > 0) drawLightning(ctx, e.points[0].x, 0, e.points[0].x, e.points[0].y);
    for (let i = 0; i < e.points.length - 1; i++) {
      drawLightning(ctx, e.points[i].x, e.points[i].y, e.points[i + 1].x, e.points[i + 1].y);
    }
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "ash") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.75;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#57534e";
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 7 + p * 1.5;
      const r = 4 + p * 20;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x + Math.cos(a) * r, e.y + Math.sin(a) * r - p * 16, 3 + (1 - p) * 2.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "burner_beam") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(e.x, e.y, 4, e.x, e.y, e.radius || 75);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(251,146,60,0.7)");
    g.addColorStop(0.6, "rgba(249,115,22,0.3)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(249,115,22,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, e.radius || 75, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "meteor_aim") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ef4444"; ctx.lineWidth = 3; ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 95 * (1 - p) + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.setLineDash([]);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#78716c";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y - 200 * (1 - p), 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "glue_drop") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.6;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#a3e635";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 85 * (1 - p) + 10, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "heal_pulse") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#4ade80"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 120) * p, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "poison_cloud") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.6;
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(e.x, e.y, 2, e.x, e.y, e.radius || 30);
    g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(163,230,53,0.7)");
    g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(101,163,13,0)");
    ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 30) * (1 + p), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "mortar_muzzle") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - p;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 6 + p * 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f59e0b";
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 3 + p * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "mortar_impact") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.55;
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 8 + p * 34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.8;
    ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
    for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 7 + p * 1.5;
      const rr = 6 + p * 22;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, e.y + Math.sin(a) * rr, 2 + (1 - p) * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "prism_beam") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.9;
    const ramp = e.ramp || 0;
    const width = 2 + ramp * 2;
    const intensity = 0.4 + ramp * 0.2;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(168,85,247,${intensity * 0.5})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = width * 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.tx, e.ty); ctx.stroke();
    const innerColor = ramp > 2 ? "#ffffff" : `rgba(168,85,247,${intensity})`;
    ctx.strokeStyle = innerColor;
    ctx.lineWidth = width;
    ctx.shadowColor = "#a855f7"; ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.tx, e.ty); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "zap_arrival") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - p;
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#3b82f6"; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 8 + p * 24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(147,197,253,0.8)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 4 + p * 16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "tesla_pulse") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.7;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 110) * (0.4 + p * 0.6), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(1 - p) * 0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 110) * (0.3 + p * 0.5), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "detonator_pulse") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.6;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 130) * (0.3 + p * 0.7), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(220,38,38,${(1 - p) * 0.15})`;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 130) * (0.3 + p * 0.7), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "harpoon_shot") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.tx, e.ty); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.tx, e.ty, 4 + (1 - p) * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "shield_bubble_pulse") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 100) * (0.5 + p * 0.5), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "capacitor_beam") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.9;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 6;
    ctx.shadowColor = e.color; ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.tx, e.ty); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(e.x, e.y); ctx.lineTo(e.tx, e.ty); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "overcharger_pulse") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.5;
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color; ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 130) * (0.3 + p * 0.7), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(1 - p) * 0.3})`; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, (e.radius || 130) * (0.2 + p * 0.5), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  } else if (e.type === "reveal_flash") {
    ctx.globalAlpha = (1 - p) * 0.6;
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 18 + p * 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${(1 - p) * 0.5})`; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(e.x, e.y, 22 + p * 16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  }
}

function drawShieldDome(ctx, pos, time) {
  const pulse = 0.6 + Math.sin(time * 6) * 0.15;
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(147,197,253,${pulse})`;
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.shadowColor = "#93c5fd"; ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 40, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.6)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  const a = (Date.now() / 400) % (Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, 40, a, a + 1.2); ctx.stroke();
}

function drawRageVignette(ctx, time) {
  const pulse = 0.25 + Math.sin(time * 8) * 0.08;
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2, GAME_HEIGHT * 0.3, GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2, GAME_HEIGHT * 0.7);
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(251,146,60,0)");
  g.addColorStop(1, `rgba(251,146,60,${pulse})`);
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, GAME_WIDTH, GAME_HEIGHT);
}

function drawWaveBanner(ctx, wave, life, time) {
  const grace = (time || 0) < 4;
  const max = grace ? 4 : 2.2;
  const p = life / max;
  const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p * 2, (1 - p) * 4));
  const label = grace ? "GET READY" : `WAVE ${wave}`;
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.font = "900 44px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.5)";
  ctx.strokeText(label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = grace ? "#38bdf8" : "#fbbf24";
  ctx.fillText(label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawOvertimeBanner(ctx, scale, tier) {
  const tierDef = tier >= 3
    ? { label: "CRITICAL", c1: "#b91c1c", c2: "#7f1d1d" }
    : tier >= 2
    ? { label: "INTENSIFYING", c1: "#ef4444", c2: "#dc2626" }
    : { label: "OVERTIME", c1: "#ef4444", c2: "#fbbf24" };
  const pulse = 0.65 + 0.35 * Math.sin(Date.now() / 250);
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse;
  ctx.font = "900 36px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 6; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.6)";
  ctx.strokeText(tierDef.label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, 42);
  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(GAME_WIDTH / 2 - 90, 42, GAME_WIDTH / 2 + 90, 42);
  grad.addColorStop(0, tierDef.c1); grad.addColorStop(0.5, tierDef.c2); grad.addColorStop(1, tierDef.c1);
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillText(tierDef.label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, 42);
  if (scale > 0) {
    ctx.font = "900 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
    ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24";
    ctx.fillText(`+${Math.round(scale * 100)}% intensity`, GAME_WIDTH / 2, 64);
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawTierAnnouncement(ctx, tier, life) {
  const max = 2;
  const p = life / max;
  const a = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p * 2, (1 - p) * 4));
  const def = tier === 5 ? { label: "TOWER BLEED!", color: "#7f1d1d" }
    : tier === 4 ? { label: "MAX PRESSURE!", color: "#ea580c" }
    : tier === 3 ? { label: "CRITICAL!", color: "#b91c1c" }
    : tier === 2 ? { label: "INTENSIFYING!", color: "#ef4444" }
    : { label: "OVERTIME!", color: "#ef4444" };
  ctx.globalAlpha = a;
  ctx.font = "900 48px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif";
  ctx.textAlign = "center"; ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
  ctx.lineWidth = 7; ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.6)";
  ctx.strokeText(def.label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
  ctx.fillStyle = def.color;
  ctx.fillText(def.label, GAME_WIDTH / 2, GAME_HEIGHT / 2);
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawLightning(ctx, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
  const segs = 7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
    const t = i / segs;
    ctx.lineTo(x1 + (x2 - x1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26, y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 26);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.9)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
  for (let i = 1; i < segs; i++) {
    const t = i / segs;
    ctx.lineTo(x1 + (x2 - x1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18, y1 + (y2 - y1) * t + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 18);
  }
  ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.restore();
}

function drawGluePuddle(ctx, g) {
  const a = Math.min(1, g.life / 6);
  ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.5;
  const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(g.x, g.y, 8, g.x, g.y, g.radius);
  grad.addColorStop(0, "rgba(163,230,53,0.7)");
  grad.addColorStop(1, "rgba(101,163,13,0)");
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(g.x, g.y, g.radius, g.radius * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = a * 0.8;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(101,163,13,0.6)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(g.x, g.y, g.radius, g.radius * 0.6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(236,252,203,0.7)";
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const ang = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 5 + g.life;
    const rr = g.radius * 0.5;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(g.x + Math.cos(ang) * rr, g.y + Math.sin(ang) * rr * 0.6, 3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

function drawMeteor(ctx, m) {
  if (m.exploded) return;
  const fall = 1 - m.timer / 0.9;
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(239,68,68,0.7)"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.setLineDash([6, 6]);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, m.y, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  const rockY = m.y - 260 * (1 - fall);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(249,115,22,0.6)"; ctx.lineWidth = 4;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(m.x, rockY - 40); ctx.lineTo(m.x, rockY); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = "#f97316"; ctx.shadowBlur = 16;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#78716c";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(m.x, rockY, 12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();
}
