import { ORB_PATTERNS } from "./skins";
import { darken, lighten, rgba } from "./colorUtils";

// Pattern overlay rendered inside the orb (clipped to its circle).
// Color model: the pattern BODY is painted in a darkened shade of the orb's
// own color (so it always harmonizes with blue/red/type-colored orbs), and the
// per-skin accent is reserved for exactly one signature highlight detail.
// "default" renders a faint stripe so opponent-placed orbs are always visible.
// Geometry is tuned per-pattern to fill 85-90%+ of the orb radius (extending to
// the edge, clipped by the circle) so patterns read as substantial, not tiny.

// Shared premium gloss: soft top-left highlight + bright rim arc, applied to
// every orb so the catalog reads as finished glossy collectibles.
function drawOrbGloss(ctx, orb, r) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    orb.x - r * 0.35, orb.y - r * 0.35, r * 0.05,
    orb.x - r * 0.35, orb.y - r * 0.35, r * 0.85
  );
  g.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0.32)");
  g.addColorStop(0.45, "rgba(255,255,255,0.06)");
  g.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)";
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.05);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.93, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.85);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Kraken — bulbous mantle, trailing tentacle arms, forward-raised tentacles,
// single predatory eye. Mythical chase item, the most striking of the set.
function drawKrakenPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, bodyLite) {
  const cx = orb.x, cy = orb.y;
  // Trailing tentacle arms (behind head)
  ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.15; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  const arms = [
    { sx: -0.3, sy: 0.05, cpx: -0.7, cpy: 0.45, ex: -0.5, ey: 0.82 },
    { sx: -0.12, sy: 0.1, cpx: -0.3, cpy: 0.55, ex: -0.18, ey: 0.86 },
    { sx: 0.12, sy: 0.1, cpx: 0.3, cpy: 0.55, ex: 0.18, ey: 0.86 },
    { sx: 0.3, sy: 0.05, cpx: 0.7, cpy: 0.45, ex: 0.5, ey: 0.82 },
  ];
  for (const a of arms) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(cx + a.sx * r, cy + a.sy * r);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + a.cpx * r, cy + a.cpy * r, cx + a.ex * r, cy + a.ey * r);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx + a.ex * r, cy + a.ey * r, r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // Bulbous mantle/head
  const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx - r * 0.12, cy - r * 0.4, r * 0.04, cx, cy - r * 0.2, r * 0.5);
  mg.addColorStop(0, bodyLite); mg.addColorStop(1, body);
  ctx.fillStyle = mg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - r * 0.72);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - r * 0.4, cy - r * 0.72, cx - r * 0.44, cy - r * 0.18, cx - r * 0.34, cy + r * 0.04);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx - r * 0.2, cy + r * 0.12, cx + r * 0.2, cy + r * 0.12, cx + r * 0.34, cy + r * 0.04);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(cx + r * 0.44, cy - r * 0.18, cx + r * 0.4, cy - r * 0.72, cx, cy - r * 0.72);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // Two forward-raised tentacles with suckers
  ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.12; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
    const sx = cx + side * r * 0.26, sy = cy - r * 0.08;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(sx, sy);
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(cx + side * r * 0.62, cy - r * 0.42, cx + side * r * 0.72, cy - r * 0.72);
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
    for (let t = 0.35; t <= 0.8; t += 0.22) {
      const px = sx + (cx + side * r * 0.72 - sx) * t;
      const py = (cy - r * 0.08) + ((cy - r * 0.72) - (cy - r * 0.08)) * t;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(px, py, r * 0.025, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  }
  ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  // Single predatory eye
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - r * 0.34, r * 0.13, r * 0.09, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - r * 0.34, r * 0.05, r * 0.07, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx - r * 0.03, cy - r * 0.37, r * 0.022, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

export function drawOrbPattern(ctx, orb, r) {
  const pid = orb.patternId;
  if (!pid) return;
  const skin = ORB_PATTERNS[pid];
  if (!skin || skin.pattern === "none") return;
  const hi = skin.accent || "#ffffff";
  const base = orb.color || "#60a5fa";
  const isDefault = pid === "default";
  // Accent-as-hero: thematic skins use the accent color as the primary fill so
  // Fire reads orange, Leaf reads green, etc. — instead of everything being a
  // darkened shade of the orb's own color. Default keeps the orb-tone body so
  // opponent-placed orbs stay visible.
  const body = isDefault ? darken(base, 0.42) : hi;
  const bodyDeep = isDefault ? darken(base, 0.6) : darken(hi, 0.35);
  const bodyLite = isDefault ? darken(base, 0.22) : lighten(hi, 0.2);

  ctx.save();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.clip();

  switch (skin.pattern) {
    case "stripe": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.globalAlpha = isDefault ? 0.22 : 0.7;
      for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 6) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + i - r, orb.y - r); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + i + r, orb.y + r); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "dots": {
      ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx += 6) for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy += 6) {
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + dx, orb.y + dy, 1.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "crosshatch": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 5) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r, orb.y + i); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r, orb.y + i); ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + i, orb.y - r); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + i, orb.y + r); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      for (let dx = -r; dx <= r; dx += 10) for (let dy = -r; dy <= r; dy += 10) {
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + dx, orb.y + dy, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "chevron": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 1.8; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 7) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r, orb.y + i); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + i - 4); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r, orb.y + i); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 7) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y + i - 4, 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "ring": {
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.25, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.92);
      g.addColorStop(0, "transparent"); g.addColorStop(0.7, "transparent"); g.addColorStop(1, rgba(body, 0.5));
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.92, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = hi; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "tree": drawTreePattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi); break;
    case "fortress": drawFortressPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi); break;
    case "diamonds": drawDiamondsPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyLite, hi); break;
    case "dragon": drawDragonPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi); break;
    case "smiley": {
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.82, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.28, orb.y - r * 0.18, r * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.28, orb.y - r * 0.18, r * 0.12, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.24, orb.y - r * 0.22, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.32, orb.y - r * 0.22, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.12; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.05, r * 0.45, 0.15 * Math.PI, 0.85 * Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "heart": {
      const hs = r * 0.9;
      const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - hs * 0.8, orb.x, orb.y + hs * 0.7);
      hg.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.18)); hg.addColorStop(1, body);
      ctx.fillStyle = hg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.82;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y + hs * 0.75);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(orb.x - hs * 1.05, orb.y - hs * 0.15, orb.x - hs * 0.55, orb.y - hs * 0.85, orb.x, orb.y - hs * 0.35);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(orb.x + hs * 0.55, orb.y - hs * 0.85, orb.x + hs * 1.05, orb.y - hs * 0.15, orb.x, orb.y + hs * 0.75);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - hs * 0.35); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + hs * 0.1); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x - r * 0.28, orb.y - r * 0.42, r * 0.12, r * 0.2, -0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.25, orb.y - r * 0.35, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "star": {
      const sg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.05, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.92);
      sg.addColorStop(0, lighten(hi, 0.3)); sg.addColorStop(1, hi);
      ctx.fillStyle = sg; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = -Math.PI / 2 + (i * 2 * Math.PI) / 5;
        const a2 = a + Math.PI / 5;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.92, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.92);
        else ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.92, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.92);
        ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a2) * r * 0.4, orb.y + Math.sin(a2) * r * 0.4);
      }
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = lighten(hi, 0.4); ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.05); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.04); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.3, orb.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "cloud": {
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath();
      const cy = orb.y + r * 0.08;
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.8, cy + r * 0.26);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.9, cy - r * 0.18, orb.x - r * 0.46, cy - r * 0.18);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.4, cy - r * 0.62, orb.x, cy - r * 0.56);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.4, cy - r * 0.62, orb.x + r * 0.46, cy - r * 0.18);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.9, cy - r * 0.18, orb.x + r * 0.8, cy + r * 0.26);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.72, cy + r * 0.46, orb.x, cy + r * 0.46);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.72, cy + r * 0.46, orb.x - r * 0.8, cy + r * 0.26);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x - r * 0.14, cy - r * 0.32, r * 0.3, r * 0.08, -0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = darken(hi, 0.2); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x, cy + r * 0.4, r * 0.5, r * 0.06, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "raindrop": {
      ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.72, orb.y, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.08, r * 0.14, r * 0.26, -0.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "wave": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.12; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      for (let row = -1; row <= 1; row++) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 4) {
          const y = orb.y + row * r * 0.4 + Math.sin(i * 0.12) * r * 0.15;
          if (i === -r) ctx.moveTo(orb.x + i, y); else ctx.lineTo(orb.x + i, y);
        }
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      for (let row = -1; row <= 1; row++) {
        for (let i = -r; i <= r; i += 8) {
          const y = orb.y + row * r * 0.4 + Math.sin(i * 0.12) * r * 0.15;
          if (Math.sin(i * 0.12) > 0.7) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + i, y - r * 0.04, 1.3, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill(); }
        }
      }
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "leaf": {
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y); ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 4);
      const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -r * 0.82, 0, r * 0.82);
      lg.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.15)); lg.addColorStop(0.5, body); lg.addColorStop(1, bodyDeep);
      ctx.fillStyle = lg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, -r * 0.82);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.46, -r * 0.22, r * 0.32, r * 0.3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.18, r * 0.66, 0, r * 0.82);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.18, r * 0.66, -r * 0.32, r * 0.3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.46, -r * 0.22, 0, -r * 0.82);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.strokeStyle = hi; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.58, orb.y + r * 0.58); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.58); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) {
        const t = i * 0.22;
        const mx = orb.x - r * 0.58 + t * r * 1.16, my = orb.y + r * 0.58 - t * r * 1.16;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx, my); ctx.lineTo(mx + r * 0.2, my + r * 0.08); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx, my); ctx.lineTo(mx - r * 0.08, my - r * 0.2); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "feather": {
      // Classic plume: central rachis running the full length, barbs angling
      // symmetrically off both sides, tapering to a pointed tip at the top and
      // a bare quill (calamus) at the base.
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y);
      const tipY = -r * 0.82, baseY = r * 0.62;
      // soft vane fill — two symmetric halves tapering to a point at the tip
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, tipY, 0, baseY);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "#ddd6fe"); fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#a78bfa"); fg.addColorStop(1, "#6d28d9");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(0, tipY);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(r * 0.44, -r * 0.5, r * 0.38, r * 0.12, 0, baseY);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.38, r * 0.12, -r * 0.44, -r * 0.5, 0, tipY);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // rachis (central spine) full length
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#4c1d95"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, r * 0.06); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, baseY); ctx.lineTo(0, tipY); ctx.stroke();
      // barbs angling symmetrically off both sides, shorter toward the tip
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#7c3aed"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      const nBarbs = 7;
      for (let i = 1; i <= nBarbs; i++) {
        const t = i / (nBarbs + 1);
        const y = baseY + (tipY - baseY) * t;
        const halfW = r * 0.36 * (1 - t * 0.55);
        const slant = r * 0.06;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(halfW, y - slant); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(-halfW, y - slant); ctx.stroke();
      }
      // quill (bare calamus) extends below the vane base
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#4c1d95"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, r * 0.07); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, baseY); ctx.lineTo(0, r * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.restore();
      break;
    }
    case "snowflake": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.08; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 3;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.9, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
        for (const d of [0.5, 0.78]) {
          const bx = orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * d, by = orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * d;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx, by); ctx.lineTo(bx + Math.cos(a + 0.7) * r * 0.22, by + Math.sin(a + 0.7) * r * 0.22); ctx.stroke();
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx, by); ctx.lineTo(bx + Math.cos(a - 0.7) * r * 0.22, by + Math.sin(a - 0.7) * r * 0.22); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "moon": {
      // Full cratered moon: soft outer rim glow, radial-shaded disc, maria
      // craters with subtle rim highlights, and a bright lit-edge arc.
      const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.78, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.98);
      glow.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");
      glow.addColorStop(1, rgba(lighten(body, 0.25), 0.5));
      ctx.fillStyle = glow; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.98, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      const mg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y - r * 0.3, r * 0.1, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.85);
      mg.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.2)); mg.addColorStop(0.7, body); mg.addColorStop(1, bodyDeep);
      ctx.fillStyle = mg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.85, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      const craters = [
        [-0.3, -0.2, 0.16], [0.22, -0.32, 0.1], [0.1, 0.28, 0.13],
        [-0.4, 0.3, 0.08], [-0.12, -0.5, 0.06], [0.38, 0.12, 0.07],
      ];
      ctx.fillStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
      for (const [cx, cy, cr] of craters) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + cx * r, orb.y + cy * r, cr * r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = lighten(body, 0.3); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35;
      for (const [cx, cy, cr] of craters) {
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + cx * r, orb.y + cy * r, cr * r, Math.PI * 1.1, Math.PI * 1.9); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = lighten(body, 0.35); ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, r * 0.05); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.85, Math.PI * 1.15, Math.PI * 1.85); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "sun": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.08; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 4;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.5, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.5);
        ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.9, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.42, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "mushroom": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fef3c7"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.16, orb.y - r * 0.06, r * 0.32, r * 0.58);
      const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.72, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.06);
      cg.addColorStop(0, lighten(hi, 0.15)); cg.addColorStop(1, hi);
      ctx.fillStyle = cg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.72, orb.y - r * 0.06);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.72, orb.y - r * 0.72, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.72);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y - r * 0.72, orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y - r * 0.06);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.28, orb.y - r * 0.32, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.46, r * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.42, orb.y - r * 0.18, r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "fire": {
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.88, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      fg.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.15)); fg.addColorStop(0.5, body); fg.addColorStop(1, bodyDeep);
      ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.72, orb.y, orb.x - r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.44);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.74, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.52, orb.x + r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.58);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.44);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.26, orb.y, orb.x - r * 0.12, orb.y - r * 0.18);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.44, orb.x + r * 0.12, orb.y - r * 0.18);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.26, orb.y, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.44);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "lightning": {
      const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.88, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.88);
      g.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.2)); g.addColorStop(1, body);
      ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.42, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.08, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y + r * 0.88);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.42, orb.y - r * 0.16);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.08, orb.y - r * 0.16);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = hi; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.42, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.08, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y + r * 0.88);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "lantern": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = darken(hi, 0.3); ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, r * 0.06); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.7, r * 0.1, Math.PI, 0); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#78716c"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y - r * 0.62, r * 0.6, r * 0.12);
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.2, orb.y - r * 0.72, r * 0.4, r * 0.1);
      const wg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.05, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.5);
      wg.addColorStop(0, "#fffbeb"); wg.addColorStop(0.5, hi); wg.addColorStop(1, darken(hi, 0.2));
      ctx.fillStyle = wg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.5, r * 0.72, r * 0.92);
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#57534e"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, r * 0.05); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.strokeRect(orb.x - r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.5, r * 0.72, r * 0.92);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.36, orb.y); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.36, orb.y); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "eye": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.82, r * 0.44, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.16, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.08, orb.y - r * 0.08, r * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e293b"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, r * 0.08); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.7, orb.y - r * 0.4); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.56, orb.x + r * 0.7, orb.y - r * 0.4); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "crown": {
      const cg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.52, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.44);
      cg.addColorStop(0, lighten(hi, 0.25)); cg.addColorStop(1, hi);
      ctx.fillStyle = cg; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.74, orb.y + r * 0.44);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.74, orb.y - r * 0.14);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.44, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.52);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.52);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.44, orb.y + r * 0.08);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.74, orb.y - r * 0.14);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.74, orb.y + r * 0.44);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = darken(hi, 0.2); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.74, orb.y + r * 0.26, r * 1.48, r * 0.18);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.38, r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.38, r * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f87171"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.35, r * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "claw": {
      const talon = "#f5f5f4";
      const tip = "#451a03";
      for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
        const ox = i * r * 0.42;
        const baseX = orb.x + ox - r * 0.4, baseY = orb.y - r * 0.66;
        const midX = orb.x + ox - r * 0.08, midY = orb.y + r * 0.08;
        const tipX = orb.x + ox + r * 0.08, tipY = orb.y + r * 0.52;
        ctx.fillStyle = talon; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(baseX - r * 0.1, baseY);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX - r * 0.12, midY, tipX - r * 0.04, tipY);
        ctx.lineTo(tipX + r * 0.04, tipY);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(midX + r * 0.12, midY, baseX + r * 0.1, baseY);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = darken(talon, 0.15); ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(baseX, baseY + r * 0.04, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle = tip; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tipX - r * 0.06, tipY - r * 0.08);
        ctx.lineTo(tipX + r * 0.06, tipY - r * 0.08);
        ctx.lineTo(tipX, tipY + r * 0.12);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "volcano": {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#57534e"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.88, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.3, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.88, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#44403c"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.fillRect(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y - r * 0.36, r * 0.6, r * 0.08);
      const lg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.3, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.74);
      lg.addColorStop(0, "#fffbeb"); lg.addColorStop(0.3, "#fbbf24"); lg.addColorStop(1, hi);
      ctx.fillStyle = lg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.1, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.1, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.06, orb.y + r * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.06, orb.y + r * 0.6);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fbbf24"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.12, orb.y - r * 0.5, r * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.56, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "windstorm": {
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.1; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let a = 0; a < Math.PI * 4; a += 0.2) {
        const rad = a * r * 0.1;
        const x = orb.x + Math.cos(a) * rad, y = orb.y + Math.sin(a) * rad;
        if (a === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.06; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let a = 0; a < Math.PI * 3.5; a += 0.2) {
        const rad = a * r * 0.085;
        const x = orb.x + Math.cos(a + Math.PI) * rad, y = orb.y + Math.sin(a + Math.PI) * rad;
        if (a === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y); else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 5 + Math.PI / 6;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.72, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.72, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "bone": {
      ctx.save(); ctx.translate(orb.x, orb.y); ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 6);
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -r * 0.18, 0, r * 0.18);
      bg.addColorStop(0, lighten(hi, 0.15)); bg.addColorStop(0.5, hi); bg.addColorStop(1, darken(hi, 0.15));
      ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      ctx.fillRect(-r * 0.58, -r * 0.18, r * 1.16, r * 0.36);
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.58, -r * 0.26, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(-r * 0.58, r * 0.26, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r * 0.58, -r * 0.26, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(r * 0.58, r * 0.26, r * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = darken(hi, 0.3); ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.3, -r * 0.1); ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.1, r * 0.06); ctx.lineTo(r * 0.05, -r * 0.04); ctx.lineTo(r * 0.25, r * 0.08); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.restore();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "spider": {
      ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.12, r * 0.34, r * 0.42, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.34, r * 0.2, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = body; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.07; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const yo = -r * 0.2 + i * r * 0.16;
        for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
          const sx = orb.x + side * r * 0.2, sy = orb.y + yo;
          const jx = orb.x + side * r * 0.5, jy = orb.y + yo - r * 0.2;
          const ex = orb.x + side * r * 0.78, ey = orb.y + yo - r * 0.32;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(jx, jy); ctx.lineTo(ex, ey); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "#ef4444"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.08, orb.y - r * 0.38, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.08, orb.y - r * 0.38, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt"; ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "phoenix": {
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.8, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.7);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "#fde047"); fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#f97316"); fg.addColorStop(1, "#dc2626");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.82;
      // left wing — layered feathers
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.55, orb.y - r * 0.2, orb.x - r * 0.88, orb.y - r * 0.62);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.6, orb.y - r * 0.1, orb.x - r * 0.42, orb.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.35, orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.12);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.32, orb.y - r * 0.5, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.22);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // right wing (mirror)
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.55, orb.y - r * 0.2, orb.x + r * 0.88, orb.y - r * 0.62);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.6, orb.y - r * 0.1, orb.x + r * 0.42, orb.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.35, orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.12);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.32, orb.y - r * 0.5, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.22);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // body + tail flames
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.14, orb.y);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.2, orb.y + r * 0.45, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.78);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.2, orb.y + r * 0.45, orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // feather lines
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,29,29,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.5, orb.y - r * 0.22); ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.74, orb.y - r * 0.48); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.5, orb.y - r * 0.22); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.74, orb.y - r * 0.48); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // head
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.3, r * 0.13, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f59e0b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.38); ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.15, orb.y - r * 0.32); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.26); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.04, orb.y - r * 0.32, r * 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "kraken": {
      drawKrakenPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, bodyLite);
      break;
    }
    case "inferno": {
      const fg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.14, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.95);
      fg.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.2)); fg.addColorStop(0.6, body); fg.addColorStop(1, bodyDeep);
      ctx.fillStyle = fg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.82;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.82);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.8, orb.y + r * 0.14, orb.x - r * 0.44, orb.y - r * 0.36);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.8, orb.x - r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.66, orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.88);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.8, orb.x + r * 0.44, orb.y - r * 0.36);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.8, orb.y + r * 0.14, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.82);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.52);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.4, orb.y + r * 0.08, orb.x - r * 0.18, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.58, orb.x + r * 0.18, orb.y - r * 0.3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.4, orb.y + r * 0.08, orb.x, orb.y + r * 0.52);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, 1, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.26);
      cg.addColorStop(0, hi); cg.addColorStop(1, rgba(hi, 0));
      ctx.fillStyle = cg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.26, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI * 2) / 5 + Math.PI / 3;
        const rr = r * (0.58 + (i % 2) * 0.16);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * rr, orb.y - r * 0.72 + Math.sin(i) * r * 0.14, r * 0.035, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    case "eclipse": {
      const eg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.42, orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.88);
      eg.addColorStop(0, "#000000"); eg.addColorStop(0.7, "#000000"); eg.addColorStop(1, "rgba(0,0,0,0)");
      ctx.fillStyle = eg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.88, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = hi; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.06; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, r * 0.74, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.strokeStyle = rgba(hi, 0.5); ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.04;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 4;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.76, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.76);
        ctx.lineTo(orb.x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.9, orb.y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.9); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      break;
    }
    default:
      break;
  }

  drawOrbGloss(ctx, orb, r);

  ctx.restore();
}

// ---- Original complex patterns (orb-tone body + accent highlight) ----
// Reworked to fill 85-90%+ of the orb radius.

// Tree: single merged foliage blob + trunk (no overlapping circles).
function drawTreePattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi) {
  // textured trunk with gradient
  const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x - r * 0.14, orb.y, orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y);
  tg.addColorStop(0, "#78350f"); tg.addColorStop(0.5, "#b45309"); tg.addColorStop(1, "#78350f");
  ctx.fillStyle = tg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.1, orb.y + r * 0.86);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.14, orb.y + r * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y + r * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.1, orb.y + r * 0.86);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // root flare
  ctx.fillStyle = "#78350f"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.1, orb.y + r * 0.86); ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.3, orb.y + r * 0.8); ctx.lineTo(orb.x - r * 0.14, orb.y + r * 0.2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.1, orb.y + r * 0.86); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.3, orb.y + r * 0.8); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y + r * 0.2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // layered canopy with radial gradient
  const cg = ctx.createRadialGradient(orb.x - r * 0.2, orb.y - r * 0.5, r * 0.05, orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.3, r * 0.8);
  cg.addColorStop(0, "#4ade80"); cg.addColorStop(0.6, "#16a34a"); cg.addColorStop(1, "#14532d");
  ctx.fillStyle = cg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y - r * 0.45, r * 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.2, r * 0.34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.36, orb.y - r * 0.2, r * 0.34, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  // foliage highlights
  ctx.fillStyle = "#bbf7d0"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
  for (const f of [[-0.3, -0.3], [0.2, -0.55], [0.35, -0.15], [-0.1, -0.1], [0.1, -0.4]]) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + f[0] * r, orb.y + f[1] * r, r * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Fortress: stone keep with battlements + gate, orb-tone body + accent flag.
function drawFortressPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi) {
  const w = r * 1.0, h = r * 1.16;
  const bx = orb.x - w / 2, by = orb.y - h / 2 + r * 0.14;
  ctx.fillStyle = body; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.75;
  ctx.fillRect(bx, by, w, h);
  const merlW = w / 5;
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i += 2) ctx.fillRect(bx + i * merlW, by - merlW * 0.8, merlW, merlW * 0.8);
  ctx.strokeStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx, by + h * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(bx + w, by + h * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx + (i + 0.5) * w / 3, by); ctx.lineTo(bx + (i + 0.5) * w / 3, by + h * 0.5); ctx.stroke(); }
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyDeep; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x - w * 0.12, by + h);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x - w * 0.12, by + h * 0.6);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x, by + h * 0.4, orb.x + w * 0.12, by + h * 0.6);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x + w * 0.12, by + h);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.fillRect(orb.x + w * 0.3, by - merlW * 1.6, r * 0.06, r * 0.26);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + w * 0.3 + r * 0.06, by - merlW * 1.6); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + w * 0.3 + r * 0.28, by - merlW * 1.4); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + w * 0.3 + r * 0.06, by - merlW * 1.2); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Diamonds: faceted gem with gradient + facet lines, orb-tone body + accent sparkles.
function drawDiamondsPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyLite, hi) {
  const dr = r * 0.82;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x, orb.y - dr, orb.x, orb.y + dr);
  g.addColorStop(0, lighten(body, 0.25)); g.addColorStop(0.5, body); g.addColorStop(1, bodyLite);
  ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - dr);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x + dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x + dr * 0.4, orb.y + dr);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x - dr * 0.4, orb.y + dr);
  ctx.lineTo(orb.x - dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - dr); ctx.lineTo(orb.x, orb.y + dr);
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x - dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2);
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - dr); ctx.lineTo(orb.x - dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2);
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x, orb.y - dr); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + dr * 0.7, orb.y - dr * 0.2);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle = hi; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x - r * 0.28, orb.y - r * 0.28, r * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y + r * 0.22, r * 0.045, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Dragon: steel-gradient sinuous body + dorsal spikes + crimson wing + horned head.
function drawDragonPattern(ctx, orb, r, body, bodyDeep, hi) {
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(orb.x - r * 0.8, orb.y, orb.x + r * 0.8, orb.y);
  bg.addColorStop(0, "#64748b"); bg.addColorStop(0.5, "#1e293b"); bg.addColorStop(1, "#0f172a");
  ctx.strokeStyle = bg; ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.28; ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x - r * 0.82, orb.y + r * 0.76);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(orb.x - r * 0.5, orb.y - r * 0.52, orb.x - r * 0.08, orb.y - r * 0.52, orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.08);
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.5, orb.y + r * 0.3, orb.x + r * 0.64, orb.y + r * 0.52, orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y + r * 0.74);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.lineCap = "butt";
  // scale texture along first bezier
  const P0x = orb.x - r * 0.82, P0y = orb.y + r * 0.76, P1x = orb.x - r * 0.5, P1y = orb.y - r * 0.52, P2x = orb.x - r * 0.08, P2y = orb.y - r * 0.52, P3x = orb.x + r * 0.22, P3y = orb.y - r * 0.08;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4;
  for (let t = 0.15; t <= 0.85; t += 0.14) {
    const mt = 1 - t;
    const bx = mt*mt*mt*P0x + 3*mt*mt*t*P1x + 3*mt*t*t*P2x + t*t*t*P3x;
    const by = mt*mt*mt*P0y + 3*mt*mt*t*P1y + 3*mt*t*t*P2y + t*t*t*P3y;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx, by, Math.max(1, r * 0.05), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  }
  // dorsal spikes
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7;
  for (let t = 0.2; t <= 0.8; t += 0.2) {
    const mt = 1 - t;
    const bx = mt*mt*mt*P0x + 3*mt*mt*t*P1x + 3*mt*t*t*P2x + t*t*t*P3x;
    const by = mt*mt*mt*P0y + 3*mt*mt*t*P1y + 3*mt*t*t*P2y + t*t*t*P3y;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(bx, by); ctx.lineTo(bx - r * 0.04, by - r * 0.2); ctx.lineTo(bx + r * 0.04, by - r * 0.06); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // crimson wing membrane
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9f1239"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.08);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.42, orb.y - r * 0.86, orb.x + r * 0.82, orb.y - r * 0.58);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(orb.x + r * 0.6, orb.y - r * 0.26, orb.x + r * 0.14, orb.y - r * 0.08);
  ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  // wing bones
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.12); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.58, orb.y - r * 0.66); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.22, orb.y - r * 0.12); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.74, orb.y - r * 0.54); ctx.stroke();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  // horned head at body end (bottom-right)
  ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(orb.x + r * 0.74, orb.y + r * 0.72, r * 0.16, r * 0.13, 0.6, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#475569";
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.66, orb.y + r * 0.62); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.6, orb.y + r * 0.42); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.78, orb.y + r * 0.6); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(orb.x + r * 0.78, orb.y + r * 0.62); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.82, orb.y + r * 0.4); ctx.lineTo(orb.x + r * 0.86, orb.y + r * 0.62); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y + r * 0.68, r * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(orb.x + r * 0.72, orb.y + r * 0.68, r * 0.02, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
}

// Heraldic emblem rendering for the canvas — a premium medallion backing plus
// a per-shape sigil. Body uses a dark-steel gradient; the per-emblem accent
// carries the single signature highlight. Rarity scales detail (sparkles at
// legendary+, inner trim at epic+). Mirrored in SVG by SkinPreview.
import { RARITIES } from "./skins";
import { lighten, darken } from "./colorUtils";

export function drawEmblem(ctx, x, y, r, emblem) {
  if (!emblem || emblem.id === "default" || emblem.shape === "none") return false;
  const acc = emblem.accent || "#fbbf24";
  const order = RARITIES[emblem.rarity]?.order ?? 0;

  // medallion backing
  ctx.save();
  ctx.shadowColor = acc; ctx.shadowBlur = 5 + order * 3;
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - r, x, y + r);
  g.addColorStop(0, "#475569"); g.addColorStop(1, "#1e293b");
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
  ctx.restore();

  // accent ring
  ctx.strokeStyle = acc; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.13);
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, r * 0.9, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.stroke();

  // sigil
  drawSigil(ctx, x, y, r * 0.6, emblem.shape, acc, order);

  // legendary+ outer sparkles
  if (order >= 3) {
    const t = Date.now() / 600;
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const a = t + (i * Math.PI) / 2;
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.45 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 2 + i)})`;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x + Math.cos(a) * r * 0.78, y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.78, 1.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function drawSigil(ctx, x, y, u, shape, acc, order) {
  ctx.save();
  switch (shape) {
    case "shield":
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - u);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.8, y - u * 0.7);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.8, y + u * 0.2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.8, y + u, x, y + u);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.8, y + u, x - u * 0.8, y + u * 0.2);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.8, y - u * 0.7);
      ctx.closePath();
      ctx.fillStyle = acc; ctx.fill();
      if (order >= 2) {
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - u * 0.5); ctx.lineTo(x, y + u * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
      }
      break;
    case "crest": {
      // heraldic torse (wreath) + three plumes + knight's helm
      const pg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - u * 0.85, x, y + u * 0.1);
      pg.addColorStop(0, lighten(acc, 0.3)); pg.addColorStop(1, acc);
      ctx.fillStyle = pg;
      for (const dx of [-0.34, 0, 0.34]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + dx * u, y + u * 0.05);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + dx * u * 1.4, y - u * 0.35, x + dx * u * 0.55, y - u * 0.82);
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + dx * u * 0.85, y - u * 0.4, x + dx * u, y + u * 0.05);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      // plume barbs
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.35)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      for (const dx of [-0.34, 0, 0.34]) {
        for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
          const t = i * 0.2;
          const px = x + dx * u * (0.2 + t * 0.35);
          const py = y + u * 0.05 - t * u * 0.85;
          ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(px, py); ctx.lineTo(px + dx * u * 0.12, py - u * 0.06); ctx.stroke();
        }
      }
      // torse (twisted wreath band)
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.fillRect(x - u * 0.5, y + u * 0.02, u, u * 0.16);
      ctx.fillStyle = lighten(acc, 0.25);
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) ctx.fillRect(x - u * 0.5 + i * u * 0.25, y + u * 0.02, u * 0.12, u * 0.16);
      // helmet dome
      const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y + u * 0.15, x, y + u * 0.72);
      hg.addColorStop(0, "#94a3b8"); hg.addColorStop(1, "#475569");
      ctx.fillStyle = hg;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.42, y + u * 0.18);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.5, y + u * 0.7, x, y + u * 0.72);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.5, y + u * 0.7, x + u * 0.42, y + u * 0.18);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // visor slit
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
      ctx.fillRect(x - u * 0.3, y + u * 0.34, u * 0.6, u * 0.06);
      break;
    }
    case "starburst": {
      const pts = 8;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (let i = 0; i < pts * 2; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / (pts * 2) - Math.PI / 2;
        const rr = i % 2 === 0 ? u : u * 0.42;
        const px = x + Math.cos(a) * rr, py = y + Math.sin(a) * rr;
        if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(px, py); else ctx.lineTo(px, py);
      }
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fillStyle = acc; ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "swords":
      // two crossed swords: blade + crossguard + hilt + pommel
      for (const ang of [-Math.PI / 4, Math.PI / 4]) {
        ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(ang);
        ctx.fillStyle = acc;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, u * 0.9); ctx.lineTo(-u * 0.08, u * 0.1); ctx.lineTo(u * 0.08, u * 0.1); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillRect(-u * 0.3, u * 0.02, u * 0.6, u * 0.1);
        ctx.fillRect(-u * 0.05, -u * 0.3, u * 0.1, u * 0.32);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(0, -u * 0.36, u * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();
      }
      break;
    case "sun":
      ctx.strokeStyle = acc; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.5, u * 0.13); ctx.lineCap = "round";
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / 8;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * u * 0.45, y + Math.sin(a) * u * 0.45);
        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a) * u, y + Math.sin(a) * u);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      ctx.fillStyle = acc; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u * 0.32, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "crown":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.7, y + u * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.7, y - u * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.4, y + u * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.2, y - u * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x, y + u * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.2, y - u * 0.5);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.4, y + u * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.7, y - u * 0.1);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.7, y + u * 0.5);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "moon":
      // clean crescent opening right + crater detail
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(x - u * 0.1, y, u, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2, false);
      ctx.arc(x + u * 0.35, y, u * 0.85, Math.PI / 2, -Math.PI / 2, true);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.3)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.35, y - u * 0.15, u * 0.09, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.2, y + u * 0.25, u * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "flame":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y + u);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.7, y + u * 0.2, x - u * 0.3, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.1, y - u * 0.6, x, y - u);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.2, y - u * 0.5, x + u * 0.3, y - u * 0.3);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.7, y + u * 0.2, x, y + u);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "eye":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x, y, u * 0.9, u * 0.5, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u * 0.28, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      if (order >= 2) {
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.85)";
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.1, y - u * 0.1, u * 0.1, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      break;
    case "fang":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.5, y - u * 0.6);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.15, y + u * 0.8);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.15, y + u * 0.8);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255,255,255,0.4)"; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - u * 0.6); ctx.lineTo(x, y + u * 0.8); ctx.stroke();
      break;
    case "kraken":
      // bulbous mantle + splayed curling tentacles + beak + eye
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u * 0.18, u * 0.36, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.strokeStyle = acc; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, u * 0.18); ctx.lineCap = "round";
      for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
        const a = i * 0.42;
        const sx = x + Math.cos(a) * u * 0.32, sy = y - u * 0.02;
        const mx = x + Math.cos(a) * u * 0.62, my = y + u * 0.4;
        const ex = x + Math.cos(a) * u * 0.5 + (i === 0 ? 0 : Math.sign(i) * u * 0.08), ey = y + u * 0.72;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.quadraticCurveTo(mx, my, ex, ey); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(ex, ey, Math.max(1.5, u * 0.07), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      // suction cups
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.35)";
      for (let i = -2; i <= 2; i++) {
        const a = i * 0.42;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + Math.cos(a) * u * 0.5, y + u * 0.3, Math.max(1, u * 0.04), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      // beak
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.7)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.07, y - u * 0.08); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.07, y - u * 0.08); ctx.lineTo(x, y + u * 0.06); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u * 0.25, u * 0.07, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u * 0.25, u * 0.035, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "phoenix": {
      // spread-wing phoenix with flame-gradient plumage
      const fg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - u * 0.8, x, y + u * 0.7);
      fg.addColorStop(0, "#fde047"); fg.addColorStop(0.5, "#f97316"); fg.addColorStop(1, "#dc2626");
      ctx.fillStyle = fg;
      // left wing — layered feathers
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.15, x - u * 0.85, y - u * 0.55);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.6, y - u * 0.05, x - u * 0.4, y + u * 0.05);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.55, y - u * 0.3, x - u * 0.2, y - u * 0.1);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.3, y - u * 0.45, x, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // right wing (mirror)
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.5, y - u * 0.15, x + u * 0.85, y - u * 0.55);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.6, y - u * 0.05, x + u * 0.4, y + u * 0.05);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.55, y - u * 0.3, x + u * 0.2, y - u * 0.1);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.3, y - u * 0.45, x, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // body + tail flames
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.12, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.18, y + u * 0.4, x, y + u * 0.7);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.18, y + u * 0.4, x + u * 0.12, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // feather separations
      ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(127,29,29,0.5)"; ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.45, y - u * 0.18); ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.7, y - u * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.25, y - u * 0.12); ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.45, y - u * 0.18); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.7, y - u * 0.42); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.25, y - u * 0.12); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.5, y - u * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
      // head
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u * 0.28, u * 0.13, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // beak
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f59e0b";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y - u * 0.36); ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.14, y - u * 0.3); ctx.lineTo(x, y - u * 0.24); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + u * 0.04, y - u * 0.3, u * 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    case "anvil":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.7, y - u * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.55, y - u * 0.3);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.55, y - u * 0.15);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.2, y - u * 0.15);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.2, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.05);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.85, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillRect(x - u * 0.25, y - u * 0.05, u * 0.5, u * 0.2);
      ctx.fillRect(x - u * 0.55, y + u * 0.15, u * 1.1, u * 0.2);
      break;
    case "compass":
      ctx.fillStyle = acc;
      for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        const a = (i * Math.PI) / 4;
        const rOut = i % 2 === 0 ? u : u * 0.55;
        const rIn = u * 0.13;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + Math.cos(a) * rOut, y + Math.sin(a) * rOut);
        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a + 0.15) * rIn, y + Math.sin(a + 0.15) * rIn);
        ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(a - 0.15) * rIn, y + Math.sin(a - 0.15) * rIn);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(15,23,42,0.5)";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y, u * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    case "serpent": {
      // coiled heraldic serpent with scale texture + detailed head
      const sg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - u * 0.6, y - u * 0.5, x + u * 0.6, y + u * 0.6);
      sg.addColorStop(0, lighten(acc, 0.2)); sg.addColorStop(1, darken(acc, 0.25));
      ctx.strokeStyle = sg; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(3, u * 0.26); ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.62, y - u * 0.55);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + u * 0.35, y - u * 0.65, x - u * 0.35, y + u * 0.12, x + u * 0.5, y + u * 0.5);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      // scales along body
      ctx.fillStyle = darken(acc, 0.35);
      const P0x = x - u * 0.62, P0y = y - u * 0.55, P1x = x + u * 0.35, P1y = y - u * 0.65, P2x = x - u * 0.35, P2y = y + u * 0.12, P3x = x + u * 0.5, P3y = y + u * 0.5;
      for (let t = 0.15; t <= 0.85; t += 0.14) {
        const mt = 1 - t;
        const bx = mt*mt*mt*P0x + 3*mt*mt*t*P1x + 3*mt*t*t*P2x + t*t*t*P3x;
        const by = mt*mt*mt*P0y + 3*mt*mt*t*P1y + 3*mt*t*t*P2y + t*t*t*P3y;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(bx, by, Math.max(1, u * 0.045), 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      }
      // belly highlight
      ctx.strokeStyle = lighten(acc, 0.3); ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, u * 0.08); ctx.lineCap = "round"; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.58, y - u * 0.5);
      ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + u * 0.32, y - u * 0.6, x - u * 0.32, y + u * 0.08, x + u * 0.46, y + u * 0.46);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1; ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      // head
      const hg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x + u * 0.4, y + u * 0.4, x + u * 0.7, y + u * 0.6);
      hg.addColorStop(0, lighten(acc, 0.15)); hg.addColorStop(1, acc);
      ctx.fillStyle = hg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x + u * 0.56, y + u * 0.5, u * 0.18, u * 0.13, 0.5, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + u * 0.6, y + u * 0.44, u * 0.05, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + u * 0.6, y + u * 0.44, u * 0.025, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // forked tongue
      ctx.strokeStyle = "#ef4444"; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, u * 0.05); ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.7, y + u * 0.56); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.84, y + u * 0.62); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.7, y + u * 0.56); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.84, y + u * 0.5); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      break;
    }
    case "griffin": {
      // scaled-up eagle-lion griffin filling the medallion
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.5, x + u * 0.5, y + u * 0.5);
      bg.addColorStop(0, lighten(acc, 0.25)); bg.addColorStop(1, darken(acc, 0.3));
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      // lion body
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(x + u * 0.08, y + u * 0.3, u * 0.52, u * 0.38, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // raised spread wing
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.28, y + u * 0.12);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.5, y - u * 0.55, x + u * 0.25, y - u * 0.5);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.5, y - u * 0.25, x + u * 0.35, y + u * 0.08);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // feather separations
      ctx.strokeStyle = darken(acc, 0.4); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.5;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const t = 0.2 + i * 0.18;
        const sx = x - u * 0.28 + t * u * 0.53;
        const sy = y + u * 0.12 - t * u * 0.62;
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(sx, sy); ctx.lineTo(sx - u * 0.05, sy - u * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // eagle head
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.4, y - u * 0.2, u * 0.24, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // hooked beak
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.56, y - u * 0.24);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.78, y - u * 0.14);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.66, y - u * 0.04, x - u * 0.54, y - u * 0.1);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // eye
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.38, y - u * 0.24, u * 0.06, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.38, y - u * 0.24, u * 0.03, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // raised foreleg
      ctx.strokeStyle = bg; ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(2, u * 0.12); ctx.lineCap = "round";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.3, y + u * 0.45); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.55, y + u * 0.7); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.lineCap = "butt";
      // claws
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      for (const dx of [-0.06, 0, 0.06]) {
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.55 + dx * u, y + u * 0.7);
        ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.55 + dx * u, y + u * 0.82);
        ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.55 + dx * u + u * 0.04, y + u * 0.72);
        ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      }
      break;
    }
    case "titan": {
      // imposing titan with fists, chest gem and glowing eyes
      const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y - u * 0.5, x, y + u * 0.5);
      bg.addColorStop(0, lighten(acc, 0.2)); bg.addColorStop(1, darken(acc, 0.3));
      ctx.fillStyle = bg;
      // shoulders/torso
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.75, y + u * 0.55);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.62, y - u * 0.12);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - u * 0.4, y - u * 0.3, x - u * 0.25, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.18, y - u * 0.42);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.18, y - u * 0.42);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.25, y - u * 0.2);
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + u * 0.4, y - u * 0.3, x + u * 0.62, y - u * 0.12);
      ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.75, y + u * 0.55);
      ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
      // fists
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.72, y + u * 0.5, u * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + u * 0.72, y + u * 0.5, u * 0.18, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // head
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y - u * 0.55, u * 0.22, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // rocky cracks
      ctx.strokeStyle = darken(acc, 0.45); ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - u * 0.4, y + u * 0.1); ctx.lineTo(x - u * 0.2, y + u * 0.3); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x + u * 0.3, y); ctx.lineTo(x + u * 0.45, y + u * 0.25); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      // chest gem
      const gg = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y + u * 0.1, 1, x, y + u * 0.1, u * 0.2);
      gg.addColorStop(0, "#fde047"); gg.addColorStop(1, "#f59e0b");
      ctx.fillStyle = gg;
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y + u * 0.1, u * 0.14, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      // eyes
      ctx.fillStyle = "#fde047";
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x - u * 0.08, y - u * 0.58, u * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x + u * 0.08, y - u * 0.58, u * 0.04, 0, Math.PI * 2); ctx.fill();
      break;
    }
    default: break;
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

// Daily missions: 3 rotating tasks tracked per day on the user profile.
const DAILY_MISSION_TEMPLATES = [
  { id: "win2", goal: 2, reward: 100 },
  { id: "play3", goal: 3, reward: 50 },
  { id: "ranked1", goal: 1, reward: 75 },
];

function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// Returns today's mission list, resetting if the date changed.
export function getDailyMissions(me) {
  const dm = me?.daily_missions || {};
  if (dm.date !== todayStr() || !Array.isArray(dm.tasks) || dm.tasks.length === 0) {
    return DAILY_MISSION_TEMPLATES.map((t) => ({ ...t, progress: 0, completed: false }));
  }
  return dm.tasks;
}

// Applies a match result to the daily missions; returns the new state + any bonus coins.
export function updateDailyMissions(me, { won, mode }) {
  const tasks = getDailyMissions(me).map((t) => ({ ...t }));
  let bonusCoins = 0;
  for (const t of tasks) {
    if (t.completed) continue;
    let inc = 0;
    if (t.id === "play3") inc = 1;
    else if (t.id === "win2" && won) inc = 1;
    else if (t.id === "ranked1" && won && mode === "ranked") inc = 1;
    if (inc > 0) {
      t.progress = Math.min(t.goal, t.progress + inc);
      if (t.progress >= t.goal && !t.completed) {
        t.completed = true;
        bonusCoins += t.reward;
      }
    }
  }
  return { daily_missions: { date: todayStr(), tasks }, bonusCoins };
}

// Splitter Orbs — game constants
// Vertical (top/bottom) split: opponent on top, player on bottom, horizontal wall in the middle.
export const GAME_WIDTH = 600;
export const GAME_HEIGHT = 900;
export const WALL_Y = 450;
export const WALL_THICKNESS = 18;

// Fixed orb-placement slots behind the wall (X positions, evenly spaced).
// Reused for both sides; tapping a slot drops the active orb at that X.
export const ORB_SLOTS = [100, 200, 300, 400, 500];

export const STATION_HP = 120;
export const STATION_RADIUS = 34;
export const SIDE_TOWER_HP = 50;
export const SIDE_TOWER_RADIUS = 18;
export const SIDE_TOWER_DAMAGE = 8;
export const SIDE_TOWER_FIRE_RATE = 1.6;
export const SIDE_TOWER_RANGE = 150;
export const SIDE_TOWER_PROJECTILE_SPEED = 340;
// Side-tower upgrade scaling (permanent meta level 0-5)
export const SIDE_TOWER_BASE_HP = 90;
export const SIDE_TOWER_HP_PER_LEVEL = 30;
export const SIDE_TOWER_BASE_DAMAGE = 8;
export const SIDE_TOWER_DAMAGE_PER_LEVEL = 2;
export const SIDE_TOWER_BASE_FIRE_RATE = 1.6;
export const SIDE_TOWER_FIRE_RATE_REDUCTION_PER_LEVEL = 0.12;
export function getSideTowerStats(level = 0) {
  const lvl = Math.max(0, Math.min(5, Math.round(level)));
  return {
    maxHp: SIDE_TOWER_BASE_HP + lvl * SIDE_TOWER_HP_PER_LEVEL,
    damage: SIDE_TOWER_BASE_DAMAGE + lvl * SIDE_TOWER_DAMAGE_PER_LEVEL,
    fireRate: Math.max(0.5, SIDE_TOWER_BASE_FIRE_RATE - lvl * SIDE_TOWER_FIRE_RATE_REDUCTION_PER_LEVEL),
  };
}
export const SUDDEN_DEATH_TIME = 300;
export const COMEBACK_HP_THRESHOLD = 0.4;
export const COMEBACK_COIN_PER_SEC = 1;

// Player station at the very bottom, opponent at the very top
export const PLAYER_STATION = { x: GAME_WIDTH / 2, y: GAME_HEIGHT - 48 };
export const OPPONENT_STATION = { x: GAME_WIDTH / 2, y: 48 };

// Built-in side towers flanking each station, just slightly above it
export const GRID_SIZE = 60;
export const TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE = 4;
export function snapToGrid(x, y) {
  const col = Math.round((x - GRID_SIZE / 2) / GRID_SIZE);
  const row = Math.round((y - GRID_SIZE / 2) / GRID_SIZE);
  return { col, row, x: col * GRID_SIZE + GRID_SIZE / 2, y: row * GRID_SIZE + GRID_SIZE / 2 };
}

export const PLAYER_SIDE_TOWERS = [
  { x: 90, y: 750 },
  { x: 510, y: 750 },
];
export const OPPONENT_SIDE_TOWERS = [
  { x: 90, y: 150 },
  { x: 510, y: 150 },
];

export const STARTING_COINS = 120;
export const COIN_CAP = 999;
export const MAX_TOWER_LEVEL = 5;

// ---- Economy curve (per-match meta coin rewards) ----
// Win pays 50, loss pays 20 — a losing player still progresses and affords a
// silver crate (200 coins) every ~4-10 matches. Combined with the daily free
// wooden crate and crate coin drops, a F2P player never hits a hard coin wall
// in the first ~20 matches.
export const MATCH_REWARD_WIN = 50;
export const MATCH_REWARD_LOSS = 20;

// Card-level → in-game level mapping
// Card 1 → start 1, max 2 | Card 2 → start 2, max 3 | Card 3 → start 3, max 4 | Card 4 → start 4, max 5 | Card 5 → start 5, max 5
// Card-level stat multiplier — higher cards make towers strictly stronger
// even when the league cap forces a low placement level.
export function getCardStatMultiplier(cardLevel = 1) {
  const lvl = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(cardLevel)));
  return [1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.35, 1.5][lvl - 1];
}
// In-game tower level cap is league-driven, not card-driven.
// Card level affects placement level (up to leagueMax-1) and the stat multiplier.
export function getCardStartLevel(cardLevel, leagueMax = 5) {
  return Math.max(1, Math.min(cardLevel - 1, getTowerMaxLevel(cardLevel, leagueMax) - 2));
}
export function getCardMaxLevel(cardLevel, leagueMax = 5) {
  return Math.max(1, leagueMax);
}

// Derived stats per upgrade level (1..5). upgradeCost is the cost to go from `level` -> level+1.
export function getTowerStats(type, level = 1, cardLevel = 1, trophies) {
  const base = TOWER_TYPES[type];
  if (!base) return null;
  const mult = level <= 1
    ? { dmg: 1, range: 1, rate: 1 }
    : level === 2
    ? { dmg: 1.4, range: 1.15, rate: 0.82 }
    : level === 3
    ? { dmg: 1.85, range: 1.3, rate: 0.66 }
    : level === 4
    ? { dmg: 2.4, range: 1.45, rate: 0.52 }
    : level === 5
    ? { dmg: 3.0, range: 1.6, rate: 0.42 }
    : { dmg: 4.5, range: 1.8, rate: 0.30 };  // L6 super upgrade
  const baseCm = getCardStatMultiplier(cardLevel);
  const cmScale = getLeagueCardMultScale(trophies);  // dampens card bonus in low leagues
  const cm = 1 + (baseCm - 1) * cmScale;
  const cmRange = 1 + (cm - 1) * 0.5;  // range gets half the card bonus
  const cmRate = 1 + (cm - 1) * 0.3;   // fireRate (cooldown) gets 30% of the card bonus
  const cmCost = 1 + (cm - 1) * 0.5;   // upgrade/sell scale with half the card bonus
  const isSuper = level >= 6;
  return {
    ...base,
    level,
    cardLevel,
    isSuper,
    perk: isSuper ? SUPER_PERKS[type] : null,
    damage: Math.round((base.damage || 0) * mult.dmg * cm),
    range: Math.round(base.range * (base.bouncer ? (1 + (level - 1) * 0.18) : mult.range) * cmRange),
    fireRate: +((base.fireRate || 0) * mult.rate / cmRate).toFixed(2),
    maxHp: Math.round((60 + (level - 1) * 30) * cm),
    upgradeCost: isSuper ? Math.round(base.cost * 5 * cmCost) : Math.round(base.cost * level * 0.5 * cmCost),
    sellValue: Math.round((base.cost * 0.5 + base.cost * (level - 1) * 0.4) * cmCost),
  };
}

// Orb card-level scaling — bought orbs get stronger with card upgrades.
// HP scales fully; damage at 90% of HP rate; speed at 60% of HP rate (so it doesn't get absurd).
export function getOrbScaleMultiplier(cardLevel = 1) {
  const lvl = Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(cardLevel)));
  const hpMult = [1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0][lvl - 1];
  return {
    hp: hpMult,
    dmg: hpMult * 0.9,
    speed: 1 + (hpMult - 1) * 0.6,
  };
}

export function getOrbStats(typeId, cardLevel = 1, trophies) {
  const base = ORB_TYPES[typeId];
  if (!base) return null;
  const m = getOrbScaleMultiplier(cardLevel);
  const scale = getLeagueCardMultScale(trophies);
  return {
    ...base,
    level: Math.max(1, Math.min(5, Math.round(cardLevel))),
    hp: Math.round(base.hp * (1 + (m.hp - 1) * scale)),
    speed: Math.round(base.speed * (1 + (m.speed - 1) * scale)),
    damage: Math.round(base.damage * (1 + (m.dmg - 1) * scale)),
  };
}

// All orbs available at the player's league tier (starters + trophy milestones + shadow).
export function getLeagueUnlockedOrbs(trophies) {
  const ids = ["normal", "fast", "bomb", "splitter", "tank"];
  for (const [orbId, threshold] of Object.entries(ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if ((trophies || 0) >= threshold && !ids.includes(orbId)) ids.push(orbId);
  }
  if ((trophies || 0) >= SHADOW_TROPHY_MIN) ids.push("shadow");
  return ids;
}

// Trophy / Elo
export const TROPHY_BASE = 30;
export function computeTrophyChange(myTrophies, oppTrophies, won) {
  const diff = oppTrophies - myTrophies;
  const expected = 1 / (1 + Math.pow(10, diff / 400));
  const score = won ? 1 : 0;
  const change = Math.round(TROPHY_BASE * (score - expected));
  if (won) return Math.max(change, 8);
  return Math.min(change, -6);
}

// ---- Leagues ----
export const LEAGUES = [
  { id: 0, name: "Beginner", min: 0, color: "#94a3b8" },
  { id: 1, name: "Rookie", min: 100, color: "#84cc16" },
  { id: 2, name: "Cadet", min: 300, color: "#22d3ee" },
  { id: 3, name: "Veteran", min: 600, color: "#3b82f6" },
  { id: 4, name: "Champion", min: 1000, color: "#8b5cf6" },

];

// ---- League-scaled orb stats & click damage ----
// Auto-spawns and AI-sent orbs scale gently by league so pressure rises as you climb.
function getLeagueId(trophies) {
  let id = 0;
  for (const l of LEAGUES) {
    if ((trophies || 0) >= l.min) id = l.id;
  }
  return id;
}
// League-gated in-game tower level cap: low leagues cap at 3, mid at 4, high at 5.
export function getLeagueMaxLevel(trophies) {
  const id = getLeagueId(trophies);
  if (id <= 1) return 3;
  if (id <= 3) return 4;
  if (id < 6) return 5;
  return 6;  // Legend league: secret L6 super upgrade reachable
}
// Effective max for a specific tower — L6 super tier requires card level 5.
export function getTowerMaxLevel(cardLevel, leagueMax = 5) {
  return (cardLevel >= 5 && leagueMax >= 6) ? 6 : Math.min(leagueMax, 5);
}
export function getLeagueOrbScale(trophies) {
  const t = getLeagueId(trophies) / 6;
  return {
    hp: 1 + t * 0.6,     // 1.0 → 1.6
    dmg: 1 + t * 0.6,   // 1.0 → 1.6
    speed: 1 + t * 0.2,  // 1.0 → 1.2
  };
}
export const CLICK_DAMAGE_BY_LEAGUE = [12, 13, 15, 16, 17, 19, 20];
export function getClickDamage(trophies) {
  return CLICK_DAMAGE_BY_LEAGUE[getLeagueId(trophies)] || 12;
}

// Expected AI skill band per league — used to pick a skill-matched ranked opponent.
export const LEAGUE_SKILL = [0.35, 0.45, 0.55, 0.65, 0.78, 0.9, 0.95];
export function getLeagueExpectedSkill(trophies) {
  return LEAGUE_SKILL[getLeagueId(trophies)] || 0.5;
}

// Per-league card multiplier scale — dampens the card-level stat bonus in low
// leagues so a maxed card can't dominate beginners. Veteran+ applies full bonus.
export const LEAGUE_CARD_MULT_SCALE = [0.30, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0];
export function getLeagueCardMultScale(trophies) {
  const id = getLeagueId(trophies || 0);
  return LEAGUE_CARD_MULT_SCALE[id] ?? 1.0;
}

// Max bought copies per level. Levels 1–3: full needed is buyable; levels 4–5: half (capped at 3).
export const BUY_CAP = 3;
export function buyableCopies(level, needed) {
  return level === 1 ? 2 : Math.min(BUY_CAP, needed);
}
