// Splitter Orbs — Sound & Haptics Manager
// Uses Web Audio API to synthesize SFX procedurally (no asset files needed).
// Preferences persisted to localStorage for instant access; synced from user profile.

let audioCtx = null;
let muted = localStorage.getItem("so_sound") !== "false";
let soundCategories = {
  clicks: localStorage.getItem("so_cat_clicks") !== "false",
  explosions: localStorage.getItem("so_cat_explosions") !== "false",
  fanfare: localStorage.getItem("so_cat_fanfare") !== "false",
};
let hapticsIntensity = localStorage.getItem("so_haptics_intensity") || "off";
let advancedHaptics = localStorage.getItem("so_advanced_haptics") === "true";

function getCtx() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return null;
  if (!audioCtx) {
    try {
      audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    } catch (e) { return null; }
  }
  if (audioCtx.state === "suspended") audioCtx.resume();
  return audioCtx;
}

function catOn(name) {
  if (muted) return false;
  return soundCategories[name] !== false;
}

// Generic tone synth
function tone(freq, duration, type = "sine", volume = 0.15, slideTo = null, category = "clicks") {
  if (!catOn(category)) return;
  const ctx = getCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
  const gain = ctx.createGain();
  osc.type = type;
  osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
  if (slideTo) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(slideTo, ctx.currentTime + duration);
  gain.gain.setValueAtTime(volume, ctx.currentTime);
  gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + duration);
  osc.connect(gain);
  gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  osc.start();
  osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration);
}

// Noise burst (for explosions / impacts)
function noise(duration, volume = 0.1, filterFreq = 1000, category = "explosions") {
  if (!catOn(category)) return;
  const ctx = getCtx();
  if (!ctx) return;
  const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * duration;
  const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
  const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
  for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * (1 - i / bufferSize);
  const src = ctx.createBufferSource();
  src.buffer = buffer;
  const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter();
  filter.type = "lowpass";
  filter.frequency.value = filterFreq;
  const gain = ctx.createGain();
  gain.gain.value = volume;
  src.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination);
  src.start();
}

// Scale a vibration pattern by the current intensity level.
function scalePattern(pattern) {
  const mult = hapticsIntensity === "high" ? 1.5 : hapticsIntensity === "low" ? 0.5 : 1;
  if (typeof pattern === "number") return Math.round(pattern * mult);
  return pattern.map((p) => Math.round(p * mult));
}

function haptic(pattern) {
  if (hapticsIntensity === "off") return;
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.vibrate) {
    try { navigator.vibrate(scalePattern(pattern)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}
// Routine haptics (click/place/coin) — only when advanced haptics is enabled.
function hapticAdvanced(pattern) {
  if (hapticsIntensity === "off" || !advancedHaptics) return;
  if (typeof navigator !== "undefined" && navigator.vibrate) {
    try { navigator.vibrate(scalePattern(pattern)); } catch (e) {}
  }
}

// ---- Public SFX API ----
export const sfx = {
  click: () => { tone(880, 0.06, "square", 0.08, null, "clicks"); hapticAdvanced(8); },
  crit: () => { tone(1200, 0.1, "square", 0.12, 600, "clicks"); haptic(15); },
  towerFire: () => { tone(440, 0.05, "sawtooth", 0.06, null, "clicks"); },
  coin: () => { tone(1318, 0.08, "sine", 0.1, null, "clicks"); hapticAdvanced(10); },
  ability: () => { tone(330, 0.15, "sine", 0.12, 880, "explosions"); haptic(20); },
  place: () => { tone(220, 0.1, "triangle", 0.1, 440, "clicks"); hapticAdvanced(12); },
  upgrade: () => { tone(523, 0.08, "sine", 0.1, null, "clicks"); setTimeout(() => tone(784, 0.1, "sine", 0.1, null, "clicks"), 60); haptic(10); },
  levelUp: () => { [523, 659, 784].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => tone(f, 0.1, "sine", 0.12, null, "clicks"), i * 60)); haptic([10, 20, 30]); },
  explosion: () => { noise(0.3, 0.12, 600, "explosions"); haptic(30); },
  victory: () => {
    [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => tone(f, 0.15, "sine", 0.12, null, "fanfare"), i * 100));
    haptic([20, 40, 20, 40, 60]);
  },
  defeat: () => {
    [440, 349, 262].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => tone(f, 0.2, "sawtooth", 0.1, null, "fanfare"), i * 120));
    haptic([40, 60, 80]);
  },
  crateOpen: () => {
    [659, 880, 1047, 1318].forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => tone(f, 0.1, "sine", 0.1, null, "fanfare"), i * 70));
    haptic([15, 30, 15, 30]);
  },
  countdown: () => { tone(660, 0.08, "sine", 0.08, null, "fanfare"); },
  matchFound: () => { tone(523, 0.1, "sine", 0.1, null, "fanfare"); setTimeout(() => tone(784, 0.15, "sine", 0.1, null, "fanfare"), 100); haptic([20, 30]); },
  disconnect: () => { tone(220, 0.3, "sawtooth", 0.1, 110, "fanfare"); haptic([50, 30, 50]); },
};

export function setMuted(val) {
  muted = !val;
  localStorage.setItem("so_sound", String(val));
}
export function setSoundCategory(name, val) {
  soundCategories[name] = val;
  localStorage.setItem(`so_cat_${name}`, String(val));
}
export function setHaptics(val) {
  // Legacy boolean toggle kept for backward compatibility; maps on→medium, off→off.
  hapticsIntensity = val ? "medium" : "off";
  localStorage.setItem("so_haptics_intensity", hapticsIntensity);
}
export function setHapticsIntensity(level) {
  hapticsIntensity = level || "off";
  localStorage.setItem("so_haptics_intensity", hapticsIntensity);
}
export function setAdvancedHaptics(val) {
  advancedHaptics = val;
  localStorage.setItem("so_advanced_haptics", String(val));
}
export function isMuted() { return muted; }
export function isHapticsOn() { return hapticsIntensity !== "off"; }
export function getHapticsIntensity() { return hapticsIntensity; }
export function getSoundCategories() { return { ...soundCategories }; }

// Sync from user profile (called on app load / settings change)
export function syncFromProfile(me) {
  if (me?.sound_enabled === false) { muted = true; localStorage.setItem("so_sound", "false"); }
  else if (me?.sound_enabled === true) { muted = false; localStorage.setItem("so_sound", "true"); }
  if (me?.sound_categories && typeof me.sound_categories === "object") {
    soundCategories = {
      clicks: me.sound_categories.clicks !== false,
      explosions: me.sound_categories.explosions !== false,
      fanfare: me.sound_categories.fanfare !== false,
    };
    localStorage.setItem("so_cat_clicks", String(soundCategories.clicks));
    localStorage.setItem("so_cat_explosions", String(soundCategories.explosions));
    localStorage.setItem("so_cat_fanfare", String(soundCategories.fanfare));
  }
  // Migrate legacy boolean to intensity if intensity missing.
  if (me?.haptics_intensity) {
    hapticsIntensity = me.haptics_intensity;
  } else if (me?.haptics_enabled === true) {
    hapticsIntensity = "medium";
  } else {
    hapticsIntensity = "off";
  }
  localStorage.setItem("so_haptics_intensity", hapticsIntensity);
  advancedHaptics = me?.advanced_haptics_enabled === true;
  localStorage.setItem("so_advanced_haptics", String(advancedHaptics));
}

// Card progression, crate, and league logic for Splitter Orbs
import {
  TOWER_TYPES, ABILITIES, ORB_TYPES, SENDABLE_ORBS, LEAGUES,
  CARD_COPIES_NEEDED, SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW, MAX_CARD_LEVEL,
  COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY, buyableCopies,
  ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS,
} from "./constants";
import { RARITIES, chestSkinPool, REMOVED_SKINS } from "./skins";

export const STARTER_TOWERS = ["basic", "machinegun", "boomerang", "bomb"];
export const STARTER_ABILITIES = ["zap", "portal", "repair", "freeze"];
export const STARTER_ORBS = ["normal", "fast", "bomb", "splitter", "tank"];

// Look up the rarity of a card from its definition.
export function getCardRarity(kind, id) {
  const table = kind === "tower" ? TOWER_TYPES : kind === "ability" ? ABILITIES : ORB_TYPES;
  return table[id]?.rarity || "common";
}

// Migrate old array-based profiles into the card system; ensure starters exist.
// One-time migration: when boughtCopies is undefined, initialize it to 0 and
// convert any copies above the new (lower) threshold into shards so no progress is lost.
export function normalizeProfile(me) {
  if (!me) me = {};
  let migratedShards = 0;
  const migrateCards = (cards) => {
    if (!cards || typeof cards !== "object") return {};
    const out = {};
    for (const [id, c] of Object.entries(cards)) {
      const level = c?.level || 0;
      const copies = c?.copies || 0;
      if (c?.boughtCopies === undefined) {
        const needed = level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? (CARD_COPIES_NEEDED[level] || 0) : 0;
        const overflow = Math.max(0, copies - needed);
        out[id] = { level, copies: copies - overflow, boughtCopies: 0 };
        migratedShards += overflow * SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW;
      } else {
        out[id] = { level, copies, boughtCopies: c.boughtCopies || 0 };
      }
    }
    return out;
  };
  const towerCards = migrateCards(me.tower_cards);
  const abilityCards = migrateCards(me.ability_cards);
  const orbCards = migrateCards(me.orb_cards);

  for (const id of (me.unlocked_towers || [])) {
    if (!towerCards[id] || towerCards[id].level === 0) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of (me.unlocked_abilities || [])) {
    if (!abilityCards[id] || abilityCards[id].level === 0) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_TOWERS) {
    if (!towerCards[id]) towerCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_ABILITIES) {
    if (!abilityCards[id]) abilityCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of STARTER_ORBS) {
    if (!orbCards[id] || orbCards[id].level === 0) orbCards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }
  for (const id of SENDABLE_ORBS) {
    if (!orbCards[id]) orbCards[id] = { level: 0, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  }

  const owned_skins = Array.isArray(me.owned_skins)
    ? me.owned_skins.filter((id) => !REMOVED_SKINS.includes(id))
    : [];
  const equipped_orb_pattern = REMOVED_SKINS.includes(me.equipped_orb_pattern) ? "default" : (me.equipped_orb_pattern || "default");
  const equipped_station_skin = me.equipped_station_skin || "default";
  const equipped_tower_skin = me.equipped_tower_skin || "default";
  const equipped_left_tower_skin = me.equipped_left_tower_skin || (equipped_tower_skin !== "default" ? equipped_tower_skin : "default");
  const equipped_right_tower_skin = me.equipped_right_tower_skin || (equipped_tower_skin !== "default" ? equipped_tower_skin : "default");
  const equipped_station_emblem = me.equipped_station_emblem || "default";
  const equipped_left_tower_emblem = me.equipped_left_tower_emblem || "default";
  const equipped_right_tower_emblem = me.equipped_right_tower_emblem || "default";

  return {
    ...me,
    tower_cards: towerCards, ability_cards: abilityCards, orb_cards: orbCards,
    shards: (me.shards || 0) + migratedShards,
    owned_skins, equipped_orb_pattern, equipped_station_skin, equipped_tower_skin,
    equipped_left_tower_skin, equipped_right_tower_skin,
    equipped_station_emblem, equipped_left_tower_emblem, equipped_right_tower_emblem,
  };
}

export function getCardLevel(me, kind, id) {
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? me?.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? me?.ability_cards : me?.orb_cards;
  return cards?.[id]?.level || 0;
}

export function isUnlocked(me, kind, id) {
  return getCardLevel(me, kind, id) >= 1;
}

export function getUnlockedTowers(me) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  return Object.keys(p.tower_cards).filter((id) => p.tower_cards[id].level >= 1);
}

export function getUnlockedAbilities(me) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  return Object.keys(p.ability_cards).filter((id) => p.ability_cards[id].level >= 1);
}

export function getUnlockedOrbs(me) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  return Object.keys(p.orb_cards).filter((id) => p.orb_cards[id].level >= 1);
}

export function getTowerMetaLevel(me, towerId) { return getCardLevel(me, "tower", towerId); }
export function getAbilityMetaLevel(me, abilityId) { return getCardLevel(me, "ability", abilityId); }

export function copiesNeeded(level) { return CARD_COPIES_NEEDED[level] || 0; }

export function getCardInfo(me, kind, id) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
  const card = cards[id] || { level: 0, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  const level = card.level || 0;
  const copies = card.copies || 0;
  const boughtCopies = card.boughtCopies || 0;
  const needed = level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? copiesNeeded(level) : 0;
  const rarity = getCardRarity(kind, id);
  const copyShardCost = COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY[rarity] || COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY.common;
  const buyable = level >= 1 && level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL ? buyableCopies(level, needed) : 0;
  const shards = p.shards || 0;
  const maxed = level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL;
  const locked = level === 0;
  const canBuyCopy = !maxed && !locked && boughtCopies < buyable && shards >= copyShardCost;
  const canLevel = !maxed && !locked && copies >= needed;
  return {
    level, copies, needed, buyableCopies: buyable, boughtCopies,
    copyShardCost, rarity, canBuyCopy, canLevel, maxed, locked, shards,
  };
}

// Buy a single copy with shards (rarity-priced). Capped at buyableCopies per level.
export function buyCopyCard(me, kind, id) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
  const card = cards[id];
  if (!card || card.level === 0 || card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL) return { me: p, success: false };
  const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
  const buyable = buyableCopies(card.level, needed);
  const bought = card.boughtCopies || 0;
  if (bought >= buyable) return { me: p, success: false };
  const rarity = getCardRarity(kind, id);
  const cost = COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY[rarity] || COPY_SHARD_COST_BY_RARITY.common;
  if ((p.shards || 0) < cost) return { me: p, success: false };
  p.shards = (p.shards || 0) - cost;
  cards[id] = { level: card.level, copies: card.copies + 1, boughtCopies: bought + 1 };
  return { me: p, success: true, spentShards: cost };
}

// Unlock a card by purchasing it with gems (sets level from 0 to 1).
export function unlockCard(me, kind, id, gemCost) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  if ((p.gems || 0) < gemCost) return { me: p, success: false };
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
  const card = cards[id];
  if (card && card.level >= 1) return { me: p, success: false };
  p.gems = (p.gems || 0) - gemCost;
  cards[id] = { level: 1, copies: 0, boughtCopies: 0 };
  return { me: p, success: true, spentGems: gemCost };
}

// Level up a card by consuming copies (free — no shard fee).
export function levelUpCard(me, kind, id) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const cards = kind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : kind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
  const card = cards[id];
  if (!card || card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL || card.level === 0) return { me: p, success: false };
  const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
  if (card.copies < needed) return { me: p, success: false };
  cards[id] = { level: card.level + 1, copies: card.copies - needed, boughtCopies: 0 };
  return { me: p, success: true, usedCopies: needed, newLevel: cards[id].level };
}

// Check trophy milestone unlocks for orbs; returns array of newly unlocked orb ids
export function checkOrbMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, orbCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [orbId, threshold] of Object.entries(ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!orbCards[orbId] || orbCards[orbId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(orbId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

// Check trophy milestone unlocks for towers; returns array of newly unlocked tower ids
export function checkTowerMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, towerCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [towerId, threshold] of Object.entries(TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!towerCards[towerId] || towerCards[towerId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(towerId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

// Check trophy milestone unlocks for abilities; returns array of newly unlocked ability ids
export function checkAbilityMilestoneUnlocks(trophies, abilityCards) {
  const unlocked = [];
  for (const [abilityId, threshold] of Object.entries(ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS)) {
    if (trophies >= threshold && (!abilityCards[abilityId] || abilityCards[abilityId].level === 0)) {
      unlocked.push(abilityId);
    }
  }
  return unlocked;
}

// ---- Multi-item crate rewards ----
// Each crate yields crate.itemCount items; a slot can be a card, coins, gems,
// shards, or a skin. A small bonus chance boosts a slot's rewards.
export function rollCrateRewards(me, crate) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const items = [];
  const total = crate.itemCount || 1;
  const guaranteed = Math.min(crate.guaranteedCards || 0, total);
  const premium = crate.id === "mythical" || crate.id === "legendary";
  if (premium && guaranteed >= 2) {
    // Premium chests: slot 1 = locked/rare card, slot 2 = ×2/×3 multi-copy bundle
    items.push(rollRareCard(p, crate));
    items.push(rollMultiCardBundle(p, crate));
    for (let i = 2; i < guaranteed; i++) items.push(rollCard(p, crate, false, crate.multiCardChance));
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < guaranteed; i++) items.push(rollCard(p, crate, false, crate.multiCardChance));
  }
  // Remaining slots free-roll
  for (let i = guaranteed; i < total; i++) items.push(rollOneSlot(p, crate));
  return items;
}

// Premium guarantee: a locked card if any exist, else a non-starter (rare) card.
function rollRareCard(p, crate) {
  const allTowers = Object.values(TOWER_TYPES).filter((t) => !t.crateOnly || (p.trophies || 0) >= (t.crateTrophyMin || 0));
  const allAbilities = Object.values(ABILITIES);
  const crateOrbs = ["sprint", "swarmer", "zap_orb", ...((p.trophies || 0) >= 1500 ? ["summoner"] : [])];
  const allOrbs = crateOrbs.map((id) => ORB_TYPES[id]).filter(Boolean);
  const lockedPool = [
    ...allTowers.filter((t) => !p.tower_cards[t.id] || p.tower_cards[t.id].level === 0).map((t) => ({ kind: "tower", def: t })),
    ...allAbilities.filter((a) => !p.ability_cards[a.id] || p.ability_cards[a.id].level === 0).map((a) => ({ kind: "ability", def: a })),
    ...allOrbs.filter((o) => !p.orb_cards[o.id] || p.orb_cards[o.id].level === 0).map((o) => ({ kind: "orb", def: o })),
  ];
  let pick;
  if (lockedPool.length) {
    pick = lockedPool[Math.floor(Math.random() * lockedPool.length)];
  } else {
    const rarePool = [
      ...allTowers.filter((t) => !STARTER_TOWERS.includes(t.id)).map((t) => ({ kind: "tower", def: t })),
      ...allAbilities.filter((a) => !STARTER_ABILITIES.includes(a.id)).map((a) => ({ kind: "ability", def: a })),
      ...allOrbs.filter((o) => !STARTER_ORBS.includes(o.id)).map((o) => ({ kind: "orb", def: o })),
    ];
    pick = rarePool.length ? rarePool[Math.floor(Math.random() * rarePool.length)] : { kind: "tower", def: allTowers[0] };
  }
  return { type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies: 1, label: pick.def.name, color: pick.def.color, rarity: "common", bonus: false };
}

// Premium guarantee: a single card pick forced to ×2 or ×3 copies.
function rollMultiCardBundle(p, crate) {
  const item = rollCard(p, crate, false, null);
  const p3 = crate.multiCardChance?.[3] || 0.1;
  item.copies = Math.random() < p3 ? 3 : 2;
  return item;
}

function rollOneSlot(p, crate) {
  const bonus = Math.random() < (crate.bonusChance || 0);
  // 1. skin drop (all chests, scaling chance)
  if (crate.skinChance > 0 && Math.random() < crate.skinChance) {
    return rollSkin(p, crate, bonus);
  }
  // 2. card
  if (Math.random() < crate.cardChance) {
    return rollCard(p, crate, bonus, crate.multiCardChance);
  }
  // 3. gems (wooden/silver only — low chests are the gem source)
  if ((crate.gemChance || 0) > 0 && Math.random() < crate.gemChance) {
    return rollGems(crate, bonus);
  }
  // 4. coins
  if (Math.random() < (crate.coinChance || 0)) {
    return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  }
  // 5. fallback: shards for gold+, coins for wooden/silver
  if ((crate.gemChance || 0) > 0) return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  return rollShards(crate, bonus);
}

function rollSkin(p, crate, bonus) {
  const pool = chestSkinPool(crate.maxRarity ?? 4);
  if (pool.length === 0) return rollCoins(crate, bonus);
  // Weight toward lower rarity (1 / (order + 1))
  const weights = pool.map((s) => 1 / (RARITIES[s.rarity].order + 1));
  const total = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let r = Math.random() * total, pick = pool[0];
  for (let i = 0; i < pool.length; i++) { r -= weights[i]; if (r <= 0) { pick = pool[i]; break; } }
  const owned = (p.owned_skins || []).includes(pick.id);
  if (owned) {
    const shards = RARITIES[pick.rarity].shardConvert * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
    return { type: "shards", amount: shards, label: `${shards} Shards`, color: "#65a30d", rarity: pick.rarity, bonus, skinDup: pick.id };
  }
  return { type: "skin", category: pick.category, skinId: pick.id, label: pick.name, color: RARITIES[pick.rarity].color, rarity: pick.rarity, bonus };
}

function rollCard(p, crate, bonus, multiCardChance) {
  const allTowers = Object.values(TOWER_TYPES).filter((t) => !t.crateOnly || (p.trophies || 0) >= (t.crateTrophyMin || 0));
  const allAbilities = Object.values(ABILITIES);
  const crateOrbs = ["sprint", "swarmer", "zap_orb", ...((p.trophies || 0) >= 1500 ? ["summoner"] : [])];
  const allOrbs = crateOrbs.map((id) => ORB_TYPES[id]).filter(Boolean);

  const lockedTowers = allTowers.filter((t) => !p.tower_cards[t.id] || p.tower_cards[t.id].level === 0);
  const lockedAbilities = allAbilities.filter((a) => !p.ability_cards[a.id] || p.ability_cards[a.id].level === 0);
  const lockedOrbs = allOrbs.filter((o) => !p.orb_cards[o.id] || p.orb_cards[o.id].level === 0);

  let pick;
  if (lockedOrbs.length && Math.random() < 0.4) {
    pick = { kind: "orb", def: lockedOrbs[Math.floor(Math.random() * lockedOrbs.length)] };
  } else if (lockedTowers.length && (lockedAbilities.length === 0 || Math.random() < 0.5)) {
    pick = { kind: "tower", def: lockedTowers[Math.floor(Math.random() * lockedTowers.length)] };
  } else if (lockedAbilities.length) {
    pick = { kind: "ability", def: lockedAbilities[Math.floor(Math.random() * lockedAbilities.length)] };
  } else {
    const candidates = [
      ...allTowers.filter((t) => p.tower_cards[t.id]?.level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL && p.tower_cards[t.id]?.level > 0).map((t) => ({ kind: "tower", def: t })),
      ...allAbilities.filter((a) => p.ability_cards[a.id]?.level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL && p.ability_cards[a.id]?.level > 0).map((a) => ({ kind: "ability", def: a })),
      ...allOrbs.filter((o) => p.orb_cards[o.id]?.level < MAX_CARD_LEVEL && p.orb_cards[o.id]?.level > 0).map((o) => ({ kind: "orb", def: o })),
    ];
    pick = candidates.length ? candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)] : { kind: "tower", def: allTowers[0] };
  }

  // Multi-card bundle: premium chests can yield 2–3 copies in one slot
  let copies = 1;
  if (multiCardChance) {
    const r = Math.random();
    const p3 = multiCardChance[3] || 0;
    const p2 = multiCardChance[2] || 0;
    if (r < p3) copies = 3;
    else if (r < p3 + p2) copies = 2;
  }

  return {
    type: "card", cardKind: pick.kind, id: pick.def.id, copies,
    label: pick.def.name, color: pick.def.color, rarity: "common", bonus,
  };
}

function rollCoins(crate, bonus) {
  const base = crate.currency === "gems" ? 60 : crate.currency === "coins" ? 40 : 25;
  const amt = Math.max(1, Math.round(base * (0.6 + Math.random() * 0.8)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1));
  return { type: "coins", amount: amt, label: `${amt} Coins`, color: "#fbbf24", rarity: "common", bonus };
}

function rollShards(crate, bonus) {
  const base = crate.currency === "gems" ? 4 : 2;
  const amt = (base + Math.floor(Math.random() * 4)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
  return { type: "shards", amount: amt, label: `${amt} Shards`, color: "#65a30d", rarity: "common", bonus };
}

function rollGems(crate, bonus) {
  const base = 2;
  const amt = (base + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)) * (bonus ? 2 : 1);
  return { type: "gems", amount: amt, label: `${amt} Gems`, color: "#22d3ee", rarity: "common", bonus };
}

// Apply an array of crate items; returns updated profile + per-item info.
// Chest-sourced copies flow into card.copies and count toward the level threshold
// but do NOT touch boughtCopies (only buy-copy purchases increment that counter).
export function applyCrateRewards(me, items) {
  const p = normalizeProfile(me);
  const owned = new Set(p.owned_skins || []);
  const perItem = items.map((item) => {
    const info = { ...item, newUnlock: false, levelUp: null, skinNew: false, skinDup: !!item.skinDup };
    if (item.type === "coins") p.coins = Math.min(9999, (p.coins || 0) + item.amount);
    else if (item.type === "gems") p.gems = (p.gems || 0) + item.amount;
    else if (item.type === "shards") p.shards = (p.shards || 0) + item.amount;
    else if (item.type === "skin") {
      if (owned.has(item.skinId)) { info.skinDup = true; }
      else { owned.add(item.skinId); info.skinNew = true; }
    } else if (item.type === "card") {
      const copies = item.copies || 1;
      const cards = item.cardKind === "tower" ? p.tower_cards : item.cardKind === "ability" ? p.ability_cards : p.orb_cards;
      const card = cards[item.id];
      if (!card || card.level === 0) {
        cards[item.id] = { level: 1, copies: Math.max(0, copies - 1), boughtCopies: 0 };
        info.newUnlock = true;
        if (copies > 1) info.levelUp = { duplicate: true, copies: copies - 1, needed: copiesNeeded(1), ready: (copies - 1) >= copiesNeeded(1) };
      } else if (card.level >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL) {
        p.shards = (p.shards || 0) + SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW * copies;
        info.levelUp = { overflow: true, shardsGained: SHARDS_PER_OVERFLOW * copies };
      } else {
        const newCopies = card.copies + copies;
        const needed = copiesNeeded(card.level);
        cards[item.id] = { level: card.level, copies: newCopies, boughtCopies: card.boughtCopies || 0 };
        info.levelUp = { duplicate: true, copies: newCopies, needed, ready: newCopies >= needed };
      }
    }
    return info;
  });
  p.owned_skins = Array.from(owned);
  return { me: p, perItem };
}

export function getLeague(trophies) {
  let league = LEAGUES[0];
  for (const l of LEAGUES) {
    if ((trophies || 0) >= l.min) league = l;
  }
  return league;
}

export function getLeagueIndex(trophies) {
  return getLeague(trophies).id;
}

function clamp(v, lo, hi) { return Math.max(lo, Math.min(hi, v)); }

// Seeded PRNG for deterministic auto-spawns in multiplayer (both clients share the seed)
function mulberry32(seed) {
  return function() {
    seed |= 0; seed = (seed + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}
let _gameRng = Math.random;
export function setGameSeed(seed) { _gameRng = mulberry32(seed >>> 0); }

      selectedTower: null,

function spawnInterval(time, mult) {
  const t = clamp(time / SPAWN_RAMP_TIME, 0, 1);
  return (SPAWN_INTERVAL_START - (SPAWN_INTERVAL_START - SPAWN_INTERVAL_MIN) * t) * (mult || 1);
}

function randomOrbType(state) {
  if ((state?.time || 0) < 12) return "normal";
  const t = clamp((state?.time || 0) / 75, 0, 1);
  let total = 0;
  const weights = {};
  for (const id of Object.keys(SPAWN_WEIGHTS_EARLY)) {
    weights[id] = SPAWN_WEIGHTS_EARLY[id] * (1 - t) + SPAWN_WEIGHTS_LATE[id] * t;
    total += weights[id];
  }
  let r = _gameRng() * total;
  for (const id of Object.keys(weights)) {
    r -= weights[id];
    if (r <= 0) return id;
  }
  return "normal";
}

// Shield-aware damage application: soaks shield first, then HP.
function applyOrbDamage(orb, dmg) {
  if (dmg <= 0) return 0;
  if (orb.armor && orb.armor > 0) {
    dmg = Math.max(1, dmg - orb.armor);
  }
  if (orb.shieldHp && orb.shieldHp > 0) {
    const absorbed = Math.min(orb.shieldHp, dmg);
    orb.shieldHp -= absorbed;
    dmg -= absorbed;
    if (dmg <= 0) return 0;
  }
  orb.hp -= dmg;
  return dmg;
}

function makeOrb(side, type, x, y, overtimeScale = 0, noReward = false, scale = { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 }, forceAttacker = null, cardLevel = 1, patternId = null) {
  const ot = 1 + (overtimeScale || 0);
  const hp = Math.round(type.hp * ot * scale.hp);
  const damage = Math.round(type.damage * ot * scale.dmg);
  const speed = type.speed * scale.speed;
  return {
    id: uid(), side, type: type.id, x, y, vx: 0,
    vy: (side === 0 ? 1 : -1) * speed,
    hp, maxHp: hp, radius: type.radius, color: type.color,
    speed, _scale: scale,
    damage, reward: type.reward,
    targetsMain: !!type.targetsMain, explodesOnDeath: !!type.explodesOnDeath,
    splitsInto: type.splitsInto || 0, splitType: type.splitType,
    detonateOnClick: !!type.detonateOnClick,
    attacker: !!type.attacker || (forceAttacker != null ? forceAttacker : (type.id === "bomb" && _gameRng() < 0.3)),
    ignoresTowers: !!type.ignoresTowers,
    shieldHp: type.shield || 0,
    healTimer: 0,
    frozen: 0, spawnAge: 0, bounceTimer: 0,
    slowTimer: 0, slowFactor: 1, burn: 0, burnDps: 0, poisonTimer: 0, poisonStacks: 0,
    noReward,
    stealth: !!type.stealth,
    attackWindow: type.attackWindow || 0,
    revealed: false,
    infectOnContact: !!type.infectOnContact,
    infectionChance: type.infectionChance || 0,
    poisonDuration: type.poisonDuration || 0,
    poisonDps: type.poisonDps || 0,
    freezeOnImpact: !!type.freezeOnImpact,
    freezeDuration: type.freezeDuration || 0,
    freezePerLevel: type.freezePerLevel || 0,
    arrivalDelay: type.arrivalDelay || 0,
    damageDuration: type.damageDuration || 0,
    dps: type.dps || 0,
    multiTower: !!type.multiTower,
    zapHop: !!type.zapHop,
    zapInterval: type.zapInterval || 0,
    zapDamage: type.zapDamage || 0,
    zapRange: type.zapRange || 0,
    structureTarget: !!type.structureTarget,
    armor: type.armor || 0,
    growth: !!type.growth,
    growthDuration: type.growthDuration || 0,
    growthHpMult: type.growthHpMult || 1,
    growthSpeedMult: type.growthSpeedMult || 1,
    growthDmgMult: type.growthDmgMult || 1,
    shieldBubble: !!type.shieldBubble,
    shieldRadius: type.shieldRadius || 0,
    shieldCap: type.shieldCap || 0,
    shieldRegenInterval: type.shieldRegenInterval || 0,
    berserker: !!type.berserker,
    phantom: !!type.phantom,
    phantomRevealTimer: 0,
    revealDuration: type.revealDuration || 0,
    leech: !!type.leech,
    leechDps: type.leechDps || 0,
    leechHealMult: type.leechHealMult || 1,
    summoner: !!type.summoner,
    summonInterval: type.summonInterval || 0,
    summonTimer: 0,
    splitHpMult: type.splitHpMult || 1,
    splitDmgMult: type.splitDmgMult || 1,
    cardLevel,
    patternId,
  };
}

function spawnOrb(state, side, typeId, noReward = false, scale = null, forceX = null, forceAttacker = null, patternId = null) {
  const type = ORB_TYPES[typeId || randomOrbType(state)];
  const x = forceX != null ? forceX : 60 + _gameRng() * (GAME_WIDTH - 120);
  const fromY = side === 0
    ? WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS / 2 + type.radius + 6
    : WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS / 2 - type.radius - 6;
  const otScale = state.overtimeActive ? state.overtimeScale : 0;
  const finalScale = scale || state.leagueScale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 };

  const orbCardLevel = state.metaLevels?.orbs?.[type.id] || 1;
  if (type.clusterSize && type.clusterSize > 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < type.clusterSize; i++) {
      const ox = clamp(x + (i - (type.clusterSize - 1) / 2) * 22, 40, GAME_WIDTH - 40);
      state.orbs.push(makeOrb(side, type, ox, fromY, otScale, noReward, finalScale, forceAttacker, orbCardLevel, patternId));
    }
  } else {
    state.orbs.push(makeOrb(side, type, x, fromY, otScale, noReward, finalScale, forceAttacker, orbCardLevel, patternId));
  }
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x, y: fromY, type: "spawnPortal", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, color: type.color });
}

export function spawnOrbOnOpponent(state, buyerSide, typeId, scale) {
  spawnOrb(state, 1 - buyerSide, typeId, true, scale, null, null, state.oppPattern || "default");
}

// ---- juice helpers ----
function addFloater(state, x, y, text, color, size = 18) {
  state.floaters.push({ id: uid(), x, y, text, color, size, life: 0.9, maxLife: 0.9, vy: -42 });
}
function addBurst(state, x, y, color, count = 8, speed = 180) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    const a = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + rand(-0.3, 0.3);
    const sp = speed * rand(0.5, 1.1);
    state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x, y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp, life: rand(0.35, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color, size: rand(2, 4.5) });
  }
}
function addSparkles(state, x, y, color, count = 10) {
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
    state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: x + rand(-20, 20), y: y + rand(-10, 10), vx: rand(-30, 30), vy: rand(-90, -40), life: rand(0.5, 0.9), maxLife: 0.9, color, size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
  }
}

export function update(state, dt, aiAction) {
  if (state.status !== "playing") return;
  state.time += dt;
  state.events = [];

  // ---- Escalation tiers (mode-driven) ----
  const esc = state.escalation;
  if (!state.overtimeActive) {
    state.overtimeTimer = Math.max(0, state.overtimeTimer - dt);
    if (state.overtimeTimer <= 0) {
      state.overtimeActive = true;
      state.overtimeScale = 0;
      state.overtimeTick = 0;
      state.escalationTier = 1;
      state.tierBanner = { life: 2, tier: 1 };
    }
  } else {
    state.overtimeTick += dt;
    if (state.overtimeTick >= esc.tickInterval) {
      state.overtimeTick -= esc.tickInterval;
      state.overtimeScale += esc.hpScale;
    }
    if (state.escalationTier < 2 && state.time >= esc.intensifying) {
      state.escalationTier = 2;
      state.intensifyActive = true;
      state.tierBanner = { life: 2, tier: 2 };
    }
    if (esc.hasCritical && state.escalationTier < 3 && state.time >= esc.critical) {
      state.escalationTier = 3;
      state.criticalActive = true;
      state.tierBanner = { life: 2, tier: 3 };
    }
    if (state.escalationTier < 4 && state.time >= esc.maxPressure) {
      state.escalationTier = 4;
      state.maxPressureActive = true;
      state.tierBanner = { life: 2, tier: 4 };
    }
    if (esc.towerBleed && state.escalationTier < 5 && state.time >= esc.towerBleed) {
      state.escalationTier = 5;
      state.towerBleedActive = true;
      state.tierBanner = { life: 2, tier: 5 };
    }
  }
  if (state.tierBanner) {
    state.tierBanner.life -= dt;
    if (state.tierBanner.life <= 0) state.tierBanner = null;
  }

  // ---- Tower bleed tier (final stage): side towers + main stations drain HP ----
  // Main stations drain but are floored at 1 HP so matches are won by gameplay,
  // not auto-killed. Side towers drain to 0.
  if (state.towerBleedActive) {
    state.sideTowerBleedTimer = (state.sideTowerBleedTimer || 0) + dt;
    if (state.sideTowerBleedTimer >= SIDE_TOWER_BLEED_INTERVAL) {
      state.sideTowerBleedTimer -= SIDE_TOWER_BLEED_INTERVAL;
      for (const st of state.player.sideTowers) if (st.hp > 0) st.hp = Math.max(0, st.hp - SIDE_TOWER_BLEED);
      for (const st of state.opponent.sideTowers) if (st.hp > 0) st.hp = Math.max(0, st.hp - SIDE_TOWER_BLEED);
      if (state.player.hp > 1) state.player.hp = Math.max(1, state.player.hp - SIDE_TOWER_BLEED);
      if (state.opponent.hp > 1) state.opponent.hp = Math.max(1, state.opponent.hp - SIDE_TOWER_BLEED);
    }
  }

  // ---- Comeback coin trickle (small edge when below 40% HP) ----
  for (const who of ["player", "opponent"]) {
    const o = state[who];
    if (o.hp > 0 && o.hp / o.station.maxHp < COMEBACK_HP_THRESHOLD) {
      o._comebackAcc = (o._comebackAcc || 0) + dt;
      if (o._comebackAcc >= 1) {
        o._comebackAcc -= 1;
        o.coins = Math.min(999, o.coins + COMEBACK_COIN_PER_SEC);
      }
    }
  }

  const newWave = Math.floor(state.time / 22) + 1;
  if (newWave > state.wave && !state.overtimeActive) { state.wave = newWave; state.waveBanner = 2.2; }
  if (state.waveBanner > 0) state.waveBanner = Math.max(0, state.waveBanner - dt);

  if (state.hitStop > 0) {
    state.hitStop = Math.max(0, state.hitStop - dt);
    updateVisuals(state, dt);
    return;
  }

  // ---- Spawn ramp ----
  state.spawnTimer -= dt;
  if (state.spawnTimer <= 0) {
    let interval = spawnInterval(state.time, state.spawnMult);
    if (state.overtimeActive) interval /= esc.spawnDivisor;
    if (state.maxPressureActive) interval /= 1.5;
    state.spawnTimer = interval;
    const t = randomOrbType(state);
    spawnOrb(state, 0, t);
    spawnOrb(state, 1, t);
    if (_gameRng() < 0.16) spawnOrb(state, 0, "mine");
    if (state.time > 30 && _gameRng() < 0.08) {
      for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) spawnOrb(state, 0, "fast");
    }
    // Bonus orbs from wave 3 — scales with league (Cadet+ = 1, Champion+ = 2)
    if (state.wave >= 3) {
      const bonus = (state.playerTrophies >= 1000 ? 2 : state.playerTrophies >= 300 ? 1 : 0) + (state.intensifyActive ? 1 : 0) + (state.maxPressureActive ? 1 : 0);
      for (let i = 0; i < bonus; i++) {
        const bt = randomOrbType(state);
        spawnOrb(state, 0, bt);
        spawnOrb(state, 1, bt);
      }
    }
  }

  // Radioactive environmental spawn (Rookie+)
  state.radioactiveTimer -= dt;
  if (state.radioactiveTimer <= 0 && state.playerTrophies >= RADIOACTIVE_TROPHY_MIN) {
    state.radioactiveTimer = state.intensifyActive ? 10 + _gameRng() * 8 : 18 + _gameRng() * 12;
    if (_gameRng() < 0.5) {
      spawnOrb(state, 0, "radioactive");
      spawnOrb(state, 1, "radioactive");
    }
  }

  // Shadow environmental spawn (Champion+)
  state.shadowTimer -= dt;
  if (state.shadowTimer <= 0 && state.playerTrophies >= SHADOW_TROPHY_MIN) {
    state.shadowTimer = state.intensifyActive ? 20 + _gameRng() * 15 : 35 + _gameRng() * 25;
    spawnOrb(state, 0, "shadow");
    spawnOrb(state, 1, "shadow");
  }

  // Fog environmental spawn (Master+)
  state.fogTimer -= dt;
  if (state.fogTimer <= 0 && state.playerTrophies >= FOG_TROPHY_MIN) {
    state.fogTimer = state.intensifyActive ? 25 + _gameRng() * 15 : 40 + _gameRng() * 20;
    spawnOrb(state, 0, "fog");
    spawnOrb(state, 1, "fog");
  }

  // ---- Ability cooldowns ----
  for (const ab of state.player.abilities) {
    if (ab.cooldown > 0) {
      ab.cooldown = Math.max(0, ab.cooldown - dt);
      if (ab.cooldown === 0) ab.ready = true;
    }
  }

  // ---- Effect timers ----
  for (const side of ["player", "opponent"]) {
    const e = state[side].effects;
    if (e.freeze > 0) e.freeze = Math.max(0, e.freeze - dt);
    if (e.rage > 0) e.rage = Math.max(0, e.rage - dt);
    if (e.shield > 0) e.shield = Math.max(0, e.shield - dt);
    if (e.overclock > 0) e.overclock = Math.max(0, e.overclock - dt);
    if (state[side].flash > 0) state[side].flash = Math.max(0, state[side].flash - dt);
    // Tower freeze (from ice orbs): decrement and emit frost particles
    for (const t of state[side].towers) {
      if (t.frozen > 0) {
        t.frozen = Math.max(0, t.frozen - dt);
        if (Math.random() < 0.25) state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: t.x + rand(-14, 14), y: t.y + rand(-10, 10), vx: rand(-10, 10), vy: rand(-30, -10), life: rand(0.3, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color: "#67e8f9", size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
      }
    }
    for (const st of state[side].sideTowers) if (st.frozen > 0) st.frozen = Math.max(0, st.frozen - dt);
  }

  // ---- Click stamina recharge ----
  if (state.player.clicks < state.player.maxClicks) {
    state.player.rechargeAcc = (state.player.rechargeAcc || 0) + dt;
    while (state.player.rechargeAcc >= state.player.rechargeInterval && state.player.clicks < state.player.maxClicks) {
      state.player.clicks += 1;
      state.player.rechargeAcc -= state.player.rechargeInterval;
    }
  } else {
    state.player.rechargeAcc = 0;
  }

  // ---- Combo timer (with grace window before streak breaks) ----
  if (state.comboTimer > 0) {
    state.comboTimer -= dt;
    if (state.comboTimer <= 0 && state.combo > 0) {
      state.comboGrace = 0.6;
      state.comboTimer = 0;
    }
  } else if (state.comboGrace > 0) {
    state.comboGrace -= dt;
    if (state.comboGrace <= 0) state.combo = 0;
  }

  if (aiAction) aiAction(state, dt);

  // ---- Damage-over-time (burn, poison) ----
  tickDoTs(state, dt);

  // ---- Healer pulses ----
  tickHealers(state, dt);

  // ---- Growth / Shield-Bubble / Berserker orbs ----
  tickGrowth(state, dt);
  tickShieldBubbles(state, dt);
  tickBerserkers(state, dt);

  // ---- Orbs move ----
  moveOrbs(state, dt);

  // ---- Bouncer towers pull + bounce ----
  bouncerUpdate(state, "player", dt);
  bouncerUpdate(state, "opponent", dt);

  // ---- Burner channel + meteors + glue + zones ----
  burnerTick(state, dt);
  tickMeteors(state, dt);
  tickGlues(state, dt);
  tickMortarShots(state, dt);
  tickZones(state, dt);
  tickMagnets(state, dt);
  tickMines(state, dt);
  tickSummoners(state, dt);

  // ---- Towers fire ----
  fireTowers(state, "player", dt);
  fireTowers(state, "opponent", dt);
  mortarFire(state, "player", dt);
  mortarFire(state, "opponent", dt);
  magnetFire(state, "player", dt);
  magnetFire(state, "opponent", dt);
  mineLayerFire(state, "player", dt);
  mineLayerFire(state, "opponent", dt);
  overchargerPulse(state, "player", dt);
  overchargerPulse(state, "opponent", dt);
  fireSideTowers(state, "player", dt);
  fireSideTowers(state, "opponent", dt);

  // Tower poison (radioactive infection)
  tickTowerPoison(state, dt);

  // ---- Projectiles move + hit ----
  updateProjectiles(state, dt);

  // ---- Orbs reaching station / side towers ----
  checkOrbCollisions(state);

  // ---- Coin pickups expire ----
  for (const c of state.coinPickups) { c.life -= dt; c.bob = (c.bob || 0) + dt; }
  state.coinPickups = state.coinPickups.filter((c) => c.life > 0);

  // ---- Cleanup ----
  state.orbs = state.orbs.filter((o) => o.hp > 0 && o.y > -50 && o.y < GAME_HEIGHT + 50);
  // Prune dead orbs from the portal targeting selection so the counter stays accurate.
  if (state.targeting) {
    state.targeting.selected = state.targeting.selected.filter((id) => state.orbs.some((o) => o.id === id));
  }
  state.projectiles = state.projectiles.filter((p) => p.life > 0);
  state.effects = state.effects.filter((e) => e.life > 0);
  for (const e of state.effects) e.life -= dt;
  if (state.shake > 0) state.shake = Math.max(0, state.shake - dt * 2.5);
  if (state.flash > 0) state.flash = Math.max(0, state.flash - dt * 3);
  if (state.clickEmptyFlash > 0) state.clickEmptyFlash = Math.max(0, state.clickEmptyFlash - dt);
  for (const t of state.player.towers) {
    if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0 && !t._rubbled) {
      t._rubbled = true;
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: t.x, y: t.y, type: "ash", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, color: "#78716c" });
      addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#94a3b8", 10, 150);
    }
  }
  for (const t of state.opponent.towers) {
    if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0 && !t._rubbled) {
      t._rubbled = true;
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: t.x, y: t.y, type: "ash", life: 0.8, maxLife: 0.8, color: "#78716c" });
      addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#94a3b8", 10, 150);
    }
  }
  state.player.towers = state.player.towers.filter((t) => (t.hp ?? 60) > 0);
  state.opponent.towers = state.opponent.towers.filter((t) => (t.hp ?? 60) > 0);
  for (const t of state.player.towers) { if (t.spawn > 0) t.spawn = Math.max(0, t.spawn - dt); if (t.fireFlash > 0) t.fireFlash = Math.max(0, t.fireFlash - dt); }
  for (const t of state.opponent.towers) { if (t.spawn > 0) t.spawn = Math.max(0, t.spawn - dt); if (t.fireFlash > 0) t.fireFlash = Math.max(0, t.fireFlash - dt); }

  updateVisuals(state, dt);

  // ---- Win/lose ----
  if (state.player.hp <= 0 && state.opponent.hp <= 0) state.status = "draw";
  else if (state.opponent.hp <= 0) state.status = "won";
  else if (state.player.hp <= 0) state.status = "lost";
}

function moveOrbs(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    orb.spawnAge = (orb.spawnAge || 0) + dt;
    if (orb.frozen > 0) { orb.frozen -= dt; continue; }
    if (orb.slowTimer > 0) orb.slowTimer = Math.max(0, orb.slowTimer - dt);
    const slow = (orb.slowTimer > 0 ? orb.slowFactor : 1) * (orb._speedBoost || 1);

    // bounce deceleration
    if (orb.bounceTimer > 0) {
      orb.bounceTimer -= dt;
      orb.x += (orb.vx || 0) * dt;
      orb.y += orb.vy * dt;
      orb.vy *= 0.94;
      if (orb.side === 0 && orb.y < WALL_Y + orb.radius + 6) { orb.y = WALL_Y + orb.radius + 6; orb.bounceTimer = 0; }
      if (orb.side === 1 && orb.y > WALL_Y - orb.radius - 6) { orb.y = WALL_Y - orb.radius - 6; orb.bounceTimer = 0; }
      if (orb.bounceTimer <= 0) { orb.vy = (orb.side === 0 ? 1 : -1) * (orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type]?.speed || 42); orb.vx = 0; }
      continue;
    }

    // phantom: stealth beeline to station, phases through towers; tap to reveal
    if (orb.phantom) {
      if (orb.revealed && orb.phantomRevealTimer > 0) {
        orb.phantomRevealTimer -= dt;
        if (orb.phantomRevealTimer <= 0) { orb.revealed = false; orb.phantomRevealTimer = 0; }
      }
      const sx = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.x : OPPONENT_STATION.x;
      const sy = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.y : OPPONENT_STATION.y;
      const dx = sx - orb.x, dy = sy - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type]?.speed || 28;
      orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      continue;
    }

    // leech: seek nearest tower, attach, drain HP and heal self
    if (orb.leech) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      if (orb._leechTargetId) {
        const tgt = owner.towers.find((t) => t.id === orb._leechTargetId);
        if (tgt && (tgt.hp ?? 0) > 0) {
          tgt.hp = (tgt.hp ?? 60) - orb.leechDps * dt;
          orb.hp = Math.min(orb.maxHp, orb.hp + orb.leechDps * orb.leechHealMult * dt);
          if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
            state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x + rand(-10, 10), y: orb.y + rand(-8, 8), vx: rand(-15, 15), vy: rand(-40, -10), life: rand(0.3, 0.5), maxLife: 0.5, color: orb.color, size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
          }
          if (tgt.hp <= 0) { tgt.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#94a3b8", 8, 140); orb._leechTargetId = null; }
          continue;
        }
        orb._leechTargetId = null;
      }
      let lTgt = null, lBestD = Infinity;
      for (const t of owner.towers) {
        if ((t.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y);
        if (d < lBestD) { lBestD = d; lTgt = t; }
      }
      if (lTgt) {
        const dx = lTgt.x - orb.x, dy = lTgt.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = orb.speed || 24;
        if (d > 22 + orb.radius) {
          orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
          orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        } else {
          orb._leechTargetId = lTgt.id;
        }
      } else {
        const sx = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.x : OPPONENT_STATION.x;
        const sy = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.y : OPPONENT_STATION.y;
        const dx = sx - orb.x, dy = sy - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = orb.speed || 24;
        orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // sprint: beeline straight to station, ignore everything
    if (orb.ignoresTowers) {
      const sx = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.x : OPPONENT_STATION.x;
      const sy = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.y : OPPONENT_STATION.y;
      const dx = sx - orb.x, dy = sy - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed;
      orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      continue;
    }

    // shadow/fog: stealth beeline to target, then delayed continuous damage
    if (orb.stealth) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      // --- Arrived: handle arrival delay → damage phase → despawn ---
      if (orb.arrived) {
        if (orb.arrivalTimer > 0) {
          orb.arrivalTimer -= dt;
          if (orb.arrivalTimer <= 0) {
            orb.damageTimer = orb.damageDuration || 3;
            orb.revealed = true;
            state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "reveal_flash", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: orb.color });
            addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 5, 120);
          }
        } else if (orb.damageTimer > 0) {
          orb.damageTimer -= dt;
          const dps = orb.dps || 0;
          if (orb.multiTower) {
            // fog: damage ALL towers on this side
            for (const tw of owner.towers) {
              if ((tw.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
              tw.hp = (tw.hp ?? 60) - dps * dt;
              if (tw.hp <= 0) { tw.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tw.x, tw.y, "#94a3b8", 5, 110); }
            }
            for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
              if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
              st.hp = st.hp - dps * dt;
              if (st.hp <= 0) { st.hp = 0; addBurst(state, st.x, st.y, "#94a3b8", 5, 110); }
            }
          } else if (orb._shadowTarget && !orb._shadowTarget.isStation) {
            // shadow: damage the targeted side tower
            const tgt = owner.sideTowers.find((st) => st.x === orb._shadowTarget.x && st.y === orb._shadowTarget.y);
            if (tgt && tgt.hp > 0) {
              tgt.hp = tgt.hp - dps * dt;
              if (tgt.hp <= 0) { tgt.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#94a3b8", 5, 110); }
            } else {
              // tower gone — redirect to station
              damageStation(state, orb.side, dps * dt);
            }
          } else {
            // shadow: damage the station
            damageStation(state, orb.side, dps * dt);
          }
          if (Math.random() < 0.18) {
            state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x + rand(-15, 15), y: orb.y + rand(-10, 10), vx: rand(-20, 20), vy: rand(-40, -10), life: rand(0.3, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color: orb.color, size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
          }
          if (orb.damageTimer <= 0) { orb.hp = 0; }
        }
        continue;
      }
      // --- Target selection ---
      if (!orb._shadowTarget) {
        if (orb.multiTower) {
          // fog: seek nearest tower (any tower or side tower)
          let tgt = null, bestD = Infinity;
          const consider = (tw) => { if ((tw.hp ?? 0) <= 0) return; const d = Math.hypot(tw.x - orb.x, tw.y - orb.y); if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; tgt = tw; } };
          for (const tw of owner.towers) consider(tw);
          for (const tw of owner.sideTowers) consider(tw);
          if (tgt) orb._shadowTarget = { x: tgt.x, y: tgt.y, isStation: false };
          else orb._shadowTarget = { x: owner.station.x, y: owner.station.y, isStation: true };
        } else {
          // shadow: random side tower or station
          const liveSideTowers = owner.sideTowers.filter((st) => st.hp > 0);
          const pool = [...liveSideTowers, owner.station];
          const tgt = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
          orb._shadowTarget = { x: tgt.x, y: tgt.y, isStation: tgt === owner.station };
        }
      }
      if (!orb._shadowTarget.isStation && !orb.multiTower) {
        const stillAlive = owner.sideTowers.some((st) => st.x === orb._shadowTarget.x && st.y === orb._shadowTarget.y && st.hp > 0);
        if (!stillAlive) orb._shadowTarget = { x: owner.station.x, y: owner.station.y, isStation: true };
      }
      const tx = orb._shadowTarget.x, ty = orb._shadowTarget.y;
      const dx = tx - orb.x, dy = ty - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed;
      const eta = d / sp;
      if (eta <= orb.attackWindow) orb.revealed = true;
      // Check arrival
      if (d < 20 + orb.radius) {
        orb.arrived = true;
        orb.arrivalTimer = orb.arrivalDelay || 0.8;
      } else {
        orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // radioactive: seek nearest living tower one at a time, infect on contact
    // (chance scales with card level), never the main station unless no towers remain
    if (orb.infectOnContact) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      const all = [...owner.towers, ...owner.sideTowers];
      let tgt = null, bestD = Infinity;
      for (const t of all) {
        if ((t.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
        if (t === orb._radioExclude) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y);
        if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; tgt = t; }
      }
      if (!tgt) {
        // only the excluded tower remains (or none) — retry without exclude
        orb._radioExclude = null;
        for (const t of all) {
          if ((t.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
          const d = Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y);
          if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; tgt = t; }
        }
      }
      if (tgt) {
        const dx = tgt.x - orb.x, dy = tgt.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed;
        if (d > 18 + orb.radius) {
          orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
          orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        } else {
          const cardLvl = orb.cardLevel || 1;
          const chance = Math.min(0.18, (orb.infectionChance || 0.10) + (cardLvl - 1) * 0.02);
          if (Math.random() < chance && (!tgt.poisonTimer || tgt.poisonTimer <= 0)) {
            tgt.poisonTimer = orb.poisonDuration;
            tgt.poisonDps = orb.poisonDps;
            state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tgt.x, y: tgt.y, type: "pop", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: "#84cc16" });
            addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#84cc16", 6, 120);
          }
          orb._radioExclude = tgt;  // retarget away from this tower next tick
        }
      } else {
        // no towers left: fall back to the station
        const sx = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.x : OPPONENT_STATION.x;
        const sy = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.y : OPPONENT_STATION.y;
        const dx = sx - orb.x, dy = sy - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed;
        orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // zap_orb: hop from tower to tower, dealing damage at each latch
    if (orb.zapHop) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      if (!orb._zapState) { orb._zapState = "seeking"; orb._zapVisited = []; }

      // Latched: deal damage to the targeted tower
      if (orb._zapState === "latched") {
        let tgt = null;
        if (orb._zapTarget) {
          for (const t of owner.towers) {
            if ((t.hp ?? 0) > 0 && t.x === orb._zapTarget.x && t.y === orb._zapTarget.y) { tgt = t; break; }
          }
          if (!tgt) {
            for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
              if (st.hp > 0 && st.x === orb._zapTarget.x && st.y === orb._zapTarget.y) { tgt = st; break; }
            }
          }
        }
        if (!tgt) {
          orb._zapState = "hopping";
        } else {
          orb._zapTimer -= dt;
          tgt.hp = (tgt.hp ?? 60) - (orb.zapDamage || 15) * dt;
          if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
            state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x + rand(-12, 12), y: orb.y + rand(-8, 8), vx: rand(-25, 25), vy: rand(-50, -10), life: rand(0.2, 0.4), maxLife: 0.4, color: "#3b82f6", size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
          }
          if (tgt.hp <= 0) { tgt.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#3b82f6", 8, 140); }
          if (orb._zapTimer <= 0) {
            orb._zapState = "hopping";
            orb._zapTarget = null;
          }
        }
      }

      // Seeking or Hopping: move toward next target
      if (orb._zapState === "seeking" || orb._zapState === "hopping") {
        if (!orb._zapNextTarget) {
          const allTowers = [
            ...owner.towers.filter((t) => (t.hp ?? 0) > 0),
            ...owner.sideTowers.filter((t) => t.hp > 0),
          ];
          let next = null, bestD = Infinity;
          for (const t of allTowers) {
            const key = `${t.x},${t.y}`;
            if (orb._zapVisited.includes(key)) continue;
            const d = Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y);
            if (d <= (orb.zapRange || 180) && d < bestD) { bestD = d; next = t; }
          }
          if (!next) {
            for (const t of allTowers) {
              const d = Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y);
              if (d <= (orb.zapRange || 180) && d < bestD) { bestD = d; next = t; }
            }
          }
          if (next) {
            orb._zapNextTarget = { x: next.x, y: next.y };
          } else {
            orb._zapNextTarget = { x: owner.station.x, y: owner.station.y, isStation: true };
          }
        }

        const tgt = orb._zapNextTarget;
        const dx = tgt.x - orb.x, dy = tgt.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const sp = orb.speed || 40;
        orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * dt;

        if (d < 22 + orb.radius) {
          if (tgt.isStation) {
            damageStation(state, orb.side, 15);
            orb.hp = 0;
            addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#3b82f6", 12, 200);
          } else {
            orb._zapTarget = { x: tgt.x, y: tgt.y };
            orb._zapState = "latched";
            orb._zapTimer = orb.zapInterval || 1.5;
            orb._zapVisited.push(`${tgt.x},${tgt.y}`);
            orb._zapNextTarget = null;
            addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#3b82f6", 10, 180);
            state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "zap_arrival", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: "#3b82f6" });
          }
        }
      }
      continue;
    }

    // attacker behavior: seek nearest tower/sideTower on this side, else station
    if (orb.attacker) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      let tgt = null, bestD = Infinity;
      const consider = (tw) => {
        if ((tw.hp ?? 0) <= 0) return;
        const d = Math.hypot(tw.x - orb.x, tw.y - orb.y);
        if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; tgt = tw; }
      };
      for (const tw of owner.towers) consider(tw);
      for (const tw of owner.sideTowers) consider(tw);
      if (tgt && bestD < 420) {
        const dx = tgt.x - orb.x, dy = tgt.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        if (d > 22 + orb.radius) {
          const atkSp = (orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed) * 0.85;
          orb.x += (dx / d) * atkSp * slow * dt;
          orb.y += (dy / d) * atkSp * slow * dt;
        } else if (orb.freezeOnImpact) {
          const cardLvl = orb.cardLevel || 1;
          const freezeDur = (orb.freezeDuration || 1) + (orb.freezePerLevel || 0) * (cardLvl - 1);
          tgt.frozen = Math.max(tgt.frozen || 0, freezeDur);
          orb.hp = 0;
          state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tgt.x, y: tgt.y, type: "freeze", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#67e8f9" });
          addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#67e8f9", 12, 200);
        } else {
          tgt.hp = (tgt.hp ?? 60) - orb.damage * dt * 1.2;
          if (tgt.hp <= 0) { tgt.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#94a3b8", 8, 140); }
        }
        continue;
      }
    }

    // gate-first targeting: nearest living side tower, else nearest ahead player tower, else station
    const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
    let gate = null, gateD = Infinity;
    for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
      if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(st.x - orb.x, st.y - orb.y);
      if (d < gateD) { gateD = d; gate = st; }
    }
    if (gate) {
      const dx = gate.x - orb.x, dy = gate.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed;
      orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      continue;
    }
    // no gate: nearest player tower within 220px AND ahead (between orb and station)
    let tgt = null, td = Infinity;
    for (const tw of owner.towers) {
      if ((tw.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(tw.x - orb.x, tw.y - orb.y);
      if (d > 220) continue;
      const ahead = orb.side === 0 ? (tw.y >= orb.y) : (tw.y <= orb.y);
      if (!ahead) continue;
      if (d < td) { td = d; tgt = tw; }
    }
    if (tgt) {
      const dx = tgt.x - orb.x, dy = tgt.y - orb.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
      const sp = (orb.speed || ORB_TYPES[orb.type].speed) * 0.85;
      if (d > 22 + orb.radius) {
        orb.x += (dx / d) * sp * slow * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / d) * sp * slow * dt;
      } else {
        tgt.hp = (tgt.hp ?? 60) - orb.damage * dt * 1.2;
        if (tgt.hp <= 0) { tgt.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tgt.x, tgt.y, "#94a3b8", 8, 140); }
      }
      continue;
    }
    // fall through to station
    orb.y += orb.vy * dt * slow;
    const stationX = orb.side === 0 ? PLAYER_STATION.x : OPPONENT_STATION.x;
    orb.x += (stationX - orb.x) * 0.25 * dt * slow;
  }
}

function tickHealers(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (orb.type !== "healer" || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    orb.healTimer = (orb.healTimer || 0) + dt;
    const interval = ORB_TYPES.healer.healInterval || 2;
    if (orb.healTimer >= interval) {
      orb.healTimer = 0;
      const radius = ORB_TYPES.healer.healRadius || 120;
      const pulse = ORB_TYPES.healer.healPulse || 8;
      let healed = false;
      for (const ally of state.orbs) {
        if (ally === orb || ally.side !== orb.side || ally.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (ally.hp >= ally.maxHp) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(ally.x - orb.x, ally.y - orb.y);
        if (d <= radius) {
          ally.hp = Math.min(ally.maxHp, ally.hp + pulse);
          healed = true;
          state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, vx: (ally.x - orb.x) * 0.5, vy: (ally.y - orb.y) * 0.5, life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: "#4ade80", size: 3, sparkle: true });
        }
      }
      if (healed) state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "heal_pulse", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#4ade80", radius });
    }
  }
}

function tickGrowth(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (!orb.growth || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    orb._growthAge = (orb._growthAge || 0) + dt;
    const t = Math.min(1, orb._growthAge / (orb.growthDuration || 8));
    if (!orb._baseMaxHp) { orb._baseMaxHp = orb.maxHp; orb._baseSpeed = orb.speed; orb._baseDamage = orb.damage; }
    const hpMult = 1 + t * ((orb.growthHpMult || 3) - 1);
    const speedMult = 1 + t * ((orb.growthSpeedMult || 1.8) - 1);
    const dmgMult = 1 + t * ((orb.growthDmgMult || 2.5) - 1);
    const oldMaxHp = orb.maxHp;
    orb.maxHp = Math.round(orb._baseMaxHp * hpMult);
    orb.hp += (orb.maxHp - oldMaxHp);
    orb.speed = orb._baseSpeed * speedMult;
    orb.damage = Math.round(orb._baseDamage * dmgMult);
    orb.vy = (orb.side === 0 ? 1 : -1) * orb.speed;
  }
}

function tickShieldBubbles(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (!orb.shieldBubble || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    orb._shieldBubbleTimer = (orb._shieldBubbleTimer || 0) + dt;
    if (orb._shieldBubbleTimer >= (orb.shieldRegenInterval || 2.5)) {
      orb._shieldBubbleTimer = 0;
      const radius = orb.shieldRadius || 100;
      const cap = orb.shieldCap || 30;
      let shielded = false;
      for (const ally of state.orbs) {
        if (ally === orb || ally.side !== orb.side || ally.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(ally.x - orb.x, ally.y - orb.y) <= radius) {
          ally.shieldHp = Math.min(cap, (ally.shieldHp || 0) + Math.round(cap * 0.3));
          shielded = true;
        }
      }
      if (shielded) {
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "shield_bubble_pulse", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: orb.color, radius });
      }
    }
  }
}

function tickBerserkers(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (!orb.berserker || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (!orb._baseSpeed) { orb._baseSpeed = orb.speed; orb._baseDamage = orb.damage; }
    const ratio = Math.max(0, orb.hp / orb.maxHp);
    const mult = 1 + (1 - ratio) * 1.5;
    orb.speed = orb._baseSpeed * mult;
    orb.damage = Math.round(orb._baseDamage * mult);
    orb.vy = (orb.side === 0 ? 1 : -1) * orb.speed;
  }
}

function bouncerUpdate(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type !== "bouncer" || (tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    const pullRange = stats.perk?.id === "pullRange" ? stats.range * stats.perk.pullMult : stats.range;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0 || orb.frozen > 0) continue;
      if (orb.bounceTimer > 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
      if (d > pullRange) continue;
      const dx = tower.x - orb.x, dy = tower.y - orb.y, dist = d || 1;
      const pullSpeed = 160;
      orb.x += (dx / dist) * pullSpeed * dt;
      orb.y += (dy / dist) * pullSpeed * dt;
      if (d < 20 + orb.radius) {
        const sizeFactor = clamp(1.6 - orb.radius / 30, 0.7, 1.6);
        const bounceSpeed = (260 + 140 * sizeFactor) * (owner.side === 0 ? -1 : 1);
        orb.vy = bounceSpeed;
        orb.vx = (orb.x - tower.x) * 1.5;
        orb.bounceTimer = 1.1;
        tower.hp = (tower.hp ?? 60) - orb.damage * 0.5 - 3;
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y, type: "pop", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: stats.color });
        addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, stats.color, 6, 120);
        if (tower.hp <= 0) { tower.hp = 0; addBurst(state, tower.x, tower.y, "#94a3b8", 10, 150); }
      }
    }
  }
}

function fireTowers(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  const rageMult = owner.effects.rage > 0 ? 3.0 : 1;
  const ocMult = owner.effects.overclock > 0 ? 1.8 : 1;
  const rateMult = rageMult * ocMult;
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type === "bouncer" || tower.type === "orb_mortar" || tower.type === "lava_mortar" || tower.type === "magnet" || tower.type === "mine_layer" || tower.type === "overcharger") continue;
    if ((tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    // Glacier: continuous slow aura (affects sprint orbs too)
    if (tower.type === "glacier" && stats.slow) {
      const slowVal = stats.perk?.id === "slow" ? stats.perk.slow : stats.slow;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y) <= stats.range) {
          orb.slowTimer = 0.3;
          orb.slowFactor = slowVal;
        }
      }
    }
    // Prism Lance: continuous beam on highest-HP orb, damage ramps while locked
    if (tower.type === "prism") {
      let beamTarget = null, bestHP = -1;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d <= stats.range && orb.hp > bestHP) { bestHP = orb.hp; beamTarget = orb; }
      }
      if (!beamTarget) { tower._beamTargetId = null; tower._beamRamp = 0; continue; }
      if (tower._beamTargetId !== beamTarget.id) { tower._beamTargetId = beamTarget.id; tower._beamRamp = 0; }
      const rampMax = stats.perk?.id === "rampMax" ? stats.perk.rampMax : (stats.rampMax || 3);
      tower._beamRamp = Math.min(rampMax, (tower._beamRamp || 0) + dt * 1.5);
      const dps = stats.damage * (1 + tower._beamRamp);
      applyOrbDamage(beamTarget, dps * dt);
      tower._beamFloater = (tower._beamFloater || 0) + dt;
      if (tower._beamFloater >= 0.3) {
        tower._beamFloater = 0;
        addFloater(state, beamTarget.x, beamTarget.y - beamTarget.radius - 6, `-${Math.round(dps)}`, stats.color, 14);
      }
      if (beamTarget.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, beamTarget, who);
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), type: "prism_beam", x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 10, tx: beamTarget.x, ty: beamTarget.y, ramp: tower._beamRamp, life: 0.1, maxLife: 0.1, color: stats.color });
      continue;
    }
    // Capacitor: charge up, then fire massive burst on highest-HP orb
    if (tower.type === "capacitor") {
      const chargeTime = (stats.chargeTime || 3) / (stats.perk?.id === "chargeSpeed" ? stats.perk.chargeMult : 1);
      tower._charge = (tower._charge || 0) + dt;
      if (tower._charge < chargeTime) continue;
      let capTarget = null, bestHP = -1;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d <= stats.range && orb.hp > bestHP) { bestHP = orb.hp; capTarget = orb; }
      }
      if (!capTarget) continue;
      tower._charge = 0;
      const dmgMult = stats.perk?.id === "chargeSpeed" ? stats.perk.dmgMult : 1;
      const dmg = Math.round(stats.damage * dmgMult);
      applyOrbDamage(capTarget, dmg);
      addFloater(state, capTarget.x, capTarget.y - capTarget.radius - 6, `-${dmg}`, stats.color, 22);
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), type: "capacitor_beam", x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 10, tx: capTarget.x, ty: capTarget.y, life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: stats.color });
      addBurst(state, capTarget.x, capTarget.y, stats.color, 12, 200);
      if (capTarget.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, capTarget, who);
      tower.fireFlash = 0.4;
      state.shake = Math.min(0.8, (state.shake || 0) + 0.3);
      continue;
    }
    const ocBuff = tower._overchargeBuff > 0 ? (tower._overchargeMult || 1.6) : 1;
    tower.cd -= dt * rateMult * ocBuff;
    if (tower._overchargeBuff > 0) tower._overchargeBuff = Math.max(0, tower._overchargeBuff - dt);
    if (tower.cd > 0) continue;
    let target = null, bestD = Infinity;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
      if (d <= stats.range && d < bestD) { bestD = d; target = orb; }
    }
    if (!target) continue;
    tower.cd = stats.fireRate;

    // Flak Cannon: 5-pellet spread
    if (tower.type === "flak") {
      const pelletCount = stats.perk?.id === "pelletCount" ? stats.perk.pelletCount : (stats.pelletCount || 5);
      const spread = stats.spreadAngle || 0.55;
      const baseAngle = Math.atan2(target.y - tower.y, target.x - tower.x);
      for (let i = 0; i < pelletCount; i++) {
        const offset = (i - (pelletCount - 1) / 2) * (spread / (pelletCount - 1 || 1));
        const angle = baseAngle + offset;
        state.projectiles.push({
          id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 6,
          vx: Math.cos(angle) * stats.projectileSpeed, vy: Math.sin(angle) * stats.projectileSpeed,
          damage: stats.damage, owner: who, side: owner.side, type: tower.type,
          color: stats.color, pierce: 1, splash: 0, slow: 0, burn: 0,
          poison: 0, poisonStacks: 1, hitIds: [], life: 1.5, age: 0, trail: [],
        });
      }
      tower.fireFlash = 0.2;
      continue;
    }

    // Harpoon: yank the furthest-progressed orb back toward the wall
    if (tower.type === "harpoon") {
      let best = null, bestProgress = -Infinity;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d > stats.range) continue;
        const progress = orb.side === 0 ? orb.y : (GAME_HEIGHT - orb.y);
        if (progress > bestProgress) { bestProgress = progress; best = orb; }
      }
      if (best) {
        const yankMult = stats.perk?.id === "yankPower" ? stats.perk.yankMult : 1;
        const wallDir = best.side === 0 ? -1 : 1;
        best.bounceTimer = 0.8;
        best.vy = wallDir * 280 * yankMult;
        best.vx = (best.x - tower.x) * 0.5;
        applyOrbDamage(best, stats.damage);
        addFloater(state, best.x, best.y - best.radius - 6, `-${stats.damage}`, stats.color, 14);
        if (best.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, best, who);
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 6, tx: best.x, ty: best.y, type: "harpoon_shot", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: stats.color });
        addBurst(state, best.x, best.y, stats.color, 8, 160);
        tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Twin Cannon: fire at the 2 lowest-HP orbs
    if (tower.type === "twin") {
      const targetCount = stats.perk?.id === "targetCount" ? stats.perk.targetCount : 2;
      const candidates = state.orbs
        .filter((o) => o.side === owner.side && o.hp > 0 && !(o.stealth && !o.revealed))
        .filter((o) => Math.hypot(o.x - tower.x, o.y - tower.y) <= stats.range)
        .sort((a, b) => a.hp - b.hp)
        .slice(0, targetCount);
      for (const tgt of candidates) {
        const dx = tgt.x - tower.x, dy = tgt.y - tower.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        state.projectiles.push({
          id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 6,
          vx: (dx / d) * stats.projectileSpeed, vy: (dy / d) * stats.projectileSpeed,
          damage: stats.damage, owner: who, side: owner.side, type: tower.type,
          color: stats.color, pierce: 1, splash: 0, slow: 0, burn: 0,
          poison: 0, poisonStacks: 1, hitIds: [], life: 3, age: 0, trail: [],
        });
      }
      tower.fireFlash = 0.2;
      continue;
    }

    // Tesla Coil: periodic AoE pulse around the tower
    if (tower.type === "tesla") {
      const pulseRadius = stats.range * (stats.perk?.id === "pulseRadius" ? stats.perk.radiusMult : 1);
      let hit = false;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d <= pulseRadius) {
          applyOrbDamage(orb, stats.damage);
          addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 6, `-${stats.damage}`, stats.color, 13);
          if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, who);
          hit = true;
        }
      }
      if (hit) {
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y, type: "tesla_pulse", life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: stats.color, radius: pulseRadius });
        addBurst(state, tower.x, tower.y, stats.color, 8, 140);
        tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Detonator: force-detonate nearby bomb orbs
    if (tower.type === "detonator") {
      const detRange = stats.range * (stats.perk?.id === "detonateRange" ? stats.perk.rangeMult : 1);
      let detonated = false;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (!orb.explodesOnDeath) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d <= detRange) {
          orb.hp = 0;
          killOrb(state, orb, who);
          detonated = true;
        }
      }
      if (detonated) {
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y, type: "detonator_pulse", life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: stats.color, radius: detRange });
        tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Seeker: fire homing missiles at 2 lowest-HP orbs
    if (tower.type === "seeker") {
      const homingCount = stats.perk?.id === "homingCount" ? stats.perk.homingCount : (stats.homingCount || 2);
      const candidates = state.orbs
        .filter((o) => o.side === owner.side && o.hp > 0 && !(o.stealth && !o.revealed))
        .filter((o) => Math.hypot(o.x - tower.x, o.y - tower.y) <= stats.range)
        .sort((a, b) => a.hp - b.hp)
        .slice(0, homingCount);
      for (const tgt of candidates) {
        const dx = tgt.x - tower.x, dy = tgt.y - tower.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        state.projectiles.push({
          id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 6,
          vx: (dx / d) * stats.projectileSpeed, vy: (dy / d) * stats.projectileSpeed,
          damage: stats.damage, owner: who, side: owner.side, type: tower.type,
          color: stats.color, pierce: 1, splash: stats.splash || 0, slow: 0, burn: 0,
          poison: 0, poisonStacks: 1, hitIds: [], life: 3, age: 0, trail: [],
          homing: true, targetId: tgt.id, homingSpeed: stats.projectileSpeed,
        });
      }
      continue;
    }

    // Arc: instant chain lightning
    if (tower.type === "arc") {
      const chain = stats.perk?.id === "chain" ? stats.perk.chain : (stats.chain || 3);
      const chainRange = 150;
      const hit = [];
      let cur = target;
      while (cur && hit.length < chain) {
        hit.push(cur);
        const dmg = Math.round(stats.damage * Math.pow(0.85, hit.length - 1));
        applyOrbDamage(cur, dmg);
        addFloater(state, cur.x, cur.y - cur.radius - 6, `-${dmg}`, stats.color, 14);
        if (cur.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, cur, who);
        let next = null, nd = chainRange;
        for (const o of state.orbs) {
          if (o.side !== owner.side || o.hp <= 0 || hit.includes(o)) continue;
          const dd = Math.hypot(o.x - cur.x, o.y - cur.y);
          if (dd < nd) { nd = dd; next = o; }
        }
        cur = next;
      }
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: 0, y: 0, type: "lightning_chain", points: hit.map((o) => ({ x: o.x, y: o.y })), life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: stats.color });
      addBurst(state, target.x, target.y, stats.color, 6, 120);
      continue;
    }

    const dx = target.x - tower.x, dy = target.y - tower.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    const perk = stats.perk;
    const isBoomerang = tower.type === "rebound";
    const pierce = isBoomerang ? 99 : (stats.pierce || 1) + (owner.effects.overclock > 0 ? 3 : 0) + (perk?.id === "pierce" ? perk.pierce : 0);
    const splash = (stats.splash || 0) + (perk?.id === "splash" ? perk.splash : 0);
    const burn = (stats.burn || 0) + (perk?.id === "burn" ? perk.burn : 0) + (perk?.id === "burnDps" ? perk.burnDps : 0);
    const slow = perk?.id === "slow" ? perk.slow : (stats.slow || 0);
    const poisonStacks = perk?.id === "poisonStacks" ? perk.poisonStacks : 1;
    state.projectiles.push({
      id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 6,
      vx: (dx / d) * stats.projectileSpeed, vy: (dy / d) * stats.projectileSpeed,
      damage: stats.damage, owner: who, side: owner.side, type: tower.type,
      color: stats.color, pierce, splash, slow, burn,
      poison: stats.poison ? 1 : 0, poisonStacks,
      hitIds: [], life: isBoomerang ? 2.5 : 3, age: 0, trail: [],
      boomerang: isBoomerang,
      boomerangTimer: isBoomerang ? (stats.range / stats.projectileSpeed) : 0,
      boomerangReturned: false,
      burnChance: stats.burnChance || 0,
      burnDps: stats.burnDps || 0,
