      knockback: tower.type === "repulsor",
      freezeBeam: tower.type === "cryo",
      freezeDuration: tower.type === "cryo"
        ? (stats.perk?.id === "freezeDuration" ? stats.perk.freezeDur : (stats.freezeDuration || 0.6) + (stats.freezePerLevel || 0) * ((tower.level || 1) - 1))
        : 0,
    });
  }
}

function fireSideTowers(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  const color = who === "player" ? "#3b82f6" : "#f43f5e";
  for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
    if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (st.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stOcBuff = st._overchargeBuff > 0 ? (st._overchargeMult || 1.6) : 1;
    st.cd = (st.cd || 0) - dt * stOcBuff;
    if (st._overchargeBuff > 0) st._overchargeBuff = Math.max(0, st._overchargeBuff - dt);
    if (st.cd > 0) continue;
    let target = null, bestD = Infinity;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - st.x, orb.y - st.y);
      if (d <= SIDE_TOWER_RANGE && d < bestD) { bestD = d; target = orb; }
    }
    if (!target) continue;
    const stStats = getSideTowerStats(state.metaLevels?.sideTower || 0);
    st.cd = stStats.fireRate;
    const dx = target.x - st.x, dy = target.y - st.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
    state.projectiles.push({
      id: uid(), x: st.x, y: st.y,
      vx: (dx / d) * SIDE_TOWER_PROJECTILE_SPEED, vy: (dy / d) * SIDE_TOWER_PROJECTILE_SPEED,
      damage: stStats.damage, owner: who, side: owner.side, type: "side",
      color, pierce: 1, splash: 0, slow: 0, burn: 0, poison: 0,
      hitIds: [], life: 3, age: 0, trail: [],
    });
  }
}

function tickTowerPoison(state, dt) {
  for (const who of ["player", "opponent"]) {
    const owner = state[who];
    for (const t of owner.towers) {
      if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
      if (t.poisonTimer && t.poisonTimer > 0) {
        t.poisonTimer -= dt;
        t.hp = (t.hp ?? 60) - (t.poisonDps || 0) * dt;
        if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
          state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: t.x + rand(-14, 14), y: t.y + rand(-10, 10), vx: rand(-15, 15), vy: rand(-50, -10), life: rand(0.3, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color: "#84cc16", size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
        }
        if (t.hp <= 0) { t.hp = 0; addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#84cc16", 8, 140); }
      }
    }
    for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
      if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (st.poisonTimer && st.poisonTimer > 0) {
        st.poisonTimer -= dt;
        st.hp = st.hp - (st.poisonDps || 0) * dt;
        if (st.hp <= 0) { st.hp = 0; addBurst(state, st.x, st.y, "#84cc16", 8, 140); }
      }
    }
  }
}



function updateProjectiles(state, dt) {
  for (const p of state.projectiles) {
    if (p.life <= 0) continue;
    p.age = (p.age || 0) + dt;
    // Boomerang reversal: reverse direction at max range, reset hit list
    if (p.boomerang) {
      p.boomerangTimer -= dt;
      if (p.boomerangTimer <= 0 && !p.boomerangReturned) {
        p.boomerangReturned = true;
        p.vx = -p.vx;
        p.vy = -p.vy;
        p.hitIds = [];
      }
    }
    // Homing: steer toward target
    if (p.homing && p.targetId) {
      const tgt = state.orbs.find((o) => o.id === p.targetId && o.hp > 0 && o.side === p.side);
      if (tgt) {
        const dx = tgt.x - p.x, dy = tgt.y - p.y, d = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
        const speed = p.homingSpeed || 260;
        const steer = 0.15;
        p.vx = p.vx * (1 - steer) + (dx / d) * speed * steer;
        p.vy = p.vy * (1 - steer) + (dy / d) * speed * steer;
        const v = Math.hypot(p.vx, p.vy);
        if (v > 0) { p.vx = (p.vx / v) * speed; p.vy = (p.vy / v) * speed; }
      } else {
        const newTgt = state.orbs.find((o) => o.side === p.side && o.hp > 0 && !(o.stealth && !o.revealed));
        if (newTgt) p.targetId = newTgt.id;
        else { p.life = 0; continue; }
      }
    }
    p.trail.push({ x: p.x, y: p.y });
    if (p.trail.length > 8) p.trail.shift();
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt; p.life -= dt;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.hp <= 0 || orb.side !== p.side || p.hitIds.includes(orb.id)) continue;
      if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - p.x, orb.y - p.y);
      if (d <= orb.radius + 6) {
        applyOrbDamage(orb, p.damage);
        p.hitIds.push(orb.id);
        p.pierce -= 1;
        addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 6, `-${p.damage}`, p.color, 15);
        if (p.splash > 0) {
          for (const o of state.orbs) {
            if (o === orb || o.side !== p.side || o.hp <= 0) continue;
            if (Math.hypot(o.x - orb.x, o.y - orb.y) <= p.splash) applyOrbDamage(o, p.damage * 0.6);
          }
          state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "explosion", life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: p.color });
          addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, p.color, 10, 220);
        }
        if (p.slow > 0) { orb.slowTimer = 3; orb.slowFactor = p.slow; }
        if (p.burn > 0) { orb.burn = 3; orb.burnDps = p.burn; }
        if (p.burnChance && Math.random() < p.burnChance) { orb.burn = Math.max(orb.burn || 0, 3); orb.burnDps = Math.max(orb.burnDps || 0, p.burnDps || 6); }
        if (p.poison > 0) { orb.poisonStacks = Math.min(5, (orb.poisonStacks || 0) + (p.poisonStacks || 1)); orb.poisonTimer = 4; }
        if (p.knockback) {
          const wallDir = orb.side === 0 ? -1 : 1;
          orb.bounceTimer = 0.7;
          orb.vy = wallDir * 220;
          orb.vx = (orb.x - p.x) * 0.8;
        }
        if (p.freezeBeam && p.freezeDuration > 0) {
          orb.frozen = Math.max(orb.frozen || 0, p.freezeDuration);
        }
        if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, p.owner);
        if (p.pierce <= 0) { p.life = 0; break; }
      }
    }
  }
}

function killOrb(state, orb, killer) {
  const isPlayer = killer === "player";
  if (!orb.noReward) {
    if (isPlayer) {
      state.player.coins = Math.min(999, state.player.coins + orb.reward);
      addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y, `+${orb.reward}`, "#fbbf24", 16);
      if (Math.random() < 0.06) {
        state.coinPickups.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, value: 10 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 6), life: 5.5, maxLife: 5.5, bob: 0 });
      }
    } else {
      state.opponent.coins = Math.min(999, state.opponent.coins + orb.reward);
    }
  }
  addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 9, 200);
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "pop", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: orb.color });
  if (orb.explodesOnDeath) {
    const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
    const station = owner.station;
    if (Math.hypot(orb.x - station.x, orb.y - station.y) < 80) damageStation(state, orb.side, 10);
    for (const t of owner.towers) {
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - t.x, orb.y - t.y) < 60) t.hp = (t.hp ?? 60) - 20;
    }
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "explosion", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#f43f5e" });
    addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#f43f5e", 14, 260);
  }
  if (orb.splitsInto > 0 && orb.splitType) {
    const st = ORB_TYPES[orb.splitType];
    for (let i = 0; i < orb.splitsInto; i++) {
      const ang = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / orb.splitsInto;
      const child = makeOrb(orb.side, st, orb.x, orb.y, 0, orb.noReward, orb._scale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 }, null, orb.cardLevel || 1);
      child.vx = Math.cos(ang) * 30;
      if (orb.splitHpMult && orb.splitHpMult !== 1) {
        child.hp = Math.max(1, Math.round(child.hp * orb.splitHpMult));
        child.maxHp = child.hp;
      }
      if (orb.splitDmgMult && orb.splitDmgMult !== 1) {
        child.damage = Math.max(1, Math.round(child.damage * orb.splitDmgMult));
      }
      state.orbs.push(child);
    }
  }
}

function damageStation(state, side, dmg) {
  const owner = side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
  if (owner.effects.shield > 0) { addSparkles(state, owner.station.x, owner.station.y, "#93c5fd", 8); return; }
  owner.hp = Math.max(0, owner.hp - dmg);
  owner.flash = 0.35;
  state.shake = Math.min(1.4, (state.shake || 0) + 0.7);
  state.hitStop = Math.max(state.hitStop, 0.07);
  addBurst(state, owner.station.x, owner.station.y, "#f43f5e", 10, 160);
}

function checkOrbCollisions(state) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    // phantom: deal damage on reaching the station, then despawn
    if (orb.phantom) {
      const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
      const station = owner.station;
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - station.x, orb.y - station.y) <= 34 + orb.radius) {
        damageStation(state, orb.side, orb.damage * (orb._damageBoost || 1));
        orb.hp = 0;
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "hit", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: orb.color });
        addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 10, 180);
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (orb.stealth) continue;  // stealth orbs handle their own damage
    if (orb.zapHop) continue;  // zap orbs handle their own tower interactions
    const owner = orb.side === 0 ? state.player : state.opponent;
    const station = owner.station;
    if (Math.hypot(orb.x - station.x, orb.y - station.y) <= 34 + orb.radius) {
      damageStation(state, orb.side, orb.damage * (orb._damageBoost || 1));
      orb.hp = 0;
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "hit", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: "#f43f5e" });
      addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 8, 180);
      continue;
    }
    // radioactive orbs pass through side towers (infection handled separately)
    if (orb.infectOnContact) continue;
    for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
      if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - st.x, orb.y - st.y) <= 18 + orb.radius) {
        st.hp -= orb.damage * (orb._damageBoost || 1);
        orb.hp = 0;
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "hit", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: "#fbbf24" });
        addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 6, 150);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
}

function updateVisuals(state, dt) {
  for (const f of state.floaters) { f.y += f.vy * dt; f.life -= dt; f.vy *= 0.96; }
  state.floaters = state.floaters.filter((f) => f.life > 0);
  for (const p of state.particles) {
    p.x += p.vx * dt; p.y += p.vy * dt;
    p.vy += (p.sparkle ? -40 : 222) * dt; p.vx *= 0.98; p.life -= dt;
  }
  state.particles = state.particles.filter((p) => p.life > 0);
}

// ---- Player actions ----
export function clickOrb(state, orbId) {
  const orb = state.orbs.find((o) => o.id === orbId);
  if (!orb || orb.side !== 0) return false;

  // shadow orbs can only be clicked during the reveal window
  if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed && !orb.phantom) return false;

  // phantom: tapping a stealthed phantom reveals it for 3 seconds (consumes a click)
  if (orb.phantom && orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) {
    if (state.player.clicks <= 0) {
      state.clickEmptyFlash = 0.4;
      addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 8, "No clicks!", "#f43f5e", 16);
      return false;
    }
    state.player.clicks -= 1;
    orb.revealed = true;
    orb.phantomRevealTimer = orb.revealDuration || 3;
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "reveal_flash", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: orb.color });
    addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 10, 160);
    addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 8, "REVEALED!", "#8b5cf6", 18);
    return true;
  }

  // Stamina: a click is consumed only when a tap lands on a live orb.
  if (state.player.clicks <= 0) {
    state.clickEmptyFlash = 0.4;
    addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 8, "No clicks!", "#f43f5e", 16);
    return false;
  }
  state.player.clicks -= 1;

  if (orb.detonateOnClick) {
    detonateMine(state, orb);
    return true;
  }

  const baseDmg = state.clickDamage || 12;
  const crit = Math.random() < 0.18;
  const dmg = crit ? baseDmg * 2 : baseDmg;
  applyOrbDamage(orb, dmg);
  if (crit) {
    addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 8, `CRIT! ${dmg}`, "#fbbf24", 22);
    addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#fde68a", 8, 160);
  } else {
    addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 8, `-${dmg}`, "#ffffff", 18);
  }
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "click", life: 0.2, maxLife: 0.2, color: crit ? "#fbbf24" : "#ffffff" });
  if (orb.hp <= 0) {
    killOrb(state, orb, "player");
    state.player.clickKills = (state.player.clickKills || 0) + 1;
    // Combo grows only from manual taps (not tower/projectile kills).
    state.combo += 1;
    state.comboTimer = 1.2;
    state.comboGrace = 0;
    const bonus = Math.min(3, Math.max(0, state.combo - 1));
    if (bonus > 0) {
      state.player.coins = Math.min(999, state.player.coins + bonus);
      addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - 16, `+${bonus}`, "#f472b6", 14);
    }
    if (state.combo >= 3) addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - 30, `COMBO x${state.combo}!`, "#f472b6", 20);
  }
  return true;
}

function detonateMine(state, orb) {
  const radius = 95;
  addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#f97316", 16, 280);
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "explosion", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#f97316" });
  state.shake = Math.min(1.2, (state.shake || 0) + 0.4);
  for (const o of state.orbs) {
    if (o === orb || o.side !== 0 || o.hp <= 0) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(o.x - orb.x, o.y - orb.y) <= radius) {
      applyOrbDamage(o, 30);
      if (o.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, o, "player");
    }
  }
  for (const t of state.player.towers) {
    if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (Math.hypot(t.x - orb.x, t.y - orb.y) <= radius) t.hp = (t.hp ?? 60) - 25;
  }
  if (Math.hypot(orb.x - PLAYER_STATION.x, orb.y - PLAYER_STATION.y) <= radius) {
    damageStation(state, 0, 18);
  }
  orb.hp = 0;
  addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - 20, "BOOM!", "#f97316", 22);
}

export function placeTower(state, type, x, y) {
  const def = TOWER_TYPES[type];
  if (!def) return false;
  const firstFree = !!state.player.firstPlacement;
  const cost = firstFree ? Math.round(def.cost * 0.8) : def.cost;
  if (state.player.coins < cost) return false;
  const { col, row, x: gx, y: gy } = snapToGrid(x, y);
  if (gy <= WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS || gy > GAME_HEIGHT - 24) return false;
  if (gx < 20 || gx > GAME_WIDTH - 20) return false;
  if (Math.hypot(gx - PLAYER_STATION.x, gy - PLAYER_STATION.y) < 64) return false;
  if (state.player.towers.some((t) => t.gridCol === col && t.gridRow === row)) return false;
  if (state.player.sideTowers.some((st) => st.hp > 0 && Math.hypot(st.x - gx, st.y - gy) < GRID_SIZE * 0.7)) return false;
  state.player.coins -= cost;
  state.player.firstPlacement = false;
  const cardLevel = state.metaLevels?.towers?.[type] || 1;
  const startLevel = getCardStartLevel(cardLevel, state.leagueMax || 5);
  const startStats = getTowerStats(type, startLevel, cardLevel, state.playerTrophies);
  const tower = { id: uid(), type, cardLevel, x: gx, y: gy, gridCol: col, gridRow: row, cd: def.mortar ? startStats.fireRate : 0.3, hp: startStats.maxHp, maxHp: startStats.maxHp, level: startLevel, spawn: 0.45 };
  state.player.towers.push(tower);
  addBurst(state, gx, gy, def.color, 10, 150);
  return tower;
}

export function upgradeTower(state, towerId) {
  const t = state.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === towerId);
  if (!t) return false;
  const level = t.level || 1;
  const cardLevel = t.cardLevel || state.metaLevels?.towers?.[t.type] || 1;
  const maxLevel = getTowerMaxLevel(cardLevel, state.leagueMax || 5);
  if (level >= maxLevel) return false;
  const next = getTowerStats(t.type, level + 1, cardLevel, state.playerTrophies);
  if (state.player.coins < next.upgradeCost) return false;
  state.player.coins -= next.upgradeCost;
  t.level = level + 1;
  t.maxHp = next.maxHp;
  t.hp = next.maxHp;
  t.spawn = 0.4;
  addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#fbbf24", 12, 160);
  addSparkles(state, t.x, t.y - 10, "#fde68a", 10);
  return true;
}

export function sellTower(state, towerId) {
  const t = state.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === towerId);
  if (!t) return false;
  const stats = getTowerStats(t.type, t.level || 1, t.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
  state.player.coins = Math.min(999, state.player.coins + (stats.sellValue || 0));
  state.player.towers = state.player.towers.filter((tw) => tw.id !== towerId);
  state.player.selectedTower = null;
  addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#94a3b8", 10, 150);
  return true;
}

export function selectTower(state, towerId) {
  state.player.selectedTower = state.player.selectedTower === towerId ? null : towerId;
  return state.player.selectedTower;
}

export function cleanseTower(state, towerId) {
  const t = state.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === towerId);
  if (!t || (t.hp ?? 60) <= 0) return false;
  if (!t.poisonTimer || t.poisonTimer <= 0) return false;
  t.poisonTimer = 0;
  t.poisonDps = 0;
  t.hp = Math.min(t.maxHp || 60, (t.hp ?? 60) + 20);
  addSparkles(state, t.x, t.y - 10, "#4ade80", 10);
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: t.x, y: t.y, type: "heal_pulse", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#4ade80", radius: 40 });
  return true;
}

export function buyOrb(state, typeId) {
  const def = ORB_TYPES[typeId];
  if (!def || state.player.coins < def.cost) return null;
  state.player.coins -= def.cost;
  state.player.orbsBought = (state.player.orbsBought || 0) + 1;
  const cardLevel = state.metaLevels?.orbs?.[typeId] || 1;
  const cardMult = getOrbScaleMultiplier(cardLevel);
  const ls = state.leagueScale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 };
  const cardScale = getLeagueCardMultScale(state.playerTrophies);
  const scale = { hp: (1 + (cardMult.hp - 1) * cardScale) * ls.hp, dmg: (1 + (cardMult.dmg - 1) * cardScale) * ls.dmg, speed: (1 + (cardMult.speed - 1) * cardScale) * ls.speed };
  // Use Math.random (not seeded PRNG) so the shared seed stays in sync; sync the exact x + attacker
  const x = 60 + Math.random() * (GAME_WIDTH - 120);
  const attacker = typeId === "bomb" ? Math.random() < 0.3 : false;
  const patternId = state.playerPattern || "default";
  spawnOrb(state, 1, typeId, true, scale, x, attacker, patternId);
  return { typeId, x, attacker, scale, patternId };
}

// Place an orb at a fixed slot behind the wall (tap-to-place flow).
// Same scaling/coin logic as buyOrb; only the X source changes (slot, not random).
export function placeOrbAtSlot(state, typeId, slotIndex) {
  const def = ORB_TYPES[typeId];
  if (!def || state.player.coins < def.cost) return null;
  const slotX = ORB_SLOTS[slotIndex] ?? ORB_SLOTS[0];
  state.player.coins -= def.cost;
  state.player.orbsBought = (state.player.orbsBought || 0) + 1;
  const cardLevel = state.metaLevels?.orbs?.[typeId] || 1;
  const cardMult = getOrbScaleMultiplier(cardLevel);
  const ls = state.leagueScale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 };
  const cardScale = getLeagueCardMultScale(state.playerTrophies);
  const scale = { hp: (1 + (cardMult.hp - 1) * cardScale) * ls.hp, dmg: (1 + (cardMult.dmg - 1) * cardScale) * ls.dmg, speed: (1 + (cardMult.speed - 1) * cardScale) * ls.speed };
  const attacker = typeId === "bomb" ? Math.random() < 0.3 : false;
  const patternId = state.playerPattern || "default";
  spawnOrb(state, 1, typeId, true, scale, slotX, attacker, patternId);
  return { typeId, x: slotX, attacker, scale, patternId };
}

export function collectCoin(state, coinId) {
  const c = state.coinPickups.find((cc) => cc.id === coinId);
  if (!c) return false;
  state.player.coins = Math.min(999, state.player.coins + c.value);
  state.coinPickups = state.coinPickups.filter((cc) => cc.id !== coinId);
  addFloater(state, c.x, c.y, `+${c.value}`, "#fbbf24", 20);
  addSparkles(state, c.x, c.y, "#fbbf24", 12);
  addBurst(state, c.x, c.y, "#fbbf24", 8, 160);
  return true;
}

// ---- Abilities ----
export function activateAbility(state, abilityId) {
  const ab = state.player.abilities.find((a) => a.id === abilityId);
  if (!ab || !ab.ready) return false;
  const def = ABILITIES[abilityId];
  const meta = ab.meta || 1;
  const stats = ABILITY_UPGRADES[abilityId]?.[meta] || {};

  if (def.targeted) {
    state.targeting = { ability: abilityId, selected: [], max: stats.max || def.max || 6 };
    return true;
  }
  if (def.channel) {
    state.player.burner = { armed: true, holding: false, x: 0, y: 0, fuel: stats.fuel || 5, maxFuel: stats.fuel || 5, radius: stats.radius || 75, dps: stats.dps || 80, burnDps: stats.burnDps || 25 };
    return true;
  }
  if (def.aimed) {
    state.aiming = { ability: abilityId, meta, radius: stats.radius || (abilityId === "meteor" ? 95 : 85), opponentSide: !!def.opponentSide };
    return true;
  }

  ab.ready = false;
  ab.cooldown = stats.cooldown || def.cooldown;
  ab.maxCooldown = ab.cooldown;
  applyAbility(state, abilityId);
  return true;
}

export function confirmAim(state, x, y) {
  if (!state.aiming) return false;
  const abilityId = state.aiming.ability;
  const meta = state.aiming.meta || 1;
  // Opponent-side abilities can't be placed on the player's half
  if (state.aiming.opponentSide && y > WALL_Y) return false;
  const ab = state.player.abilities.find((a) => a.id === abilityId);
  const stats = ABILITY_UPGRADES[abilityId]?.[meta] || {};
  if (ab) { ab.ready = false; ab.cooldown = stats.cooldown || ABILITIES[abilityId].cooldown; ab.maxCooldown = ab.cooldown; }
  applyAimedAbility(state, abilityId, x, y, meta);
  state.aiming = null;
  return true;
}

export function cancelAim(state) { state.aiming = null; return true; }

export function startBurnerHold(state, x, y) {
  const b = state.player.burner;
  if (!b || !b.armed) return false;
  b.holding = true; b.x = x; b.y = y;
  return true;
}
export function updateBurnerHold(state, x, y) {
  const b = state.player.burner;
  if (!b || !b.holding) return false;
  b.x = x; b.y = y;
  return true;
}
export function endBurnerHold(state) {
  const b = state.player.burner;
  if (!b || !b.holding) return false;
  b.holding = false;
  return true;
}
export function cancelBurner(state) { state.player.burner = null; return true; }

export function addTargetOrb(state, orbId) {
  if (!state.targeting) return false;
  const orb = state.orbs.find((o) => o.id === orbId);
  if (!orb || orb.side !== 0 || orb.hp <= 0) return false;
  const tg = state.targeting;
  const idx = tg.selected.indexOf(orbId);
  if (idx >= 0) { tg.selected.splice(idx, 1); return true; }
  if (tg.selected.length >= tg.max) return false;
  tg.selected.push(orbId);
  if (tg.selected.length >= tg.max) return confirmTargeting(state);
  return true;
}

export function confirmTargeting(state) {
  if (!state.targeting) return false;
  const tg = state.targeting;
  const ab = state.player.abilities.find((a) => a.id === tg.ability);
  const meta = ab?.meta || 1;
  const stats = ABILITY_UPGRADES[tg.ability]?.[meta] || {};
  if (ab) { ab.ready = false; ab.cooldown = stats.cooldown || ABILITIES[tg.ability].cooldown; ab.maxCooldown = ab.cooldown; }
  let portaledOrbs = null;
  if (tg.ability === "portal") {
    portaledOrbs = tg.selected.map((id) => {
      const orb = state.orbs.find((o) => o.id === id);
      return orb ? { typeId: orb.type, x: orb.x, attacker: false, scale: orb._scale || state.leagueScale } : null;
    }).filter(Boolean);
    state.lastPortal = portaledOrbs;
  }
  applyTargetedAbility(state, tg.ability, tg.selected);
  state.targeting = null;
  return { ability: tg.ability, portaledOrbs };
}

export function cancelTargeting(state) { state.targeting = null; return true; }

function applyAbility(state, abilityId) {
  const ab = state.player.abilities.find((a) => a.id === abilityId);
  const meta = ab?.meta || 1;
  const stats = ABILITY_UPGRADES[abilityId]?.[meta] || {};
  switch (abilityId) {
    case "zap": {
      state.flash = 0.4;
      state.shake = Math.min(1.2, (state.shake || 0) + 0.6);
      const zapDmg = stats.damage || 30;
      const targets = state.orbs.filter((o) => o.side === 0 && o.hp > 0 && !(o.stealth && !o.revealed)).sort((a, b) => a.x - b.x);
      if (targets.length > 0) {
        const points = targets.map((o) => ({ x: o.x, y: o.y }));
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: 0, y: 0, type: "lightning_chain", points, life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#facc15" });
        for (const orb of targets) {
          applyOrbDamage(orb, zapDmg);
          addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 6, `-${zapDmg}`, "#facc15", 16);
          if (orb.hp <= 0) {
            state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "ash", life: 0.9, maxLife: 0.9, color: "#78716c" });
            killOrb(state, orb, "player");
          }
        }
      }
      if (stats.stationDent > 0) damageStation(state, 1, stats.stationDent);
      break;
    }
    case "repair": {
      state.player.hp = Math.min(STATION_HP, state.player.hp + (stats.heal || 35));
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: PLAYER_STATION.x, y: PLAYER_STATION.y, type: "repair", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, color: "#4ade80" });
      addSparkles(state, PLAYER_STATION.x, PLAYER_STATION.y, "#4ade80", 16);
      break;
    }
    case "freeze": {
      const dur = stats.duration || ABILITY_DURATION.freeze;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) if (orb.side === 0) orb.frozen = dur;
      state.player.effects.freeze = dur;
      addSparkles(state, GAME_WIDTH / 2, WALL_Y + 120, "#67e8f9", 18);
      break;
    }
    case "rage": { state.player.effects.rage = stats.duration || ABILITY_DURATION.rage; break; }
    case "shield": {
      state.player.effects.shield = stats.duration || ABILITY_DURATION.shield;
      addSparkles(state, PLAYER_STATION.x, PLAYER_STATION.y, "#93c5fd", 14);
      break;
    }
    case "overclock": {
      state.player.effects.overclock = stats.duration || ABILITY_DURATION.overclock;
      addSparkles(state, GAME_WIDTH / 2, WALL_Y + 120, "#22d3ee", 18);
      break;
    }
    case "deep_freeze": {
      const dur = stats.duration || 2;
      for (const t of state.opponent.towers) if ((t.hp ?? 0) > 0) t.frozen = Math.max(t.frozen || 0, dur);
      for (const st of state.opponent.sideTowers) if (st.hp > 0) st.frozen = Math.max(st.frozen || 0, dur);
      addSparkles(state, GAME_WIDTH / 2, WALL_Y - 120, "#67e8f9", 22);
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: GAME_WIDTH / 2, y: WALL_Y - 100, type: "freeze", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, color: "#67e8f9" });
      break;
    }
    default: break;
  }
}

function applyAimedAbility(state, abilityId, x, y, meta = 1) {
  const stats = ABILITY_UPGRADES[abilityId]?.[meta] || {};
  if (abilityId === "meteor") {
    state.meteors.push({ id: uid(), x, y, timer: 0.9, radius: stats.radius || 95, damage: stats.damage || 60, exploded: false });
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x, y, type: "meteor_aim", life: 0.9, maxLife: 0.9, color: "#ef4444" });
  } else if (abilityId === "glue") {
    state.glues.push({ id: uid(), x, y, life: stats.duration || 6, radius: stats.radius || 85, slow: stats.slow || 0.35 });
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x, y, type: "glue_drop", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#a3e635" });
  } else if (abilityId === "speed_zone" || abilityId === "damage_zone" || abilityId === "frost_zone") {
    state.zones.push({ id: uid(), type: abilityId, x, y, radius: stats.radius || 90, boost: stats.boost || 0.15, life: stats.duration || 8, ownerSide: 0 });
    const zc = abilityId === "frost_zone" ? "#67e8f9" : abilityId === "speed_zone" ? "#fbbf24" : "#f43f5e";
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x, y, type: "glue_drop", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: zc });
    addSparkles(state, x, y, zc, 14);
  }
}

function tickDoTs(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (orb.burn > 0) {
      orb.burn -= dt;
      applyOrbDamage(orb, (orb.burnDps || 0) * dt);
      if (Math.random() < 0.4) {
        state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x + rand(-orb.radius, orb.radius), y: orb.y, vx: rand(-20, 20), vy: rand(-80, -30), life: rand(0.3, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color: ["#fb923c", "#f97316", "#fbbf24"][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)], size: rand(2, 4), sparkle: true });
      }
      if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, orb.side === 0 ? "player" : "opponent");
    }
    if (orb.poisonTimer > 0) {
      orb.poisonTimer -= dt;
      applyOrbDamage(orb, (orb.poisonStacks || 0) * 2 * dt);
      if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
        state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x + rand(-orb.radius, orb.radius), y: orb.y, vx: rand(-15, 15), vy: rand(-50, -10), life: rand(0.3, 0.5), maxLife: 0.5, color: "#84cc16", size: rand(1.5, 3) });
      }
      if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, orb.side === 0 ? "player" : "opponent");
    }
  }
}

function burnerTick(state, dt) {
  const b = state.player.burner;
  if (!b) return;
  if (b.holding && b.fuel > 0) {
    b.fuel = Math.max(0, b.fuel - dt);
    const radius = b.radius || 75;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== 0 || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - b.x, orb.y - b.y) <= radius + orb.radius) {
        applyOrbDamage(orb, (b.dps || 80) * dt);
        orb.burn = Math.max(orb.burn || 0, 1.5);
        orb.burnDps = b.burnDps || 25;
        if (Math.random() < 0.5) addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, "#fb923c", 2, 80);
      }
    }
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: b.x + rand(-20, 20), y: b.y + rand(-10, 10), vx: rand(-30, 30), vy: rand(-100, -40), life: rand(0.3, 0.6), maxLife: 0.6, color: ["#fb923c", "#f97316", "#fbbf24"][Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)], size: rand(2, 5), sparkle: true });
    }
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: b.x, y: b.y, type: "burner_beam", life: 0.1, maxLife: 0.1, color: "#fb923c", radius });
    if (b.fuel <= 0) {
      b.holding = false; b.armed = false;
      const ab = state.player.abilities.find((a) => a.id === "burner");
      const bMeta = ab?.meta || 1;
      const bStats = ABILITY_UPGRADES.burner?.[bMeta] || {};
      if (ab) { ab.ready = false; ab.cooldown = bStats.cooldown || ABILITIES.burner.cooldown; ab.maxCooldown = ab.cooldown; }
      state.player.burner = null;
    }
  }
}

function tickMeteors(state, dt) {
  for (const m of state.meteors) {
    if (m.exploded) continue;
    m.timer -= dt;
    if (m.timer <= 0) {
      m.exploded = true;
      state.shake = Math.min(1.4, (state.shake || 0) + 0.9);
      state.hitStop = Math.max(state.hitStop, 0.08);
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: m.x, y: m.y, type: "explosion", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, color: "#ef4444" });
      addBurst(state, m.x, m.y, "#ef4444", 18, 300);
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== 0 || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(orb.x - m.x, orb.y - m.y) <= m.radius) {
          applyOrbDamage(orb, m.damage || 60);
          if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, "player");
        }
      }
    }
  }
  state.meteors = state.meteors.filter((m) => !m.exploded);
}

function tickGlues(state, dt) {
  for (const g of state.glues) {
    g.life -= dt;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - g.x, orb.y - g.y) <= g.radius) {
        orb.slowTimer = 0.4; orb.slowFactor = g.slow || 0.35;
      }
    }
  }
  state.glues = state.glues.filter((g) => g.life > 0);
}

// ---- Zones: speed boost, damage boost, frost zone (placed on opponent's side) ----
function tickZones(state, dt) {
  // Reset per-frame boosts on all orbs
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    orb._speedBoost = 1;
    orb._damageBoost = 1;
  }
  for (const z of state.zones) {
    z.life -= dt;
    const ownerSide = z.ownerSide ?? 0;
    if (z.type === "speed_zone" || z.type === "damage_zone") {
      // Boost orbs on the opposite side of the zone owner
      const orbSide = 1 - ownerSide;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== orbSide || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(orb.x - z.x, orb.y - z.y) <= z.radius) {
          if (z.type === "speed_zone") orb._speedBoost = z.boost;
          else orb._damageBoost = z.boost;
        }
      }
    } else if (z.type === "frost_zone") {
      // Freeze towers on the opposite side of the zone owner
      const towerOwner = 1 - ownerSide;
      const owner = state[towerOwner === 0 ? "player" : "opponent"];
      for (const t of owner.towers) {
        if ((t.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(t.x - z.x, t.y - z.y) <= z.radius) t.frozen = Math.max(t.frozen || 0, 0.5);
      }
      for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
        if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (Math.hypot(st.x - z.x, st.y - z.y) <= z.radius) st.frozen = Math.max(st.frozen || 0, 0.5);
      }
      if (Math.random() < 0.3) {
        state.particles.push({ id: uid(), x: z.x + rand(-z.radius, z.radius), y: z.y + rand(-z.radius * 0.6, z.radius * 0.6), vx: rand(-15, 15), vy: rand(-30, -10), life: rand(0.4, 0.8), maxLife: 0.8, color: "#67e8f9", size: rand(1.5, 3), sparkle: true });
      }
    }
  }
  state.zones = state.zones.filter((z) => z.life > 0);
}

// ---- Magnet tower: lobs attractor zones that pull orbs into a cluster ----
function magnetFire(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type !== "magnet") continue;
    if ((tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    tower.cd -= dt;
    if (tower.cd > 0) continue;
    tower.cd = stats.fireRate;
    const isPlayer = owner.side === 0;
    const minY = isPlayer ? WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS + 40 : 90;
    const maxY = isPlayer ? GAME_HEIGHT - 90 : WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS - 40;
    let attempts = 0, mx = GAME_WIDTH / 2, my = (minY + maxY) / 2, ok = false;
    while (attempts < 12 && !ok) {
      mx = 60 + Math.random() * (GAME_WIDTH - 120);
      my = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);
      ok = true;
      for (const t of owner.towers) { if (Math.hypot(t.x - mx, t.y - my) < 50) { ok = false; break; } }
      attempts++;
    }
    const perk = stats.perk;
    const duration = 4 * (perk?.id === "pullRadius" ? perk.durationMult : 1);
    const radius = 100 * (perk?.id === "pullRadius" ? perk.radiusMult : 1);
    state.magnets = state.magnets || [];
    state.magnets.push({ id: uid(), x: mx, y: my, life: duration, maxLife: duration, radius, pullSpeed: 140, ownerSide: owner.side });
    tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 14, type: "mortar_muzzle", life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25, color: stats.color });
  }
}

function tickMagnets(state, dt) {
  for (const m of (state.magnets || [])) {
    m.life -= dt;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== m.ownerSide || orb.hp <= 0 || orb.frozen > 0 || orb.bounceTimer > 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - m.x, orb.y - m.y);
      if (d <= m.radius && d > 5) {
        const dx = m.x - orb.x, dy = m.y - orb.y, dist = d || 1;
        orb.x += (dx / dist) * m.pullSpeed * dt;
        orb.y += (dy / dist) * m.pullSpeed * dt;
      }
    }
  }
  state.magnets = (state.magnets || []).filter((m) => m.life > 0);
}

// ---- Mine Layer tower: drops landmines that detonate on orb contact ----
function mineLayerFire(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type !== "mine_layer") continue;
    if ((tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    state.mines = state.mines || [];
    const maxMines = stats.perk?.id === "mineCount" ? stats.perk.maxMines : 3;
    if (state.mines.filter((m) => m.ownerSide === owner.side).length >= maxMines) continue;
    tower.cd -= dt;
    if (tower.cd > 0) continue;
    tower.cd = stats.fireRate;
    const isPlayer = owner.side === 0;
    const minY = isPlayer ? WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS + 40 : 90;
    const maxY = isPlayer ? GAME_HEIGHT - 90 : WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS - 40;
    const mx = 60 + Math.random() * (GAME_WIDTH - 120);
    const my = minY + Math.random() * (maxY - minY);
    const splashMult = stats.perk?.id === "mineCount" ? stats.perk.splashMult : 1;
    state.mines.push({ id: uid(), x: mx, y: my, radius: 80 * splashMult, damage: stats.damage, ownerSide: owner.side, detonated: false });
    tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
  }
}

function tickMines(state, dt) {
  for (const m of (state.mines || [])) {
    if (m.detonated) continue;
    for (const orb of state.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== m.ownerSide || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(orb.x - m.x, orb.y - m.y) <= 20 + orb.radius) {
        m.detonated = true;
        for (const o of state.orbs) {
          if (o.side !== m.ownerSide || o.hp <= 0) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(o.x - m.x, o.y - m.y) <= m.radius) {
            applyOrbDamage(o, m.damage);
            if (o.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, o, m.ownerSide === 0 ? "player" : "opponent");
          }
        }
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: m.x, y: m.y, type: "explosion", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: "#f97316" });
        addBurst(state, m.x, m.y, "#f97316", 14, 240);
        state.shake = Math.min(1.0, (state.shake || 0) + 0.4);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  state.mines = (state.mines || []).filter((m) => !m.detonated);
}

// ---- Overcharger tower: pulses a fire-rate buff to adjacent friendly towers ----
function overchargerPulse(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type !== "overcharger") continue;
    if ((tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    tower.cd -= dt;
    if (tower.cd > 0) continue;
    tower.cd = stats.fireRate;
    const pulseRadius = stats.range * (stats.perk?.id === "buffStrength" ? stats.perk.radiusMult : 1);
    const buffMult = 1.6 * (stats.perk?.id === "buffStrength" ? stats.perk.buffMult : 1);
    for (const t of owner.towers) {
      if (t === tower || (t.hp ?? 0) <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(t.x - tower.x, t.y - tower.y) <= pulseRadius) { t._overchargeBuff = 2.5; t._overchargeMult = buffMult; }
    }
    for (const st of owner.sideTowers) {
      if (st.hp <= 0) continue;
      if (Math.hypot(st.x - tower.x, st.y - tower.y) <= pulseRadius) { st._overchargeBuff = 2.5; st._overchargeMult = buffMult; }
    }
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y, type: "overcharger_pulse", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: stats.color, radius: pulseRadius });
    addBurst(state, tower.x, tower.y, stats.color, 10, 140);
    tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
  }
}

// ---- Summoner orb: periodically spawns weak minion orbs while traveling ----
function tickSummoners(state, dt) {
  for (const orb of state.orbs) {
    if (!orb.summoner || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
    orb.summonTimer = (orb.summonTimer || 0) + dt;
    if (orb.summonTimer >= (orb.summonInterval || 2.5)) {
      orb.summonTimer = 0;
      const minion = makeOrb(orb.side, ORB_TYPES.normal, orb.x + rand(-15, 15), orb.y, 0, true, orb._scale || state.leagueScale, null, orb.cardLevel || 1);
      minion.hp = 8; minion.maxHp = 8; minion.radius = 14; minion.noReward = true;
      state.orbs.push(minion);
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "spawnPortal", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: orb.color });
      addBurst(state, orb.x, orb.y, orb.color, 6, 100);
    }
  }
}

function mortarFire(state, who, dt) {
  const owner = state[who];
  for (const tower of owner.towers) {
    if (tower.type !== "orb_mortar" && tower.type !== "lava_mortar") continue;
    if ((tower.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
    if (tower.frozen > 0) continue;
    const stats = getTowerStats(tower.type, tower.level || 1, tower.cardLevel || 1, state.playerTrophies);
    tower.cd -= dt;
    if (tower.cd > 0) continue;

    if (tower.type === "lava_mortar") {
      // Defensive fire-bomb mortar: lob at nearest orb on our side.
      let target = null, bestD = Infinity;
      for (const orb of state.orbs) {
        if (orb.side !== owner.side || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
        if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - tower.x, orb.y - tower.y);
        if (d <= stats.range && d < bestD) { bestD = d; target = orb; }
      }
      if (!target) continue;
      tower.cd = stats.fireRate;
      state.mortarShots = state.mortarShots || [];
      state.mortarShots.push({
        id: uid(), ownerSide: owner.side, isLava: true,
        launchX: tower.x, launchY: tower.y - 8,
        targetX: target.x, targetY: target.y,
        timer: 0.7, maxTimer: 0.7, spawned: false,
        damage: stats.damage, splash: stats.splash || 50,
        burnChance: stats.burnChance || 0, burnDps: stats.burnDps || 0,
        color: stats.color,
      });
      tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 14, type: "mortar_muzzle", life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25, color: stats.color });
      continue;
    }

    // orb_mortar: lob a random league-unlocked orb onto the opponent's field.
    tower.cd = stats.fireRate * (stats.perk?.id === "mortarRapid" ? stats.perk.cooldownMult : 1);
    const pool = getLeagueUnlockedOrbs(state.playerTrophies || 0);
    const orbId = pool[Math.floor(_gameRng() * pool.length)] || "normal";
    const targetSide = 1 - owner.side;
    const tx = 60 + _gameRng() * (GAME_WIDTH - 120);
    const ty = targetSide === 1
      ? 90 + _gameRng() * (WALL_Y - 40 - 90)
      : WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS + 40 + _gameRng() * (GAME_HEIGHT - WALL_Y - WALL_THICKNESS - 40 - 90);
    state.mortarShots = state.mortarShots || [];
    state.mortarShots.push({
      id: uid(), ownerSide: owner.side, orbType: orbId,
      launchX: tower.x, launchY: tower.y - 8,
      targetX: tx, targetY: ty,
      timer: 0.85, maxTimer: 0.85, spawned: false,
      color: ORB_TYPES[orbId]?.color || "#f59e0b",
    });
    tower.fireFlash = 0.3;
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: tower.x, y: tower.y - 14, type: "mortar_muzzle", life: 0.25, maxLife: 0.25, color: "#f59e0b" });
  }
}

function tickMortarShots(state, dt) {
  for (const m of (state.mortarShots || [])) {
    m.timer -= dt;
    if (m.timer <= 0 && !m.spawned) {
      m.spawned = true;
      if (m.isLava) {
        // Fire bomb impact: splash damage + burn chance to nearby orbs.
        const killer = m.ownerSide === 0 ? "player" : "opponent";
        for (const orb of state.orbs) {
          if (orb.side !== m.ownerSide || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
          if (orb.stealth && !orb.revealed) continue;
          if (Math.hypot(orb.x - m.targetX, orb.y - m.targetY) <= (m.splash || 50)) {
            applyOrbDamage(orb, m.damage || 18);
            addFloater(state, orb.x, orb.y - orb.radius - 6, `-${m.damage || 18}`, m.color, 14);
            if (m.burnChance && Math.random() < m.burnChance) {
              orb.burn = Math.max(orb.burn || 0, 3);
              orb.burnDps = Math.max(orb.burnDps || 0, m.burnDps || 6);
            }
            if (orb.hp <= 0) killOrb(state, orb, killer);
          }
        }
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: m.targetX, y: m.targetY, type: "explosion", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: m.color || "#f97316" });
        addBurst(state, m.targetX, m.targetY, m.color || "#f97316", 14, 220);
        state.shake = Math.min(0.6, (state.shake || 0) + 0.2);
      } else {
        spawnLobbedOrb(state, m.ownerSide, m.orbType, m.targetX, m.targetY);
        state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: m.targetX, y: m.targetY, type: "mortar_impact", life: 0.5, maxLife: 0.5, color: m.color });
        addBurst(state, m.targetX, m.targetY, m.color, 12, 200);
        state.shake = Math.min(0.8, (state.shake || 0) + 0.3);
      }
    }
  }
  state.mortarShots = (state.mortarShots || []).filter((m) => m.timer > 0);
}

function spawnLobbedOrb(state, ownerSide, typeId, x, y) {
  const type = ORB_TYPES[typeId] || ORB_TYPES.normal;
  const targetSide = 1 - ownerSide;
  const finalScale = state.leagueScale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 };
  const otScale = state.overtimeActive ? state.overtimeScale : 0;
  const lobbedCardLevel = state.metaLevels?.orbs?.[type.id] || 1;
  state.orbs.push(makeOrb(targetSide, type, x, y, otScale, true, finalScale, null, lobbedCardLevel));
  state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x, y, type: "spawnPortal", life: 0.45, maxLife: 0.45, color: type.color });
}

function applyTargetedAbility(state, abilityId, selectedIds) {
  if (abilityId === "portal") {
    for (const id of selectedIds) {
      const orb = state.orbs.find((o) => o.id === id);
      if (!orb) continue;
      orb.side = 1;
      orb.y = WALL_Y - 30;
      orb.vy = -Math.abs(orb.vy || 42);
      orb.attacker = false;
      state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: orb.x, y: WALL_Y, type: "portal", life: 0.6, maxLife: 0.6, color: "#818cf8" });
    }
  }
}

export function setSelectedTower(state, type) {
  state.player.selectedTowerType = type;
}

// ---- Multiplayer remote actions (applied to the opponent's side in the local sim) ----
export function remotePlaceTower(state, td) {
  const def = TOWER_TYPES[td.type];
  if (!def) return false;
  state.opponent.towers.push({
    id: td.id, type: td.type, cardLevel: td.cardLevel || 1,
    x: td.x, y: td.y, gridCol: td.gridCol, gridRow: td.gridRow,
    cd: def.mortar ? 10 : 0.3, hp: td.hp, maxHp: td.maxHp, level: td.level || 1, spawn: 0.45,
  });
  addBurst(state, td.x, td.y, def.color, 10, 150);
  return true;
}

export function remoteUpgradeTower(state, towerId) {
  const t = state.opponent.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === towerId);
  if (!t) return false;
  const level = t.level || 1;
  const cardLevel = t.cardLevel || 1;
  const maxLevel = getTowerMaxLevel(cardLevel, state.leagueMax || 5);
  if (level >= maxLevel) return false;
  const next = getTowerStats(t.type, level + 1, cardLevel, state.playerTrophies);
  t.level = level + 1;
  t.maxHp = next.maxHp;
  t.hp = next.maxHp;
  t.spawn = 0.4;
  addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#fbbf24", 12, 160);
  return true;
}

export function remoteSellTower(state, towerId) {
  const t = state.opponent.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === towerId);
  if (!t) return false;
  state.opponent.towers = state.opponent.towers.filter((tw) => tw.id !== towerId);
  addBurst(state, t.x, t.y, "#94a3b8", 10, 150);
  return true;
}

export function remoteBuyOrb(state, typeId, x, attacker, scale, patternId) {
  spawnOrb(state, 0, typeId, true, scale || state.leagueScale, x, attacker, patternId || state.oppPattern || "default");
  return true;
}

export function remotePortal(state, orbs) {
  if (!orbs) return false;
  for (const od of orbs) {
    spawnOrb(state, 0, od.typeId, true, od.scale || state.leagueScale, od.x, od.attacker || false);
  }
  return true;
}

export function remoteAbility(state, abilityId, payload) {
  if (abilityId === "zap") {
    for (const o of state.orbs) { if (o.side === 1 && o.hp > 0) { addBurst(state, o.x, o.y, "#facc15", 4, 100); o.hp = 0; } }
    state.effects.push({ id: uid(), x: GAME_WIDTH / 2, y: WALL_Y - 60, type: "zap_flash", life: 0.4, maxLife: 0.4, color: "#facc15" });
  } else if (abilityId === "freeze") {
    for (const o of state.orbs) { if (o.side === 1 && o.hp > 0) o.frozen = 4; }
    state.opponent.effects.freeze = 4;
  } else if (abilityId === "rage") { state.opponent.effects.rage = 6; }
  else if (abilityId === "overclock") { state.opponent.effects.overclock = 6; }
  else if (abilityId === "shield") { state.opponent.effects.shield = 5; }
  else if (abilityId === "repair") {
    state.opponent.hp = Math.min(state.opponent.station.maxHp, state.opponent.hp + 35);
    addSparkles(state, OPPONENT_STATION.x, OPPONENT_STATION.y, "#4ade80", 14);
  } else if (abilityId === "meteor" && payload) {
    state.meteors.push({ id: uid(), x: payload.x, y: payload.y, timer: 0.9, radius: 95, damage: 60, exploded: false });
  } else if (abilityId === "glue" && payload) {
    state.glues.push({ id: uid(), x: payload.x, y: payload.y, life: 6, radius: 85, slow: 0.35 });
  } else if (abilityId === "deep_freeze") {
    for (const t of state.player.towers) if ((t.hp ?? 0) > 0) t.frozen = Math.max(t.frozen || 0, 2);
    for (const st of state.player.sideTowers) if (st.hp > 0) st.frozen = Math.max(st.frozen || 0, 2);
  } else if ((abilityId === "speed_zone" || abilityId === "damage_zone" || abilityId === "frost_zone") && payload) {
    state.zones = state.zones || [];
    state.zones.push({ id: uid(), type: abilityId, x: payload.x, y: payload.y, radius: payload.radius || 90, boost: payload.boost || 0.15, life: payload.duration || 8, ownerSide: 1 });
  }
  return true;
}

// In-app achievement definitions — Play-style engagement loop with coin/shard rewards
import { SENDABLE_ORBS, TOWER_TYPES, MAX_CARD_LEVEL } from "./constants";

export const ACHIEVEMENTS = [
  { id: "first_win", icon: "🏆", reward: { coins: 100, shards: 0 }, check: (p) => (p.wins || 0) >= 1 },
  { id: "first_ranked", icon: "⚔️", reward: { coins: 50, shards: 2 }, check: (p, r) => r.won && r.mode === "ranked" },
  { id: "trophies_300", icon: "🥉", reward: { coins: 200, shards: 5 }, check: (p) => (p.trophies || 0) >= 300 },
  { id: "trophies_600", icon: "🥈", reward: { coins: 300, shards: 10 }, check: (p) => (p.trophies || 0) >= 600 },
  { id: "trophies_1000", icon: "🥇", reward: { coins: 500, shards: 20 }, check: (p) => (p.trophies || 0) >= 1000 },
  { id: "win_10", icon: "🔥", reward: { coins: 150, shards: 5 }, check: (p) => (p.wins || 0) >= 10 },
  { id: "win_50", icon: "💪", reward: { coins: 400, shards: 15 }, check: (p) => (p.wins || 0) >= 50 },
  { id: "streak_5", icon: "⚡", reward: { coins: 200, shards: 5 }, check: (p) => (p.win_streak || 0) >= 5 },
  { id: "streak_10", icon: "🌟", reward: { coins: 400, shards: 15 }, check: (p) => (p.win_streak || 0) >= 10 },
  { id: "unlock_all_orbs", icon: "🔮", reward: { coins: 500, shards: 25 }, check: (p) => SENDABLE_ORBS.every((id) => (p.orb_cards?.[id]?.level || 0) >= 1) },
  { id: "unlock_all_towers", icon: "🏰", reward: { coins: 500, shards: 25 }, check: (p) => Object.keys(TOWER_TYPES).every((id) => (p.tower_cards?.[id]?.level || 0) >= 1) },
  { id: "card_master", icon: "⭐", reward: { coins: 1000, shards: 50 }, check: (p) => {
    const all = [...Object.values(p.tower_cards || {}), ...Object.values(p.ability_cards || {}), ...Object.values(p.orb_cards || {})];
    return all.some((c) => (c?.level || 0) >= MAX_CARD_LEVEL);
  }},
  { id: "matches_25", icon: "🎮", reward: { coins: 100, shards: 3 }, check: (p) => ((p.wins || 0) + (p.losses || 0)) >= 25 },
];

// Returns array of newly-unlocked achievement definitions (not yet in profile.achievements)
export function evaluateAchievements(profile, matchResult) {
  const unlocked = profile.achievements || [];
  const newlyUnlocked = [];
  for (const ach of ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (unlocked.includes(ach.id)) continue;
    try {
      if (ach.check(profile, matchResult)) newlyUnlocked.push(ach);
    } catch (e) { /* skip broken checks */ }
  }
  return newlyUnlocked;
}

// Simple AI opponent controller
import {
  TOWER_TYPES, ORB_TYPES, OPPONENT_STATION, GAME_WIDTH, WALL_Y, getTowerStats,
  getCardStartLevel, getTowerMaxLevel,
} from "./constants";
import { spawnOrbOnOpponent } from "./engine";
import { STATION_SKINS, TOWER_SKINS, EMBLEMS, ORB_PATTERNS } from "./skins";

// Deterministic cosmetic bundle for AI opponents so they no longer appear blank.
// Seeded per match so the same bot always wears the same heraldry.
export function rollAICosmetics(seed = 0) {
  let s = (seed || 12345) >>> 0;
  const rnd = () => { s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0; return s / 4294967296; };
  // ~70% of bots wear fully default cosmetics; ~30% get exactly one common-rarity item.
  const pickCommon = (catalog) => {
    const ids = Object.keys(catalog).filter((k) => k !== "default" && catalog[k].rarity === "common");
    return ids.length ? ids[Math.floor(rnd() * ids.length)] : "default";
  };
  const bundle = {
    station: "default", leftTower: "default", rightTower: "default",
    stationEmblem: "default", leftTowerEmblem: "default", rightTowerEmblem: "default",
    orbPattern: "default",
  };
  if (rnd() < 0.3) {
    const slot = Math.floor(rnd() * 7);
    if (slot === 0) bundle.station = pickCommon(STATION_SKINS);
    else if (slot === 1) bundle.leftTower = pickCommon(TOWER_SKINS);
    else if (slot === 2) bundle.rightTower = pickCommon(TOWER_SKINS);
    else if (slot === 3) bundle.stationEmblem = pickCommon(EMBLEMS);
    else if (slot === 4) bundle.leftTowerEmblem = pickCommon(EMBLEMS);
    else if (slot === 5) bundle.rightTowerEmblem = pickCommon(EMBLEMS);
    else bundle.orbPattern = pickCommon(ORB_PATTERNS);
  }
  return bundle;
}

export function createAI(skill = 0.5) {
  return { skill, clickTimer: 0, buyTimer: 0, towerTimer: 0 };
}

export function runAI(ai, state, dt) {
  if (state.status !== "playing") return;
  const opp = state.opponent;
  const aiClickDmg = Math.round((state.clickDamage || 12) * (0.7 + ai.skill * 0.3));

  // Click orbs on opponent side (top). Most dangerous = smallest y (closest to top station).
  ai.clickTimer -= dt;
  if (ai.clickTimer <= 0) {
    ai.clickTimer = 0.5 - ai.skill * 0.3;
    const targets = state.orbs.filter((o) => o.side === 1 && o.hp > 0 && !(o.stealth && !o.revealed));
    if (targets.length) {
      targets.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);
      const t = targets[0];
      t.hp -= aiClickDmg;
      state.effects.push({ id: "aic" + Math.random(), x: t.x, y: t.y, type: "click", life: 0.2, maxLife: 0.2, color: "#ffffff" });
      if (t.hp <= 0) killOrbAI(state, t);
    }
  }

  // Buy orbs to send to player — include tank to pressure towers
  // In overtime, spend much more aggressively
  const otMult = state.overtimeActive ? 0.4 : 1;
  ai.buyTimer -= dt;
  if (ai.buyTimer <= 0) {
    ai.buyTimer = (6 - ai.skill * 3) * otMult;
    const buyChance = state.overtimeActive ? 0.6 + ai.skill * 0.3 : 0.3 + ai.skill * 0.4;
    if (opp.coins >= 40 && Math.random() < buyChance) {
      const baseChoices = state.overtimeActive
        ? ["fast", "bomb", "tank", "tank", "sprint", "swarmer"]
        : ["normal", "fast", "splitter", "bomb", "tank", "tank"];
      let choices = state.playerTrophies >= 100 ? [...baseChoices, "carrier"] : baseChoices;
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 300) choices = [...choices, "armored", "shield_bubble"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 500) choices = [...choices, "ice"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 600) choices = [...choices, "zap_orb", "growth"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 600) choices = [...choices, "phantom"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 1000) choices = [...choices, "berserker", "shadow", "leech"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 1200) choices = [...choices, "fog"];
      if (state.playerTrophies >= 1500) choices = [...choices, "summoner"];
      const pick = choices[Math.floor(Math.random() * choices.length)];
      const def = ORB_TYPES[pick];
      if (opp.coins >= def.cost) {
        opp.coins -= def.cost;
        spawnOrbOnOpponent(state, 1, pick, state.leagueScale || { hp: 1, dmg: 1, speed: 1 });
      }
    }
  }

  // Place towers in the opponent's (top) half — mix in bouncers at higher skill
  ai.towerTimer -= dt;
  if (ai.towerTimer <= 0) {
    ai.towerTimer = (8 - ai.skill * 4) * otMult;
    let pool = ai.skill > 0.6
      ? ["basic", "machinegun", "bouncer", "repulsor", "cryo", "seeker", "prism", "twin", "flak", "tesla"]
      : ai.skill > 0.4
      ? ["basic", "machinegun", "bouncer", "repulsor", "seeker", "twin", "flak", "harpoon"]
      : ["basic", "machinegun", "twin"];
    if (state.playerTrophies >= 600) pool = [...pool, "magnet"];
    if (state.playerTrophies >= 1000) pool = [...pool, "capacitor"];
    if (state.playerTrophies >= 1500) pool = [...pool, "overcharger"];
    if (state.playerTrophies >= 2000) pool = [...pool, "mine_layer"];
    const type = pool[Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length)];
    const def = TOWER_TYPES[type];
    if (opp.coins >= def.cost && opp.towers.length < 5) {
      const x = 80 + Math.random() * (GAME_WIDTH - 160);
      const y = 130 + Math.random() * (WALL_Y - 170);
      const aiCardLevel = Math.max(1, (state.leagueMax || 5) - 1);
      const aiLevel = getCardStartLevel(aiCardLevel, state.leagueMax || 5);
      const aiStats = getTowerStats(type, aiLevel, aiCardLevel, state.playerTrophies);
      opp.coins -= def.cost;
      opp.towers.push({ id: "ai" + Math.random(), type, cardLevel: aiCardLevel, x, y, cd: 0.3, hp: aiStats.maxHp, maxHp: aiStats.maxHp, level: aiLevel, spawn: 0.4 });
    }
    // Upgrade existing towers toward the league ceiling (mirrors player progression)
    if (ai.skill > 0.5 && opp.towers.length > 0) {
      const leagueMax = state.leagueMax || 5;
      const upgradable = opp.towers.filter((t) => (t.level || 1) < getTowerMaxLevel(t.cardLevel || 1, leagueMax));
      if (upgradable.length > 0) {
        const t = upgradable[Math.floor(Math.random() * upgradable.length)];
        const next = getTowerStats(t.type, (t.level || 1) + 1, t.cardLevel || (t.level || 1), state.playerTrophies);
        if (next && opp.coins >= next.upgradeCost) {
          opp.coins -= next.upgradeCost;
          t.level = (t.level || 1) + 1;
          t.maxHp = next.maxHp;
          t.hp = next.maxHp;
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

function killOrbAI(state, orb) {
  if (!orb.noReward) {
    state.opponent.coins = Math.min(999, state.opponent.coins + orb.reward);
  }
  state.effects.push({ id: "aie" + Math.random(), x: orb.x, y: orb.y, type: "pop", life: 0.3, maxLife: 0.3, color: orb.color });
}

// All chest-droppable skins up to a max rarity order, across all categories.
export function chestSkinPool(maxRarityOrder) {
  const pool = [];
  for (const cat of Object.values(SKIN_CATEGORIES)) {
    for (const skin of Object.values(cat.catalog)) {
      if (skin.source !== "chest") continue;
      if (RARITIES[skin.rarity].order <= maxRarityOrder) pool.push({ ...skin, category: cat.id });
    }
  }
  return pool;
}

// Shared color helpers for canvas + SVG pattern rendering.
// All return hex strings (or rgba() for alpha) so they work in both
// canvas fillStyle/strokeStyle and SVG fill/stroke attributes.

export function parseHex(hex) {
  let h = (hex || "#000000").replace("#", "");
  if (h.length === 3) h = h.split("").map((c) => c + c).join("");
  const n = parseInt(h, 16);
  return { r: (n >> 16) & 255, g: (n >> 8) & 255, b: n & 255 };
}

function clamp(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(255, Math.round(v))); }

function toHex({ r, g, b }) {
  return "#" + [r, g, b].map((v) => clamp(v).toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
}

// amount: 0..1 — how much darker (0 = same, 1 = black)
export function darken(hex, amount = 0.4) {
  const { r, g, b } = parseHex(hex);
  return toHex({ r: r * (1 - amount), g: g * (1 - amount), b: b * (1 - amount) });
}

// amount: 0..1 — how much lighter (0 = same, 1 = white)
export function lighten(hex, amount = 0.4) {
  const { r, g, b } = parseHex(hex);
  return toHex({ r: r + (255 - r) * amount, g: g + (255 - g) * amount, b: b + (255 - b) * amount });
}

// rgba string with alpha
export function rgba(hex, alpha = 1) {
  const { r, g, b } = parseHex(hex);
  return `rgba(${clamp(r)},${clamp(g)},${clamp(b)},${alpha})`;
}

// Detects whether the app is running inside the Base44 native WebView wrapper.
// Google blocks OAuth consent screens inside embedded WebViews
// (disallowed_useragent), so auth surfaces hide the Google button when this
// returns true and promote email/password to the primary entry instead.
// Mirrors the detection regex used in src/App.jsx.
export function isNativeWebView() {
  if (typeof window === "undefined") return false;
  const ua = window.navigator?.userAgent || "";
  const referrer = typeof document !== "undefined" ? document.referrer || "" : "";
  const isAndroidWebView = /Android.*?(wv|WebView)|Version\/\d+\.\d+/.test(ua);
  const isTwa = /android-app:\/\//.test(referrer);
  const isIosWebView = /iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(ua) && !/Safari/.test(ua);
  return isAndroidWebView || isTwa || isIosWebView;
}

const isNode = typeof window === 'undefined';
const windowObj = isNode ? { localStorage: new Map() } : window;
const storage = windowObj.localStorage;

const toSnakeCase = (str) => {
	return str.replace(/([A-Z])/g, '_$1').toLowerCase();
}

const getAppParamValue = (paramName, { defaultValue = undefined, removeFromUrl = false } = {}) => {
	if (isNode) {
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const storageKey = `base44_${toSnakeCase(paramName)}`;
	const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
	const searchParam = urlParams.get(paramName);
	if (removeFromUrl) {
		urlParams.delete(paramName);
		const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}${urlParams.toString() ? `?${urlParams.toString()}` : ""
			}${window.location.hash}`;
		window.history.replaceState({}, document.title, newUrl);
	}
	if (searchParam) {
		storage.setItem(storageKey, searchParam);
		return searchParam;
	}
	if (defaultValue) {
		storage.setItem(storageKey, defaultValue);
		return defaultValue;
	}
	const storedValue = storage.getItem(storageKey);
	if (storedValue) {
		return storedValue;
	}
	return null;
}

const getAppParams = () => {
	if (getAppParamValue("clear_access_token") === 'true') {
		storage.removeItem('base44_access_token');
		storage.removeItem('token');
	}
	return {
		appId: getAppParamValue("app_id", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_ID }),
		token: getAppParamValue("access_token", { removeFromUrl: true }),
		fromUrl: getAppParamValue("from_url", { defaultValue: window.location.href }),
		functionsVersion: getAppParamValue("functions_version", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION }),
		appBaseUrl: getAppParamValue("app_base_url", { defaultValue: import.meta.env.VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL }),
	}
}


export const appParams = {
	...getAppParams()
}

FILE: src/lib/authReturnTo.js

// Shared by the auth pages (Login, Register, and any page that resumes a flow
// after sign-in, e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page). Keep the redirect
// validation in one place — it is security-sensitive and easy to drift.

// Resolve ?returnTo= to a safe same-origin path, else "/".
//
// The same-origin check alone is not enough: a value like /.//evil.com or
// /\evil.com parses same-origin but normalizes to a protocol-relative
// //evil.com when assigned to location.href — an open redirect. So require the
// resolved path to be exactly one leading slash (no "//" prefix, no backslash).
export function safeReturnTo() {
  const raw = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("returnTo");
  if (!raw) return "/";
  try {
    const url = new URL(raw, window.location.origin);
    if (url.origin !== window.location.origin) return "/";
    // Strip app-bootstrap params: app-params.js persists these from the URL into
    // localStorage before the SDK initializes, so a crafted returnTo could
    // otherwise poison the freshly issued session — repointing the app at an
    // attacker's backend (app_base_url/app_id/functions_version) or overwriting
    // the token. Normal app-flow params (e.g. the OAuth consent ctx) are kept.
    // The full app-params.js bootstrap set (src/lib/app-params.js) — any of
    // these in a crafted returnTo would be persisted at next load.
    for (const p of ["access_token", "clear_access_token", "app_id", "app_base_url", "functions_version", "from_url"]) {
      url.searchParams.delete(p);
    }
    const path = url.pathname + url.search;
    if (!path.startsWith("/") || path.startsWith("//") || path.includes("\\")) return "/";
    return path;
  } catch {
    return "/";
  }
}

// Render-order helpers for the Collection page.
// Pure sorting/bucketing only — no business logic changes.
import { TOWER_TYPES, ABILITIES, ORB_TYPES, ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS } from "@/game/constants";
import { STARTER_TOWERS, STARTER_ABILITIES, STARTER_ORBS, getCardInfo } from "@/game/progression";
import { RARITIES } from "@/game/skins";

const STARTER_SETS = {
  tower: new Set(STARTER_TOWERS),
  ability: new Set(STARTER_ABILITIES),
  orb: new Set(STARTER_ORBS),
};

const TROPHY_MAPS = {
  tower: TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS,
  ability: ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS,
  orb: ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS,
};

function rarityOrder(rarity) {
  return RARITIES[rarity]?.order ?? 0;
}

// Bucket card defs by acquisition source for owned cards, plus a locked bucket
// for not-yet-unlocked cards. Each bucket is sorted common → legendary.
export function bucketCards(kind, defs, me) {
  const starters = STARTER_SETS[kind];
  const trophyMap = TROPHY_MAPS[kind];
  const buckets = { starter: [], trophy: [], crate: [], locked: [] };
  for (const def of defs) {
    const info = me ? getCardInfo(me, kind, def.id) : null;
    if (info?.locked) {
      buckets.locked.push(def);
      continue;
    }
    if (starters.has(def.id)) buckets.starter.push(def);
    else if (def.crateOnly) buckets.crate.push(def);
    else buckets.trophy.push(def);
  }
  const byRarity = (a, b) => rarityOrder(a.rarity) - rarityOrder(b.rarity);
  buckets.starter.sort(byRarity);
  buckets.trophy.sort(byRarity);
  buckets.crate.sort(byRarity);
  buckets.locked.sort(byRarity);
  return buckets;
}

// Sort skins: buyable (shop/default) first, then crate-only (chest),
// each subgroup ordered common → mythical.
export function sortSkins(skins) {
  return [...skins].sort((a, b) => {
    const aBuyable = a.source === "shop" || a.source === "default";
    const bBuyable = b.source === "shop" || b.source === "default";
    if (aBuyable !== bBuyable) return aBuyable ? -1 : 1;
    return rarityOrder(a.rarity) - rarityOrder(b.rarity);
  });
}

import React, { createContext, useState, useContext, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { appParams } from '@/lib/app-params';
import { createAxiosClient } from '@base44/sdk/dist/utils/axios-client';
import { consumePendingMerge } from '@/lib/googleMerge';
import { tryRestoreSnapshot, hasStoredSnapshot, setupSnapshotListeners } from '@/lib/profileSnapshot';
import { APP_VERSION } from '@/lib/appVersion';
import { compareVersions } from '@/lib/versionCompare';

const AuthContext = createContext();

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
  const [isLoadingAuth, setIsLoadingAuth] = useState(true);
  const [isLoadingPublicSettings, setIsLoadingPublicSettings] = useState(true);
  const [authError, setAuthError] = useState(null);
  const [authChecked, setAuthChecked] = useState(false);
  const [appPublicSettings, setAppPublicSettings] = useState(null); // Contains only { id, public_settings }
  // Version gate: 'ok' | 'force' | 'soft' | null (not yet checked)
  const [versionStatus, setVersionStatus] = useState(null);
  const [versionInfo, setVersionInfo] = useState(null);
  // Ban status: null when not banned, or { reason, banUntil } when actively banned
  const [banStatus, setBanStatus] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    checkAppState();
  }, []);

  // Save a profile snapshot when the app is backgrounded or closed.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAuthenticated) return;
    const cleanup = setupSnapshotListeners();
    return cleanup;
  }, [isAuthenticated]);

  const checkAppState = async () => {
    try {
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(true);
      setAuthError(null);
      
      // First, check app public settings (with token if available)
      // This will tell us if auth is required, user not registered, etc.
      const appClient = createAxiosClient({
        baseURL: `/api/apps/public`,
        headers: {
          'X-App-Id': appParams.appId
        },
        token: appParams.token, // Include token if available
        interceptResponses: true
      });
      
      try {
        const publicSettings = await appClient.get(`/prod/public-settings/by-id/${appParams.appId}`);
        setAppPublicSettings(publicSettings);
        
        // If we got the app public settings successfully, check if user is authenticated
        if (appParams.token) {
          await checkUserAuth();
        } else {
          setIsLoadingAuth(false);
          setIsAuthenticated(false);
          setAuthChecked(true);
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      } catch (appError) {
        console.error('App state check failed:', appError);
        
        // Handle app-level errors
        if (appError.status === 403 && appError.data?.extra_data?.reason) {
          const reason = appError.data.extra_data.reason;
          if (reason === 'auth_required') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'auth_required',
              message: 'Authentication required'
            });
          } else if (reason === 'user_not_registered') {
            setAuthError({
              type: 'user_not_registered',
              message: 'User not registered for this app'
            });
          } else {
            setAuthError({
              type: reason,
              message: appError.message
            });
          }
        } else {
          setAuthError({
            type: 'unknown',
            message: appError.message || 'Failed to load app'
          });
        }
        setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
        setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Unexpected error:', error);
      setAuthError({
        type: 'unknown',
        message: error.message || 'An unexpected error occurred'
      });
      setIsLoadingPublicSettings(false);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
    }
  };

  const checkUserAuth = async () => {
    try {
      // Now check if the user is authenticated
      setIsLoadingAuth(true);
      const currentUser = await base44.auth.me();
      const merged = await consumePendingMerge(currentUser);
      let finalUser = merged ? await base44.auth.me() : currentUser;

      // Auto-restore: if this is a fresh anonymous session (blank profile) and a
      // signed snapshot exists in localStorage, attempt to restore the old profile.
      if (!merged && !finalUser.onboarded && !(finalUser.wins > 0) && !(finalUser.losses > 0) && !(finalUser.trophies > 0) && hasStoredSnapshot()) {
        const restored = await tryRestoreSnapshot();
        if (restored) {
          finalUser = await base44.auth.me();
        }
      }
      // Server-side post-auth init: beta gift (200 gems) + daily login stamp.
      // These are backend-only fields — the client must not write them.
      let userToSet = finalUser;
      try {
        const res = await base44.functions.invoke("postAuthInit", {});
        if (res.data?.success && res.data.user) {
          userToSet = res.data.user;
        }
      } catch (e) { /* offline/guest — skip */ }
      setUser(userToSet);
      // Evaluate ban status: banned===true AND (permanent or not yet expired)
      const u = userToSet;
      if (u?.banned) {
        const expired = u.ban_until && new Date(u.ban_until).getTime() <= Date.now();
        setBanStatus(expired ? null : { reason: u.ban_reason || '', banUntil: u.ban_until || null });
      } else {
        setBanStatus(null);
      }
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
    } catch (error) {
      console.error('User auth check failed:', error);
      setIsLoadingAuth(false);
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
      setAuthChecked(true);
      
      // If user auth fails, it might be an expired token
      if (error.status === 401 || error.status === 403) {
        setAuthError({
          type: 'auth_required',
          message: 'Authentication required'
        });
      }
    }
  };

  // ---- Version gate ----
  // Fetches version info from the server and sets versionStatus:
  // 'force' (below min), 'soft' (below latest), or 'ok'.
  const checkVersion = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("getVersionInfo", {});
      const info = res.data || res;
      const min = info.min_required_version || "1.0.0";
      const latest = info.latest_version || "1.0.0";
      setVersionInfo({ min_required_version: min, latest_version: latest });
      if (compareVersions(APP_VERSION, min) < 0) {
        setVersionStatus("force");
      } else if (compareVersions(APP_VERSION, latest) < 0) {
        // Check if the user dismissed this specific latest version this session
        const dismissKey = `updatePromptDismissed:${latest}`;
        if (sessionStorage.getItem(dismissKey) === "1") {
          setVersionStatus("ok");
        } else {
          setVersionStatus("soft");
        }
      } else {
        setVersionStatus("ok");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // If the version check fails (offline, function not deployed yet),
      // don't block the player — default to 'ok'.
      setVersionStatus("ok");
    }
  }, []);

  // Re-check version (used by the service-worker update listener).
  // Clears any prior soft-dismiss so a newly-required version shows the overlay.
  const recheckVersion = useCallback(async () => {
    // Clear dismiss flags so a force-update from a new SW isn't suppressed
    try {
      Object.keys(sessionStorage)
        .filter((k) => k.startsWith("updatePromptDismissed:"))
        .forEach((k) => sessionStorage.removeItem(k));
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    await checkVersion();
  }, [checkVersion]);

  // Force the update overlay — called when matchmaking returns 426.
  const forceVersionUpdate = useCallback((minRequired) => {
    setVersionInfo((prev) => ({
      min_required_version: minRequired || prev?.min_required_version || APP_VERSION,
      latest_version: prev?.latest_version || APP_VERSION,
    }));
    setVersionStatus("force");
  }, []);

  // Dismiss the soft update prompt for the current latest version (session-scoped).
  const dismissUpdatePrompt = useCallback(() => {
    if (versionInfo?.latest_version) {
      try {
        sessionStorage.setItem(`updatePromptDismissed:${versionInfo.latest_version}`, "1");
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    }
    setVersionStatus("ok");
  }, [versionInfo]);

  // Check version once the user is authenticated.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (isAuthenticated) checkVersion();
  }, [isAuthenticated, checkVersion]);

  const logout = (shouldRedirect = true) => {
    setUser(null);
    setIsAuthenticated(false);
    
    if (shouldRedirect) {
      // Use the SDK's logout method which handles token cleanup and redirect
      base44.auth.logout(window.location.href);
    } else {
      // Just remove the token without redirect
      base44.auth.logout();
    }
  };

  const navigateToLogin = () => {
    // Use the SDK's redirectToLogin method
    base44.auth.redirectToLogin(window.location.href);
  };

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ 
      user, 
      isAuthenticated, 
      isLoadingAuth,
      isLoadingPublicSettings,
      authError,
      appPublicSettings,
      authChecked,
      versionStatus,
      versionInfo,
      recheckVersion,
      forceVersionUpdate,
      dismissUpdatePrompt,
      banStatus,
      logout,
      navigateToLogin,
      checkUserAuth,
      checkAppState
    }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
  }
  return context;
};

// Country-based age thresholds (GDPR Art. 8).
// Selecting a country sets the UI language default and the age threshold.
// These countries are supported — users from other regions see
// a "not available in your region" message (privacy policy §11).
export const SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES = [
  { code: 'dk', label: 'Danmark', flag: '🇩🇰', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'de', label: 'Deutschland', flag: '🇩🇪', lang: 'de', threshold: 16 },
  { code: 'es', label: 'España', flag: '🇪🇸', lang: 'es', threshold: 14 },
  { code: 'fr', label: 'France', flag: '🇫🇷', lang: 'fr', threshold: 15 },
  { code: 'ie', label: 'Ireland', flag: '🇮🇪', lang: 'en', threshold: 16 },
  { code: 'it', label: 'Italia', flag: '🇮🇹', lang: 'it', threshold: 14 },
  { code: 'nl', label: 'Nederland', flag: '🇳🇱', lang: 'nl', threshold: 16 },
  { code: 'no', label: 'Norge', flag: '🇳🇴', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'at', label: 'Österreich', flag: '🇦🇹', lang: 'de', threshold: 14 },
  { code: 'pl', label: 'Polska', flag: '🇵🇱', lang: 'pl', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'pt', label: 'Portugal', flag: '🇵🇹', lang: 'pt', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'ro', label: 'România', flag: '🇷🇴', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'ch', label: 'Schweiz', flag: '🇨🇭', lang: 'de', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'fi', label: 'Suomi', flag: '🇫🇮', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'se', label: 'Sverige', flag: '🇸🇪', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'en', label: 'United Kingdom', flag: '🇬🇧', lang: 'en', threshold: 13 },
  { code: 'ja', label: '日本', flag: '🇯🇵', lang: 'ja', threshold: 13 },
];

export const COUNTRY_AGE_THRESHOLDS = {
  de: 16, nl: 16, fr: 15, es: 14, it: 14, en: 13, pt: 13, ja: 13,
  ch: 13, at: 14, pl: 13, se: 13, ie: 16, dk: 13, fi: 13, no: 13, ro: 13,
};

// Calculate age in full years from a { day, month, year } object.
// month is 1-based (1 = January).
export function calculateAge(dob) {
  const today = new Date();
  let age = today.getFullYear() - dob.year;
  const monthDiff = today.getMonth() + 1 - dob.month;
  if (monthDiff < 0 || (monthDiff === 0 && today.getDate() < dob.day)) {
    age--;
  }
  return age;
}

// Get the age threshold for a country code (defaults to 16 — safest).
export function getThresholdByCountry(countryCode) {
  return COUNTRY_AGE_THRESHOLDS[countryCode] || 16;
}

// Find the country that matches a given language code (for pre-selection
// in the re-check dialog based on the user's stored language).
export function countryByLang(lang) {
  return SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.code === lang) || SUPPORTED_COUNTRIES.find((c) => c.lang === lang) || null;
}
