import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';


export default function PageNotFound({}) {
    const location = useLocation();
    const pageName = location.pathname.substring(1);

    const { data: authData, isFetched } = useQuery({
        queryKey: ['user'],
        queryFn: async () => {
            try {
                const user = await base44.auth.me();
                return { user, isAuthenticated: true };
            } catch (error) {
                return { user: null, isAuthenticated: false };
            }
        }
    });
    
    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-slate-50">
            <div className="max-w-md w-full">
                <div className="text-center space-y-6">
                    {/* 404 Error Code */}
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                        <h1 className="text-7xl font-light text-slate-300">404</h1>
                        <div className="h-0.5 w-16 bg-slate-200 mx-auto"></div>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Main Message */}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                        <h2 className="text-2xl font-medium text-slate-800">
                            Page Not Found
                        </h2>
                        <p className="text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                            The page <span className="font-medium text-slate-700">"{pageName}"</span> could not be found in this application.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Admin Note */}
                    {isFetched && authData.isAuthenticated && authData.user?.role === 'admin' && (
                        <div className="mt-8 p-4 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                            <div className="flex items-start space-x-3">
                                <div className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-orange-100 flex items-center justify-center mt-0.5">
                                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-orange-400"></div>
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-left space-y-1">
                                    <p className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">Admin Note</p>
                                    <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                                        This could mean that the AI hasn't implemented this page yet. Ask it to implement it in the chat.
                                    </p>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    )}
                    
                    {/* Action Button */}
                    <div className="pt-6">
                        <button 
                            onClick={() => window.location.href = '/'} 
                            className="inline-flex items-center px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-50 hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-slate-500"

// Compares semver strings (major.minor.patch). Returns -1 / 0 / 1.
// Missing version is treated as "0.0.0".
export function compareVersions(a, b) {
  // Strip any '-...' pre-release suffix (e.g. '1.1.0-beta') before numeric
  // compare so suffixes never produce NaN-equal (silent miscomparison) results.
  const seg = (v) => (v || "0.0.0").split(".").map((s) => Number(s.split("-")[0]));
  const pa = seg(a);
  const pb = seg(b);
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const av = pa[i] || 0;
    const bv = pb[i] || 0;
    if (av < bv) return -1;
    if (av > bv) return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

import { toast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";

// Map server error codes to i18n keys.
const ERROR_KEYS = {
  eula_required: "errors.eulaRequired",
  rate_limited: "errors.rateLimited",
  concurrent_modification: "errors.concurrentModification",
  insufficient_funds: "errors.insufficientFunds",
  insufficient_shards: "errors.insufficientFunds",
  match_too_short: "errors.matchTooShort",
  ai_daily_cap: "errors.aiDailyCap",
  outcome_mismatch: "errors.outcomeMismatch",
  not_owned: "errors.notOwned",
  max_level: "errors.maxLevel",
  already_claimed: "errors.alreadyClaimed",
  already_redeemed: "errors.alreadyRedeemed",
  invalid_code: "errors.invalidCode",
  unauthorized: "errors.unauthorized",
  card_locked: "errors.cardLocked",
  buy_limit_reached: "errors.buyLimitReached",
};

// Extract the error code from a thrown SDK error or a { success: false } response.
export function extractErrorCode(errorOrData) {
  if (!errorOrData) return null;
  return errorOrData?.data?.error || errorOrData?.error || null;
}

// Show a destructive toast for a backend error code.
export function showErrorToast(errorOrData, t, navigate) {
  const code = extractErrorCode(errorOrData) || "unknown";
  const i18nKey = ERROR_KEYS[code] || "errors.unknown";
  toast({
    title: t("errors.title"),
    description: t(i18nKey),
    variant: "destructive",
  });
  // EULA expiry requires re-acceptance — redirect to Home after a brief delay.
  if (code === "eula_required" && navigate) {
    setTimeout(() => navigate("/"), 1000);
  }
}

// Run an async action with an optimistic state update that rolls back on error.
//
//   await optimisticAction({
//     currentState: me,            // the value before the action
//     setState: setMe,            // setter for that value
//     optimisticPatch: { ... },   // applied immediately for instant feedback
//     apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("buySkin", { ... }),
//     onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, ...data }),  // server-confirmed merge
//     t, navigate,                // for error toasts / EULA redirect
//   });
//
// Returns the server response data on success, or null on error (after rollback + toast).
export async function optimisticAction({ currentState, setState, optimisticPatch, apiCall, onSuccess, t, navigate }) {
  const original = currentState;
  setState({ ...original, ...optimisticPatch });
  try {
    const res = await apiCall();
    const data = res?.data ?? res;
    if (data?.success === false || data?.error) {
      setState(original);
      showErrorToast(data, t, navigate);
      return null;
    }
    if (onSuccess) {
      setState(onSuccess(original, data));
    }
    return data;
  } catch (error) {
    setState(original);
    showErrorToast(error, t, navigate);
    return null;
  }
}

// Tracks which cards the user has already seen in the Collection, via localStorage.
// Cards unlocked from crates get a "NEW" badge until the user views that tab.

export function getSeenCards(userId) {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(`seen_cards_${userId}`);
    return new Set(raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []);
  } catch {
    return new Set();
  }
}

export function markCardsSeen(userId, cardIds) {
  try {
    const seen = getSeenCards(userId);
    cardIds.forEach((id) => seen.add(id));
    localStorage.setItem(`seen_cards_${userId}`, JSON.stringify([...seen]));
  } catch {}
}

export function getNewCardIds(userId, cardIds) {
  const seen = getSeenCards(userId);
  return cardIds.filter((id) => !seen.has(id));
}

import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { toast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { computeFingerprint } from "@/lib/deviceFingerprint";

const MERGE_KEY = "pending_google_merge_blob";

// Stash the local profile as a server-signed HMAC blob before the Google
// OAuth redirect. The blob is signed by createProfileSnapshot using
// PROFILE_SNAPSHOT_SECRET — a player cannot tamper with it.
export async function stashLocalProfile(me) {
  if (!me) return;
  try {
    const fingerprint = computeFingerprint();
    const res = await base44.functions.invoke("createProfileSnapshot", { fingerprint });
    if (res.data?.blob) {
      localStorage.setItem(MERGE_KEY, res.data.blob);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // If the signed stash fails, we proceed without it — the player can still
    // link Google, they just won't carry over anonymous progress.
  }
}

function getPendingMergeBlob() {
  try {
    return localStorage.getItem(MERGE_KEY);
  } catch { return null; }
}

function clearPendingMerge() {
  localStorage.removeItem(MERGE_KEY);
}

// Called after the Google redirect re-authenticates the app. If a signed blob
// was stashed, the backend verifies the HMAC signature and applies the
// profile to the fresh Google account server-side. Returns true when a merge
// happened so the caller can re-fetch the user object.
export async function consumePendingMerge(me) {
  const blob = getPendingMergeBlob();
  if (!blob) return false;
  clearPendingMerge();
  try {
    const fingerprint = computeFingerprint();
    const res = await base44.functions.invoke("consumeMerge", { blob, fingerprint });
    const r = res.data;
    if (r?.merged) {
      toast({ title: "Google linked!", description: "Your progress has been carried over." });
      return true;
    }
    if (r?.reason === "existing_account") {
      toast({ title: "Switched to your Google account", description: "Your previous local progress was not carried over." });
      return false;
    }
    return false;
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

// Frontend tracking helpers for admin economy stats.
// Stamps daily logins and accumulates spent counters on the user profile.

export function todayStr() {
  return new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

// Returns an updateMe patch to stamp today's login, or null if already stamped.
export function stampLogin(user) {
  const today = todayStr();
  const days = Array.isArray(user?.login_days) ? user.login_days : [];
  if (days.includes(today)) return null;
  return { login_days: [...days, today] };
}

// Returns an updateMe patch incrementing the given currency's lifetime spent counter.
export function spendDelta(user, currency, amount) {
  if (!amount || amount <= 0) return {};
  const key = `${currency}_spent`;
  return { [key]: (user?.[key] || 0) + amount };
}

// Client-side device fingerprint generation.
// Collects stable signals that identify a device without being unique enough
// to track across devices. Used for secure profile snapshot restoration.

function hashString(str) {
  let hash = 0x811c9dc5; // FNV-1a 32-bit offset basis
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    hash ^= str.charCodeAt(i);
    hash = Math.imul(hash, 0x01000193); // FNV-1a prime
  }
  return (hash >>> 0).toString(16);
}

function computeCanvasHash() {
  try {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width = 200;
    canvas.height = 50;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    if (!ctx) return 'no-canvas';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
    ctx.font = '14px Arial';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f60';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, 200, 50);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#069';
    ctx.fillText('Splitter Orbs fingerprint', 2, 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(102, 204, 0, 0.7)';
    ctx.fillText('Splitter Orbs fingerprint', 4, 4);
    return hashString(canvas.toDataURL());
  } catch {
    return 'canvas-error';
  }
}

export function computeFingerprint() {
  return {
    screenWidth: window.screen.width,
    screenHeight: window.screen.height,
    colorDepth: window.screen.colorDepth,
    hardwareConcurrency: navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 0,
    maxTouchPoints: navigator.maxTouchPoints || 0,
    timezone: Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '',
    canvasHash: computeCanvasHash(),
  };
}

FILE: src/lib/profileSnapshot.js
========================================
// Client-side profile snapshot manager.
// Saves a signed snapshot when the app is backgrounded/closed, and
// auto-restores it when a new anonymous session is detected.

import { base44 } from '@/api/base44Client';
import { computeFingerprint } from '@/lib/deviceFingerprint';

const SNAPSHOT_KEY = 'profile_snapshot_blob';

// Save a signed snapshot to the backend + localStorage.
// Called on app background/close.
export function saveSnapshot() {
  try {
    const fingerprint = computeFingerprint();
    base44.functions.invoke('createProfileSnapshot', { fingerprint }).then((res) => {
      if (res.data?.blob) {
        localStorage.setItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY, res.data.blob);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  } catch {}
}

// Set up listeners that save a snapshot when the app is backgrounded or closed.
export function setupSnapshotListeners() {
  const visibilityHandler = () => {
    if (document.hidden) saveSnapshot();
  };
  const pageHideHandler = () => saveSnapshot();
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', visibilityHandler);
  window.addEventListener('pagehide', pageHideHandler);
  return () => {
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', visibilityHandler);
    window.removeEventListener('pagehide', pageHideHandler);
  };
}

// Attempt to restore a stored snapshot. Returns true on success.
export async function tryRestoreSnapshot() {
  try {
    const blob = localStorage.getItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    if (!blob) return false;
    const fingerprint = computeFingerprint();
    const res = await base44.functions.invoke('restoreProfileSnapshot', { blob, fingerprint });
    if (res.data?.restored) {
      localStorage.removeItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
      return true;
    }
    // Restore failed (tampered, already used, activity gate, fingerprint mismatch).
    // Discard the blob and proceed as a new user.
    localStorage.removeItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    return false;
  } catch {
    localStorage.removeItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
    return false;
  }
}

export function hasStoredSnapshot() {
  try {
    return !!localStorage.getItem(SNAPSHOT_KEY);
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

  { code: 'el', label: 'Ελληνικά', flag: '🇬🇷' },

// Launch languages — only these appear in the language selector.
// All 20 locale files remain imported so hidden languages can be re-enabled later.
export const LANGS_LAUNCH = [
  { code: 'en', label: 'English', flag: '🇬🇧' },
  { code: 'de', label: 'Deutsch', flag: '🇩🇪' },
  { code: 'es', label: 'Español', flag: '🇪🇸' },
  { code: 'fr', label: 'Français', flag: '🇫🇷' },
  { code: 'nl', label: 'Nederlands', flag: '🇳🇱' },
  { code: 'ja', label: '日本語', flag: '🇯🇵' },
  { code: 'it', label: 'Italiano', flag: '🇮🇹' },
  { code: 'pt', label: 'Português', flag: '🇵🇹' },
];

// Preserve the context object across HMR updates so hot-reloaded consumers
// still see the same context the already-mounted Provider is providing.
let LanguageContext;
if (import.meta.hot && import.meta.hot.data.LanguageContext) {
  LanguageContext = import.meta.hot.data.LanguageContext;
} else {
  LanguageContext = createContext();
}
if (import.meta.hot) {
  import.meta.hot.dispose((data) => { data.LanguageContext = LanguageContext; });
}

export function LanguageProvider({ children }) {
  const [lang, setLangState] = useState('en');

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('so_lang');
    if (saved && LOCALES[saved]) setLangState(saved);
    base44.auth.me().then((me) => {
      if (me?.language && LOCALES[me.language]) {
        setLangState(me.language);
        localStorage.setItem('so_lang', me.language);
      }
    }).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    document.documentElement.dir = lang === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
  }, [lang]);

  const setLang = useCallback((newLang) => {
    setLangState(newLang);
    localStorage.setItem('so_lang', newLang);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ language: newLang }).catch(() => {});
  }, []);

  const t = useCallback((key, params) => {
    let str = LOCALES[lang];
    for (const k of key.split('.')) {
      str = str?.[k];
      if (str === undefined) break;
    }
    if (typeof str !== 'string') {
      str = en;
      for (const k of key.split('.')) str = str?.[k];
      if (typeof str !== 'string') return key;
    }
    if (params) {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
        str = str.replace(new RegExp(`\\{${k}\\}`, 'g'), v);
      }
    }
    return str;
  }, [lang]);

  return (
    <LanguageContext.Provider value={{ lang, setLang, t, LANGS, LANGS_LAUNCH }}>
      {children}
    </LanguageContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTranslation() {
  const ctx = useContext(LanguageContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTranslation must be used within LanguageProvider');
  return ctx;
}

FILE: src/hooks/useImmersive.js
========================================
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

// Enter fullscreen on the first user gesture to hide the OS status bar
// (WiFi/clock) on Android. Guarded by feature detection; rejections ignored.
export function useImmersiveEntry() {
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = document.documentElement;
    const req = el.requestFullscreen || el.webkitRequestFullscreen;
    if (!req) return;
    let entered = false;
    const handler = () => {
      if (entered) return;
      entered = true;
      try {
        const r = req.call(el);
        if (r && typeof r.catch === "function") r.catch(() => {});
      } catch (e) {}
      window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handler, true);
    };
    window.addEventListener("pointerdown", handler, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("pointerdown", handler, true);
  }, []);
}

// Whether the app is currently in fullscreen — used to decide if safe-area
// padding is still needed as a fallback.
export function useImmersive() {
  const [active, setActive] = useState(
    () => !!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement)
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    const on = () =>
      setActive(!!(document.fullscreenElement || document.webkitFullscreenElement));
    document.addEventListener("fullscreenchange", on);
    document.addEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange", on);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("fullscreenchange", on);
      document.removeEventListener("webkitfullscreenchange", on);
    };
  }, []);
  return active;
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-size.jsx

import * as React from "react"

export function useSize(ref) {
  const [size, setSize] = React.useState(null)

  // useLayoutEffect (not useEffect): the initial measurement must land before
  // the browser paints, so consumers can render their real content on the
  // very first painted frame instead of a guess. A ResizeObserver's first
  // callback arrives too late for that — by then an <img> src guess has
  // already been dispatched to the network.
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const element = ref.current
    if (!element) return

    const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect()
    setSize({ width: rect.width, height: rect.height })

    const observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      const { width, height } = entry.contentRect
      setSize({ width, height })
    })

    observer.observe(element)
    return () => observer.disconnect()
  }, [ref])

  return size
}

FILE: src/hooks/useBackButton.js
========================================
import { useEffect } from "react";

// Reusable Android hardware-back / popstate guard for sub-screens.
// On mount it pushes a sentinel history entry; when the user presses back,
// we intercept the popstate and navigate to `fallback` instead of leaving the app.
//
// Usage: useBackButton(() => navigate("/"))  — call inside a component.
export default function useBackButton(onBack, enabled = true) {
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    // Seed a history entry we own so popstate fires on the first back press.
    window.history.pushState({ soBackGuard: true }, "", window.location.href);

    const handler = (e) => {
      // Prevent the default back-exit by pushing our sentinel again and
      // delegating to the caller's navigation.
      window.history.pushState({ soBackGuard: true }, "", window.location.href);
      if (typeof onBack === "function") onBack();
    };
    window.addEventListener("popstate", handler);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener("popstate", handler);
    };
  }, [onBack, enabled]);
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.jsx

import * as React from "react"

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState(undefined)

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`)
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    }
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange)
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT)
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, [])

  return !!isMobile
}

import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";

const CURRENCIES = [
  { id: "coins", label: "Münzen", icon: <CoinIcon size={16} />, color: "amber" },
  { id: "gems", label: "Edelsteine", icon: <GemIcon size={16} />, color: "cyan" },

  { id: "trophies", label: "Trophäen", icon: <span className="text-base">🏆</span>, color: "amber" },
];

export default function Admin() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Grant form state
  const [username, setUsername] = useState("");
  const [currency, setCurrency] = useState("coins");
  const [amount, setAmount] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("stats");
  const [reports, setReports] = useState([]);
  const [reportsLoading, setReportsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [versionMin, setVersionMin] = useState("");
  const [versionLatest, setVersionLatest] = useState("");
  const [versionBusy, setVersionBusy] = useState(false);
  const [versionResult, setVersionResult] = useState(null);
  // Moderation state
  const [banUsername, setBanUsername] = useState("");
  const [banReason, setBanReason] = useState("");
  const [banUnit, setBanUnit] = useState("days");
  const [banValue, setBanValue] = useState("");
  const [banPermanent, setBanPermanent] = useState(false);
  const [banBusy, setBanBusy] = useState(false);
  const [banResult, setBanResult] = useState(null);
  const [bannedUsers, setBannedUsers] = useState([]);
  const [bannedLoading, setBannedLoading] = useState(false);
  const [resetBusy, setResetBusy] = useState(false);
  const [showResetConfirm, setShowResetConfirm] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user === null) return;
    if (user.role !== "admin") { navigate("/", { replace: true }); return; }
    loadStats();
    loadVersionInfo();
  }, [user]);

  const loadStats = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const users = await base44.entities.User.list("-created_date", 500);
      const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      const dailyLogins = users.filter((u) =>
        Array.isArray(u.login_days) && u.login_days.includes(today)
      ).length;
      const totalSeconds = users.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.total_seconds_played || 0), 0);
      const coinsSpent = users.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.coins_spent || 0), 0);
      const gemsSpent = users.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.gems_spent || 0), 0);
      const shardsSpent = users.reduce((s, u) => s + (u.shards_spent || 0), 0);
      const googleConnected = users.filter((u) => u.google_linked === true).length;
      const bannedCount = users.filter((u) => u.banned === true).length;
      const crates = users.reduce(
        (acc, u) => {
          const c = u.crates_opened || {};
          acc.free += c.free || 0;
          acc.gem += c.gem || 0;
          acc.shard += c.shard || 0;
          acc.purchased += c.purchased || 0;
          return acc;
        },
        { free: 0, gem: 0, shard: 0, purchased: 0 }
      );
      setStats({
        totalUsers: users.length,
        dailyLogins,
        hoursPlayed: (totalSeconds / 3600).toFixed(1),
        coinsSpent,
        gemsSpent,
        shardsSpent,
        googleConnected,
        bannedCount,
        crates,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      setStats({ error: true });
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const loadReports = async () => {
    setReportsLoading(true);
    try {
      const rpts = await base44.entities.UserReport.list("-created_date", 100);
      setReports(rpts);
    } catch (e) {
      setReports([]);
    }
    setReportsLoading(false);
  };

  const updateReportStatus = async (id, status) => {
    try {
      await base44.entities.UserReport.update(id, { status });
      setReports((rpts) => rpts.map((r) => (r.id === id ? { ...r, status } : r)));
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const loadVersionInfo = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("getVersionInfo", {});
      const r = res.data || res;
      setVersionMin(r.min_required_version || "1.0.0");
      setVersionLatest(r.latest_version || "1.0.0");
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  };

  const handleSaveVersion = async () => {
    if (versionBusy || !versionMin.trim() || !versionLatest.trim()) return;
    setVersionBusy(true);
    setVersionResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("setVersionInfo", {
        min_required_version: versionMin.trim(),
        latest_version: versionLatest.trim(),
      });
      const r = res.data || res;
      if (r?.min_required_version) {
        setVersionResult({ type: "success", msg: `Gespeichert: min ${r.min_required_version}, latest ${r.latest_version}` });
      } else {
        setVersionResult({ type: "error", msg: "Fehler beim Speichern" });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setVersionResult({ type: "error", msg: "Fehler beim Speichern" });
    }
    setVersionBusy(false);
  };

  const loadBannedUsers = async () => {
    setBannedLoading(true);
    try {
      const users = await base44.entities.User.list("-created_date", 500);
      setBannedUsers(users.filter((u) => u.banned === true));
    } catch (e) {
      setBannedUsers([]);
    }
    setBannedLoading(false);
  };

  const handleBan = async () => {
    if (banBusy || !banUsername.trim() || !banReason.trim()) return;
    if (!banPermanent && (!banValue || Number(banValue) <= 0)) return;
    setBanBusy(true);
    setBanResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("banUser", {
        username: banUsername.trim(),
        reason: banReason.trim(),
        permanent: banPermanent,
        durationValue: Number(banValue) || 0,
        durationUnit: banUnit,
      });
      const r = res.data || res;
      if (r?.success) {
        setBanResult({ type: "success", msg: `${r.target_name} gesperrt (${r.duration_label})` });
        setBanUsername(""); setBanReason(""); setBanValue("");
        setBanPermanent(false); setBanUnit("days");
        loadBannedUsers();
        loadStats();
      } else {
        const code = r?.error || "error";
        const msg = code === "user_not_found" ? "Spieler nicht gefunden"
          : code === "cannot_ban_admin" ? "Admins können nicht gesperrt werden"
          : code === "self" ? "Du kannst dich nicht selbst sperren"
          : code === "Forbidden" ? "Keine Admin-Berechtigung"
          : code === "reason required" ? "Grund erforderlich"
          : code === "invalid duration" ? "Ungültige Dauer"
          : "Fehler beim Sperren";
        setBanResult({ type: "error", msg });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setBanResult({ type: "error", msg: "Fehler beim Sperren" });
    }
    setBanBusy(false);
  };

  const handleUnban = async (username) => {
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("unbanUser", { username });
      const r = res.data || res;
      if (r?.success) {
        loadBannedUsers();
        loadStats();
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  };

  const handleGrant = async () => {
    if (busy || !username.trim() || !amount) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setResult(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("grantCurrency", {
        username: username.trim(),
        currency,
        amount: Number(amount),
      });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success) {
        setResult({ type: "success", msg: `${r.amount > 0 ? "+" : ""}${r.amount} ${r.currency} → ${r.username} (neu: ${r.newBalance})` });
        setUsername(""); setAmount("");
      } else {
        const code = r?.error || "error";
        const msg = code === "user_not_found" ? "Spieler nicht gefunden"
          : code === "Forbidden" ? "Keine Admin-Berechtigung"
          : code === "invalid_input" ? "Ungültige Eingabe"
          : "Fehler";
        setResult({ type: "error", msg });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setResult({ type: "error", msg: "Fehler" });
    }
    setBusy(false);
  };

  const handleResetOnboarding = async () => {
    if (resetBusy) return;
    setResetBusy(true);
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("resetOwnAccountForOnboardingTest", {});
      window.location.href = "/";
    } catch (e) {
      setResetBusy(false);
    }
  };

  if (!user || user.role !== "admin") {
    return <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center text-slate-400 text-sm">…</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pt-8 pb-16">
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">Admin</h1>
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700">
            ← Start
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Tab bar */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 mb-6">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("stats")}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${tab === "stats" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500"}`}
          >
            Statistiken
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setTab("reports"); if (reports.length === 0) loadReports(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${tab === "reports" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500"}`}
          >
            Meldungen
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => { setTab("mod"); if (bannedUsers.length === 0) loadBannedUsers(); }}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${tab === "mod" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500"}`}
          >
            Moderation
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === "stats" && (
        <>
        {/* Stats */}
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Statistiken</h2>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {[0,1,2,3,4].map((i) => <div key={i} className="h-24 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-100 animate-pulse" />)}
          </div>
        ) : stats?.error ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-rose-500 font-bold">Statistiken konnten nicht geladen werden.</p>
        ) : (
          <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-8">
            <StatCard label="Spieler gesamt" value={stats.totalUsers} icon="👥" />
            <StatCard label="Logins heute" value={stats.dailyLogins} icon="📅" />
            <StatCard label="Spielstunden" value={stats.hoursPlayed} icon="⏱️" />
            <StatCard label="Münzen ausgegeben" value={stats.coinsSpent} icon={<CoinIcon size={18} />} />
            <StatCard label="Edelsteine ausgegeben" value={stats.gemsSpent} icon={<GemIcon size={18} />} />
            <StatCard label="Splitter ausgegeben" value={stats.shardsSpent} icon={<ShardIcon size={18} />} />
            <StatCard label="Google verbunden" value={stats.googleConnected} icon="🔗" />
            <StatCard label="Gesperrt" value={stats.bannedCount} icon="🚫" />
          </div>
          <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 mb-8">
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">📦 Kisten geöffnet</p>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 text-center">
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 tabular-nums">{stats.crates.free}</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold">Gratis</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 tabular-nums">{stats.crates.gem}</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold">Edelstein</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 tabular-nums">{stats.crates.shard}</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold">Splitter</div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 tabular-nums">{stats.crates.purchased}</div>
                <div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold">Gekauft</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Grant panel */}
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Währung vergeben</h2>
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Benutzername</label>
            <input
              value={username}
              onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Spielername eingeben"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Währung</label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2">
              {CURRENCIES.map((c) => (
                <button
                  key={c.id}
                  onClick={() => setCurrency(c.id)}
                  className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-0.5 py-2 rounded-xl border-2 text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    currency === c.id ? "border-slate-900 bg-slate-900 text-white" : "border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:border-slate-300"
                  }`}
                >
                  {c.icon}
                  <span className="text-[10px]">{c.label}</span>
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Menge (negativ für Abzug)</label>
            <input
              type="number"
              value={amount}
              onChange={(e) => setAmount(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="z.B. 1000"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleGrant}
            disabled={busy || !username.trim() || !amount}
            className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
              busy || !username.trim() || !amount
                ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-700"
            }`}
          >
            {busy ? "…" : "Vergeben"}
          </button>
          {result && (
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold animate-pop-in ${
              result.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-600" : "bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-500"
            }`}>
              {result.msg}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Version Gate */}
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Version Gate</h2>
        <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 space-y-4">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Spieler unter „Min. Required" müssen updaten. Spieler unter „Latest" sehen einen Hinweis.</p>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Min. Required Version</label>
            <input
              value={versionMin}
              onChange={(e) => setVersionMin(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="1.0.0"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Latest Version</label>
            <input
              value={versionLatest}
              onChange={(e) => setVersionLatest(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="1.0.0"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
            />
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={handleSaveVersion}
            disabled={versionBusy || !versionMin.trim() || !versionLatest.trim()}
            className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
              versionBusy || !versionMin.trim() || !versionLatest.trim()
                ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-700"
            }`}
          >
            {versionBusy ? "…" : "Speichern"}
          </button>
          {versionResult && (
            <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold animate-pop-in ${
              versionResult.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-600" : "bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-500"
            }`}>
              {versionResult.msg}
            </div>
          )}
          </div>

          {/* Screenshot tool */}
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Play Store</h2>
          <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 space-y-3 mb-8">
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Erstelle Play Store-Screenshots aus echten App-Captures (1080×1920, EN/DE).</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/screenshot-tool")}
              className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold text-sm hover:bg-slate-700"
            >
              Screenshot-Tool öffnen
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Onboarding test */}
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Onboarding-Test</h2>
          <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 space-y-3 mb-8">
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">Setzt dein eigenes Konto auf den Neustand zurück, um den kompletten Onboarding- + EULA- + Alters-Flow zu testen.</p>
          <button
            onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(true)}
            disabled={resetBusy}
            className="w-full py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold text-sm hover:bg-amber-600 disabled:opacity-40"
          >
            {resetBusy ? "…" : "Konto zurücksetzen (Onboarding-Test)"}
          </button>
          </div>
          </>
          )}

        {tab === "reports" && (
          <ReportsSection
            reports={reports}
            loading={reportsLoading}
            onRefresh={loadReports}
            onUpdateStatus={updateReportStatus}
          />
        )}

        {tab === "mod" && (
          <ModerationSection
            bannedUsers={bannedUsers}
            bannedLoading={bannedLoading}
            onRefresh={loadBannedUsers}
            onBan={handleBan}
            onUnban={handleUnban}
            banUsername={banUsername} setBanUsername={setBanUsername}
            banReason={banReason} setBanReason={setBanReason}
            banUnit={banUnit} setBanUnit={setBanUnit}
            banValue={banValue} setBanValue={setBanValue}
            banPermanent={banPermanent} setBanPermanent={setBanPermanent}
            banBusy={banBusy}
            banResult={banResult}
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {showResetConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <RotateCcw className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">Konto zurücksetzen?</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">Dies löscht all deinen Fortschritt, Münzen, Karten und Skins und startet das Onboarding neu. Nicht rückgängig zu machen.</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button onClick={() => setShowResetConfirm(false)} disabled={resetBusy} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 disabled:opacity-40">
                Abbrechen
              </button>
              <button onClick={handleResetOnboarding} disabled={resetBusy} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold hover:bg-amber-600 disabled:opacity-40">
                {resetBusy ? "…" : "Zurücksetzen"}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

const REPORT_CATEGORIES = {
  harassment: "Belästigung",
  cheating: "Betrug",
  inappropriate_name: "Unangemessener Name",
  spam: "Spam",
  other: "Sonstiges",
};

const STATUS_LABELS = {
  pending: "Offen",
  reviewed: "Bearbeitet",
  dismissed: "Abgewiesen",
};

function ReportsSection({ reports, loading, onRefresh, onUpdateStatus }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Meldungen</h2>
        <button onClick={onRefresh} className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700">
          ↻ Aktualisieren
        </button>
      </div>
      {loading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0,1,2].map((i) => <div key={i} className="h-20 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-100 animate-pulse" />)}
        </div>
      ) : reports.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Keine Meldungen</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {reports.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.id} className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm truncate">
                    Gemeldet: <span className="text-slate-900">{r.reported_name}</span>
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 truncate">ID: {r.reported_id}</p>
                </div>
                <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold ${
                  r.status === "pending" ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-600" :
                  r.status === "reviewed" ? "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600" :
                  "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
                }`}>
                  {STATUS_LABELS[r.status] || r.status}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[11px] font-bold">
                  {REPORT_CATEGORIES[r.category] || r.category}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">
                  {new Date(r.created_date).toLocaleString("de-DE")}
                </span>
              </div>
              {r.description && (
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-2 mb-2">{r.description}</p>
              )}
              {r.status === "pending" && (
                <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-2">
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onUpdateStatus(r.id, "reviewed")}
                    className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-emerald-600"
                  >
                    Bearbeitet
                  </button>
                  <button
                    onClick={() => onUpdateStatus(r.id, "dismissed")}
                    className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200"
                  >
                    Abweisen
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value, icon }) {
  return (
    <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
      <div className="text-xl mb-1">{icon}</div>
      <div className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 tabular-nums">{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

function ModerationSection({
  bannedUsers, bannedLoading, onRefresh, onBan, onUnban,
  banUsername, setBanUsername, banReason, setBanReason,
  banUnit, setBanUnit, banValue, setBanValue,
  banPermanent, setBanPermanent, banBusy, banResult,
}) {
  const canBan = banUsername.trim() && banReason.trim() && (banPermanent || (banValue && Number(banValue) > 0)) && !banBusy;
  return (
    <div>
      {/* Ban form */}
      <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-3">Spieler sperren</h2>
      <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 space-y-4 mb-6">
        <div>
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Benutzername</label>
          <input
            value={banUsername}
            onChange={(e) => setBanUsername(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Spielername eingeben"
            className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
          />
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Dauer</label>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 mb-2">
            {[
              { id: "hours", label: "Stunden" },
              { id: "days", label: "Tage" },
              { id: "weeks", label: "Wochen" },
              { id: "permanent", label: "Dauerhaft" },
            ].map((u) => (
              <button
                key={u.id}
                onClick={() => {
                  if (u.id === "permanent") { setBanPermanent(true); }
                  else { setBanPermanent(false); setBanUnit(u.id); }
                }}
                className={`py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                  (u.id === "permanent" && banPermanent) || (u.id !== "permanent" && !banPermanent && banUnit === u.id)
                    ? "bg-slate-900 text-white"
                    : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200"
                }`}
              >
                {u.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          {!banPermanent && (
            <input
              type="number"
              value={banValue}
              onChange={(e) => setBanValue(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Anzahl"
              min="1"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
            />
          )}
        </div>
        <div>
          <label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1 block">Grund</label>
          <textarea
            value={banReason}
            onChange={(e) => setBanReason(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Grund der Sperre (wird dem Spieler angezeigt)"
            maxLength={500}
            rows={3}
            className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 resize-none"
          />
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={onBan}
          disabled={!canBan}
          className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
            canBan ? "bg-rose-500 text-white hover:bg-rose-600" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
          }`}
        >
          {banBusy ? "…" : "Sperren"}
        </button>
        {banResult && (
          <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold animate-pop-in ${
            banResult.type === "success" ? "bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-600" : "bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-500"
          }`}>
            {banResult.msg}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Active bans list */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Aktive Sperren</h2>
        <button onClick={onRefresh} className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-700">
          ↻ Aktualisieren
        </button>
      </div>
      {bannedLoading ? (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0,1,2].map((i) => <div key={i} className="h-20 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-100 animate-pulse" />)}
        </div>
      ) : bannedUsers.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 text-center">
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">Keine aktiven Sperren</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {bannedUsers.map((u) => {
            const isPermanent = !u.ban_until;
            const expiry = isPermanent
              ? "Dauerhaft"
              : new Date(u.ban_until).toLocaleDateString("de-DE", { day: "2-digit", month: "short", year: "numeric", hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
            return (
              <div key={u.id} className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm truncate">{u.display_name}</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">Bis: {expiry}</p>
                  </div>
                  <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-600">
                    {isPermanent ? "Dauerhaft" : "Befristet"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                {u.ban_reason && (
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg p-2 mb-2">{u.ban_reason}</p>
                )}
                <button
                  onClick={() => onUnban(u.display_name)}
                  className="w-full py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-emerald-600"
                >
                  Entsperren
                </button>
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { ACHIEVEMENTS } from "@/game/achievements";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";

export default function Achievements() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => {
      setMe(m);
    }).catch(() => setMe({}));
  }, []);

  const unlocked = me?.achievements || [];
  const newIds = me?.new_achievements || [];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pt-10 pb-24">
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("achievements.title")}</h1>
          <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-600 font-bold text-sm">
            {unlocked.length}/{ACHIEVEMENTS.length}
          </span>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-6 text-center">{t("achievements.subtitle")}</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {ACHIEVEMENTS.map((ach) => {
            const isUnlocked = unlocked.includes(ach.id);
            const isNew = newIds.includes(ach.id);
            return <AchievementCard key={ach.id} ach={ach} unlocked={isUnlocked} isNew={isNew} t={t} />;
          })}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AchievementCard({ ach, unlocked, isNew, t }) {
  return (
    <div className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all ${unlocked ? "border-amber-300 bg-white shadow-sm" : "border-slate-200 bg-white opacity-60"}`}>
      {isNew && (
        <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 px-1.5 h-5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center font-black animate-pop-in">
          NEW
        </span>
      )}
      {unlocked && <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 text-emerald-500 text-base">✓</span>}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center pt-2">
        <div className={`text-4xl mb-2 ${unlocked ? "" : "grayscale opacity-40"}`}>{ach.icon}</div>
        <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800 leading-tight mb-1">{t(`achievements.${ach.id}.name`)}</h3>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 leading-snug mb-2 min-h-[28px]">{t(`achievements.${ach.id}.desc`)}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          {ach.reward.coins > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500">🪙 {ach.reward.coins}</span>
          )}
          {ach.reward.shards > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-violet-500">💎 {ach.reward.shards}</span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Login.jsx
========================================
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { LogIn, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";
import { isNativeWebView } from "@/lib/isNativeWebView";

export default function Login() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  // Post-login destination (e.g. the MCP OAuth consent page sends users here
  // with returnTo so the grant flow can resume). Same-origin paths only.
  const returnTo = safeReturnTo();
  const inWebView = isNativeWebView();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.loginViaEmailPassword(email, password);
      window.location.href = returnTo;
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid email or password");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", returnTo);
  };

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={LogIn}
      title="Welcome back"
      subtitle="Log in to your account"
      footer={
        <>
          Don't have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/register" + (returnTo !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(returnTo) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Create one
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      {!inWebView && (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
            onClick={handleGoogle}
          >
            <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
            Continue with Google
          </Button>

          <div className="relative mb-6">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
              <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
              <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
            <Link to="/forgot-password" className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline">
              Forgot password?
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="current-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Logging in...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Log in"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Home.jsx
========================================
import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import LeagueBadge from "@/components/LeagueBadge";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import OnboardingOverlay from "@/components/OnboardingOverlay";
import DailyMissions from "@/components/DailyMissions";
import MatchHistory from "@/components/MatchHistory";
import { Settings as SettingsIcon, Users } from "lucide-react";
import { syncFromProfile } from "@/game/sound";
import GoogleLinkDialog from "@/components/GoogleLinkDialog";
import EulaAcceptanceOverlay from "@/components/EulaAcceptanceOverlay";
import BetaWelcomePopup from "@/components/BetaWelcomePopup";
import { CURRENT_EULA_VERSION } from "@/lib/eulaVersion";
import WelcomeScreen from "@/components/WelcomeScreen";

export default function Home() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [showOnboarding, setShowOnboarding] = useState(false);
  const [showEula, setShowEula] = useState(false);
  const [showGoogleDialog, setShowGoogleDialog] = useState(false);
  const [showBetaWelcome, setShowBetaWelcome] = useState(false);
  const [googleBannerDismissed, setGoogleBannerDismissed] = useState(
    () => localStorage.getItem("google_banner_dismissed") === "true"
  );
  const [activeSession, setActiveSession] = useState(null);
  const logoTapsRef = useRef(0);
  const logoTimerRef = useRef(null);

  const handleLogoTap = () => {
    logoTapsRef.current += 1;
    if (logoTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(logoTimerRef.current);
    if (logoTapsRef.current >= 5) {
      logoTapsRef.current = 0;
      navigate("/admin");
      return;
    }
    logoTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => { logoTapsRef.current = 0; }, 1500);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => {
      setMe(m);
      syncFromProfile(m);
      // Session-persistent flags: onboarding and tutorial completion both
      // persist server-side, but me() can return a stale read after returning
      // from the tutorial. These flags guard every Home mount within the
      // session so the modals/redirect don't re-fire on a stale read. A fresh
      // app launch re-fetches me() and reads the persisted server values.
      let justOnboarded = false;
      let justCompletedTutorial = false;
      try { justOnboarded = sessionStorage.getItem("onboarding_completed") === "1"; } catch (e) {}
      try { justCompletedTutorial = sessionStorage.getItem("tutorial_completed") === "1"; } catch (e) {}
      // Onboarding (language + name) comes first, then the tutorial.
      const forceOnboarding = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("onboarding") === "1";
      if (m && (!m.onboarded || forceOnboarding) && !(justOnboarded && !forceOnboarding)) {
        setShowOnboarding(true);
        return;
      }
      // A just-onboarded player already accepted the EULA during onboarding,
      // so skip the standalone EULA re-check for the rest of the session.
      if (m && m.eula_accepted_version !== CURRENT_EULA_VERSION && !justOnboarded) {
        setShowEula(true);
        return;
      }
      if (m && !m.tutorial_done && !justCompletedTutorial) {
        navigate("/game?mode=tutorial", { replace: true });
        return;
      }
      if (m && m.beta_gift_gems && !m.beta_welcome_seen) {
        setShowBetaWelcome(true);
      }
      base44.functions.invoke("getActiveSession", {}).then((res) => {
        if (res.data?.active && res.data.sessionId) setActiveSession(res.data);
      }).catch(() => {});
    }).catch(() => setMe(null)).finally(() => setLoading(false));
  }, []);

  const winRate = me && (me.wins + me.losses) > 0
    ? Math.round((me.wins / (me.wins + me.losses)) * 100)
    : 0;
  const gamesPlayed = me ? (me.wins || 0) + (me.losses || 0) : 0;
  const showLeague = gamesPlayed >= 5;

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
        <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-2">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <div className="text-5xl mb-3 animate-float-bob">⚡</div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-black tracking-tighter mb-2">
              <span className="text-blue-500">SPLITTER</span>{" "}
              <span className="text-rose-500">ORBS</span>
            </h1>
            <div className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-3" />
            <div className="h-3 w-32 mx-auto rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => (
              <div key={i} className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-100">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-2" />
                <div className="w-12 h-6 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-1" />
                <div className="w-16 h-3 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!me) {
    return <WelcomeScreen />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 mb-2">
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/friends")} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all relative">
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/settings")} className="p-2 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all">
            <SettingsIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="text-center mb-8">
          {activeSession && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 border-2 border-amber-300 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 animate-pop-in">
              <div className="text-left">
                <p className="text-sm font-black text-amber-700">🎮 {t("game.rejoinTitle")}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-amber-600">vs {activeSession.opponent?.name || "Opponent"}</p>
              </div>
              <button
                onClick={() => navigate("/game")}
                className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 text-white text-sm font-black hover:bg-amber-600 transition-colors"
              >
                {t("game.rejoin")}
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="text-5xl mb-3 animate-float-bob select-none" onClick={handleLogoTap}>⚡</div>
          <h1 className="text-4xl font-black tracking-tighter mb-2">
            <span className="text-blue-500">SPLITTER</span>{" "}
            <span className="text-rose-500">ORBS</span>
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm mb-6 max-w-xs mx-auto">
            {t("home.tagline")}
          </p>
          {(me?.login_days?.length || 0) >= 30 && !googleBannerDismissed && (
            <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-50 border-2 border-indigo-200 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 animate-pop-in">
              <div className="text-left">
                <p className="text-sm font-black text-indigo-700">🔒 Secure your progress</p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-indigo-600">Connect Google to keep it forever</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowGoogleDialog(true)}
                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-black whitespace-nowrap hover:bg-indigo-600 transition-colors"
                >
                  Connect
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setGoogleBannerDismissed(true);
                    localStorage.setItem("google_banner_dismissed", "true");
                  }}
                  className="px-2 py-2 rounded-xl text-indigo-400 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-100 transition-colors"
                >
                  ✕
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/setup")}
            className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white text-lg font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-xl shadow-blue-500/30"
          >
            ⚔️ {t("home.playNow")}
          </button>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-3">{t("home.trainingHint")}</p>
        </div>

        {me && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-6">
            <LeagueBadge trophies={me.trophies || 0} size="lg" showLabel />
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <StatCard label={t("home.trophies")} value={me?.trophies || 0} icon="🏆" color="text-amber-500" />
          <StatCard label={t("home.winRate")} value={`${winRate}%`} icon="📊" color="text-blue-500" />
          <StatCard label={t("home.wins")} value={me?.wins || 0} icon="✅" color="text-emerald-500" />
          <StatCard label={t("home.losses")} value={me?.losses || 0} icon="❌" color="text-rose-500" />
        </div>

        {me && <DailyMissions me={me} />}
        {me && <MatchHistory me={me} />}
      </div>

      {showOnboarding && (
        <OnboardingOverlay me={me} onDone={() => {
          setShowOnboarding(false);
          setMe({ ...me, onboarded: true, eula_accepted_version: CURRENT_EULA_VERSION });
          // Session guard: prevents a stale me() read from re-showing the
          // onboarding modal after the tutorial completes.
          try { sessionStorage.setItem("onboarding_completed", "1"); } catch (e) {}
          if (!me?.tutorial_done) navigate("/game?mode=tutorial", { replace: true });
        }} />
      )}

      {showGoogleDialog && (
        <GoogleLinkDialog me={me} onClose={() => setShowGoogleDialog(false)} />
      )}

      {showEula && (
        <EulaAcceptanceOverlay onAccepted={() => {
          setShowEula(false);
          const updatedMe = { ...me, eula_accepted_version: CURRENT_EULA_VERSION };
          setMe(updatedMe);
          if (!updatedMe.tutorial_done) navigate("/game?mode=tutorial", { replace: true });
        }} />
      )}

      {showBetaWelcome && (
        <BetaWelcomePopup onClose={() => {
          setShowBetaWelcome(false);
          setMe((m) => ({ ...m, beta_welcome_seen: true }));
        }} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value, icon, color }) {
  return (
    <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
      <div className="text-2xl mb-1">{icon}</div>
      <div className={`text-2xl font-black ${color}`}>{value}</div>
      <div className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold">{label}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from "react";
import { Shield, FileText, Database, Lock, Users, Mail, Globe, ExternalLink } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import LegalBackButton from "@/components/LegalBackButton";

export default function PrivacyPolicy() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pt-6 pb-24">
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
          <LegalBackButton label={t("privacy.back")} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all" />

          </Section>

          <Section icon={Shield} title={t("privacy.s8Title")}>
            <p>{t("privacy.s8Body")}</p>
          </Section>

          <Section icon={FileText} title={t("privacy.s9Title")}>
            <p>{t("privacy.s9Body")}</p>
          </Section>

          <Section icon={Mail} title={t("privacy.s10Title")}>
            <p className="mb-2">{t("privacy.s10Body")}</p>

              {t("privacy.s10Link")} <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            </a>
          </Section>

          <Section icon={Globe} title={t("privacy.s11Title")}>
            <p>{t("privacy.s11Body")}</p>
          </Section>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function Section({ icon: Icon, title, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
        <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
        </div>
        <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{title}</h2>
      </div>
      <div className="text-sm text-slate-600 leading-relaxed space-y-1">
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Settings.jsx
