import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation, LANGS_LAUNCH } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import GoogleLinkDialog from "@/components/GoogleLinkDialog";
import { Globe, User, Shield, ArrowLeft, Check, Volume2, Vibrate, Trash2, FileText, Wrench, Users, GraduationCap, Download, Flag, X, Maximize } from "lucide-react";
import { sfx, setMuted, setSoundCategory, setHapticsIntensity, setAdvancedHaptics, syncFromProfile } from "@/game/sound";
import ReportUserDialog from "@/components/ReportUserDialog";
import AgeGateRecheck from "@/components/AgeGateRecheck";
import useBackButton from "@/hooks/useBackButton";

export default function Settings() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t, lang, setLang } = useTranslation();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [savedName, setSavedName] = useState(false);
  const [nameError, setNameError] = useState(null);
  const [nameBusy, setNameBusy] = useState(false);
  const [showGoogleDialog, setShowGoogleDialog] = useState(false);
  const [soundOn, setSoundOn] = useState(true);
  const [soundCats, setSoundCats] = useState({ clicks: true, explosions: true, fanfare: true });
  const [hapticsIntensity, setHapticsIntensityState] = useState("off");
  const [advancedHapticsOn, setAdvancedHapticsOn] = useState(false);
  const [towerMenuAnytime, setTowerMenuAnytime] = useState(false);
  const [fitToScreen, setFitToScreen] = useState(true);
  const [showMaximizeToggle, setShowMaximizeToggle] = useState(true);
  const [showDeleteDialog, setShowDeleteDialog] = useState(false);
  const [showRecheck, setShowRecheck] = useState(false);
  const [recheckSuccess, setRecheckSuccess] = useState(false);
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [deleteConfirmText, setDeleteConfirmText] = useState("");
  const [showNameConfirm, setShowNameConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [downloading, setDownloading] = useState(false);
  // Report-by-username flow
  const [showReportInput, setShowReportInput] = useState(false);
  const [reportUsername, setReportUsername] = useState("");
  const [reportPreview, setReportPreview] = useState(null);
  const [reportLooking, setReportLooking] = useState(false);
  const [reportTarget, setReportTarget] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => {
      setMe(m);
      setName(m?.display_name || m?.full_name || "Player");
      syncFromProfile(m);
      setSoundOn(m?.sound_enabled !== false);
      setSoundCats({
        clicks: m?.sound_categories?.clicks !== false,
        explosions: m?.sound_categories?.explosions !== false,
        fanfare: m?.sound_categories?.fanfare !== false,
      });
      setHapticsIntensityState(m?.haptics_intensity || (m?.haptics_enabled ? "medium" : "off"));
      setAdvancedHapticsOn(m?.advanced_haptics_enabled === true);
      setTowerMenuAnytime(m?.tower_menu_anytime === true);
      setFitToScreen(m?.fit_to_screen !== false);
      setShowMaximizeToggle(m?.show_maximize_toggle !== false);
    }).catch(() => setMe({}));
  }, []);

  const toggleSound = (val) => {
    setSoundOn(val);
    setMuted(val);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ sound_enabled: val }).catch(() => {});
    if (val) sfx.coin();
  };
  const changeHapticsIntensity = (level) => {
    setHapticsIntensityState(level);
    setHapticsIntensity(level);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ haptics_intensity: level }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const toggleSoundCategory = (name, val) => {
    setSoundCats((cur) => ({ ...cur, [name]: val }));
    setSoundCategory(name, val);
    const next = { ...soundCats, [name]: val };
    base44.auth.updateMe({ sound_categories: next }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const toggleAdvancedHaptics = (val) => {
    setAdvancedHapticsOn(val);
    setAdvancedHaptics(val);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ advanced_haptics_enabled: val }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const toggleTowerMenuAnytime = (val) => {
    setTowerMenuAnytime(val);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ tower_menu_anytime: val }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const toggleFitToScreen = (val) => {
    setFitToScreen(val);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ fit_to_screen: val }).catch(() => {});
  };
  const toggleShowMaximizeToggle = (val) => {
    setShowMaximizeToggle(val);
    base44.auth.updateMe({ show_maximize_toggle: val }).catch(() => {});
  };

  // Android back button: return to Home instead of exiting the app.
  useBackButton(() => navigate("/"));

  const handleDownloadData = async () => {
    setDownloading(true);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("exportUserData", {});
      const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(res.data, null, 2)], { type: "application/json" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `splitter-orbs-data-${new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]}.json`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (e) {}
    setDownloading(false);
  };

  const handleDeleteAccount = async () => {
    setDeleting(true);
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("deleteAccount", {});
      window.location.href = "/";
    } catch (e) {
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  const lookupReportTarget = async () => {
    if (!reportUsername.trim()) return;
    setReportLooking(true);
    setReportPreview(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("lookupUserByUsername", { username: reportUsername.trim() });
      const r = res.data || res;
      if (r?.found && !r?.isSelf) {
        setReportPreview({ id: r.id, name: r.display_name, trophies: r.trophies || 0 });
      } else if (r?.isSelf) {
        setReportPreview({ isSelf: true });
      } else {
        setReportPreview({ notFound: true });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setReportPreview({ notFound: true });
    }
    setReportLooking(false);
  };

  const openReportDialog = () => {
    if (!reportPreview?.id) return;
    setReportTarget({ id: reportPreview.id, name: reportPreview.name });
    setShowReportInput(false);
  };

  // Name change requires a confirmation dialog because it changes how friends find you.
  const requestSaveName = () => {
    if (!name.trim() || name.trim() === (me?.display_name || me?.full_name || "Player")) return;
    setShowNameConfirm(true);
  };

  const saveName = async () => {
    if (nameBusy || !name.trim()) return;
    setNameBusy(true);
    setNameError(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("setDisplayName", { name: name.trim() });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success) {
        setSavedName(true);
        setTimeout(() => setSavedName(false), 2000);
        setShowNameConfirm(false);
      } else if (r?.error === "name_taken") {
        setNameError("taken");
        setShowNameConfirm(false);
      } else if (r?.error === "name_inappropriate") {
        setNameError("inappropriate");
        setShowNameConfirm(false);
      } else {
        setNameError("error");
        setShowNameConfirm(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setNameError("error");
      setShowNameConfirm(false);
    }
    setNameBusy(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 1.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-6">
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600" />
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 text-sm">{t("settings.back")}</span>
          </button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("settings.title")}</h1>
        </div>

        {/* Profile section */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <User className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("settings.profile")}</h2>
          </div>
          <label className="text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold">{t("settings.displayName")}</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-1">
            <input
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => { setName(e.target.value); setNameError(null); }}
              className={`flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 ${nameError ? "border-rose-400 focus:border-rose-500" : "border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400"}`}
            />
            <button
              onClick={requestSaveName}
              disabled={nameBusy || !name.trim()}
              className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
            >
              {savedName ? <Check className="w-4 h-4" /> : nameBusy ? "…" : t("settings.save")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {nameError && (
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mt-1.5 animate-pop-in">
              {nameError === "taken" ? t("settings.nameTaken") : nameError === "inappropriate" ? t("settings.nameInappropriate") : t("settings.nameError")}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/friends")}
            className="mt-3 w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
          >
            <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("settings.friends")}</span>
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Language section */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Globe className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("settings.language")}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("settings.languageDesc")}</p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-4 min-[360px]:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
            {LANGS_LAUNCH.map((l) => (
              <button
                key={l.code}
                onClick={() => setLang(l.code)}
                className={`p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center gap-1 transition-all ${
                  lang === l.code
                    ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50 scale-105"
                    : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="text-xl">{l.flag}</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-700 leading-tight text-center">{l.label}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Sound & Haptics */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-purple-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Volume2 className="w-5 h-5 text-purple-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("settings.sound")}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("settings.soundDesc")}</p>
          <ToggleRow icon={Volume2} label={t("settings.sound")} value={soundOn} onChange={toggleSound} />
          {soundOn && (
            <div className="ml-6 mt-1 pl-3 border-l-2 border-slate-200 space-y-0.5">
              <ToggleRow icon={Volume2} label={t("settings.soundClicks")} value={soundCats.clicks} onChange={(v) => toggleSoundCategory("clicks", v)} />
              <ToggleRow icon={Volume2} label={t("settings.soundExplosions")} value={soundCats.explosions} onChange={(v) => toggleSoundCategory("explosions", v)} />
              <ToggleRow icon={Volume2} label={t("settings.soundFanfare")} value={soundCats.fanfare} onChange={(v) => toggleSoundCategory("fanfare", v)} />
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-2 mb-2">
              <Vibrate className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <p className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm">{t("settings.hapticsIntensity")}</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{t("settings.hapticsIntensityDesc")}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5 px-2">
              {["off", "low", "medium", "high"].map((lvl) => (
                <button
                  key={lvl}
                  onClick={() => changeHapticsIntensity(lvl)}
                  className={`py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                    hapticsIntensity === lvl
                      ? "bg-blue-500 text-white scale-[1.03]"
                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200"
                  }`}
                >
                  {t(`settings.haptic${lvl.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + lvl.slice(1)}`)}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          {hapticsIntensity !== "off" && (
            <div className="ml-6 mt-1 pl-3 border-l-2 border-slate-200">
              <ToggleRow icon={Vibrate} label={t("settings.advancedHaptics")} desc={t("settings.advancedHapticsDesc")} value={advancedHapticsOn} onChange={toggleAdvancedHaptics} />
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Gameplay */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Wrench className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("settings.gameplay")}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("settings.gameplayDesc")}</p>
          <ToggleRow icon={Wrench} label={t("settings.towerMenuAnytime")} desc={t("settings.towerMenuAnytimeDesc")} value={towerMenuAnytime} onChange={toggleTowerMenuAnytime} />
          <ToggleRow icon={Maximize} label={t("settings.fitToScreen")} desc={t("settings.fitToScreenDesc")} value={fitToScreen} onChange={toggleFitToScreen} />
          <ToggleRow icon={Maximize} label={t("settings.showMaximizeToggle")} desc={t("settings.showMaximizeToggleDesc")} value={showMaximizeToggle} onChange={toggleShowMaximizeToggle} />
          <button
            onClick={() => navigate("/game?mode=tutorial&from=settings")}
            className="mt-2 w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
          >
            <GraduationCap className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />
            <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("settings.replayTutorial")}</span>
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Account section */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Shield className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("settings.account")}</h2>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("settings.accountDesc")}</p>

          <div className="space-y-2">
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowGoogleDialog(true)}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <GoogleIcon size={20} />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("settings.google")}</span>
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">{t("settings.connect")}</span>

            <button
              onClick={() => { setShowReportInput(true); setReportUsername(""); setReportPreview(null); }}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <Flag className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">Spieler melden</span>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/privacy")}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("settings.privacyPolicy")}</span>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/impressum")}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("impressum.title")}</span>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigate("/eula")}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("eula.settingsEula")}</span>
              <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400 rotate-180" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={handleDownloadData}
              disabled={downloading}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              <Download className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("eula.downloadData")}</span>
              {downloading && <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">…</span>}
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => { setDeleteConfirmText(""); setShowDeleteDialog(true); }}
              className="w-full p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-rose-200 hover:border-rose-400 flex items-center gap-3 transition-all"
            >
              <Trash2 className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500" />
              <span className="font-bold text-rose-500 text-sm flex-1 text-left">{t("settings.deleteAccount")}</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showGoogleDialog && me && (
        <GoogleLinkDialog me={{ ...me, display_name: name, language: lang }} onClose={() => setShowGoogleDialog(false)} returnUrl={window.location.href} />
      )}

      {/* AgeGateRecheck removed — under-threshold users are now blocked during onboarding */}

      {showReportInput && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[90] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-md flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Flag className="w-5 h-5 text-rose-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900">Spieler melden</h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400">Per Benutzername suchen</p>
              </div>
              <button onClick={() => setShowReportInput(false)} className="p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors">
                <X className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
              </button>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
              <input
                value={reportUsername}
                onChange={(e) => { setReportUsername(e.target.value); setReportPreview(null); }}
                onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && lookupReportTarget()}
                placeholder="Benutzername eingeben"
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
              />
              <button
                onClick={lookupReportTarget}
                disabled={reportLooking || !reportUsername.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {reportLooking ? "…" : "Suchen"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {reportPreview && !reportPreview.notFound && !reportPreview.isSelf && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 mb-3 flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-slate-200 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-black text-slate-600">
                  {reportPreview.name?.[0]?.toUpperCase() || "?"}
                </div>
                <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm truncate">{reportPreview.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">🏆 {reportPreview.trophies} Trophäen</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {reportPreview?.isSelf && (
              <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 text-center mb-3">Du kannst dich nicht selbst melden.</p>
            )}
            {reportPreview?.notFound && (
              <p className="text-xs text-rose-400 text-center mb-3">Spieler nicht gefunden.</p>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={openReportDialog}
              disabled={!reportPreview?.id}
              className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
                reportPreview?.id ? "bg-rose-500 text-white hover:bg-rose-600" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
              }`}
            >
              Weiter zur Meldung
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {reportTarget && (
        <ReportUserDialog
          reportedId={reportTarget.id}
          reportedName={reportTarget.name}
          onClose={() => setReportTarget(null)}
          onSubmitted={() => setReportTarget(null)}
        />
      )}

      {showNameConfirm && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-amber-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <User className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-500" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">{t("settings.changeNameTitle")}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">{t("settings.changeNameBody")}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowNameConfirm(false)}
                disabled={nameBusy}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {t("settings.cancel")}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={saveName}
                disabled={nameBusy}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {nameBusy ? t("settings.deleting") : t("settings.confirmChange")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {showDeleteDialog && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full bg-rose-100 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <Trash2 className="w-7 h-7 text-rose-500" />
            </div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">{t("settings.deleteConfirmTitle")}</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-4">{t("settings.deleteConfirmBody")}</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 mb-1.5 text-left">{t("settings.deleteTypeHint")}</p>
            <input
              value={deleteConfirmText}
              onChange={(e) => setDeleteConfirmText(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="delete"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-rose-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 mb-4 text-center lowercase"
            />
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowDeleteDialog(false)}
                disabled={deleting}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {t("settings.cancel")}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleDeleteAccount}
                disabled={deleting || deleteConfirmText.trim().toLowerCase() !== "delete"}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold hover:bg-rose-600 disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                {deleting ? t("settings.deleting") : t("settings.deleteButton")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ToggleRow({ icon: Icon, label, desc, value, onChange }) {
  return (
    <button
      onClick={() => onChange(!value)}
      className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-2 rounded-xl hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all"
    >
      <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-500" />
      <div className="flex-1 text-left">
        <p className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm">{label}</p>
        {desc && <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{desc}</p>}
      </div>
      <div className={`w-11 h-6 rounded-full transition-colors ${value ? "bg-blue-500" : "bg-slate-200"} relative`}>
        <div className={`absolute top-0.5 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white shadow transition-transform ${value ? "translate-x-[22px]" : "translate-x-0.5"}`} />
      </div>
    </button>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import {
  ABILITIES, AI_LEVELS, TOWER_TYPES, TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE,
  ORB_TYPES, SENDABLE_ORBS, ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE, ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS,
} from "@/game/constants";
import { normalizeProfile } from "@/game/progression";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import TowerIcon from "@/components/game/TowerIcon";
import CoinIcon from "@/components/game/CoinIcon";
import LoadoutInfoBadge from "@/components/LoadoutInfoBadge";
import useBackButton from "@/hooks/useBackButton";

const ICONS = { zap: "⚡", portal: "🌀", repair: "➕", freeze: "❄️", rage: "🔥", shield: "🛡️", burner: "🌋", meteor: "☄️", glue: "🟢", overclock: "⚙️", speed_zone: "💨", damage_zone: "💢", frost_zone: "🌨️", deep_freeze: "🧊" };

export default function PreGameSetup() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState(null);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState(["zap", "portal", "repair"]);
  const [towers, setTowers] = useState(["basic", "machinegun", "boomerang", "bomb"]);
  const [orbs, setOrbs] = useState(["normal", "fast", "bomb", "splitter", "tank"]);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState("casual");
  const [difficulty, setDifficulty] = useState("normal");
  const [showQuickPlay, setShowQuickPlay] = useState(true);

  // Android back button: return to Home instead of exiting the app.
  useBackButton(() => navigate("/"));

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((me) => {
      const p = normalizeProfile(me);
      setProfile(p);
      if (p.selected_abilities?.length === 3) setSelected(p.selected_abilities);
      if (p.selected_towers?.length) setTowers(p.selected_towers);
      if (p.selected_orbs?.length) setOrbs(p.selected_orbs);
      setShowQuickPlay(true);
    }).catch(() => { setProfile(normalizeProfile({})); setShowQuickPlay(true); });
  }, []);

  const unlockedAbilities = profile ? Object.keys(profile.ability_cards || {}).filter((id) => (profile.ability_cards[id]?.level || 0) >= 1) : ["zap","portal","repair","freeze"];
  const unlockedTowers = profile ? Object.keys(profile.tower_cards || {}).filter((id) => (profile.tower_cards[id]?.level || 0) >= 1) : ["basic","machinegun","boomerang","bomb"];
  const unlockedOrbs = profile ? Object.keys(profile.orb_cards || {}).filter((id) => (profile.orb_cards[id]?.level || 0) >= 1) : ["normal","fast","bomb","splitter","tank"];
  const lockedTowerCount = Object.values(TOWER_TYPES).filter((def) => !unlockedTowers.includes(def.id)).length;
  const lockedOrbCount = SENDABLE_ORBS.filter((id) => !unlockedOrbs.includes(id)).length;
  const lockedAbilityCount = Object.values(ABILITIES).filter((def) => !unlockedAbilities.includes(def.id)).length;

  const toggleAbility = (id) => {
    setSelected((cur) => {
      if (cur.includes(id)) return cur.filter((a) => a !== id);
      if (cur.length >= 3) return cur;
      return [...cur, id];
    });
  };

  const toggleTower = (id) => {
    setTowers((cur) => {
      if (cur.includes(id)) return cur.filter((a) => a !== id);
      if (cur.length >= TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE) return cur;
      return [...cur, id];
    });
  };

  const toggleOrb = (id) => {
    setOrbs((cur) => {
      if (cur.includes(id)) return cur.filter((a) => a !== id);
      if (cur.length >= ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE) return cur;
      return [...cur, id];
    });
  };

  const start = async () => {
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("setLoadout", { towers, orbs, abilities: selected });
    } catch (e) { /* guest */ }
    navigate(`/game?mode=${mode}&abilities=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(selected))}&difficulty=${difficulty}&towers=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(towers))}&orbs=${encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(orbs))}`);
  };

  if (!showQuickPlay && !profile) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-100 to-blue-50 flex flex-col items-center px-4 pb-10 text-slate-900" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
        <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="self-start mb-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 text-sm font-bold">← {t("game.home")}</button>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight mb-1">{t("setup.title")}</h1>
        <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-8">{t("setup.subtitle", { towers: TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE, orbs: ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE })}</p>
        <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-6">
          <div className="h-3 w-32 rounded bg-slate-200 animate-pulse mb-2" />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-100 bg-white flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-1" />
                <div className="w-12 h-2 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-1" />
                <div className="w-8 h-2 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-6">
          <div className="h-3 w-24 rounded bg-slate-200 animate-pulse mb-2" />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
            {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-100 bg-white flex flex-col items-center">
                <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-1" />
                <div className="w-12 h-2 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-4">
          <div className="h-3 w-20 rounded bg-slate-200 animate-pulse mb-2" />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-100 bg-white">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
                  <div className="w-20 h-3 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
                </div>
                <div className="w-full h-2 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse mb-1" />
                <div className="w-2/3 h-2 rounded bg-slate-100 animate-pulse" />
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-40 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-slate-200 animate-pulse" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (showQuickPlay) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-100 to-blue-50 flex flex-col items-center px-4 pb-10 text-slate-900" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
        <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="self-start mb-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 text-sm font-bold">← {t("game.home")}</button>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight mb-1">{t("setup.title")}</h1>
        <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-8">{t("setup.quickPlayHint")}</p>
        <div className="text-6xl mb-6 animate-float-bob">⚔️</div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
          {[
            { id: "training", label: t("setup.training"), icon: "🎯" },
            { id: "casual", label: t("setup.casual"), icon: "🎲" },
            { id: "ranked", label: t("setup.ranked"), icon: "🏆" },
          ].map((m) => (
            <button
              key={m.id}
              onClick={() => setMode(m.id)}
              className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
                mode === m.id ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600"
              }`}
            >
              {m.icon} {m.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
        {mode === "ranked" && (
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 text-center max-w-sm mb-4">{t("setup.rankedBetaDisclaimer")}</p>
        )}
        <button
          onClick={() => start()}
          className="w-full max-w-sm py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white text-lg font-black hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-xl shadow-blue-500/30 mb-4"
        >
          ⚡ {t("setup.quickPlay")} →
        </button>
        <button
          onClick={() => setShowQuickPlay(false)}
          className="w-full max-w-sm py-3 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 text-sm font-black hover:border-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
        >
          ⚙️ {t("setup.changeLoadout")}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-100 to-blue-50 flex flex-col items-center px-4 pb-10 text-slate-900" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
      <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="self-start mb-2 text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 text-sm font-bold">← {t("game.home")}</button>
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-black tracking-tight mb-1">{t("setup.title")}</h1>
      <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm mb-6">{t("setup.subtitle", { towers: TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE, orbs: ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE })}</p>

      <div className="flex gap-2 mb-6">
        {[
          { id: "training", label: t("setup.training"), icon: "🎯" },
          { id: "casual", label: t("setup.casual"), icon: "🎲" },
          { id: "ranked", label: t("setup.ranked"), icon: "🏆" },
        ].map((m) => (
          <button
            key={m.id}
            onClick={() => setMode(m.id)}
            className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
              mode === m.id ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300"
            }`}
          >
            {m.icon} {m.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {mode === "ranked" && (
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 text-center max-w-md mb-4">{t("setup.rankedBetaDisclaimer")}</p>
      )}

      {mode === "training" && (
        <div className="mb-6 w-full max-w-md">
          <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2 text-center">{t("setup.aiDifficulty")}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2 justify-center">
            {Object.entries(AI_LEVELS).map(([id, lvl]) => (
              <button
                key={id}
                onClick={() => setDifficulty(id)}
                className={`px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
                  difficulty === id ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300"
                }`}
              >
                {t(`difficulty.${id}`)}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tower loadout */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-6">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("setup.towers")} · {towers.length}/{TOWER_LOADOUT_SIZE}</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-6 gap-2">
          {Object.values(TOWER_TYPES).filter((def) => unlockedTowers.includes(def.id)).map((def) => {
            const locked = !unlockedTowers.includes(def.id);
            const isSel = towers.includes(def.id);
            return (
              <div
                key={def.id}
                onClick={() => !locked && toggleTower(def.id)}
                className={`relative p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center transition-all bg-white ${
                  isSel
                    ? "border-amber-400 bg-amber-50 scale-[1.04]"
                    : locked
                    ? "border-slate-200 opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed"
                    : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:scale-[1.03] cursor-pointer"
                }`}
              >
                <LoadoutInfoBadge title={t(`towers.${def.id}.name`)} description={t(`towers.${def.id}.desc`)} />
                <TowerIcon type={def.id} size={32} />
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-700 leading-tight text-center mt-0.5">{t(`towers.${def.id}.name`)}</span>
                <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500">
                  {locked ? "🔒" : (<><CoinIcon size={9} />{def.cost}</>)}
                </span>
                {isSel && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                    {towers.indexOf(def.id) + 1}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {lockedTowerCount > 0 && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2 text-center font-bold">{t("setup.moreInLab", { n: lockedTowerCount })}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Orb loadout */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-6">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("setup.orbs")} · {orbs.length}/{ORB_LOADOUT_SIZE}</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
          {SENDABLE_ORBS.filter((id) => unlockedOrbs.includes(id)).map((id) => {
            const def = ORB_TYPES[id];
            if (!def) return null;
            const locked = !unlockedOrbs.includes(id);
            const isSel = orbs.includes(id);
            const trophyReq = ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[id];
            return (
              <div
                key={id}
                onClick={() => !locked && toggleOrb(id)}
                className={`relative p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 flex flex-col items-center transition-all bg-white ${
                  isSel
                    ? "border-indigo-400 bg-indigo-50 scale-[1.04]"
                    : locked
                    ? "border-slate-200 opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed"
                    : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:scale-[1.03] cursor-pointer"
                }`}
              >
                <LoadoutInfoBadge title={t(`orbs.${def.id}.name`)} description={t(`orbs.${def.id}.desc`)} />
                <div
                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black text-white"
                  style={{ background: def.color, boxShadow: `0 0 8px ${def.color}66` }}
                >
                  {def.hp}
                </div>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-slate-700 leading-tight text-center mt-0.5">{t(`orbs.${def.id}.name`)}</span>
                {locked ? (
                  <span className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400">
                    {trophyReq ? t("setup.trophyReq", { n: trophyReq }) : t("setup.crateLock")}
                  </span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500">
                    <CoinIcon size={9} />{def.cost}
                  </span>
                )}
                {isSel && (
                  <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
                    {orbs.indexOf(id) + 1}
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {lockedOrbCount > 0 && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2 text-center font-bold">{t("setup.moreInLab", { n: lockedOrbCount })}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Abilities */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-2xl mb-4">
        <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("setup.powers")} · {selected.length}/3</p>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {Object.values(ABILITIES).filter((def) => unlockedAbilities.includes(def.id)).map((def) => {
            const locked = !unlockedAbilities.includes(def.id);
            const isSel = selected.includes(def.id);
            return (
              <button
                key={def.id}
                disabled={locked}
                onClick={() => toggleAbility(def.id)}
                className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 text-left transition-all ${
                  isSel
                    ? "border-blue-400 bg-blue-50 scale-[1.03]"
                    : locked
                    ? "border-slate-200 opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed bg-white"
                    : "border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 hover:scale-[1.02] bg-white"
                }`}
              >
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-lg" style={{ background: def.color + "22", boxShadow: `0 0 10px ${def.color}66` }}>
                    {ICONS[def.id] || "✨"}
                  </div>
                  <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t(`abilities.${def.id}.name`)}</span>
                  {locked && <span className="ml-auto text-lg">🔒</span>}
                  {isSel && (
                    <span className="ml-auto text-xs font-bold bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-full px-2 py-0.5">
                      {selected.indexOf(def.id) + 1}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 leading-snug">{t(`abilities.${def.id}.desc`)}</p>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
        {lockedAbilityCount > 0 && (
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-2 text-center font-bold">{t("setup.moreInLab", { n: lockedAbilityCount })}</p>
        )}
      </div>

      <button
        onClick={start}
        disabled={selected.length !== 3 || towers.length < 1 || orbs.length < 1}
        className="px-10 py-4 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white text-lg font-black disabled:opacity-40 hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-xl shadow-blue-500/30"
      >
        {t("setup.startMatch")} →
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { AI_OPPONENTS } from "@/game/constants";
import { ACHIEVEMENTS } from "@/game/achievements";
import LeagueBadge from "@/components/LeagueBadge";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import confetti from "canvas-confetti";
import { optimisticAction, showErrorToast } from "@/lib/optimisticAction";

export default function Leaderboard() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("ranks");
  const [rows, setRows] = useState([]);
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await base44.functions.invoke("getLeaderboard", {});
        const d = res.data || {};
        if (d.rows && d.rows.length > 0) {
          setRows(d.rows);
        } else {
          setRows(AI_OPPONENTS.map((b) => ({ display_name: b.name, trophies: b.trophies, wins: 0, losses: 0 })));
        }
      } catch (e) {
        setRows(AI_OPPONENTS.map((b) => ({ display_name: b.name, trophies: b.trophies, wins: 0, losses: 0 })));
      }
      try {
        const m = await base44.auth.me();
        setMe(m);
      } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
      setLoading(false);
    })();
  }, []);

  const unlocked = me?.achievements || [];
  const claimed = me?.claimed_achievements || [];
  const newIds = me?.new_achievements || [];
  const unclaimedCount = unlocked.filter((id) => !claimed.includes(id)).length;

  const handleClaim = async (ach) => {
    if (!me) return;
    const reward = ach.reward || {};
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: {
        coins: (me.coins || 0) + (reward.coins || 0),
        shards: (me.shards || 0) + (reward.shards || 0),
        claimed_achievements: [...(me.claimed_achievements || []), ach.id],
        new_achievements: (me.new_achievements || []).filter((id) => id !== ach.id),
      },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("claimAchievementRewards", { achievementIds: [ach.id] }),
      onSuccess: (prev, d) => ({ ...prev, coins: d.coins, shards: d.shards, claimed_achievements: d.claimed_achievements || prev.claimed_achievements, new_achievements: [] }),
      t,
    });
  };

  const handleClaimAll = async () => {
    if (!me) return;
    const unclaimedAchs = ACHIEVEMENTS.filter((a) => unlocked.includes(a.id) && !claimed.includes(a.id));
    if (unclaimedAchs.length === 0) return;
    const totalCoins = unclaimedAchs.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.reward?.coins || 0), 0);
    const totalShards = unclaimedAchs.reduce((s, a) => s + (a.reward?.shards || 0), 0);
    const claimedIds = unclaimedAchs.map((a) => a.id);
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: {
        coins: (me.coins || 0) + totalCoins,
        shards: (me.shards || 0) + totalShards,
        claimed_achievements: [...(me.claimed_achievements || []), ...claimedIds],
        new_achievements: [],
      },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("claimAchievementRewards", {}),
      onSuccess: (prev, d) => ({ ...prev, coins: d.coins, shards: d.shards, claimed_achievements: d.claimed_achievements || prev.claimed_achievements, new_achievements: [] }),
      t,
    });
    const end = Date.now() + 800;
    (function frame() {
      confetti({ particleCount: 4, spread: 60, origin: { x: Math.random(), y: 0.3 } });
      if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    })();
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-4">{t("leaderboard.title")}</h1>

        {/* Tab toggle */}
        <div className="flex p-1 mb-6 rounded-2xl bg-slate-100 border border-slate-200">
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("ranks")}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
              tab === "ranks" ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-400"
            }`}
          >
            {t("leaderboard.tabRanks")}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("achievements")}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all relative ${
              tab === "achievements" ? "bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm" : "text-slate-400"
            }`}
          >
            {t("leaderboard.tabAchievements")}
            {unclaimedCount > 0 && (
              <span className="absolute top-1 right-2 min-w-4 h-4 px-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center font-black animate-pop-in">
                {unclaimedCount}
              </span>
            )}
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === "ranks" ? (
          loading ? (
            <div className="text-center text-slate-400 py-20">{t("leaderboard.loading")}</div>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {rows.map((r, i) => {
                const isMe = me && r.id === me.id;
                const medal = i === 0 ? "🥇" : i === 1 ? "🥈" : i === 2 ? "🥉" : `${i + 1}`;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={i}
                    className={`flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all ${
                      isMe ? "border-blue-400 bg-blue-50" : "border-slate-200 bg-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="w-8 text-center font-black text-lg text-slate-700">{medal}</div>
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white">
                      {(r.display_name || r.full_name || "?").charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-bold text-slate-800">{r.display_name || r.full_name || "Unknown"}{isMe && ` ${t("leaderboard.you")}`}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-slate-400">{r.wins || 0}W · {r.losses || 0}L</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <LeagueBadge trophies={r.trophies || 0} size="sm" />
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <p className="text-xl font-black text-amber-500">{r.trophies || 0}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400">{t("leaderboard.trophies")}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <p className="text-slate-400 text-sm">{t("achievements.subtitle")}</p>
              <span className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-600 font-bold text-sm">
                {unlocked.length}/{ACHIEVEMENTS.length}
              </span>
            </div>
            {unclaimedCount >= 2 && (
              <button onClick={handleClaimAll} className="w-full py-3 mb-4 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-yellow-500 text-white font-black text-sm hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform shadow-lg shadow-amber-500/30 animate-pop-in">
                {t("achievements.claimAll")} ({unclaimedCount})
              </button>
            )}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              {ACHIEVEMENTS.map((ach) => {
                const isUnlocked = unlocked.includes(ach.id);
                const isNew = newIds.includes(ach.id);
                const isClaimed = claimed.includes(ach.id);
                return <AchievementCard key={ach.id} ach={ach} unlocked={isUnlocked} isNew={isNew} claimed={isClaimed} onClaim={handleClaim} t={t} />;
              })}
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AchievementCard({ ach, unlocked, isNew, claimed, onClaim, t }) {
  const [burst, setBurst] = useState(false);
  const [claiming, setClaiming] = useState(false);
  const handleClaim = async () => {
    if (claimed || !unlocked || claiming) return;
    setClaiming(true);
    setBurst(true);
    try { await onClaim(ach); } finally { setClaiming(false); }
    setTimeout(() => setBurst(false), 1500);
  };
  return (
    <div className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 transition-all overflow-hidden ${unlocked ? "border-amber-300 bg-white shadow-sm" : "border-slate-200 bg-white opacity-60"}`}>
      {isNew && !claimed && (
        <span className="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 px-1.5 h-5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-[9px] flex items-center justify-center font-black animate-pop-in">
          NEW
        </span>
      )}
      {claimed && <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 text-emerald-500 text-base">✓</span>}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center pt-2">
        <div className={`text-4xl mb-2 ${unlocked ? "" : "grayscale opacity-40"}`}>{ach.icon}</div>
        <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800 leading-tight mb-1">{t(`achievements.${ach.id}.name`)}</h3>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 leading-snug mb-2 min-h-[28px]">{t(`achievements.${ach.id}.desc`)}</p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
          {ach.reward.coins > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-500">🪙 {ach.reward.coins}</span>
          )}
          {ach.reward.shards > 0 && (
            <span className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-lime-600"><ShardIcon size={10} /> {ach.reward.shards}</span>
          )}
        </div>
        {unlocked && !claimed ? (
          <button onClick={handleClaim} disabled={claiming} className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-yellow-500 text-white text-xs font-black hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-md disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:hover:scale-100">
            {claiming ? "…" : t("achievements.claim")}
          </button>
        ) : claimed ? (
          <div className="w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 text-xs font-bold text-center">{t("achievements.claimed")}</div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {burst && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none flex items-center justify-center">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-amber-200/40 animate-pulse" />
          {ach.reward.coins > 0 && Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (
            <span key={`c${i}`} className="absolute text-base animate-float-up" style={{ left: `${15 + i * 12}%`, top: "45%", animationDelay: `${i * 0.07}s` }}>🪙</span>
          ))}
          {ach.reward.shards > 0 && Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
            <span key={`s${i}`} className="absolute animate-float-up" style={{ left: `${28 + i * 14}%`, top: "45%", animationDelay: `${i * 0.09}s` }}><ShardIcon size={14} /></span>
          ))}
          <span className="relative text-xl font-black text-amber-600 animate-pop-in z-10">
            +{ach.reward.coins > 0 ? `${ach.reward.coins}🪙 ` : ""}{ach.reward.shards > 0 ? `${ach.reward.shards}💎` : ""}
          </span>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useRef, useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

// Play Store screenshot overlay generator.
// Upload a phone screenshot, pick a screen preset + language, export a
// 1080x1920 PNG with a clean rounded card (contain-fit, nothing cropped),
// accent bar, localized headline + subhead, and SPLITTER ORBS wordmark.

const PRESETS = [
  {
    id: "home",
    accent: "#3b82f6",
    en: { headline: "Build. Blast. Climb.", subhead: "Real-time 1v1 tower defense" },
    de: { headline: "Bauen. Sprengen. Aufsteigen.", subhead: "Echtzeit-1v1-Tower-Defense" },
  },
  {
    id: "loadout",
    accent: "#f59e0b",
    en: { headline: "Build Your Loadout", subhead: "3 powers · 4 towers · 5 orbs" },
    de: { headline: "Stelle dein Loadout zusammen", subhead: "3 Kräfte · 4 Türme · 5 Orbs" },
  },
  {
    id: "match",
    accent: "#f43f5e",
    en: { headline: "Split-Screen Battles", subhead: "Click orbs, deploy towers, win" },
    de: { headline: "Split-Screen-Schlachten", subhead: "Orbs tippen, Türme bauen, siegen" },
  },
];

const CANVAS_W = 1080;
const CANVAS_H = 1920;
const FONT = "ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif";

export default function ScreenshotTool() {
  const canvasRef = useRef(null);
  const imgRef = useRef(null);
  const fileRef = useRef(null);
  const [preset, setPreset] = useState(PRESETS[0]);
  const [lang, setLang] = useState("en");
  const [hasImage, setHasImage] = useState(false);

  const draw = useCallback((img, p, l) => {
    const pr = p || preset;
    const lg = l || lang;
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    canvas.width = CANVAS_W;
    canvas.height = CANVAS_H;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

    // light slate-50 canvas
    ctx.fillStyle = "#f8fafc";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, CANVAS_W, CANVAS_H);

    // screenshot card: contain-fit inside a rounded rect with thin border + shadow
    const cardX = 70, cardY = 420, cardW = CANVAS_W - 140, cardH = 1320;
    const radius = 48;

    // soft drop shadow
    ctx.save();
    ctx.shadowColor = "rgba(15,23,42,0.16)";
    ctx.shadowBlur = 60;
    ctx.shadowOffsetY = 18;
    roundRect(ctx, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, radius);
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.restore();

    // thin slate-200 border
    roundRect(ctx, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, radius);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#e2e8f0";
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.stroke();

    if (img) {
      // contain-fit inside the card (with small inset padding), letterbox if needed
      const pad = 14;
      const innerX = cardX + pad, innerY = cardY + pad;
      const innerW = cardW - pad * 2, innerH = cardH - pad * 2;
      const scale = Math.min(innerW / img.width, innerH / img.height);
      const w = img.width * scale, h = img.height * scale;
      const x = innerX + (innerW - w) / 2;
      const y = innerY + (innerH - h) / 2;
      // clip to rounded card so the image stays inside the frame
      ctx.save();
      roundRect(ctx, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, radius);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f1f5f9";
      ctx.fillRect(innerX, innerY, innerW, innerH);
      ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, w, h);
      ctx.restore();
    } else {
      // placeholder
      ctx.save();
      roundRect(ctx, cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH, radius);
      ctx.clip();
      ctx.fillStyle = "#f1f5f9";
      ctx.fillRect(cardX, cardY, cardW, cardH);
      ctx.fillStyle = "#94a3b8";
      ctx.font = `600 44px ${FONT}`;
      ctx.textAlign = "center";
      ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
      ctx.fillText("Upload a screenshot →", CANVAS_W / 2, cardY + cardH / 2);
      ctx.restore();
    }

    // accent bar
    ctx.fillStyle = pr.accent;
    roundRect(ctx, 90, 150, 16, 168, 8);
    ctx.fill();

    // headline
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
    ctx.font = `800 92px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
    ctx.fillText(pr[lg].headline, 130, 150, CANVAS_W - 200);

    // subhead
    ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
    ctx.font = `500 46px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.fillText(pr[lg].subhead, 132, 272, CANVAS_W - 200);

    // wordmark bottom-right
    ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
    ctx.font = `800 38px ${FONT}`;
    ctx.textAlign = "right";
    ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
    ctx.fillText("SPLITTER ORBS", CANVAS_W - 70, CANVAS_H - 64);
    ctx.textAlign = "left";
    ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  }, [preset, lang]);

  const onFile = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
    const img = new Image();
    img.onload = () => { imgRef.current = img; setHasImage(true); draw(img, preset, lang); };
    img.src = url;
  };

  const pickPreset = (p) => { setPreset(p); draw(imgRef.current, p, lang); };
  const pickLang = (l) => { setLang(l); draw(imgRef.current, preset, l); };

  const download = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const a = document.createElement("a");
    a.download = `splitter-orbs-${preset.id}-${lang}.png`;
    a.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    a.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-6">
      <div className="max-w-5xl mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-1">Screenshot Overlay Tool</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">
          Upload a phone screenshot, pick a screen and language, and export a Play Store-ready 1080×1920 PNG.
        </p>
        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">1. Choose screen</label>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-5">
              {PRESETS.map((p) => (
                <button
                  key={p.id}
                  onClick={() => pickPreset(p)}
                  className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border-2 transition ${
                    preset.id === p.id ? "text-white" : "bg-white text-slate-600 border-slate-200"
                  }`}
                  style={preset.id === p.id ? { background: p.accent, borderColor: p.accent } : {}}
                >
                  {p.en.headline}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">2. Language</label>
            <div className="inline-flex rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 overflow-hidden mb-5">
              {["en", "de"].map((l) => (
                <button
                  key={l}
                  onClick={() => pickLang(l)}
                  className={`px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold uppercase transition ${
                    lang === l ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "bg-white text-slate-500"
                  }`}
                >
                  {l}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">3. Upload screenshot</label>
            <input
              ref={fileRef}
              type="file"
              accept="image/*"
              onChange={onFile}
              className="block w-full text-sm text-slate-500 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-xl file:border-0 file:bg-slate-900 file:text-white file:font-bold"
            />

            <div className="mt-4">
              <Button onClick={download} disabled={!hasImage}>
                Download PNG
              </Button>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-6 text-xs text-slate-400 leading-relaxed">
              <p>Output: 1080×1920 PNG (9:16). The screenshot is contain-fit (nothing cropped) inside a clean rounded card with a thin border and soft shadow.</p>
              <p className="mt-2">Tip: capture screenshots on a 1080×1920 device or emulator for the sharpest result.</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-center">
            <canvas ref={canvasRef} className="w-full max-w-[320px] rounded-2xl shadow-lg bg-white" />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// Rounded-rectangle path helper (does not fill/stroke on its own)
function roundRect(ctx, x, y, w, h, r) {
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(x + r, y);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y, x + w, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x + w, y + h, x, y + h, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y + h, x, y, r);
  ctx.arcTo(x, y, x + w, y, r);
  ctx.closePath();
}
