import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { ChevronRight } from "lucide-react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { CRATE_TYPES } from "@/game/constants";
import { normalizeProfile } from "@/game/progression";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import CrateIcon from "@/components/CrateIcon";
import CoinIcon from "@/components/game/CoinIcon";
import GemIcon from "@/components/GemIcon";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";
import GemPacks from "@/components/GemPacks";
import CardFlipReveal from "@/components/CardFlipReveal";
import { sfx } from "@/game/sound";
import { optimisticAction, showErrorToast } from "@/lib/optimisticAction";

const GEM_TO_COIN_RATE = 10;

export default function Shop() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [claimed, setClaimed] = useState(false);
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("idle");
  const [revealItems, setRevealItems] = useState(null);
  const [activeCrate, setActiveCrate] = useState(null);

  const [voucherInput, setVoucherInput] = useState("");
  const [voucherStatus, setVoucherStatus] = useState(null);
  const [voucherBusy, setVoucherBusy] = useState(false);
  const [gemCrateClaimed, setGemCrateClaimed] = useState(false);
  const [gemCrateBusy, setGemCrateBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => setMe(normalizeProfile(m))).catch(() => setMe(normalizeProfile({})));
    // Read-only eligibility check (does NOT consume the daily claim)
    base44.functions.invoke("claimDailyCrate", {}).then((res) => {
      setClaimed(!res.data?.eligible);
    }).catch(() => setClaimed(false));
    base44.functions.invoke("claimDailyGemCrate", {}).then((res) => {
      setGemCrateClaimed(!res.data?.eligible);
    }).catch(() => setGemCrateClaimed(false));
  }, []);

  const coins = me?.coins || 0;
  const gems = me?.gems || 0;
  const shards = me?.shards || 0;

  const openCrate = async (crateId, isFree = false) => {
    if (phase !== "idle") return;
    const crate = CRATE_TYPES[crateId];
    if (!isFree) {
      if (crate.currency === "coins" && coins < crate.cost) return;
      if (crate.currency === "gems" && gems < crate.cost) return;
    }
    sfx.crateOpen();
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("openCrate", { crateId, claimFree: isFree });
      const data = res.data;
      if (!data?.success) {
        if (isFree && data?.error === "already claimed today") setClaimed(true);
        else showErrorToast(data, t);
        return;
      }
      setRevealItems(data.items);
      setActiveCrate(crateId);
      setMe((m) => ({
        ...m,
        coins: data.coins, gems: data.gems, shards: data.shards,
        tower_cards: data.tower_cards, ability_cards: data.ability_cards,
        orb_cards: data.orb_cards, owned_skins: data.owned_skins,
        last_free_crate: isFree ? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10) : m?.last_free_crate,
      }));
      if (isFree) setClaimed(true);
      setPhase("reveal");
    } catch (e) {
      showErrorToast(e, t);
    }
  };

  const redeemVoucher = async () => {
    if (voucherBusy || !voucherInput.trim()) return;
    setVoucherBusy(true);
    setVoucherStatus(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("redeemVoucher", { code: voucherInput.trim() });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success) {
        setMe((m) => ({ ...m, coins: (m?.coins || 0) + r.reward.coins, gems: (m?.gems || 0) + r.reward.gems, shards: (m?.shards || 0) + r.reward.shards }));
        setVoucherStatus({ type: "success", reward: r.reward });
        setVoucherInput("");
      } else {
        setVoucherStatus({ type: "error", code: r?.error || "invalid_code" });
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setVoucherStatus({ type: "error", code: "invalid_code" });
    }
    setVoucherBusy(false);
  };

  const claimGemCrate = async () => {
    if (gemCrateBusy || gemCrateClaimed) return;
    setGemCrateBusy(true);
    sfx.crateOpen();
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("claimDailyGemCrate", { claim: true });
      const data = res.data;
      if (data?.granted) {
        setMe((m) => ({ ...m, gems: (m?.gems || 0) + data.granted }));
        setGemCrateClaimed(true);
      } else if (data?.error === "already claimed today") {
        setGemCrateClaimed(true);
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    setGemCrateBusy(false);
  };

  const exchangeGems = async (gemAmount) => {
    if (gems < gemAmount) return;
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { gems: gems - gemAmount, coins: coins + gemAmount * GEM_TO_COIN_RATE },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("exchangeGems", { gemAmount }),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, gems: data.gems, coins: data.coins }),
      t,
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-6">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("shop.title")}</h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-600 font-bold text-sm">
              <CoinIcon size={14} /> {coins}
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-cyan-50 border border-cyan-200 text-cyan-600 font-bold text-sm">
              <GemIcon size={14} /> {gems}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Gem exchange */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1">
            <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("shop.exchangeTitle")}</h2>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-xl bg-cyan-50 border border-cyan-200 text-cyan-600 font-bold text-sm">
              <GemIcon size={12} /> {gems}
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("shop.exchangeRate")}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {[1, 5, 10].map((g) => (
              <button
                key={g}
                onClick={() => exchangeGems(g)}
                disabled={gems < g}
                className={`flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm transition-all ${
                  gems < g
                    ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                    : "bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-amber-500/30"
                }`}
              >
                <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"><GemIcon size={12} /> {g}</span><br /><span className="text-[10px] font-bold opacity-90 inline-flex items-center gap-0.5">→ <CoinIcon size={11} /> {g * GEM_TO_COIN_RATE}</span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="mb-6 p-3 rounded-2xl bg-violet-50 border border-violet-200 flex items-center gap-2">
          <ShardIcon size={28} />
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-violet-700">{t("shop.shards", { n: shards })}</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-violet-400">{t("shop.shardsHint")}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <GemPacks onGemsChange={() => base44.auth.me().then((m) => setMe(normalizeProfile(m))).catch(() => {})} />

        {/* Skins → Lab */}
        <button
          onClick={() => navigate("/collection?tab=skins")}
          className="w-full mb-8 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4 text-left hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors"
        >
          <div className="flex -space-x-2">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-cyan-400 to-blue-500 border-2 border-white" />
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-400 to-purple-500 border-2 border-white" />
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-400 to-orange-500 border-2 border-white" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{t("shop.skinsCard")}</h3>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{t("shop.skinsCardHint")}</p>
          </div>
          <ChevronRight className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-400" />
        </button>

        {/* Crates */}
        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 mb-3">{t("shop.crates")}</h2>
        <div className="space-y-3 mb-8">
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.wooden}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="wood" />}
            actionLabel={claimed ? t("shop.claimed") : t("shop.freeDaily")}
            actionDisabled={claimed || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("wooden", true)}
            subLabel={t("shop.freeEveryDay")}
            t={t}
          />
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.silver}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="silver" />}
            actionLabel={(<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><CoinIcon size={12} /> {CRATE_TYPES.silver.cost}</span>)}
            actionDisabled={coins < CRATE_TYPES.silver.cost || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("silver")}
            subLabel={t("shop.betterOdds")}
            t={t}
          />
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.gold}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="gold" />}
            actionLabel={(<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><GemIcon size={12} /> {CRATE_TYPES.gold.cost}</span>)}
            actionDisabled={gems < CRATE_TYPES.gold.cost || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("gold")}
            subLabel={t("shop.guaranteedCard")}
            t={t}
          />
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.mythical}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="crystal" />}
            actionLabel={(<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><GemIcon size={12} /> {CRATE_TYPES.mythical.cost}</span>)}
            actionDisabled={gems < CRATE_TYPES.mythical.cost || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("mythical")}
            subLabel={t("shop.mythicalHint")}
            t={t}
          />
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.legendary}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="legendary" />}
            actionLabel={(<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><GemIcon size={12} /> {CRATE_TYPES.legendary.cost}</span>)}
            actionDisabled={gems < CRATE_TYPES.legendary.cost || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("legendary")}
            subLabel={t("shop.legendaryHint")}
            t={t}
          />
          <CrateCard
            crate={CRATE_TYPES.discovery}
            icon={<CrateIcon size={56} tone="emerald" />}
            actionLabel={(<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1"><GemIcon size={12} /> {CRATE_TYPES.discovery.cost}</span>)}
            actionDisabled={gems < CRATE_TYPES.discovery.cost || phase !== "idle"}
            onAction={() => openCrate("discovery")}
            subLabel={t("shop.discoveryHint")}
            t={t}
          />
        </div>

        {/* Voucher code */}
        <div className="mb-4 p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
          <h2 className="font-bold text-slate-800 mb-1">{t("shop.voucherTitle")}</h2>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("shop.voucherHint")}</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <input
              value={voucherInput}
              onChange={(e) => setVoucherInput(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
              onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && redeemVoucher()}
              placeholder={t("shop.voucherPlaceholder")}
              className="flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 uppercase tracking-wide"
            />
            <button
              onClick={redeemVoucher}
              disabled={voucherBusy || !voucherInput.trim()}
              className={`px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
                voucherBusy || !voucherInput.trim()
                  ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                  : "bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-blue-500/30"
              }`}
            >
              {t("shop.redeem")}
            </button>
          </div>
          {voucherStatus?.type === "success" && (
            <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 animate-pop-in">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-600">
                {t("shop.voucherSuccess")}
                {voucherStatus.reward.coins > 0 && ` +${voucherStatus.reward.coins}🪙`}
                {voucherStatus.reward.gems > 0 && ` +${voucherStatus.reward.gems}💎`}
                {voucherStatus.reward.shards > 0 && <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5"> +{voucherStatus.reward.shards}<ShardIcon size={12} /></span>}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
          {voucherStatus?.type === "error" && (
            <div className="mt-2 p-2.5 rounded-xl bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 animate-pop-in">
              <p className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-500">
                {voucherStatus.code === "already_redeemed" ? t("shop.voucherAlreadyUsed") : t("shop.voucherInvalid")}
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {phase === "reveal" && revealItems && activeCrate && (
        <CardFlipReveal
          items={revealItems}
          crateTone={CRATE_TYPES[activeCrate].tone}
          onClose={() => { setPhase("idle"); setRevealItems(null); setActiveCrate(null); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CrateCard({ crate, icon, actionLabel, actionDisabled, onAction, subLabel, t }) {
  return (
    <div className="p-5 rounded-3xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4">
      <div className="animate-float-bob">{icon}</div>
      <div className="flex-1">
        <h3 className="font-bold text-slate-800">{crate.name} {t("shop.crateSuffix")}</h3>
        <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400">{subLabel}</p>
        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-0.5">
          {t("shop.itemsCount", { n: crate.itemCount })} · {t("shop.skinChance", { n: Math.round(crate.skinChance * 100) })}
        </p>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-1">
          {crate.guaranteeNewCard ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 text-[9px] font-bold">
              {t("shop.guaranteedNewCard")}
            </span>
          ) : crate.guaranteedCards > 0 ? (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 text-[9px] font-bold">
              {t("shop.guaranteedCardBadge", { n: crate.guaranteedCards })}
            </span>
          ) : null}
          {crate.multiCardChance && (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-violet-50 text-violet-600 text-[9px] font-bold">
              {t("shop.multiCardBadge")}
            </span>
          )}
          {(crate.gemChance || 0) > 0 && (
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-cyan-50 text-cyan-600 text-[9px] font-bold">
              {t("shop.gemBadge")}
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
      <button
        onClick={onAction}
        disabled={actionDisabled}
        className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all whitespace-nowrap ${
          actionDisabled
            ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed"
            : "bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-400 to-green-500 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-emerald-500/30"
        }`}
      >
        {actionLabel}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

// Build the full cosmetics bundle (station + left/right tower skins + 3 emblems)
// from the player's equipped fields. `tower` is kept as a legacy fallback.
function cosmeticsBundle(c) {
  return {
    station: c.stationSkin || "default",
    leftTower: c.leftTowerSkin || c.towerSkin || "default",
    rightTower: c.rightTowerSkin || c.towerSkin || "default",
    stationEmblem: c.stationEmblem || "default",
    leftTowerEmblem: c.leftTowerEmblem || "default",
    rightTowerEmblem: c.rightTowerEmblem || "default",
  };
}

export default function Game() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  });
  const [matchInfo, setMatchInfo] = useState(null);

  const [searchToast, setSearchToast] = useState("");
  const [showTip, setShowTip] = useState(false);
  const [showShardCrate, setShowShardCrate] = useState(false);
  const [shardCrateAmount, setShardCrateAmount] = useState(0);
  const resultSavedRef = useRef(false);
  const mpRef = useRef(null);
  const mpInfoRef = useRef(null);
  const myUserIdRef = useRef(null);
  const oppHeartbeatRef = useRef({ ts: 0, hp: 120 });
  const heartbeatTimerRef = useRef(0);
