  const [rejoinData, setRejoinData] = useState(null);
  const [showForfeitDialog, setShowForfeitDialog] = useState(false);
  const [placementMode, setPlacementMode] = useState({ active: false, typeId: null });
  const [editMode, setEditMode] = useState(false);
  const [tutorialStep, setTutorialStep] = useState(null);
  const tutorialStepRef = useRef(null);
  const tutorialActiveRef = useRef(false);
  const abilityBarRef = useRef(null);
  const towerTrayRef = useRef(null);
  const abilitiesOnlyRef = useRef(null);
  const editToggleRef = useRef(null);
  const orbShopRef = useRef(null);
  const orbTapCountRef = useRef(0);
  const [orbTapCount, setOrbTapCount] = useState(0);
  const [coachmarkHidden, setCoachmarkHidden] = useState(false);
  const [tutorialSkippable, setTutorialSkippable] = useState(false);
  const tutorialUpgradedRef = useRef(false);
  const [tutorialSubstep, setTutorialSubstep] = useState(null);
  const tutorialSubstepRef = useRef(null);
  const [showReportDialog, setShowReportDialog] = useState(false);
  const [fitToScreen, setFitToScreen] = useState(true);
  const [showMaximizeToggle, setShowMaximizeToggle] = useState(true);
  const [maximized, setMaximized] = useState(false);
  // Session-only override: when the saved preference is fit-to-screen, the
  // maximize icon lets the player switch this match to the full/scrollable
  // layout without changing their Settings preference.
  const useFitLayout = fitToScreen && !maximized;

  const advanceTutorial = () => {
    const cur = tutorialStepRef.current;
    if (cur === null || cur >= 5) return;
    const next = cur + 1;
    tutorialStepRef.current = next;
    setTutorialStep(next);
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s) {
      // Step 3 (index 2): give coins to afford a tower upgrade.
      if (next === 2) s.player.coins = 500;
      // Step 5 (index 4): give coins to afford sending orbs.
      if (next === 4) s.player.coins = 800;
    }
    tutorialSubstepRef.current = null;
    setTutorialSubstep(null);
    setCoachmarkHidden(false);
  };
  const hideCoachmark = () => setCoachmarkHidden(true);
  const completeTutorial = async () => {
    tutorialStepRef.current = null;
    setTutorialStep(null);
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s) s.status = "finished";
    // Only proceed when the backend persist actually succeeds — otherwise
    // tutorial_done never saves and Home re-triggers the tutorial on the
    // next visit. On failure, stay in the tutorial so the player can retry.
    try {
      await base44.functions.invoke("completeTutorial", {});
    } catch (e) {
      if (s) s.status = "playing";
      tutorialStepRef.current = 5;
      setTutorialStep(5);
      showErrorToast(e, t, navigate);
      return;
    }
    resultSavedRef.current = true;
    // Session-persistent guard: Home honors this flag for the whole session
    // so a stale me() read doesn't bounce the player back into the tutorial.
    try { sessionStorage.setItem("tutorial_completed", "1"); } catch (e) {}
    const from = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("from");
    navigate(from === "settings" ? "/settings" : "/");
  };

  const mode = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("mode") || "casual";
  const difficulty = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("difficulty") || "normal";
  const privateSessionId = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("sessionId");
  const abilitiesParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("abilities");
  const towersParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("towers");
  let loadoutTowers = ["basic", "machinegun", "boomerang", "bomb"];
  try { if (towersParam) loadoutTowers = JSON.parse(towersParam); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  const orbsParam = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("orbs");
  let loadoutOrbs = ["normal", "fast", "bomb", "splitter", "tank"];
  try { if (orbsParam) loadoutOrbs = JSON.parse(orbsParam); } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

  // Start instantly vs AI (no matchmaking wait)
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
      if (mpRef.current) { mpRef.current.destroy(); mpRef.current = null; }
      // Clean up stale waiting queue entries (player left during search)
      if (myUserIdRef.current) {
        base44.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({ player_id: myUserIdRef.current, status: "waiting" })
          .then((entries) => { for (const e of entries) base44.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(e.id).catch(() => {}); })
          .catch(() => {});
      }
    };
  }, []);

  const beginMatch = useCallback((vsReal) => {
    // Record AI match start time for server-side duration verification
    if (mode !== "tutorial") {
      base44.functions.invoke("startAiMatch", { mode, client_version: APP_VERSION }).catch((e) => {
        if (e?.response?.status === 426) forceVersionUpdate(e.response.data?.min_required_version);
      });
    }
    let chosenAbilities = ["zap", "portal", "repair"];
    try {
      if (abilitiesParam) chosenAbilities = JSON.parse(abilitiesParam);
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

    const isTraining = mode === "training";
    const isTutorial = mode === "tutorial";
    const aiLevel = AI_LEVELS[difficulty] || AI_LEVELS.normal;
    const opponent = isTutorial
      ? { name: "Tutorial", trophies: 0, skill: 0 }
      : isTraining
      ? { name: `Training Bot · ${aiLevel.label}`, trophies: profileTrophiesRef.current || 0, skill: aiLevel.skill }
      : vsReal
      ? { name: "Online Rival", trophies: 100, skill: 0.6 }
      : (() => {
          const expectedSkill = getLeagueExpectedSkill(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
          let best = AI_OPPONENTS[0], bestDiff = Infinity;
          for (const bot of AI_OPPONENTS) {
            const d = Math.abs(bot.skill - expectedSkill);
            if (d < bestDiff) { bestDiff = d; best = bot; }
          }
          return best;
        })();

    const leagueScale = getLeagueOrbScale(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const clickDmg = getClickDamage(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const leagueMax = getLeagueMaxLevel(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    leagueMaxRef.current = leagueMax;
    const maxClicks = 20 + (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 2;
    const rechargeInterval = Math.max(0.1, 0.5 - (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 0.04);
    stateRef.current = createInitialState(chosenAbilities, aiLevel.spawnMult, metaLevelsRef.current, leagueScale, clickDmg, leagueMax, null, maxClicks, rechargeInterval, mode);
    stateRef.current.playerTrophies = profileTrophiesRef.current || 0;
    stateRef.current.playerPattern = myCosmeticsRef.current.orbPattern;
    stateRef.current.playerSkins = cosmeticsBundle(myCosmeticsRef.current);
    const aiCosm = rollAICosmetics(Date.now() & 0xffffffff);
    stateRef.current.oppPattern = aiCosm.orbPattern || "default";
    stateRef.current.oppSkins = aiCosm;
    aiRef.current = isTutorial ? null : createAI(opponent.skill);
    if (isTutorial) {
      // Sandbox: pre-place towers, unkillable stations, spending money — no stakes
      stateRef.current.player.coins = 999;
      placeTower(stateRef.current, "basic", 220, 680);
      placeTower(stateRef.current, "machinegun", 380, 640);
      stateRef.current.player.coins = 300;
      stateRef.current.player.firstPlacement = true;
      stateRef.current.player.hp = 9999;
      stateRef.current.player.station.maxHp = 9999;
      stateRef.current.opponent.hp = 9999;
      stateRef.current.opponent.station.maxHp = 9999;
      stateRef.current.spawnTimer = 1.5;
      orbTapCountRef.current = 0;
      setOrbTapCount(0);
      tutorialUpgradedRef.current = false;
      tutorialSubstepRef.current = null;
      setTutorialSubstep(null);
      tutorialStepRef.current = 0;
      setTutorialStep(0);
    }
    setMatchInfo({ opponentName: opponent.name, opponentTrophies: opponent.trophies, vsReal, mode });
    setSearching(false);
    setHud({
      playerHp: stateRef.current.player.hp,
      oppHp: stateRef.current.opponent.hp,
      coins: stateRef.current.player.coins,
      abilities: stateRef.current.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })),
      status: "playing",
      time: 0,
      combo: 0,
      targeting: null,
      aiming: null,
      burnerArmed: false,
      firstPlacement: true,
      clickDamage: stateRef.current.clickDamage || 12,
      clicks: stateRef.current.player.clicks,
      maxClicks: stateRef.current.player.maxClicks,
      clickEmptyFlash: 0,
      escalationTier: 0,
    });
  }, [abilitiesParam, mode, difficulty]);

  const beginMultiplayerMatch = useCallback((data) => {
    const { sessionId, opponent, seed, role } = data;
    let chosenAbilities = ["zap", "portal", "repair"];
    try { if (abilitiesParam) chosenAbilities = JSON.parse(abilitiesParam); } catch (e) {}
    const leagueScale = getLeagueOrbScale(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const clickDmg = getClickDamage(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const leagueMax = getLeagueMaxLevel(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    leagueMaxRef.current = leagueMax;
    const maxClicks = 20 + (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 2;
    const rechargeInterval = Math.max(0.1, 0.5 - (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 0.04);
    stateRef.current = createInitialState(chosenAbilities, 1, metaLevelsRef.current, leagueScale, clickDmg, leagueMax, seed, maxClicks, rechargeInterval, mode);
    stateRef.current.playerTrophies = profileTrophiesRef.current || 0;
    stateRef.current.playerPattern = myCosmeticsRef.current.orbPattern;
    stateRef.current.playerSkins = cosmeticsBundle(myCosmeticsRef.current);
    stateRef.current.oppPattern = "default";
    stateRef.current.oppSkins = { station: "default", leftTower: "default", rightTower: "default", stationEmblem: "default", leftTowerEmblem: "default", rightTowerEmblem: "default" };
    aiRef.current = null;
    mpInfoRef.current = { sessionId, role, seed, opponent };
    const mp = createSyncManager(sessionId, role, myCosmeticsRef.current);
    mpRef.current = mp;
    setMatchInfo({ opponentName: opponent.name, opponentTrophies: opponent.trophies, vsReal: true, mode, multiplayer: true, opponentId: data.opponentId });
    setSearching(false);
    sfx.matchFound();
    setHud({
      playerHp: stateRef.current.player.hp, oppHp: stateRef.current.opponent.hp,
      coins: stateRef.current.player.coins,
      abilities: stateRef.current.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })),
      status: "playing", time: 0, combo: 0, targeting: null, aiming: null,
      burnerArmed: false, firstPlacement: true, clickDamage: stateRef.current.clickDamage || 12,
      clicks: stateRef.current.player.clicks, maxClicks: stateRef.current.player.maxClicks, clickEmptyFlash: 0,
      escalationTier: 0,
    });
    mp.setReady();
    mp.subscribe({
      onRemoteAction: (action) => {
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s && s.status === "playing") mp.applyRemoteAction(action, s);
      },
      onHeartbeat: ({ ts, hp }) => {
        oppHeartbeatRef.current = { ts, hp };
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s) { s.opponent.hp = hp; setHud((h) => ({ ...h, oppHp: hp })); }
      },
      onStatusChange: (status, session) => {
        if (status === "finished") {
          const s = stateRef.current;
          if (s && s.status === "playing") s.status = session.winner_id === myUserIdRef.current ? "won" : "lost";
        }
      },
      onCosmetics: (cosmetics) => {
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s) {
          s.oppPattern = cosmetics.orbPattern || "default";
          s.oppSkins = {
            station: cosmetics.stationSkin || "default",
            leftTower: cosmetics.leftTowerSkin || cosmetics.towerSkin || "default",
            rightTower: cosmetics.rightTowerSkin || cosmetics.towerSkin || "default",
            stationEmblem: cosmetics.stationEmblem || "default",
            leftTowerEmblem: cosmetics.leftTowerEmblem || "default",
            rightTowerEmblem: cosmetics.rightTowerEmblem || "default",
          };
        }
      },
    });
  }, [abilitiesParam, mode]);

  // Game loop
  useEffect(() => {
    if (searching || !stateRef.current) return;
    lastTimeRef.current = performance.now();
    const loop = (now) => {
      const s = stateRef.current;
      if (!s) return;
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - lastTimeRef.current) / 1000);
      lastTimeRef.current = now;
      const isMP = !!mpRef.current;
      const skipAI = isMP || mode === "tutorial";
      update(s, dt, skipAI ? null : (st, d) => runAI(aiRef.current, st, d));
      if (isMP) {
        // Override opponent HP from sync (authoritative) and re-evaluate win/loss
        s.opponent.hp = oppHeartbeatRef.current.hp;
        if (s.player.hp <= 0 && s.opponent.hp <= 0) s.status = "draw";
        else if (s.opponent.hp <= 0) s.status = "won";
        else if (s.player.hp <= 0) s.status = "lost";
        else s.status = "playing";
        if (s.status === "playing") {
          heartbeatTimerRef.current += dt;
          if (heartbeatTimerRef.current >= 3) {
            heartbeatTimerRef.current = 0;
            mpRef.current?.sendHeartbeat(s.player.hp, s.time);
          }
          const oppTs = oppHeartbeatRef.current.ts;
          if (oppTs > 0) {
            const staleSec = (Date.now() - oppTs) / 1000;
            if (staleSec > 6) {
              const remaining = Math.max(0, 25 - (staleSec - 6));
              const remInt = Math.ceil(remaining);
              if (!showDisconnectRef.current) { showDisconnectRef.current = true; setShowDisconnect(true); }
              if (remInt !== disconnectTimerRef.current) { disconnectTimerRef.current = remInt; setDisconnectTimer(remInt); }
              if (remaining <= 0) s.status = "won";
            } else if (showDisconnectRef.current) {
              showDisconnectRef.current = false; setShowDisconnect(false);
            }
          }
        }
      }
      if (Math.floor(now / 100) !== Math.floor((now - dt * 1000) / 100)) {
        setHud({
          playerHp: s.player.hp,
          oppHp: s.opponent.hp,
          coins: s.player.coins,
          abilities: s.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })),
          status: s.status,
          time: s.time,
          combo: s.combo,
          targeting: s.targeting ? { selected: s.targeting.selected.length, max: s.targeting.max } : null,
          aiming: s.aiming?.ability || null,
          burnerArmed: !!s.player.burner?.armed,
          firstPlacement: !!s.player.firstPlacement,
          overtimeTimer: s.overtimeTimer,
          overtimeActive: s.overtimeActive,
          maxPressure: s.maxPressureActive,
          escalationTier: s.escalationTier || 0,
          clickDamage: s.clickDamage || 12,
          clicks: s.player.clicks,
          maxClicks: s.player.maxClicks,
          clickEmptyFlash: s.clickEmptyFlash || 0,
        });
      }
      if (s.status !== "playing") {
        if (!resultSavedRef.current) {
          resultSavedRef.current = true;
          handleMatchEnd(s.status);
        }
        return;
      }
      rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    };
    rafRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(rafRef.current);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [searching]);

  const profileTrophiesRef = useRef(0);
  const leagueMaxRef = useRef(5);
  const handLevelRef = useRef(0);
  const towerMenuAnytimeRef = useRef(false);
  const myCosmeticsRef = useRef({ orbPattern: "default", stationSkin: "default", towerSkin: "default" });
  const [resultData, setResultData] = useState(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((me) => {
      myUserIdRef.current = me.id;
      tutorialActiveRef.current = mode === "tutorial";
      if (mode === "tutorial") setTutorialSkippable(me.tutorial_done === true || new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("from") === "settings");
      profileTrophiesRef.current = me.trophies || 0;
      handLevelRef.current = me.hand_level || 0;
      towerMenuAnytimeRef.current = me.tower_menu_anytime === true;
      setFitToScreen(me.fit_to_screen !== false);
      setShowMaximizeToggle(me.show_maximize_toggle !== false);
      syncFromProfile(me);
      myCosmeticsRef.current = {
        orbPattern: me.equipped_orb_pattern || "default",
        stationSkin: me.equipped_station_skin || "default",
        towerSkin: me.equipped_tower_skin || "default",
        leftTowerSkin: me.equipped_left_tower_skin || me.equipped_tower_skin || "default",
        rightTowerSkin: me.equipped_right_tower_skin || me.equipped_tower_skin || "default",
        stationEmblem: me.equipped_station_emblem || "default",
        leftTowerEmblem: me.equipped_left_tower_emblem || "default",
        rightTowerEmblem: me.equipped_right_tower_emblem || "default",
      };
      const p = normalizeProfile(me);
      const towerMeta = {};
      const abilityMeta = {};
      const orbMeta = {};
      for (const id of Object.keys(p.tower_cards)) towerMeta[id] = p.tower_cards[id].level || 1;
      for (const id of Object.keys(p.ability_cards)) abilityMeta[id] = p.ability_cards[id].level || 1;
      for (const id of Object.keys(p.orb_cards)) orbMeta[id] = p.orb_cards[id].level || 1;
      metaLevelsRef.current = { towers: towerMeta, abilities: abilityMeta, orbs: orbMeta, sideTower: me.side_tower_level || 0 };
      if (mode === "tutorial") { beginMatch(false); return; }
      if (mode === "training") { beginMatch(false); return; }
      if (mode === "private" && privateSessionId) { return; } // handled by the private-join effect below
      base44.functions.invoke("getActiveSession", {}).then((res) => {
        if (res.data?.active && res.data.sessionId) setRejoinData(res.data);
      }).catch(() => {});
    }).catch((e) => {
      console.error("[Game] auth.me failed", e);
      if (mode === "training" || mode === "tutorial") beginMatch(false);
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [beginMatch]);

  // Private match: join a pre-created session directly (no matchmaking queue).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== "private" || !privateSessionId) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await base44.functions.invoke("getActiveSession", { sessionId: privateSessionId });
        if (cancelled) return;
        if (res.data?.active && res.data.sessionId) {
          beginMultiplayerMatch({
            sessionId: res.data.sessionId,
            opponent: res.data.opponent,
            seed: res.data.seed,
            role: res.data.role,
          });
        } else {
          // Session no longer active — bail to home.
          navigate("/");
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (!cancelled) setTimeout(() => navigate("/"), 1500);
      }
    })();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [mode, privateSessionId, beginMultiplayerMatch]);

  // Casual/ranked: search for a human opponent via matchmake.
  // The 15s AI fallback is driven by the local countdown (effect below), not the
  // server's searchSeconds, so a stale queue entry can never trigger an early fallback.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searching || stateRef.current) return;
    if (mode === "training" || mode === "private" || mode === "tutorial") return;
    let cancelled = false;
    // Delete any leftover 'waiting' entries for this user so the server's elapsed
    // restarts at 0 (a stale entry from a previous search would inflate searchSeconds).
    if (myUserIdRef.current) {
      base44.entities.MatchmakingQueue.filter({ player_id: myUserIdRef.current, status: "waiting" })
        .then((entries) => { for (const e of entries) base44.entities.MatchmakingQueue.delete(e.id).catch(() => {}); })
        .catch(() => {});
    }
    const poll = async () => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      try {
        const res = await base44.functions.invoke("matchmake", { mode, client_version: APP_VERSION });
        if (cancelled || !searching || stateRef.current) return;
        if (res.data && res.data.sessionId) { beginMultiplayerMatch(res.data); return; }
        setTimeout(poll, 2000);
      } catch (e) {
        if (e?.response?.status === 426) { forceVersionUpdate(e.response.data?.min_required_version); return; }
        setTimeout(poll, 2000);
      }
    };
    poll();
    return () => { cancelled = true; };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [searching, mode, beginMatch, beginMultiplayerMatch]);

  // Casual 15s AI fallback: triggered by the local countdown hitting 0, independent
  // of the server's elapsed time so it can never fire before 15 seconds.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searching || stateRef.current) return;
    if (mode === "training" || mode === "private" || mode === "tutorial") return;
    if (searchTime > 0) return;
    setSearchToast(t("game.noPlayerFound"));
    const to = setTimeout(() => { if (searching && !stateRef.current) beginMatch(false); }, 1400);
    return () => clearTimeout(to);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [searching, mode, searchTime, beginMatch]);

  // Smooth 1s search countdown (casual + ranked) so the number ticks every second.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searching || mode === "training" || mode === "private" || mode === "tutorial") return;
    setSearchTime(mode === "ranked" ? 30 : 15);
    const iv = setInterval(() => setSearchTime((s) => Math.max(0, s - 1)), 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [searching, mode]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searching) {
      setShowTip(true);
      const t = setTimeout(() => setShowTip(false), 6000);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  }, [searching]);

  // Android back-button / popstate: show forfeit confirm before leaving
  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode === "tutorial") return;
    if (searching || resultData) return;
    const handler = (e) => {
      if (!stateRef.current || stateRef.current.status !== "playing") return;
      e.preventDefault();
      setShowForfeitDialog(true);
      window.history.pushState(null, "", window.location.href);
    };
    window.history.pushState(null, "", window.location.href);
    window.addEventListener("popstate", handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("popstate", handler);
  }, [searching, resultData]);

  const handleMatchEnd = useCallback(async (status) => {
    if (!matchInfo) return;
    const won = status === "won";
    if (won) sfx.victory(); else sfx.defeat();
    const isMultiplayer = !!matchInfo.multiplayer;
    const gameTime = Math.floor(stateRef.current?.time || 0);

    if (isMultiplayer) {
      try {
        const res = await base44.functions.invoke("finalizeMatch", {
          sessionId: mpInfoRef.current?.sessionId,
          outcome: won ? "win" : "loss",
          gameTime,
        });
        const d = res.data || {};
        const iWon = d.iWon ?? won;
        const oldTrophies = d.oldTrophies ?? profileTrophiesRef.current;
        const newTrophies = d.myNewTrophies ?? oldTrophies;
        setResultData({
          won: iWon, change: d.myChange || 0,
          opponent: matchInfo.opponentName, opponentId: matchInfo.opponentId,
          oldTrophies, newTrophies,
          oldLeague: d.oldLeague || getLeague(oldTrophies),
          newLeague: d.newLeague || getLeague(newTrophies),
          promoted: d.promoted, demoted: d.demoted,
          shardDrop: d.shardDrop, shardCrateAmt: d.shardCrateAmt,
          orbUnlocks: d.orbUnlocks || [], towerUnlocks: d.towerUnlocks || [],
          achievementUnlocks: d.achievementUnlocks || [],
          shardsEarned: d.myShardIncome || 0,
        });
        if (d.shardDrop && d.shardCrateAmt > 0) {
          setShardCrateAmount(d.shardCrateAmt);
          setTimeout(() => setShowShardCrate(true), 500);
        }
        if (iWon) {
          const end = Date.now() + 1200;
          (function frame() { confetti({ particleCount: 6, spread: 70, startVelocity: 45, origin: { x: Math.random(), y: 0.2 } }); if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame); })();
        }
      } catch (e) {
        if (e?.data?.error === "eula_required") { navigate("/"); return; }
        showErrorToast(e, t, navigate);
      }
      mpRef.current?.destroy(); mpRef.current = null;
      return;
    }

    // AI / training / casual — all go through finalizeAiMatch (server-side)
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("finalizeAiMatch", {
        mode: matchInfo.mode,
        outcome: won ? "win" : "loss",
        gameTime,
      });
      const d = res.data || {};
      if (d.training) {
        setResultData({ won, change: 0, opponent: matchInfo.opponentName, training: true });
      } else {
        setResultData({
          won: d.won, change: d.change,
          opponent: d.opponentName || matchInfo.opponentName,
          opponentId: matchInfo.opponentId,
          oldTrophies: d.oldTrophies, newTrophies: d.newTrophies,
          oldLeague: d.oldLeague, newLeague: d.newLeague,
          promoted: d.promoted, demoted: d.demoted,
          shardDrop: d.shardDrop, shardCrateAmt: d.shardCrateAmt,
          orbUnlocks: d.orbUnlocks || [], towerUnlocks: d.towerUnlocks || [],
          achievementUnlocks: d.achievementUnlocks || [],
          shardsEarned: d.shardsEarned || 0,
        });
        if (d.shardDrop && d.shardCrateAmt > 0) {
          setShardCrateAmount(d.shardCrateAmt);
          setTimeout(() => setShowShardCrate(true), 500);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // EULA requirement — redirect to Home for re-acceptance
      if (e?.data?.error === "eula_required") { navigate("/"); return; }
      // Security rejection (match_too_short, ai_daily_cap, outcome_mismatch, rate_limited)
      showErrorToast(e, t, navigate);
      // Show result without persistence
      setResultData({ won, change: 0, opponent: matchInfo.opponentName, training: matchInfo.mode === "training" });
    }
    if (won) {
      const end = Date.now() + 1200;
      (function frame() { confetti({ particleCount: 6, spread: 70, startVelocity: 45, origin: { x: Math.random(), y: 0.2 } }); if (Date.now() < end) requestAnimationFrame(frame); })();
    }
  }, [matchInfo]);

  // Canvas interactions
  const getCanvasPos = (e) => {
    const canvas = e.currentTarget;
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    const x = ((e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * GAME_WIDTH;
    const y = ((e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * GAME_HEIGHT;
    return { x, y };
  };

  const handleCanvasClick = (e) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s || s.status !== "playing") return;
    if (placementMode.active) return;
    setShowTip(false);
    const { x, y } = getCanvasPos(e);

    // 1. coin pickups (top priority)
    let coin = null, coinD = Infinity;
    for (const c of s.coinPickups) {
      const d = Math.hypot(c.x - x, c.y - y);
      if (d <= 40 && d < coinD) { coinD = d; coin = c; }
    }
    if (coin) {
      collectCoin(s, coin.id);
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      sfx.coin();
      return;
    }

    // Edit mode: only tower selection matters; orbs are ignored.
    if (s.editMode) {
      let tw = null, td = Infinity;
      for (const t of s.player.towers) {
        if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(t.x - x, t.y - y);
        if (d <= 34 && d < td) { td = d; tw = t; }
      }
      if (tw) {
        s.player.selectedTower = tw.id;
        const twCard = tw.cardLevel || metaLevelsRef.current.towers?.[tw.type] || 1;
        setSelectedTower({ id: tw.id, type: tw.type, level: tw.level || 1, cardLevel: twCard, x: tw.x, y: tw.y, maxLevel: getTowerMaxLevel(twCard, leagueMaxRef.current) });
      } else if (selectedTower) {
        s.player.selectedTower = null; setSelectedTower(null);
      }
      return;
    }

    // 2. targeting mode (portal)
    if (s.targeting) {
      let orb = null, od = Infinity;
      for (const o of s.orbs) {
        if (o.side !== 0 || o.hp <= 0) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(o.x - x, o.y - y);
        if (d <= o.radius + 8 && d < od) { od = d; orb = o; }
      }
      if (orb) {
        addTargetOrb(s, orb.id);
        setHud((h) => ({ ...h, targeting: s.targeting ? { selected: s.targeting.selected.length, max: s.targeting.max } : null }));
        if (!s.targeting && s.lastPortal && mpRef.current) {
          mpRef.current.sendAction("portal", { orbs: s.lastPortal }, s.time);
          s.lastPortal = null;
        }
      }
      return;
    }

    // aiming an aimed ability (meteor, glue, speed_zone, damage_zone, frost_zone)
    if (s.aiming) {
      const aimAb = s.aiming.ability;
      const ok = confirmAim(s, x, y);
      if (ok) {
        setHud((h) => ({ ...h, abilities: s.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })), aiming: null }));
        if (mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("ability", { abilityId: aimAb, x, y }, s.time);
      }
      return;
    }
    // burner is armed — ignore taps (hold to burn)
    if (s.player.burner && s.player.burner.armed) return;

    // 3. placing a tower — one per grid cell; exit placing after attempt
    if (placing) {
      const tower = placeTower(s, placing, x, y);
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      if (tower) {
        sfx.place();
        if (tutorialStepRef.current === 1) advanceTutorial();
      }
      if (tower && mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("placeTower", { id: tower.id, type: tower.type, cardLevel: tower.cardLevel, x: tower.x, y: tower.y, gridCol: tower.gridCol, gridRow: tower.gridRow, hp: tower.hp, maxHp: tower.maxHp, level: tower.level }, s.time);
      setPlacing(null);
      previewRef.current = { placing: null, mx: 0, my: 0 };
      return;
    }

    // 4. cleanse an infected tower (placed or side) on tap
    let infected = null, infD = Infinity;
    const checkInf = (t) => {
      if ((t.hp ?? 0) <= 0 || !(t.poisonTimer > 0)) return;
      const d = Math.hypot(t.x - x, t.y - y);
      if (d <= 30 && d < infD) { infD = d; infected = t; }
    };
    for (const t of s.player.towers) checkInf(t);
    for (const t of s.player.sideTowers) checkInf(t);
    if (infected) {
      cleanseTower(s, infected);
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h }));
      return;
    }

    // 7. click an orb — checked before tower selection so an orb overlapping a tower wins
    let target = null, bestD = Infinity;
    for (const orb of s.orbs) {
      if (orb.side !== 0 || orb.hp <= 0) continue;
      const d = Math.hypot(orb.x - x, orb.y - y);
      if (d <= orb.radius * 1.5 && d < bestD) { bestD = d; target = orb; }
    }
    if (target) {
      const hit = clickOrb(s, target.id);
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      if (hit) {
        sfx.click();
        if (tutorialStepRef.current === 0) {
          hideCoachmark();
          orbTapCountRef.current += 1;
          setOrbTapCount(orbTapCountRef.current);
          if (orbTapCountRef.current >= 5) advanceTutorial();
        }
      }
      if (selectedTower) { s.player.selectedTower = null; setSelectedTower(null); }
      return;
    }

    // 8. select a placed tower — only when 'open anytime' setting is on (edit mode handled above)
    if (towerMenuAnytimeRef.current) {
      let tw = null, td = Infinity;
      for (const t of s.player.towers) {
        if ((t.hp ?? 60) <= 0) continue;
        const d = Math.hypot(t.x - x, t.y - y);
        if (d <= 30 && d < td) { td = d; tw = t; }
      }
      if (tw) {
        s.player.selectedTower = tw.id;
        const twCard = tw.cardLevel || metaLevelsRef.current.towers?.[tw.type] || 1;
        setSelectedTower({ id: tw.id, type: tw.type, level: tw.level || 1, cardLevel: twCard, x: tw.x, y: tw.y, maxLevel: getTowerMaxLevel(twCard, leagueMaxRef.current) });
        return;
      }
    }

    // 9. empty tap deselects
    if (selectedTower) { s.player.selectedTower = null; setSelectedTower(null); }
  };

  const handlePointerDown = (e) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s || s.status !== "playing") return;
    if (s.player.burner && s.player.burner.armed) {
      const { x, y } = getCanvasPos(e);
      startBurnerHold(s, x, y);
    }
  };
  const handlePointerMove = (e) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    const { x, y } = getCanvasPos(e);
    previewRef.current = { placing: previewRef.current.placing, mx: x, my: y };
    if (s && s.player.burner && s.player.burner.holding) updateBurnerHold(s, x, y);
  };
  const handlePointerUp = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s && s.player.burner && s.player.burner.holding) endBurnerHold(s);
  };

  const handleAbilityUse = (id) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    // Using an ability exits edit mode so it fires in normal-play context
    if (editMode) {
      setEditMode(false);
      s.editMode = false;
      s.player.selectedTower = null;
      setSelectedTower(null);
    }
    if (s.targeting && id === "portal") return; // already targeting
    if (s.aiming && id !== s.aiming.ability) return;
    if (s.player.burner && s.player.burner.armed) {
      if (id === "burner") { cancelBurner(s); setHud((h) => ({ ...h, burnerArmed: false })); return; }
      return;
    }
    activateAbility(s, id);
    sfx.ability();
    if (tutorialStepRef.current === 3) {
      hideCoachmark();
      const step = 3;
      setTimeout(() => { if (tutorialStepRef.current === step) advanceTutorial(); }, 2500);
    }
    setHud((h) => ({
      ...h,
      abilities: s.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })),
      targeting: s.targeting ? { selected: s.targeting.selected.length, max: s.targeting.max } : h.targeting,
      aiming: s.aiming?.ability || null,
      burnerArmed: !!s.player.burner?.armed,
    }));
    if (mpRef.current && !s.targeting && !s.aiming && !(s.player.burner && s.player.burner.armed)) {
      mpRef.current.sendAction("ability", { abilityId: id }, s.time);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmTargeting = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s || !s.targeting) return;
    const result = confirmTargeting(s);
    setHud((h) => ({ ...h, targeting: null, abilities: s.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })) }));
    if (mpRef.current && result?.portaledOrbs) mpRef.current.sendAction("portal", { orbs: result.portaledOrbs }, s.time);
    if (mpRef.current && result?.ability && result.ability !== "portal") mpRef.current.sendAction("ability", { abilityId: result.ability }, s.time);
  };

  const handleCancelTargeting = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    cancelTargeting(s);
    setHud((h) => ({ ...h, targeting: null }));
  };

  const handleOpenPlacement = () => {
    const typeId = lastOrbRef.current || loadoutOrbs[0];
    setPlacementMode({ active: true, typeId });
    setShowTip(false);
    if (tutorialStepRef.current === 4) hideCoachmark();
  };
  const handlePlaceOrbAtSlot = (slotIndex) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s || !placementMode.active) return;
    const result = placeOrbAtSlot(s, placementMode.typeId, slotIndex);
    if (result) {
      lastOrbRef.current = placementMode.typeId;
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      if (mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("buyOrb", result, s.time);
      if (tutorialStepRef.current === 4) {
        const step = 4;
        setTimeout(() => { if (tutorialStepRef.current === step) advanceTutorial(); }, 2500);
      }
    }
  };
  const handleSwitchPlacementOrb = (typeId) => {
    setPlacementMode({ active: true, typeId });
  };
  const handleCancelPlacement = () => {
    setPlacementMode({ active: false, typeId: null });
  };
  const handleToggleEditMode = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    const next = !editMode;
    setEditMode(next);
    if (s) s.editMode = next;
    if (!next && selectedTower) { s.player.selectedTower = null; setSelectedTower(null); }
    if (next && tutorialStepRef.current === 2) hideCoachmark();
    if (!next && tutorialStepRef.current === 2 && tutorialUpgradedRef.current) {
      tutorialSubstepRef.current = null;
      setTutorialSubstep(null);
      advanceTutorial();
    }
  };

  const handleSelectTower = (type) => {
    setPlacing(type);
    previewRef.current = { placing: type, mx: previewRef.current.mx, my: previewRef.current.my };
    if (type) setShowTip(false);
    if (type && tutorialStepRef.current === 1) hideCoachmark();
  };

  const handleUpgrade = (id) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    if (upgradeTower(s, id)) {
      const tw = s.player.towers.find((t) => t.id === id);
      const twCard = tw?.cardLevel || 1;
      setSelectedTower((cur) => (cur && tw ? { ...cur, level: tw.level, cardLevel: twCard, maxLevel: getTowerMaxLevel(twCard, leagueMaxRef.current) } : null));
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      if (mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("upgradeTower", { towerId: id }, s.time);
      if (tutorialStepRef.current === 2) {
        tutorialUpgradedRef.current = true;
        // Prompt the player to close edit mode as an explicit substep.
        tutorialSubstepRef.current = "closeEdit";
        setTutorialSubstep("closeEdit");
        setCoachmarkHidden(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSell = (id) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    sellTower(s, id);
    setSelectedTower(null);
    setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
    if (mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("sellTower", { towerId: id }, s.time);
  };

  const closeTowerPopup = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s) s.player.selectedTower = null;
    setSelectedTower(null);
  };

  const handleForfeit = async () => {
    setPlacementMode({ active: false, typeId: null });
    setEditMode(false);
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s) s.editMode = false;
    if (mpRef.current && mpInfoRef.current) {
      mpRef.current.sendAction("forfeit", {}, s?.time || 0);
      try {
        await base44.functions.invoke("finalizeMatch", {
          sessionId: mpInfoRef.current.sessionId, outcome: "forfeit", gameTime: Math.floor(s?.time || 0),
        });
      } catch (e) {}
      mpRef.current.destroy(); mpRef.current = null;
    }
    navigate("/");
  };

  const handleClaimVictory = () => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (s && s.status === "playing") s.status = "won";
  };

  const handleRejoinMatch = useCallback(() => {
    if (!rejoinData) return;
    const { sessionId, opponent, seed, role, events_a, events_b, gameTime, myHp, oppHp } = rejoinData;
    let chosenAbilities = ["zap", "portal", "repair"];
    try { if (abilitiesParam) chosenAbilities = JSON.parse(abilitiesParam); } catch (e) {}
    const leagueScale = getLeagueOrbScale(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const clickDmg = getClickDamage(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    const leagueMax = getLeagueMaxLevel(profileTrophiesRef.current || 0);
    leagueMaxRef.current = leagueMax;
    const maxClicks = 20 + (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 2;
    const rechargeInterval = Math.max(0.1, 0.5 - (handLevelRef.current || 0) * 0.04);
    stateRef.current = createInitialState(chosenAbilities, 1, metaLevelsRef.current, leagueScale, clickDmg, leagueMax, seed, maxClicks, rechargeInterval, mode);
    stateRef.current.playerTrophies = profileTrophiesRef.current || 0;
    stateRef.current.playerPattern = myCosmeticsRef.current.orbPattern;
    stateRef.current.playerSkins = cosmeticsBundle(myCosmeticsRef.current);
    const oppCosm = rejoinData.oppCosmetics || {};
    stateRef.current.oppPattern = oppCosm.orbPattern || "default";
    stateRef.current.oppSkins = {
      station: oppCosm.stationSkin || "default",
      leftTower: oppCosm.leftTowerSkin || oppCosm.towerSkin || "default",
      rightTower: oppCosm.rightTowerSkin || oppCosm.towerSkin || "default",
      stationEmblem: oppCosm.stationEmblem || "default",
      leftTowerEmblem: oppCosm.leftTowerEmblem || "default",
      rightTowerEmblem: oppCosm.rightTowerEmblem || "default",
    };
    aiRef.current = null;
    // Restore towers from action log (skip transient orbs/abilities)
    const myEvents = role === "a" ? (events_a || []) : (events_b || []);
    const oppEvents = role === "a" ? (events_b || []) : (events_a || []);
    for (const ev of myEvents) {
      if (ev.type === "placeTower") {
        stateRef.current.player.towers.push({ id: ev.payload.id, type: ev.payload.type, cardLevel: ev.payload.cardLevel, x: ev.payload.x, y: ev.payload.y, gridCol: ev.payload.gridCol, gridRow: ev.payload.gridRow, cd: 0.3, hp: ev.payload.hp, maxHp: ev.payload.maxHp, level: ev.payload.level, spawn: 0 });
      } else if (ev.type === "upgradeTower") {
        const t = stateRef.current.player.towers.find((tw) => tw.id === ev.payload.towerId);
        if (t) { const next = getTowerStats(t.type, (t.level || 1) + 1, t.cardLevel || 1); t.level = (t.level || 1) + 1; t.maxHp = next.maxHp; t.hp = next.maxHp; }
      } else if (ev.type === "sellTower") {
        stateRef.current.player.towers = stateRef.current.player.towers.filter((tw) => tw.id !== ev.payload.towerId);
      }
    }
    for (const ev of oppEvents) {
      if (ev.type === "placeTower") remotePlaceTower(stateRef.current, ev.payload);
      else if (ev.type === "upgradeTower") remoteUpgradeTower(stateRef.current, ev.payload.towerId);
      else if (ev.type === "sellTower") remoteSellTower(stateRef.current, ev.payload.towerId);
    }
    stateRef.current.time = gameTime || 0;
    stateRef.current.player.hp = myHp || 120;
    stateRef.current.opponent.hp = oppHp || 120;
    stateRef.current.player.firstPlacement = stateRef.current.player.towers.length === 0;
    mpInfoRef.current = { sessionId, role, seed, opponent };
    const mp = createSyncManager(sessionId, role, myCosmeticsRef.current);
    mpRef.current = mp;
    setMatchInfo({ opponentName: opponent.name, opponentTrophies: opponent.trophies, vsReal: true, mode, multiplayer: true, opponentId: rejoinData.opponentId });
    setRejoinData(null);
    setSearching(false);
    setHud({
      playerHp: stateRef.current.player.hp, oppHp: stateRef.current.opponent.hp,
      coins: stateRef.current.player.coins,
      abilities: stateRef.current.player.abilities.map((a) => ({ ...a })),
      status: "playing", time: stateRef.current.time, combo: 0, targeting: null, aiming: null,
      burnerArmed: false, firstPlacement: stateRef.current.player.firstPlacement,
      clickDamage: stateRef.current.clickDamage || 12,
      clicks: stateRef.current.player.clicks, maxClicks: stateRef.current.player.maxClicks, clickEmptyFlash: 0,
      escalationTier: 0,
    });
    mp.subscribe({
      onRemoteAction: (action) => {
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s && s.status === "playing") mp.applyRemoteAction(action, s);
      },
      onHeartbeat: ({ ts, hp }) => {
        oppHeartbeatRef.current = { ts, hp };
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s) { s.opponent.hp = hp; setHud((h) => ({ ...h, oppHp: hp })); }
      },
      onStatusChange: (status, session) => {
        if (status === "finished") {
          const s = stateRef.current;
          if (s && s.status === "playing") s.status = session.winner_id === myUserIdRef.current ? "won" : "lost";
        }
      },
      onCosmetics: (cosmetics) => {
        const s = stateRef.current;
        if (s) {
          s.oppPattern = cosmetics.orbPattern || "default";
          s.oppSkins = {
            station: cosmetics.stationSkin || "default",
            leftTower: cosmetics.leftTowerSkin || cosmetics.towerSkin || "default",
            rightTower: cosmetics.rightTowerSkin || cosmetics.towerSkin || "default",
            stationEmblem: cosmetics.stationEmblem || "default",
            leftTowerEmblem: cosmetics.leftTowerEmblem || "default",
            rightTowerEmblem: cosmetics.rightTowerEmblem || "default",
          };
        }
      },
    });
  }, [abilitiesParam, mode, rejoinData]);

  // ---- Drag-to-place ----
  const getCanvasPosFromScreen = (screenX, screenY) => {
    const rect = canvasWrapRef.current?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!rect) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const x = ((screenX - rect.left) / rect.width) * GAME_WIDTH - 16;
    const offsetY = 36;
    const y = ((screenY - offsetY - rect.top) / rect.height) * GAME_HEIGHT;
    return { x, y };
  };

  const handleDragStart = (type) => {
    dragStateRef.current = { active: true, type };
    setPlacing(type);
    setShowTip(false);
    if (tutorialStepRef.current === 1) hideCoachmark();
  };

  const handleDragMove = (screenX, screenY) => {
    const { x, y } = getCanvasPosFromScreen(screenX, screenY);
    previewRef.current = { placing: dragStateRef.current.type, mx: x, my: y };
  };

  const handleDragEnd = (screenX, screenY) => {
    const s = stateRef.current;
    if (!s || !dragStateRef.current.active) { dragStateRef.current = { active: false, type: null }; return; }
    const { x, y } = getCanvasPosFromScreen(screenX, screenY);
    if (y > WALL_Y + WALL_THICKNESS && y < GAME_HEIGHT - 24 && x > 20 && x < GAME_WIDTH - 20) {
      const tower = placeTower(s, dragStateRef.current.type, x, y);
      setHud((h) => ({ ...h, coins: s.player.coins }));
      if (tower && tutorialStepRef.current === 1) advanceTutorial();
      if (tower && mpRef.current) mpRef.current.sendAction("placeTower", { id: tower.id, type: tower.type, cardLevel: tower.cardLevel, x: tower.x, y: tower.y, gridCol: tower.gridCol, gridRow: tower.gridRow, hp: tower.hp, maxHp: tower.maxHp, level: tower.level }, s.time);
    }
    dragStateRef.current = { active: false, type: null };
    setPlacing(null);
    previewRef.current = { placing: null, mx: 0, my: 0 };
  };

  const selectedTowerAlive = selectedTower && stateRef.current?.player.towers.some((t) => t.id === selectedTower.id && (t.hp ?? 60) > 0);

  const tutorialSteps = [
    { targetRef: canvasWrapRef, title: t("tutorial.step1Title"), body: t("tutorial.step1Body"), progress: { label: `${orbTapCount}/5`, pct: Math.min(100, (orbTapCount / 5) * 100) } },
    { targetRef: towerTrayRef, title: t("tutorial.step2Title"), body: t("tutorial.step2Body") },
    { targetRef: editToggleRef, title: t("tutorial.step4Title"), body: t("tutorial.step4Body") },
    { targetRef: abilitiesOnlyRef, title: t("tutorial.step3Title"), body: t("tutorial.step3Body") },
    { targetRef: orbShopRef, title: t("tutorial.step5Title"), body: t("tutorial.step5Body") },
    { targetRef: null, title: t("tutorial.step6Title"), body: t("tutorial.step6Body"), cta: t("tutorial.go") },
  ];

  // "Close edit mode" substep: shown right after upgrading a tower (step 2).
  const activeTutorialCoachmark = tutorialSubstep === "closeEdit" && tutorialStep === 2
    ? { targetRef: editToggleRef, title: t("tutorial.closeEditTitle"), body: t("tutorial.closeEditBody") }
    : tutorialSteps[tutorialStep];

  if (rejoinData) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
        <RejoinPrompt
          opponentName={rejoinData.opponent?.name || "Opponent"}
          onRejoin={handleRejoinMatch}
          onForfeit={async () => {
            try {
              await base44.functions.invoke("finalizeMatch", { sessionId: rejoinData.sessionId, outcome: "forfeit", gameTime: rejoinData.gameTime || 0 });
            } catch (e) {}
            setRejoinData(null);
            navigate("/");
          }}
        />
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (searching) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-900 px-4">
        <div className="text-5xl mb-6 animate-float-bob">{mode === "training" || mode === "tutorial" ? "🎯" : "🛰️"}</div>
        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-2 text-slate-500">{mode === "training" || mode === "tutorial" ? t("game.startingMatch") : mode === "ranked" ? t("game.searchingRanked") : t("game.searching")}</h2>
        {mode !== "training" && mode !== "tutorial" && (
          <>
            <div className="text-7xl font-black tabular-nums my-2 animate-searching-pulse">{Math.max(0, searchTime)}</div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{mode === "ranked" ? t("game.searchingRanked") : t("game.searchingHint")}</p>
            <button onClick={() => beginMatch(false)} className="mt-6 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 font-bold text-slate-600 text-sm">
              {t("game.playVsAi")}
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {searchToast && (
          <div className="fixed bottom-12 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold shadow-lg animate-pop-in">
            {searchToast}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (resultData) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-white flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-slate-900 px-4">
        {resultData.promoted && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-400/20 to-transparent animate-pulse" />
            <div className="relative text-center animate-pop-in">
              <div className="text-7xl mb-4">🎉</div>
              <h2 className="text-4xl font-black mb-2" style={{ color: resultData.newLeague?.color }}>{t("game.promoted")}</h2>
              <p className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-700">{t(`leagues.${resultData.newLeague?.id}`)} {t("game.leagueSuffix")}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        {resultData.demoted && !resultData.promoted && (
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">
            <div className="text-center animate-pop-in">
              <div className="text-5xl mb-3">⬇️</div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-black mb-1 text-rose-500">{t("game.demoted")}</h2>
              <p className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-600">{t(`leagues.${resultData.newLeague?.id}`)} {t("game.leagueSuffix")}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="text-7xl mb-4">{resultData.won ? "🏆" : "💥"}</div>
        <h2 className="text-4xl font-black mb-2">
          {resultData.training ? (resultData.won ? t("game.trainingWin") : t("game.trainingLoss")) : (resultData.won ? t("game.victory") : t("game.defeat"))}
        </h2>
        <div className="mb-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          <p className="text-slate-400">{t("game.vs")} {resultData.opponent}</p>
          {resultData.opponentId && (
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowReportDialog(true)}
              className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-500 transition-colors flex items-center gap-1"
            >
              <Flag className="w-3 h-3" /> {t("report.reportButton")}
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {resultData.training ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-8">{t("game.noTrophyChange")}</p>
        ) : (
          <>
            {resultData.change === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-slate-400 mb-3">{t("game.noTrophyChange")}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className={`text-2xl font-bold mb-3 ${resultData.change >= 0 ? "text-emerald-500" : "text-rose-500"}`}>
                {resultData.change >= 0 ? "+" : "−"}{t("game.trophiesChange", { n: Math.abs(resultData.change) })}
              </p>
            )}
            {resultData.shardsEarned > 0 && (
              <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 mb-3 animate-pop-in">
                <ShardIcon size={20} />
                <p className="text-lg font-bold text-lime-600">{t("game.shardsEarned", { n: resultData.shardsEarned })}</p>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
              <LeagueBadge trophies={resultData.oldTrophies || 0} size="sm" />
              <span className="text-slate-400 text-xl">→</span>
              <LeagueBadge trophies={resultData.newTrophies || 0} size="md" showLabel />
            </div>
            {resultData.shardDrop && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 animate-pop-in">
                <span className="text-3xl">💎</span>
                <p className="text-xl font-black text-violet-500">{t("shardCrate.reward", { n: resultData.shardCrateAmt || 1 })}</p>
              </div>
            )}
            {resultData.orbUnlocks?.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-6 animate-pop-in text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-500 mb-1">{t("game.newOrbUnlock")}</p>
                {resultData.orbUnlocks.map((id) => (
                  <p key={id} className="text-2xl font-black" style={{ color: ORB_TYPES[id]?.color }}>
                    {t(`orbs.${id}.name`)} {t("game.orbSuffix")}
                  </p>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            {resultData.towerUnlocks?.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-6 animate-pop-in text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-500 mb-1">{t("game.newTowerUnlock")}</p>
                {resultData.towerUnlocks.map((id) => (
                  <p key={id} className="text-2xl font-black" style={{ color: TOWER_TYPES[id]?.color }}>
                    {t(`towers.${id}.name`)}
                  </p>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
            {resultData.achievementUnlocks?.length > 0 && (
              <div className="mb-6 animate-pop-in text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-500 mb-2">{t("achievements.title")} ✨</p>
                {resultData.achievementUnlocks.map((a) => (
                  <div key={a.id} className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mb-1">
                    <span className="text-2xl">{a.icon}</span>
                    <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-700">{t(`achievements.${a.id}.name`)}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-500">
                      {t("game.claimInAwards")}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
        <div className="flex gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-400 font-bold">
            {t("game.home")}
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="px-6 py-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-700 font-bold">
            {t("game.playAgain")}
          </button>
        </div>
        {showShardCrate && (
          <ShardCrateReveal shards={shardCrateAmount} onClose={() => setShowShardCrate(false)} />
        )}
        {showReportDialog && resultData?.opponentId && (
          <ReportUserDialog
            reportedId={resultData.opponentId}
            reportedName={resultData.opponent}
            onClose={() => setShowReportDialog(false)}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className={`${useFitLayout ? "h-[100dvh] overflow-hidden" : "min-h-screen"} bg-gradient-to-b from-slate-100 via-blue-50 to-slate-100 flex flex-col text-slate-900`}>
      {/* Slim top bar */}
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-3 py-1.5 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur border-b border-slate-200" style={immersive ? undefined : { paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 0.375rem)" }}>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0 flex-1">
          <button
            onClick={mode === "tutorial" ? completeTutorial : () => setShowForfeitDialog(true)}
            className="shrink-0 w-10 h-10 min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors"
            aria-label={mode === "tutorial" ? t("game.home") : t("game.forfeit")}
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" />
          </button>
          <div className="flex flex-col min-w-0 gap-0.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 truncate">{matchInfo?.opponentName}</p>
              {matchInfo && !matchInfo.vsReal && (
                <span className="shrink-0 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-200 text-slate-500 text-[10px] font-black">{t("game.vsAi")}</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <span className={`self-start -ml-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold tabular-nums ${
            hud.escalationTier >= 5
              ? "bg-red-900 text-white animate-pulse"
              : hud.escalationTier >= 4
              ? "bg-orange-500 text-white animate-pulse"
              : hud.escalationTier >= 3
              ? "bg-red-200 text-red-700 animate-pulse"
              : hud.escalationTier >= 2
              ? "bg-red-100 text-red-600 animate-pulse"
              : hud.overtimeActive
              ? "bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 animate-pulse"
              : hud.overtimeTimer <= 30
              ? "bg-red-50 text-red-500 animate-pulse"
              : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
          }`}>
            {hud.escalationTier >= 5
              ? t("game.towerBleed")
              : hud.escalationTier >= 4
              ? t("game.maxPressure")
              : hud.escalationTier >= 3
              ? t("game.critical")
              : hud.escalationTier >= 2
              ? t("game.intensifying")
              : hud.overtimeActive
              ? t("game.overtime")
              : `${Math.floor(hud.overtimeTimer / 60)}:${Math.floor(hud.overtimeTimer % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`}
          </span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <div
            className={`flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-full font-bold text-xs tabular-nums transition-all ${
              hud.clicks <= 0
                ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-500 animate-coin-bounce"
                : hud.clicks >= hud.maxClicks
                ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 ring-1 ring-emerald-300"
                : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
            }`}
            title={`Tap damage: ${hud.clickDamage || 12}`}
          >
            <span className="text-[11px]">👆</span>
            <span key={hud.clicks} className="inline-block animate-coin-bounce">{hud.clicks ?? 20}/{hud.maxClicks || 20}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-600 font-bold text-sm">
            <span className="inline-block w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-300 to-amber-500 shadow-sm" />
            <span key={hud.coins} className="inline-block animate-coin-bounce">{hud.coins}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Game field — portrait canvas */}
      <div className={`flex-1 flex items-center justify-center p-2 sm:p-4 ${useFitLayout ? "min-h-0" : ""}`}>
        <div className={`relative ${useFitLayout ? "h-full aspect-[600/900] max-w-[460px] max-h-[690px]" : "w-full max-w-[460px] aspect-[600/900]"}`}>
          <div ref={canvasWrapRef} className="absolute inset-0 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-xl">
            <GameCanvas
              stateRef={stateRef}
              onCanvasClick={handleCanvasClick}
              onCanvasPointerDown={handlePointerDown}
              onCanvasPointerMove={handlePointerMove}
              onCanvasPointerUp={handlePointerUp}
              previewRef={previewRef}
            />

            {fitToScreen && showMaximizeToggle && !placing && !hud.targeting && !hud.aiming && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setMaximized((m) => !m)}
                className="absolute top-2 left-2 z-20 w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/30 text-slate-500/60 hover:text-slate-700 hover:bg-white/40 transition-all active:scale-95"
                aria-label={maximized ? "Shrink to fit" : "Expand to full view"}
              >
                {maximized ? <Minimize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <Maximize2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
              </button>
            )}

            {/* Placement indicator + cancel */}
            {placing && (
              <>
                <div className="absolute top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2">
                  <div className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg animate-pop-in">
                    {t("game.placing", { name: TOWER_TYPES[placing]?.name })}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  onClick={() => { setPlacing(null); previewRef.current = { placing: null, mx: 0, my: 0 }; }}
                  className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg hover:bg-rose-600"
                >
                  {t("game.cancel")}
                </button>
              </>
            )}

            {/* Targeting (portal) bar */}
            {hud.targeting && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-indigo-600 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg animate-pop-in">
                  <span>{t("game.portal", { n: hud.targeting.selected, m: hud.targeting.max })}</span>
                  <button onClick={handleConfirmTargeting} className="px-4 py-2 min-h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-white text-indigo-600 font-black hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 transition-transform">{t("game.send")}</button>
                  <button onClick={handleCancelTargeting} className="w-9 h-9 min-h-[44px] flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-indigo-800 text-white hover:bg-indigo-900">✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Aiming hint (meteor / glue / zones) */}
            {hud.aiming && !placing && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20">
                <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg animate-pop-in">
                  {t(`game.${{ meteor: "meteorAim", glue: "glueAim", speed_zone: "speedZoneAim", damage_zone: "damageZoneAim", frost_zone: "frostZoneAim" }[hud.aiming] || "meteorAim"}`)}
                  <button onClick={() => { cancelAim(stateRef.current); setHud((h) => ({ ...h, aiming: null })); }} className="ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white text-rose-600 font-black">✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {/* Burner armed hint */}
            {hud.burnerArmed && !placing && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20">
                <div className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-orange-600 text-white text-xs font-bold shadow-lg animate-pop-in">
                  {t("game.burnerAim")}
                  <button onClick={() => { cancelBurner(stateRef.current); setHud((h) => ({ ...h, burnerArmed: false })); }} className="ml-2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-white text-orange-600 font-black">✕</button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            {/* Combo badge */}
            {hud.combo >= 2 && !placing && !hud.targeting && !hud.aiming && !hud.burnerArmed && (
              <div className="absolute top-2 right-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-rose-500 text-white font-black text-sm shadow-lg animate-ready-pulse">
                {t("game.combo", { n: hud.combo })}
              </div>
            )}

            {showTip && !placing && !hud.targeting && !hud.aiming && !hud.burnerArmed && tutorialStep === null && (
              <div className="absolute bottom-3 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-4 py-2 rounded-2xl bg-slate-900/90 text-white text-xs font-bold text-center shadow-lg max-w-[80%] animate-float-bob">
                {t("game.tip")}
              </div>
            )}

            {showDisconnect && mpRef.current && (
              <DisconnectOverlay
                opponentName={matchInfo?.opponentName || "Opponent"}
                secondsLeft={disconnectTimer}
                onClaimVictory={handleClaimVictory}
              />
            )}

            {hud.clickEmptyFlash > 0 && (
              <div className="absolute inset-0 pointer-events-none rounded-3xl shadow-[inset_0_0_50px_rgba(244,63,94,0.45)]" />
            )}

            {placementMode.active && hud.status === "playing" && (
              <PlacementOverlay
                activeTypeId={placementMode.typeId}
                equippedOrbs={loadoutOrbs}
                coins={hud.coins}
                onSlotTap={handlePlaceOrbAtSlot}
                onSwitchOrb={handleSwitchPlacementOrb}
                onCancel={handleCancelPlacement}
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Upgrade / sell popup — outside the clipped canvas so it can overflow */}
          {selectedTowerAlive && selectedTower && (
            <UpgradePopup
              tower={{ ...selectedTower, xPct: (selectedTower.x / GAME_WIDTH) * 100, yPct: (selectedTower.y / GAME_HEIGHT) * 100 }}
              coins={hud.coins}
              maxLevel={selectedTower.maxLevel || 5}
              onUpgrade={() => handleUpgrade(selectedTower.id)}
              onSell={() => handleSell(selectedTower.id)}
              onClose={closeTowerPopup}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Bottom HUD — abilities on top, towers below */}
      <div className="bg-white/90 backdrop-blur border-t border-slate-200 px-3 pt-3 pb-4">
        <div className="max-w-[460px] mx-auto flex flex-col gap-2">
          <div ref={abilityBarRef} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pb-5">
            <div ref={abilitiesOnlyRef}>
              <AbilityBar abilities={hud.abilities} onUse={handleAbilityUse} armedId={hud.aiming || (hud.burnerArmed ? "burner" : null)} />
            </div>
            <div ref={orbShopRef} className="relative">
              {placementMode.active ? (
                <div className="w-14 h-14" />
              ) : (
                <RadialOrbShop onOpenPlacement={handleOpenPlacement} />
              )}
              <EditModeToggle ref={editToggleRef} active={editMode} onClick={handleToggleEditMode} />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div ref={towerTrayRef} className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-100">
            <TowerTray
              unlocked={loadoutTowers}
              coins={hud.coins}
              selected={placing}
              onSelect={handleSelectTower}
              onDragStart={handleDragStart}
              onDragMove={handleDragMove}
              onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
              firstPlacement={hud.firstPlacement}
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {showForfeitDialog && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] bg-black/50 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center p-6">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full text-center shadow-2xl animate-pop-in">
            <div className="text-5xl mb-3">🏳️</div>
            <h3 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mb-2">{t("game.forfeitMatch")}?</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mb-6">{t("game.vs")} {matchInfo?.opponentName || "Opponent"}</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowForfeitDialog(false)}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300"
              >
                {t("game.cancel")}
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={async () => { setShowForfeitDialog(false); await handleForfeit(); }}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-xl bg-rose-500 text-white font-bold hover:bg-rose-600"
              >
                {t("game.forfeitMatch")}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {tutorialStep !== null && !searching && !resultData && !coachmarkHidden && activeTutorialCoachmark && (
        <TutorialCoachmark
          targetRef={activeTutorialCoachmark.targetRef}
          title={activeTutorialCoachmark.title}
          body={activeTutorialCoachmark.body}
          cta={activeTutorialCoachmark.cta}
          progress={activeTutorialCoachmark.progress}
          skippable={tutorialSkippable}
          onCta={completeTutorial}
          onSkip={completeTutorial}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Friends.jsx
