import React, { useEffect, useState, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import LeagueBadge from "@/components/LeagueBadge";
import { Users, UserPlus, Search, Swords, Check, X, Copy, Clock, ArrowLeft, Flag } from "lucide-react";
import useBackButton from "@/hooks/useBackButton";
import ReportUserDialog from "@/components/ReportUserDialog";
import { APP_VERSION } from "@/lib/appVersion";
import { useAuth } from "@/lib/AuthContext";

const INVITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 60000;

export default function Friends() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const { forceVersionUpdate } = useAuth();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [data, setData] = useState({ friends: [], incoming: [], outgoing: [], invites: [], myInvites: [] });
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("friends");
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [preview, setPreview] = useState(null);
  const [searching, setSearching] = useState(false);
  const [searchErr, setSearchErr] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  const [reportTarget, setReportTarget] = useState(null);
  const dataRef = useRef(data);
  dataRef.current = data;

  const showToast = useCallback((msg) => {
    setToast(msg);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 2500);
  }, []);

  // Android back button: mirror the in-app back button (return to Home).
  useBackButton(() => navigate("/"));

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("getFriends", {});
      if (res.data) setData(res.data);
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => setMe(m)).catch(() => setMe(null));
    load();
  }, [load]);

  // Live updates: subscribe to the three social entities and refetch on any change.
  useEffect(() => {
    let unsubs = [];
    let alive = true;
    const onEvent = () => { if (alive) load(); };
    (async () => {
      try {
        unsubs.push(base44.entities.FriendRequest.subscribe(onEvent));
        unsubs.push(base44.entities.Friendship.subscribe(onEvent));
        unsubs.push(base44.entities.GameInvite.subscribe(onEvent));
      } catch (e) {}
    })();
    return () => { alive = false; unsubs.forEach((u) => { try { u(); } catch (e) {} }); };
  }, [load]);

  // Auto-join when a game invite I sent gets accepted.
  useEffect(() => {
    const accepted = dataRef.current.myInvites?.find((inv) => inv.status === "accepted" && inv.session_id);
    if (accepted) navigate(`/game?mode=private&sessionId=${accepted.session_id}`);
  }, [data, navigate]);

  const doSearch = async () => {
    const u = query.trim();
    if (!u || searching) return;
    setSearching(true); setSearchErr(null); setPreview(null);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("lookupUserByUsername", { username: u });
      const r = res.data;
      if (!r?.found) setSearchErr(t("friends.notFound"));
      else if (r.isSelf) setSearchErr(t("friends.self"));
      else setPreview({ id: r.id, name: r.display_name, trophies: r.trophies });
    } catch (e) { setSearchErr(t("friends.searchError")); }
    setSearching(false);
  };

  const sendRequest = async () => {
    if (!preview) return;
    setBusy(preview.id);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("sendFriendRequest", { to_username: preview.name });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success) { showToast(t("friends.requestSent")); setPreview(null); setQuery(""); load(); }
      else if (r?.error === "already_friends") showToast(t("friends.alreadyFriends"));
      else if (r?.error === "already_pending") showToast(t("friends.alreadyPending"));
      else if (r?.error === "limit") showToast(t("friends.limit"));
      else showToast(t("friends.sendError"));
    } catch (e) { showToast(t("friends.sendError")); }
    setBusy(null);
  };

  const acceptRequest = async (requestId) => {
    setBusy(requestId);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("acceptFriendRequest", { requestId });
      if (res.data?.success) { showToast(t("friends.added")); load(); }
      else showToast(t("friends.sendError"));
    } catch (e) { showToast(t("friends.sendError")); }
    setBusy(null);
  };

  const declineRequest = async (requestId) => {
    setBusy(requestId);
    try { await base44.entities.FriendRequest.delete(requestId); } catch (e) {}
    setBusy(null); load();
  };

  const cancelRequest = async (requestId) => {
    setBusy(requestId);
    try { await base44.entities.FriendRequest.delete(requestId); } catch (e) {}
    setBusy(null); load();
  };

  const challenge = async (friendId, friendName) => {
    setBusy(friendId);
    try {
      await base44.entities.GameInvite.create({
        from_user_id: me.id,
        from_name: me.display_name || "Player",
        to_user_id: friendId,
        to_name: friendName,
        status: "pending",
      });
      showToast(t("friends.inviteSent"));
      load();
    } catch (e) { showToast(t("friends.sendError")); }
    setBusy(null);
  };

  const acceptInvite = async (inviteId) => {
    setBusy(inviteId);
    try {
      const res = await base44.functions.invoke("createPrivateMatch", { inviteId, client_version: APP_VERSION });
      const r = res.data;
      if (r?.success && r.sessionId) {
        navigate(`/game?mode=private&sessionId=${r.sessionId}`);
      } else if (r?.error === "expired") {
        showToast(t("friends.inviteExpired"));
        load();
      } else {
        showToast(t("friends.sendError"));
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (e?.response?.status === 426) { forceVersionUpdate(e.response.data?.min_required_version); return; }
      showToast(t("friends.sendError"));
    }
    setBusy(null);
  };

  const declineInvite = async (inviteId) => {
    setBusy(inviteId);
    try { await base44.entities.GameInvite.update(inviteId, { status: "declined" }); } catch (e) {}
    setBusy(null); load();
  };

  const cancelInvite = async (inviteId) => {
    setBusy(inviteId);
    try { await base44.entities.GameInvite.update(inviteId, { status: "cancelled" }); } catch (e) {}
    setBusy(null); load();
  };

  const copyUsername = async () => {
    if (!me?.display_name) return;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(me.display_name); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1500); } catch (e) {}
  };

  const incomingCount = data.incoming.length + data.invites.length;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 1.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-5">
          <button onClick={() => navigate("/")} className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-slate-300 transition-all">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600" />
          </button>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Users className="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" /> {t("friends.title")}
          </h1>
        </div>

        {/* My username card */}
        {me && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
            <p className="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-1">{t("friends.yourUsername")}</p>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-lg font-black text-slate-900 truncate">{me.display_name || "—"}</span>
                <LeagueBadge trophies={me.trophies || 0} size="sm" />
              </div>
              <button onClick={copyUsername} className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors shrink-0" title={t("friends.copy")}>
                {copied ? <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-500" /> : <Copy className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-500" />}
              </button>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 mt-1">{t("friends.shareHint")}</p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 mb-4 sticky z-10" style={{ top: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 0.5rem)" }}>
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("friends")}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${tab === "friends" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500"}`}
          >
            {t("friends.tabFriends")} · {data.friends.length}
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setTab("requests")}
            className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${tab === "requests" ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500"}`}
          >
            {t("friends.tabRequests")}
            {incomingCount > 0 && <span className="min-w-5 h-5 px-1 rounded-full bg-rose-500 text-white text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center font-black">{incomingCount}</span>}
          </button>
        </div>

        {tab === "friends" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Add friend */}
            <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5"><UserPlus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-500" /> {t("friends.addFriend")}</p>
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input
                  value={query}
                  onChange={(e) => { setQuery(e.target.value); setPreview(null); setSearchErr(null); }}
                  onKeyDown={(e) => e.key === "Enter" && doSearch()}
                  placeholder={t("friends.usernamePlaceholder")}
                  maxLength={20}
                  className="flex-1 px-3 py-2.5 rounded-xl border-2 border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-400 outline-none text-sm font-bold text-slate-800"
                />
                <button
                  onClick={doSearch}
                  disabled={!query.trim() || searching}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold hover:bg-slate-700 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                >
                  {searching ? "…" : <><Search className="w-4 h-4" /> {t("friends.search")}</>}
                </button>
              </div>
              {searchErr && <p className="text-xs font-bold text-rose-500 mt-2 animate-pop-in">{searchErr}</p>}
              {preview && (
                <div className="mt-3 p-3 rounded-xl bg-slate-50 border-2 border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3 animate-pop-in">
                  <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-blue-600">
                    {preview.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 truncate">{preview.name}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><LeagueBadge trophies={preview.trophies} size="sm" showLabel /></div>
                  </div>
                  <button
                    onClick={sendRequest}
                    disabled={busy === preview.id}
                    className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-600 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                  >
                    {busy === preview.id ? "…" : t("friends.add")}
                  </button>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Friends list */}
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("friends.yourFriends")}</p>
              {data.friends.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 text-center">
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{t("friends.noFriends")}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {data.friends
                    .slice()
                    .sort((a, b) => (b.trophies || 0) - (a.trophies || 0))
                    .map((f) => {
                      const myInvite = data.myInvites?.find((inv) => inv.to_user_id === f.id && inv.status === "pending");
                      const isWaiting = !!myInvite;
                      const ageMs = myInvite ? Date.now() - new Date(myInvite.created_date).getTime() : 0;
                      const inviteExpired = isWaiting && ageMs > INVITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
                      return (
                        <div key={f.id} className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-blue-600 shrink-0">
                            {f.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 truncate">{f.name}</p>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><LeagueBadge trophies={f.trophies || 0} size="sm" showLabel /></div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {isWaiting ? (
                              inviteExpired ? (
                                <button
                                  onClick={() => cancelInvite(myInvite.inviteId)}
                                  disabled={busy === f.id}
                                  className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 text-xs font-bold hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1"
                                >
                                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t("friends.cancel")}
                                </button>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 text-amber-600 text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-pulse" /> {t("friends.waiting")}
                                </span>
                              )
                            ) : (
                              <button
                                onClick={() => challenge(f.id, f.name)}
                                disabled={busy === f.id}
                                className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:scale-105 transition-transform disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                              >
                                <Swords className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t("friends.play")}
                              </button>
                            )}
                            <button
                              onClick={() => setReportTarget({ id: f.id, name: f.name })}
                              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-500 transition-all"
                              title={t("report.reportButton")}
                            >
                              <Flag className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* Sent requests */}
            {data.outgoing.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("friends.sent")}</p>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {data.outgoing.map((r) => (
                    <div key={r.requestId} className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-slate-500">
                        {r.to_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                      <p className="flex-1 font-bold text-slate-700 truncate text-sm">{r.to_name}</p>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 mr-1">{t("friends.pending")}</span>
                      <button
                        onClick={() => cancelRequest(r.requestId)}
                        disabled={busy === r.requestId}
                        className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                      >
                        <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {tab === "requests" && (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            {/* Game invites */}
            {data.invites.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("friends.gameInvites")}</p>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {data.invites.map((inv) => {
                    const ageMs = Date.now() - new Date(inv.created_date).getTime();
                    const expired = ageMs > INVITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
                    return (
                      <div key={inv.inviteId} className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 border-2 border-amber-300 flex items-center gap-3 animate-pop-in">
                        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-amber-200 flex items-center justify-center">
                          <Swords className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-700" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <p className="font-bold text-amber-800 truncate text-sm">{inv.from_name}</p>
                          <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-600">{expired ? t("friends.expired") : t("friends.challengesYou")}</p>
                        </div>
                        {expired ? (
                          <button onClick={() => declineInvite(inv.inviteId)} className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-white text-amber-600 text-xs font-bold border-2 border-amber-200">
                            {t("friends.dismiss")}
                          </button>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                            <button
                              onClick={() => acceptInvite(inv.inviteId)}
                              disabled={busy === inv.inviteId}
                              className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-amber-600 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1"
                            >
                              {busy === inv.inviteId ? "…" : <><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t("friends.accept")}</>}
                            </button>
                            <button
                              onClick={() => declineInvite(inv.inviteId)}
                              disabled={busy === inv.inviteId}
                              className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-white text-amber-600 border-2 border-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-100 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                            >
                              <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Friend requests */}
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-bold mb-2">{t("friends.friendRequests")}</p>
              {data.incoming.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-6 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-slate-200 text-center">
                  <p className="text-sm text-slate-400">{t("friends.noRequests")}</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {data.incoming.map((r) => (
                    <div key={r.requestId} className="p-3 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3 animate-pop-in">
                      <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-blue-100 flex items-center justify-center font-black text-blue-600">
                        {r.from_name.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-800 truncate">{r.from_name}</p>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5"><LeagueBadge trophies={r.from_trophies || 0} size="sm" showLabel /></div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                        <button
                          onClick={() => acceptRequest(r.requestId)}
                          disabled={busy === r.requestId}
                          className="px-3 py-2 rounded-lg bg-blue-500 text-white text-xs font-bold hover:bg-blue-600 transition-all disabled:opacity-40 flex items-center gap-1"
                        >
                          {busy === r.requestId ? "…" : <><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> {t("friends.accept")}</>}
                        </button>
                        <button
                          onClick={() => declineRequest(r.requestId)}
                          disabled={busy === r.requestId}
                          className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-slate-100 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-200 transition-all disabled:opacity-40"
                        >
                          <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {toast && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-24 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-slate-900 text-white text-sm font-bold shadow-xl animate-pop-in">
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}

      {reportTarget && (
        <ReportUserDialog
          reportedId={reportTarget.id}
          reportedName={reportTarget.name}
          onClose={() => setReportTarget(null)}
          onSubmitted={() => { showToast(t("report.submitted")); load(); }}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/OAuthConsent.jsx
========================================
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { appParams } from "@/lib/app-params";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";

// App-side OAuth consent page for the app's MCP server. The platform redirects
// AI clients here (see base44/mcp/config.json `consent_path`) with an opaque
// `ctx` handle — the authorization request itself lives on the server. This page
// gates on the app-user session, fetches the display info for that handle, shows
// the categories of access being granted, and posts the approve/deny decision.
// Do not change the fetch calls, headers, or the `ctx` handle handling — styling
// and copy are safe to edit.
export default function OAuthConsent() {
  const ctx = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("ctx");
  const [info, setInfo] = useState(null);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [decided, setDecided] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [reconnect, setReconnect] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    (async () => {
      let redirecting = false;
      try {
        if (!ctx) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        // Resolve the handle first: a dead handle must never render
        // approve/deny, and the response carries the app's configured login
        // route for the signed-out redirect below. Send the session (cookie +
        // bearer token) so the server can list the granted tools for a
        // signed-in user — the same auth the approve/deny call sends; without
        // it the display request is anonymous and shows no tools.
        const infoHeaders = {};
        if (appParams.token) infoHeaders.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
        const res = await fetch(
          `/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/consent-info?handle=${encodeURIComponent(ctx)}`,
          { credentials: "include", headers: infoHeaders },
        );
        if (!res.ok) {
          setError("This authorization link is invalid or has expired.");
          return;
        }
        const data = await res.json();
        // Gate on the server's auth result, NOT base44.auth.isAuthenticated():
        // the SDK check runs the bearer path, so a cookie-only session (platform
        // login/SSO, or a private app with a stale localStorage token) would read
        // as signed-out and redirect — even though /consent-info just
        // authenticated this same request via its cookie fallback. data.authenticated
        // keeps the redirect decision in agreement with what the server returned.
        if (!data.authenticated) {
          // The short handle rides back in returnTo; login_path is
          // owner-configured and validated server-side as a same-origin path.
          // Send from_url too: a custom-auth app coerced to platform auth (e.g.
          // public_without_login under workspace SSO) serves the platform login,
          // which honors from_url rather than returnTo. Rebuild the query from
          // `ctx` alone — never forward window.location.search raw: the platform
          // resume returns from_url verbatim, so crafted extras on the consent
          // link (app_base_url, access_token, …) would ride through the login
          // round-trip and app-params.js would persist them into the freshly
          // authenticated session.
          const returnTo =
            window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          redirecting = true; // keep the spinner while the browser navigates
          window.location.href =
            (data.login_path || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        setInfo(data);
      } catch (e) {
        setError("Could not load this authorization request. Please try again.");
      } finally {
        if (!redirecting) setChecking(false);
      }
    })();
  }, [ctx]);

  const respond = async (action) => {
    setSubmitting(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const headers = { "Content-Type": "application/json" };
      // Cookie-backed sessions carry no token; sending "Bearer null" would
      // shadow the valid cookie, so add the header only when a token exists.
      if (appParams.token) headers.Authorization = "Bearer " + appParams.token;
      const res = await fetch(`/api/apps/${appParams.appId}/mcp/authorize-grant`, {
        method: "POST",
        credentials: "include",
        headers,
        body: JSON.stringify({ ctx, action }),
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        // 401 = the session expired before the (single-use, still-unconsumed)
        // handle was spent; retrying the same controls re-sends the dead session
        // forever. Send the user back through login preserving `ctx` — the same
        // redirect the initial signed-out path uses — so they can return and
        // approve the still-valid handle.
        if (res.status === 401) {
          const returnTo = window.location.pathname + "?ctx=" + encodeURIComponent(ctx);
          const encoded = encodeURIComponent(returnTo);
          window.location.href =
            ((info && info.login_path) || "/login") + "?returnTo=" + encoded + "&from_url=" + encoded;
          return;
        }
        // These all come AFTER the single-use handle is atomically consumed
        // (409 tool set changed; 403 host/resource/app mismatch; 404 access
        // gone; 400 malformed/handle already used), so retrying can only 404.
        // Show a terminal reconnect state, not an impossible "try again".
        if ([400, 403, 404, 409].includes(res.status)) {
          let detail = "";
          try { detail = (await res.json()).detail; } catch (_) { /* keep default */ }
          setReconnect(detail || "This authorization can no longer be completed. Reconnect from your AI client to try again.");
          setSubmitting(false);
          return;
        }
        throw new Error("Could not complete authorization. Please try again.");
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      window.location.href = data.redirect_url;
      if (!/^https?:/i.test(data.redirect_url)) {
        // Custom-scheme redirect (native AI clients, e.g. cursor://): browsers
        // may block or not visibly navigate, so show a terminal state instead
        // of an eternal spinner.
        setDecided(action);
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      setError(e.message);
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (checking) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center py-6 text-muted-foreground">
          <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 mr-2 animate-spin" aria-hidden="true" />
          Loading…
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const client = (info && info.client_name) || "An AI client";
  const appName = (info && info.app_name) || "this app";

  if (decided) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={ShieldCheck}
        title={decided === "approve" ? "Access granted" : "Access denied"}
        subtitle={`You can return to ${client} and close this window.`}
      />
    );
  }

  // Terminal: the authorization request is no longer valid (tool set changed +
  // handle consumed). Retrying can't succeed, so show reconnect guidance with
  // no approve/deny controls.
  if (reconnect) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Reconnect required">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {reconnect}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  // No consent details means nothing trustworthy to approve: a failed
  // consent-info load (expired handle, rate limit, transient error) renders
  // the error alone, never the approve/deny controls.
  if (error && !info) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout icon={ShieldCheck} title="Authorize access">
        <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  const tools = Array.isArray(info.tools) ? info.tools : [];

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={ShieldCheck}
      title="Authorize access"
      subtitle={`${client} wants to access ${appName} on your behalf`}
    >
      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground mb-2">
        {tools.length ? `It will be able to use these tools in ${appName}:` : "No tools requested"}
      </p>
      {tools.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm mb-6">
          {tools.map((tool) => (
            <li key={tool.name} className="flex flex-col">
              <span className="text-foreground font-medium">
                {tool.title || tool.name}
              </span>
              {tool.description && (
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{tool.description}</span>
              )}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}

      <div className="flex gap-3">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("deny")}
        >
          Deny
        </Button>
        <Button
          className="flex-1 h-12 font-medium"
          disabled={submitting}
          onClick={() => respond("approve")}
        >
          {submitting ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" /> : null}
          Approve
        </Button>
      </div>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Landing.jsx
========================================
import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Download, Smartphone, Swords, Layers, Trophy, Star } from "lucide-react";

// A cute orb character with a face, facing off across the central wall.
function OrbCharacter({ light, dark, glow, delay = 0, mirror = false }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`absolute bottom-3 w-20 h-20 rounded-full animate-float-bob ${mirror ? "scale-x-[-1]" : ""}`}
      style={{
        left: mirror ? undefined : 0,
        right: mirror ? 0 : undefined,
        background: `radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, ${light}, ${dark})`,
        boxShadow: `0 14px 30px ${glow}`,
        animationDelay: `${delay}s`,
      }}
    >
      {/* shine */}
      <div className="absolute top-2 left-3 w-5 h-3 rounded-full bg-white/45 blur-[2px]" />
      {/* face */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center pt-3">
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-white flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-800" />
          </div>
          <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-white flex items-center justify-center">
            <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-slate-800" />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="w-6 h-3 mt-1 rounded-b-full border-b-[3px] border-slate-800/70" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SpeechBubble({ children, side }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={`absolute top-0 ${side === "left" ? "left-2" : "right-2"} px-3 py-1.5 rounded-2xl bg-white text-slate-800 text-[11px] font-black shadow-lg animate-pop-in`}
    >
      {children}
      <div
        className={`absolute top-3 ${side === "left" ? "left-[-5px]" : "right-[-5px]"} w-3 h-3 bg-white rotate-45`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function Feature({ icon: Icon, text }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/20">
      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
        <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
      </div>
      <span className="text-sm font-bold text-white">{text}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Landing() {
  const [deferredPrompt, setDeferredPrompt] = useState(null);
  const [isIOS, setIsIOS] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Detect iOS (no beforeinstallprompt support)
    const ua = navigator.userAgent || navigator.vendor || window.opera;
    const ios = /iPad|iPhone|iPod/.test(ua) && !window.MSStream;
    setIsIOS(ios);

    // Capture the PWA install prompt event
    const handler = (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      setDeferredPrompt(e);
    };
    window.addEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('beforeinstallprompt', handler);
  }, []);

  const handleInstall = async () => {
    if (deferredPrompt) {
      deferredPrompt.prompt();
      await deferredPrompt.userChoice;
      setDeferredPrompt(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen relative overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden bg-gradient-to-b from-indigo-600 via-purple-600 to-rose-500 flex flex-col items-center px-6 py-10 landscape:py-6 text-white">
      {/* Floating decorative shapes */}
      <div className="absolute top-10 left-4 w-10 h-10 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 rotate-12 animate-float-bob" style={{ animationDelay: "0.2s" }} />
      <div className="absolute top-28 right-6 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-amber-300/40 animate-float-bob" style={{ animationDelay: "0.5s" }} />
      <div className="absolute bottom-36 left-8 w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-cyan-300/30 animate-float-bob" style={{ animationDelay: "0.8s" }} />
      <div className="absolute bottom-48 right-10 w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-white/10 -rotate-12 animate-float-bob" style={{ animationDelay: "1.1s" }} />

      {/* Orb duel scene */}
      <div className="relative w-full max-w-xs h-52 landscape:h-36 mb-5 landscape:mb-3">
        {/* central wall */}
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-4 w-4 h-28 rounded-full bg-slate-800/80 shadow-xl" />
        <div className="absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bottom-2 w-10 h-3 rounded-full bg-slate-900/40 blur-sm" />
        <OrbCharacter light="#60a5fa" dark="#2563eb" glow="rgba(37,99,235,0.5)" delay={0} />
        <OrbCharacter light="#fb7185" dark="#e11d48" glow="rgba(225,29,72,0.5)" delay={0.3} mirror />
        <SpeechBubble side="left">Your towers are toast! 🔥</SpeechBubble>
        <SpeechBubble side="right">Bring it on! ⚔️</SpeechBubble>
      </div>

      {/* Title */}
      <h1 className="text-5xl landscape:text-4xl font-black tracking-tighter text-center drop-shadow-lg mb-2 landscape:mb-1">
        <span className="text-amber-300">SPLITTER</span>{" "}
        <span className="text-white">ORBS</span>
      </h1>
      <p className="text-white/90 text-sm text-center max-w-xs leading-relaxed mb-5 landscape:mb-3">
        Split-screen 1v1 tower defense. Blast orbs, build towers, unleash powers, and climb the leagues.
      </p>

      {/* Feature bullets */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs space-y-2.5 mb-5 landscape:mb-3 landscape:space-y-1.5">
        <Feature icon={Swords} text="1v1 split-screen duel" />
        <Feature icon={Layers} text="Unlock & upgrade cards" />
        <Feature icon={Trophy} text="Climb the ranks" />
      </div>

      {/* Social proof */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 mb-5 landscape:mb-3">
        {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((i) => (
          <Star key={i} className="w-4 h-4 fill-amber-300 text-amber-300" />
        ))}
        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-white/80 ml-1.5">Early access now live</span>
      </div>

      {/* Install CTA — logic preserved exactly, only styling adapted */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-xs flex flex-col items-center gap-3 landscape:gap-2">
        {deferredPrompt ? (
          <button
            onClick={handleInstall}
            className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-white text-indigo-600 text-lg font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-2xl hover:scale-[1.02] transition-transform"
          >
            <Download className="w-5 h-5" />
            INSTALL APP
          </button>
        ) : isIOS ? (
          <div className="w-full text-center bg-white/15 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-white/20">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-white font-bold mb-2">
              <Smartphone className="w-5 h-5" />
              <span>Add to Home Screen</span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-white/80 leading-relaxed">
              Tap the Share button <span className="font-bold">⬆️</span> in Safari,
              then <span className="font-bold">"Add to Home Screen"</span> to install.
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button
            disabled
            className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/30 text-white/70 text-lg font-black flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
          >
            <Download className="w-5 h-5" />
            INSTALL APP
          </button>
        )}

        <p className="text-white/60 text-[10px] text-center mt-1">
          Requires installation — not playable in browser.
        </p>

        <div className="flex gap-3 mt-1">
          <a href="/privacy" className="text-white/70 text-[11px] underline hover:text-white transition-colors">
            Privacy Policy
          </a>
          <a href="/impressum" className="text-white/70 text-[11px] underline hover:text-white transition-colors">
            Impressum
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { UserPlus, Mail, Lock, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { InputOTP, InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot } from "@/components/ui/input-otp";
import AuthLayout from "@/components/AuthLayout";
import GoogleIcon from "@/components/GoogleIcon";
import { toast } from "@/components/ui/use-toast";
import { safeReturnTo } from "@/lib/authReturnTo";
import { isNativeWebView } from "@/lib/isNativeWebView";

export default function Register() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [showOtp, setShowOtp] = useState(false);
  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState("");
  const inWebView = isNativeWebView();

  const handleSubmit = async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      setError("Passwords do not match");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await base44.auth.register({ email, password });
      setShowOtp(true);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Registration failed");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleVerify = async () => {
    setError("");
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const result = await base44.auth.verifyOtp({ email, otpCode });
      if (result?.access_token) {
        base44.auth.setToken(result.access_token);
      }
      window.location.href = safeReturnTo();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Invalid verification code");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleResend = async () => {
    setError("");
    try {
      await base44.auth.resendOtp(email);
      toast({
        title: "Code sent",
        description: "Check your email for the new code.",
      });
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message || "Failed to resend code");
    }
  };

  const handleGoogle = () => {
    base44.auth.loginWithProvider("google", safeReturnTo());
  };

  if (showOtp) {
    return (
      <AuthLayout
        icon={Mail}
        title="Verify your email"
        subtitle={`We sent a code to ${email}`}
      >
        {error && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
          <InputOTP
            maxLength={6}
            value={otpCode}
            onChange={setOtpCode}
            autoFocus
            autoComplete="one-time-code"
          >
            <InputOTPGroup>
              <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
              <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
            </InputOTPGroup>
          </InputOTP>
        </div>
        <Button
          className="w-full h-12 font-medium"
          onClick={handleVerify}
          disabled={loading || otpCode.length < 6}
        >
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Verifying...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Verify"
          )}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-4">
          Didn't receive the code?{" "}
          <button onClick={handleResend} className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline">
            Resend
          </button>
        </p>
      </AuthLayout>
    );
  }

  return (
    <AuthLayout
      icon={UserPlus}
      title="Create your account"
      subtitle="Sign up to get started"
      footer={
        <>
          Already have an account?{" "}
          <Link
            to={"/login" + (safeReturnTo() !== "/" ? "?returnTo=" + encodeURIComponent(safeReturnTo()) : "")}
            className="text-primary font-medium hover:underline"
          >
            Log in
          </Link>
        </>
      }
    >
      {!inWebView && (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="w-full h-12 text-sm font-medium mb-6"
            onClick={handleGoogle}
          >
            <GoogleIcon className="w-5 h-5 mr-2" />
            Continue with Google
          </Button>

          <div className="relative mb-6">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center">
              <div className="w-full border-t border-border" />
            </div>
            <div className="relative flex justify-center text-xs uppercase">
              <span className="bg-card px-3 text-muted-foreground">or</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {error && (
        <div className="mb-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-sm">
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="email">Email</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Mail className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="email"
              type="email"
              autoComplete="email"
              autoFocus
              placeholder="you@example.com"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="password">Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="password"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="confirm">Confirm Password</Label>
          <div className="relative">
            <Lock className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden="true" />
            <Input
              id="confirm"
              type="password"
              autoComplete="new-password"
              placeholder="••••••••"
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-10 h-12"
              required
            />
          </div>
        </div>
        <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 font-medium" disabled={loading}>
          {loading ? (
            <>
              <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
              Creating account...
            </>
          ) : (
            "Create account"
          )}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </AuthLayout>
  );
}

FILE: src/pages/Collection.jsx

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { base44 } from "@/api/base44Client";
import { TOWER_TYPES, ABILITIES, ORB_TYPES, SENDABLE_ORBS, ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS, MAX_CARD_LEVEL, getOrbStats } from "@/game/constants";
import { normalizeProfile, getCardInfo } from "@/game/progression";
import { SKIN_CATEGORIES, RARITIES, isSkinOwned } from "@/game/skins";
import { useTranslation } from "@/i18n/LanguageContext";
import TowerIcon from "@/components/game/TowerIcon";
import ShardIcon from "@/components/ShardIcon";
import CopyIcon from "@/components/CopyIcon";
import SkinPreview from "@/components/SkinPreview";
import EmblemsTowersSection from "@/components/EmblemsTowersSection";
import HandUpgradeCard from "@/components/HandUpgradeCard";
import SideTowerUpgradeCard from "@/components/SideTowerUpgradeCard";
import GemIcon from "@/components/GemIcon";
import { sfx } from "@/game/sound";
import { optimisticAction } from "@/lib/optimisticAction";
import CountUp from "@/components/CountUp";
import { ConfettiBurst, StarBurst, FloatingText } from "@/components/CardEffects";
import { getNewCardIds, markCardsSeen } from "@/lib/seenCards";
import { bucketCards, sortSkins } from "@/lib/collectionSort";

const ABILITY_ICONS = { zap: "⚡", portal: "🌀", repair: "➕", freeze: "❄️", rage: "🔥", shield: "🛡️", burner: "🌋", meteor: "☄️", glue: "🟢", overclock: "⚙️", speed_zone: "💨", damage_zone: "💢", frost_zone: "🌨️", deep_freeze: "🧊" };

const SECTIONS = [
  { key: "starter", label: "sectionStarter" },
  { key: "trophy", label: "sectionTrophy" },
  { key: "crate", label: "sectionCrate" },
  { key: "locked", label: "sectionLocked" },
];

export default function Collection() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [me, setMe] = useState(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(null);
  // Synchronous lock so rapid double-taps can't bypass the async busy state
  // and fire two upgrades before the first write lands (avoids 409 races).
  const upgradeLock = useRef(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState(() => {
    const q = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get("tab");
    return ["towers", "orbs", "powers", "skins", "upgrades"].includes(q) ? q : "towers";
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    base44.auth.me().then((m) => setMe(normalizeProfile(m))).catch(() => setMe(normalizeProfile({})));
  }, []);

  const [newCardIds, setNewCardIds] = useState(new Set());
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!me?.id) return;
    const userId = me.id;
    let cardIds = [];
    if (tab === "towers") cardIds = Object.values(TOWER_TYPES).filter((d) => !getCardInfo(me, "tower", d.id).locked).map((d) => d.id);
    else if (tab === "orbs") cardIds = SENDABLE_ORBS.filter((id) => !getCardInfo(me, "orb", id).locked);
    else if (tab === "powers") cardIds = Object.values(ABILITIES).filter((d) => !getCardInfo(me, "ability", d.id).locked).map((d) => d.id);
    if (cardIds.length === 0) return;
    const newIds = getNewCardIds(userId, cardIds);
    setNewCardIds(new Set(newIds));
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      markCardsSeen(userId, cardIds);
      setNewCardIds(new Set());
    }, 2500);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [tab, me?.id]);

  const handleLevelUp = async (kind, id) => {
    if (!me || upgradeLock.current) return;
    upgradeLock.current = true;
    const cardField = kind === "tower" ? "tower_cards" : kind === "ability" ? "ability_cards" : "orb_cards";
    const cardInfo = getCardInfo(me, kind, id);
    setBusy(id);
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: {
        [cardField]: {
          ...me[cardField],
          [id]: { ...me[cardField][id], level: (me[cardField][id]?.level || 1) + 1, copies: Math.max(0, (cardInfo?.copies || 0) - (cardInfo?.needed || 1)) },
        },
      },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("levelUpCard", { kind, id }),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, [cardField]: data[cardField] }),
      t,
    });
    setBusy(null);
    upgradeLock.current = false;
  };

  const handleBuyCopy = async (kind, id) => {
    if (!me || upgradeLock.current) return;
    upgradeLock.current = true;
    const cardField = kind === "tower" ? "tower_cards" : kind === "ability" ? "ability_cards" : "orb_cards";
    const cardInfo = getCardInfo(me, kind, id);
    setBusy(id);
    const result = await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: {
        shards: Math.max(0, shards - (cardInfo?.copyShardCost || 0)),
        [cardField]: {
          ...me[cardField],
          [id]: { ...me[cardField][id], copies: (me[cardField][id]?.copies || 0) + 1, boughtCopies: (me[cardField][id]?.boughtCopies || 0) + 1 },
        },
      },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("buyCardCopy", { kind, id }),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, shards: data.shards, [cardField]: data[cardField] }),
      t,
    });
    if (result) sfx.coin();
    setBusy(null);
    upgradeLock.current = false;
  };

  const equipSkin = async (category, skinId) => {
    if (!me) return;
    const field = SKIN_CATEGORIES[category].equippedField;
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { [field]: skinId },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("equipSkin", { field, id: skinId }),
      onSuccess: (prev, d) => ({ ...prev, [field]: d[field] || skinId }),
      t,
    });
  };

  // Equip an arbitrary field (used by the emblem / side-tower slots which each
  // have their own equipped_* field rather than a single per-category field).
  const equipField = async (field, id) => {
    if (!me) return;
    await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { [field]: id },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("equipSkin", { field, id }),
      onSuccess: (prev, d) => ({ ...prev, [field]: d[field] || id }),
      t,
    });
  };

  const buySkin = async (category, skin) => {
    if (!me || skin.source !== "shop") return;
    if (isSkinOwned(me, category, skin.id)) return;
    if ((me.gems || 0) < skin.price) return;
    const result = await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { gems: (me.gems || 0) - skin.price, owned_skins: [...(me.owned_skins || []), skin.id] },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("buySkin", { category, skinId: skin.id }),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, gems: data.gems, owned_skins: data.owned_skins }),
      t,
    });
    if (result) sfx.coin();
  };

  const upgradeHand = async () => {
    if (!me) return;
    const result = await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { shards: Math.max(0, (me.shards || 0) - 100), hand_level: (me.hand_level || 0) + 1 },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("upgradeHand", {}),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, shards: data.shards, hand_level: data.hand_level }),
      t,
    });
    if (result) sfx.coin();
  };

  const upgradeSideTower = async () => {
    if (!me) return;
    const result = await optimisticAction({
      currentState: me, setState: setMe,
      optimisticPatch: { shards: Math.max(0, (me.shards || 0) - 34), side_tower_level: (me.side_tower_level || 0) + 1 },
      apiCall: () => base44.functions.invoke("upgradeSideTower", {}),
      onSuccess: (prev, data) => ({ ...prev, shards: data.shards, side_tower_level: data.side_tower_level }),
      t,
    });
    if (result) sfx.coin();
  };

  const shards = me?.shards || 0;

  const renderSections = (kind, defs) => {
    const buckets = bucketCards(kind, defs, me);
    let idx = 0;
    return SECTIONS.map((sec) => {
      const list = buckets[sec.key];
      if (!list.length) return null;
      return (
        <div key={sec.key} className="mb-5">
          <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">{t(`collection.${sec.label}`)}</h2>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            {list.map((def) => {
              const i = idx++;
              return (
                <CardView key={def.id} def={def} kind={kind} info={me ? getCardInfo(me, kind, def.id) : null} busy={busy === def.id} onLevelUp={() => handleLevelUp(kind, def.id)} onBuyCopy={() => handleBuyCopy(kind, def.id)} t={t} index={i} isNew={newCardIds.has(def.id)} />
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    });
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: "towers", label: t("collection.towers") },
    { id: "orbs", label: t("collection.orbs") },
    { id: "powers", label: t("collection.powers") },
    { id: "skins", label: t("collection.skins") },
    { id: "upgrades", label: t("collection.upgrades") },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 px-4 pb-24" style={{ paddingTop: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 2.5rem)" }}>
      <div className="max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">{t("collection.title")}</h1>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-lime-50 border border-lime-200 text-lime-600 font-bold text-sm">
            <ShardIcon size={14} /> <CountUp value={shards} />
          </div>
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-400 mb-4 text-center">{t("collection.hint")}</p>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="flex gap-1 p-1 rounded-2xl bg-white border-2 border-slate-200 mb-5 sticky z-10" style={{ top: "calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + 0.5rem)" }}>
          {tabs.map((tb) => (
            <button
              key={tb.id}
              onClick={() => setTab(tb.id)}
              className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                tab === tb.id ? "bg-slate-900 text-white" : "text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
              }`}
            >
              {tb.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        {tab === "skins" ? (
          <SkinsTab me={me} onEquip={equipSkin} onEquipField={equipField} onBuy={buySkin} t={t} />
        ) : (
          <>
            {tab === "towers" && <>{renderSections("tower", Object.values(TOWER_TYPES))}</>}
            {tab === "orbs" && <>{renderSections("orb", SENDABLE_ORBS.map((id) => ORB_TYPES[id]).filter(Boolean))}</>}
            {tab === "powers" && <>{renderSections("ability", Object.values(ABILITIES))}</>}
            {tab === "upgrades" && (
              <div className="space-y-3">
                <HandUpgradeCard level={me?.hand_level || 0} shards={shards} onUpgrade={upgradeHand} />
                <SideTowerUpgradeCard level={me?.side_tower_level || 0} shards={shards} onUpgrade={upgradeSideTower} />
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function SkinsTab({ me, onEquip, onEquipField, onBuy, t }) {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <EmblemsTowersSection me={me} onEquip={onEquipField} onBuy={onBuy} t={t} />
      {Object.values(SKIN_CATEGORIES).filter((cat) => !cat.hidden).sort((a, b) => (a.id === "orb" ? 1 : b.id === "orb" ? -1 : 0)).map((cat) => {
        const equippedField = cat.equippedField;
        const equippedId = me?.[equippedField] || "default";
        const skins = Object.values(cat.catalog);
        const sorted = sortSkins(skins);
        return (
          <div key={cat.id}>
            <h2 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-700 mb-2">{t(`shop.cat_${cat.id}`)}</h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              {sorted.map((skin) => {
                const owned = isSkinOwned(me, cat.id, skin.id);
                const equipped = equippedId === skin.id;
                const rarityColor = RARITIES[skin.rarity].color;
                return (
                  <div
                    key={skin.id}
                    className={`relative p-2 rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white flex flex-col items-center transition-all ${equipped ? "border-slate-900 shadow-md scale-[1.02]" : "border-slate-200"}`}
                  >
                    {equipped && <span className="absolute -top-2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-slate-900 text-white text-[8px] font-black">{t("collection.equipped")}</span>}
                    <div className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-2 h-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: rarityColor }} />
                    <SkinPreview category={cat.id} skinId={skin.id} size={52} />
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-700 text-center leading-tight mt-1">{skin.name}</span>
                    {owned ? (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onEquip(cat.id, skin.id)}
                        disabled={equipped}
                        className={`mt-1 w-full py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all ${
                          equipped ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-slate-900 text-white hover:scale-105"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {equipped ? t("collection.equipped") : t("collection.equip")}
                      </button>
                    ) : skin.source === "chest" ? (
                      <span className="mt-1 text-[9px] font-bold text-violet-500 text-center leading-tight">{t("shop.chestOnly")}</span>
                    ) : (
                      <button
                        onClick={() => onBuy(cat.id, skin)}
                        disabled={(me?.gems || 0) < skin.price}
                        className={`mt-1 w-full py-1 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold transition-all inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-0.5 ${
                          (me?.gems || 0) < skin.price ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 cursor-not-allowed" : "bg-cyan-500 text-white hover:scale-105"
                        }`}
                      >
                        {skin.price === 0 ? t("shop.free") : <><GemIcon size={10} /> {skin.price}</>}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

function CardView({ def, kind, info, busy, onLevelUp, onBuyCopy, t, index = 0, isNew = false }) {
  const [flipped, setFlipped] = useState(false);
  const [effects, setEffects] = useState(null);
  const [coinBounce, setCoinBounce] = useState(false);
  if (!info) return <div className="p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-200 bg-white h-32 animate-pulse" />;

  const isTower = kind === "tower";
  const isOrb = kind === "orb";
  const canFlip = isTower || isOrb;
  const locked = info.locked;
  const maxed = info.maxed;
  const level = info.level;
  const descText = isTower ? t(`towers.${def.id}.desc`) : t(`orbs.${def.id}.desc`);
  const nameText = isTower ? t(`towers.${def.id}.name`) : t(`orbs.${def.id}.name`);
  const rarity = RARITIES[info.rarity];
  const rarityColor = rarity?.color || "#94a3b8";
  const rarityOrder = rarity?.order || 0;
  const dealInStyle = { animationDelay: `${index * 40}ms`, willChange: "transform" };

  const handleLevelUpClick = () => {
    if (busy) return;
    setEffects("levelup");
    sfx.levelUp();
    onLevelUp();
    setTimeout(() => setEffects(null), 1000);
  };

  const handleBuyClick = () => {
    if (busy) return;
    if (!info.canBuyCopy) {
      setEffects("broke");
      setTimeout(() => setEffects(null), 500);
      return;
    }
    setCoinBounce(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCoinBounce(false), 300);
    onBuyCopy();
  };

  const InfoButton = ({ onClick, label }) => (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); }}
      className="absolute top-2 right-2 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-200 hover:text-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center text-[11px] font-black transition-colors z-10"
      aria-label={label}
    >
      i
    </button>
  );

  const frontFace = (
    <div className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white [backface-visibility:hidden] flex flex-col ${isOrb ? "h-[216px]" : "h-[200px]"} ${locked ? "border-slate-200 opacity-60" : maxed ? "border-amber-300" : effects === "broke" ? "border-red-500 animate-card-shake" : "border-slate-200"}`}>
      {canFlip && <InfoButton onClick={() => setFlipped(true)} label="Show description" />}
      {isNew && !locked && (
        <span className="absolute top-2 left-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-red-500 text-white text-[8px] font-black z-20 animate-new-badge-pulse">NEW</span>
      )}
      <div className="relative flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
        {isTower ? (
          <TowerIcon type={def.id} size={38} level={level} />
        ) : isOrb ? (
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-black text-white" style={{ background: def.color, boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${def.color}88` }}>{def.hp}</div>
        ) : (
          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-lg" style={{ background: def.color + "22", boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${def.color}88` }}>{ABILITY_ICONS[def.id] || "✨"}</div>
        )}
        <div className="flex-1">
          <h3 className="font-bold leading-tight text-slate-800">{kind === "tower" ? t(`towers.${def.id}.name`) : kind === "orb" ? t(`orbs.${def.id}.name`) : t(`abilities.${def.id}.name`)}</h3>
          <span className="inline-block px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[8px] font-black mt-0.5" style={{ background: rarityColor + "22", color: rarityColor }}>{t(`rarities.${info.rarity}`)}</span>
          <div className="flex gap-1 mt-0.5">
            {Array.from({ length: MAX_CARD_LEVEL }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((l) => (
              <span key={l} className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${l <= level ? "bg-amber-400" : "bg-slate-200"}`} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-end">
      {locked ? (
        <div className="relative text-center text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 py-3">
          {isOrb && ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] ? t("collection.trophyLock", { n: ORB_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] }) : isTower && TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] ? t("collection.trophyLock", { n: TOWER_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] }) : kind === "ability" && ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] ? t("collection.trophyLock", { n: ABILITY_TROPHY_UNLOCKS[def.id] }) : t("collection.crateLock")}
        </div>
      ) : maxed ? (
        <>
          {isOrb && (<div className="relative text-[10px] text-slate-400 text-center mb-1">HP {getOrbStats(def.id, level).hp} · SPD {getOrbStats(def.id, level).speed} · DMG {getOrbStats(def.id, level).damage}</div>)}
          <div className="relative text-center text-xs font-bold text-amber-500 py-2">{t("collection.maxLevel")}</div>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          {isOrb && (
            <div className="relative text-[10px] text-slate-500 text-center mb-1.5">HP {getOrbStats(def.id, level).hp}→<span className="text-emerald-500 font-bold">{getOrbStats(def.id, level + 1).hp}</span> · SPD {getOrbStats(def.id, level).speed}→<span className="text-emerald-500 font-bold">{getOrbStats(def.id, level + 1).speed}</span> · DMG {getOrbStats(def.id, level).damage}→<span className="text-emerald-500 font-bold">{getOrbStats(def.id, level + 1).damage}</span></div>
          )}
          <div className="relative mb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[10px] text-slate-400 mb-0.5">
              <span>{t("collection.copies")}</span>
              <span>{info.copies}/{info.needed}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full bg-slate-100 overflow-hidden">
              <div className={`h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${info.copies >= info.needed ? "bg-emerald-500 shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(16,185,129,0.6)]" : "bg-slate-400"}`} style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (info.copies / info.needed) * 100)}%` }} />
            </div>
            {info.buyableCopies > 0 && (<p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 text-right mt-0.5">{t("collection.copiesBought", { bought: info.boughtCopies, buyable: info.buyableCopies })}</p>)}
          </div>
          {info.copies >= info.needed ? (
            <button onClick={handleLevelUpClick} disabled={busy} className="relative w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all animate-ready-pulse bg-emerald-500 text-white shadow-lg shadow-emerald-500/40">
              ⭐ {t("collection.levelUp")}
            </button>
          ) : info.boughtCopies < info.buyableCopies ? (
            <button onClick={handleBuyClick} disabled={busy} className={`relative w-full py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all ${coinBounce ? "animate-coin-bounce" : ""} ${info.canBuyCopy && !busy ? "bg-lime-500 text-white hover:scale-105 shadow-md shadow-lime-500/30" : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-400"}`}>
              {busy ? <span className="animate-pulse">…</span> : (<span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1">{t("collection.buyCopy")} <ShardIcon size={13} /> {info.copyShardCost}</span>)}
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="relative w-full py-2 rounded-xl bg-slate-100 text-slate-400 text-[11px] font-bold text-center">📦 {t("collection.collectMore")}</div>
          )}
        </>
      )}
      </div>

      {!locked && rarityOrder > 0 && (<div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-2xl pointer-events-none animate-rarity-aura" style={{ "--aura": rarityColor }} />)}
      {!locked && rarityOrder >= 2 && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl pointer-events-none">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 animate-shimmer-sweep" style={{ background: `linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, ${rarityColor}22 50%, transparent 70%)`, backgroundSize: "200% 200%" }} />
        </div>
      )}
      {effects === "levelup" && (
        <>
          <ConfettiBurst color={rarityColor} />
          <StarBurst />
          <FloatingText text={t("collection.levelUp").toUpperCase() + "!"} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );

  const backFace = (
    <div className={`absolute inset-0 p-4 rounded-2xl border-2 bg-white [backface-visibility:hidden] [transform:rotateY(180deg)] flex flex-col ${maxed ? "border-amber-300" : "border-slate-200"}`}>
      <InfoButton onClick={() => setFlipped(false)} label="Show card" />
      <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center h-full gap-2 pt-1">
        {isTower ? (<TowerIcon type={def.id} size={32} level={level} />) : (<div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-black text-white" style={{ background: def.color, boxShadow: `0 0 12px ${def.color}88` }}>{def.hp}</div>)}
        <h3 className="font-bold leading-tight text-slate-800 text-sm">{nameText}</h3>
        <p className="text-[11px] leading-snug text-slate-500">{descText}</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (!canFlip) {
    return (<div className="animate-card-deal-in" style={dealInStyle}>{frontFace}</div>);
  }

  return (
    <div className="[perspective:1000px] animate-card-deal-in" style={dealInStyle}>
      <div className={`relative transition-transform duration-500 [transform-style:preserve-3d] ${flipped ? "[transform:rotateY(180deg)]" : ""}`}>
        {frontFace}
        {backFace}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
